jobs.title: Principal Product Manager - Compute AI Infra
jobs.desc:
About the team
We are the product management team for the Compute service of the volcano engine, which is the cloud service provided by ByteDance. It includes all the different types of compute instances and the supporting services built around it, such as Autoscaling, Server Migration and Systems Manager. Both the business and the team are growing rapidly as we are building the next generation AI infrastructure and innovate on behalf of our customers. We are a team with diverse backgrounds and we strive to provide everyone in the team with great opportunities to learn and grow.

Responsibilities:
We are currently hiring product managers to build our next generation compute services to power large-scale AI infrastructure. The candidate will need to:
- Work closely with internal and external customers as well as sales and solution architects to collect customer needs and feedback.
- Work with the R&D team to clarify and prioritize product needs and design product features accordingly.
- Define product go to market strategy, including positioning, pricing, promotion as well as lifecycle management.
- Define product goals and core business metrics, and continuously track these metrics to improve our products.
- Manage and maintain product roadmaps and be able to articulate the value of each feature to customers.
- Perform competitive analysis, track industry technology trends to feed into the product planning.

Minimum Qualification:
- Technical background with more than 3 years of experience as a ToB product manager
- Deep understanding of the cloud industry
- Some level of understanding of virtualization, networking, storage, server hardware, containers, etc.
- Be able to prioritize and maximize the product value for our customers
- Be curious about new technologies and new industry trends in areas such as cloud infrastructure, deep learning, big data, and security

Preferred Qualification:
- Previous experiences with large CSPs(Cloud Service Providers) are preferred
- Excellent communication skills and be able to work closely with various stakeholders to achieve product goals
- Strong analytical skills and strong execution

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - AI Data and Safety
jobs.desc:
About the team
The AI Data and Safety team plays a critical role in advancing Seed foundational models across modalities and improving AI-native applications built on the Seed model series. We work across the data lifecycle, from defining evaluation approaches and translating user feedback and benchmark outcomes into data requests, to building scalable processes that improve data quality and support rapid model iteration.

Our team combines technical and operational capabilities, bringing together multidisciplinary talent across product management, data engineering, and data operations. Our work is driven by people who think deeply about model behavior, move quickly to solve complex problems, and bring first-hand experience as both builders and users of models and agents.

In close partnership with Seed researchers, industry experts, and leading data vendors, we tackle challenging data problems at the frontier of AI development, helping improve both model performance and user experience.

Responsibilities
- Collaborate with technical teams to precisely define the data requirements necessary for aligning Large Language Models (LLMs) across global markets.
- Develop methodologies for data acquisition and production, while also monitoring costs and assessing the effectiveness and efficiency of these processes. Ensure data quality is maintained at high standards and continually enhance processes based on both quantitative and qualitative feedback.
- Evaluate the impact of data production tools on the effectiveness and quality of data production. Work closely with technical teams to enhance both the quality and effectiveness of these tools.
- Proactively identify and mitigate potential biases and vulnerabilities in the data production process. This includes, but is not limited to, addressing human and system biases through the implementation of technical, product, and operational solutions.

Minimum Qualifications
- Solid understanding of alignment and related approaches, such as Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT), Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF), and others. Or solid experience in moderation, labeling, search quality, or data synthesis.
- Minimum of two years of experience as a product manager or product strategist, including process design experience.

Preferred Qualifications
- A strong interest in both LLMs and human behavior/experience/wellbeing.
- Collaborative team player who knows how to assertively advocate for their ideas without being overbearing.
- Skilled in maintaining attention to detail while staying focused on prioritized goals and the bigger picture.

jobs.title: Sr. Product Manager Professional, Servers
jobs.loc: Morrisville, North Carolina, United States of America
jobs.desc:
Job Description

The Server Product Manager owns the definition, delivery, and lifecycle performance of complex server products or product line elements. The role is accountable for making high‑quality product decisions, ensuring strong cross-functional execution, and maintaining product competitiveness throughout the lifecycle.

This role operates as the primary integrator across engineering, operations, sales, and marketing, translating requirements into clear direction, aligning stakeholders, and driving execution with consistency and predictability. The Product Manager applies deep domain expertise to improve decision outcomes, product quality, and business performance within their scope. You will be expected to own one or more server products as well as supporting sustaining activities on existing products.

Key Responsibilities

Product Definition and Decision Ownership

• Define product requirements, configurations, and positioning within assigned scope

• Develop clear, well-founded recommendations with explicit trade-offs across cost, performance, and timing

• Drive alignment on product decisions across stakeholders and ensure consistent understanding and execution

• Anticipate dependencies and downstream impacts to minimise rework and late-stage changes

Lifecycle Management and Execution

• Own the product lifecycle from concept through launch, in-market management, and transition

• Ensure product readiness across all dimensions, including supply, quality, pricing, and sales enablement

• Maintain predictable execution cadence, proactively addressing risks and resolving issues

• Support lifecycle transitions, replacements, and substitutions while ensuring continuity for customers and sales

Cross-Functional Leadership

• Lead coordination across engineering, supply chain, operations, sales, and marketing teams

• Align priorities, timelines, and deliverables across multiple stakeholders and regions

• Resolve conflicts and remove execution barriers to maintain progress and delivery quality

• Establish clear accountability and ownership across all aspects of product execution

Product Competitiveness and Performance

• Ensure products meet competitive benchmarks across performance, cost, feature set, and customer value

• Monitor product performance in market and drive improvements where required

• Support pricing, positioning, and configuration decisions in collaboration with commercial teams

• Identify opportunities to improve product offering or address competitive gaps

Data, Tools, and Operational Discipline

• Maintain accuracy and consistency of product data, configuration tools, and supporting collateral

• Ensure stakeholders have access to reliable, up-to-date information for decision-making and execution

• Establish and uphold standards that improve data quality and reduce operational errors

• Resolve inconsistencies across teams, regions, or systems to maintain a single source of truth

Customer and Market Engagement

• Develop strong understanding of customer requirements and usage scenarios across target segments

• Incorporate customer and partner feedback into product definition and ongoing improvements

• Engage with key stakeholders to validate product direction and support business development activities

Expertise and Continuous Improvement

• Act as a recognized subject-matter expert within assigned product scope

• Track relevant industry trends, technology developments, and partner roadmaps

• Apply expertise to improve product decisions, resolve complex issues, and guide stakeholders

• Share knowledge and contribute to the development of team capability and best practices

Technical & AI Fluency

• Comfortable working closely with engineering and technical teams without needing to specialize in implementation

• Curious and open to continuous learning across technologies, tools, and evolving product domains

• Interest in leveraging AI-assisted tools to improve effectiveness, insight

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager – AI Platforms and Hybrid Cloud
jobs.loc: Morrisville, North Carolina, United States of America
jobs.desc:
Role Overview

Lenovo is seeking an experienced Senior Technical Product Manager to shape the roadmap and drive delivery for our enterprise Hybrid Cloud Platform.

In this role, you will define the core capabilities that connect on-premises data centers with public clouds, giving enterprise customers a unified, reliable environment to run and manage their applications. You will focus on what to build and why—defining platform features across compute, storage, networking, and access control that make it easy for engineering teams and enterprise users to deploy workloads wherever they make the most sense.

You will treat both internal offering teams and external enterprise clients as your platform customers. Your mission is to listen to their needs, translate their technical challenges into clear product requirements, and partner with engineering squads who bring the technical architecture to life.

Key Responsibilities

1. Hybrid Cloud Strategy & Core Capabilities

• Define the product vision, roadmap, and release milestones for our hybrid cloud platform across private infrastructure and major public cloud providers.

• Specify core platform features across compute, storage, networking, and user authentication so teams can deploy and run applications seamlessly.

• Lead 0-to-1 MVP scoping for new platform releases, balancing customer-requested features against realistic delivery timelines.

2. Workload Management & Scaling

• Define requirements for workload placement, allowing customers to easily balance applications between their private environments and public cloud capacity.

• Ensure the platform provides reliable multi-tenant isolation, security policies, and health monitoring so customers trust it for production workloads.

3. Developer Experience & Customer Enablement

• Run regular discovery sessions with platform users (both internal teams and external customers) to understand integration friction and day-to-day pain points.

• Specify self-service platform tools, clear APIs, and developer documentation that make onboarding smooth and self-guided.

• Author clear Product Requirements Documents (PRDs) and user stories that outline business value and acceptance criteria for engineering teams.

4. Cloud Economics & Usage Tracking

• Define capabilities that give customers visibility into their resource usage and spending across hybrid environments.

• Specify quota controls, budget alerts, and reporting dashboards so organizations can monitor their cloud investments with confidence.

5. AI & Modern Workload Readiness

• Ensure the platform is ready to support modern workloads, including allocating GPU resources and supporting modern AI tools and data services as customer demand grows.

Required Qualifications

• 8+ Years of Product Management Experience: Must have a proven track record of owning and shipping software products from concept through launch in a dedicated Product Manager capacity.

• Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Business, or equivalent practical experience.

• Demonstrated Cloud Offering Ownership: Prior hands-on experience operating as a Product Manager for a commercial or enterprise cloud offering/product (public, private, or hybrid cloud environments).

• Cloud & Infrastructure Fundamentals: Solid understanding of core cloud infrastructure components (compute, storage, and networking) and how private enterprise environments connect with public cloud platforms (such as AWS, Azure, or GCP).

• Core Inbound PM Craft: Demonstrated experience gathering customer requirements, writing detailed PRDs, defining API interfaces, and prioritizing roadmaps using structured decision-making frameworks.

• Customer Empathy & Discovery: Strong background in customer discovery—uncovering underlying user needs and translating them into practical software capabilities.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Advanced Storage Platforms
jobs.loc: Morrisville, North Carolina, United States of America
jobs.desc:
Overview

The Senior Product Manager, Advanced Platforms owns product execution for Lenovo’s SDS, HPC storage, and emerging platforms. The role leads platform transitions, qualifications, governance, and lifecycle management, converting broader portfolio direction into scalable business outcomes.

Working across partners, engineering, solutions, sales, and support, this PM establishes repeatable operating models and ensures advanced platforms are competitive, supportable, and ready for adoption and growth.

Key Responsibilities

Portfolio and Lifecycle Ownership

• Own roadmap, requirements, software cadence, launch, adoption, and growth for SDS, HPC storage, and emerging platforms.

• Lead platform transitions and develop business cases for new technologies.

• Translate portfolio strategy into executable plans with clear priorities and outcomes.

Qualification, Governance & Certification

• Lead platform qualification and certification programs.

• Establish repeatable governance for partner-based solutions and emerging technologies.

• Coordinate readiness across engineering, services, sales, support, and lifecycle teams.

Partner & Ecosystem Management

• Serve as the product interface for selected OEM and technology partners.

• Influence partner roadmaps through customer requirements, market insight, and business priorities.

• Evaluate partnership opportunities and drive cross-functional execution.

• Track AI infrastructure, HPC, SDS, and data-platform trends to identify requirements, opportunities, and competitive risks.

Basic Qualifications:

• 8+ years of product management or related infrastructure technology experience.

• Experience with enterprise storage, infrastructure software, datacenter technologies, or adjacent markets.

• Experience operating in a partner-based business model, including joint roadmap planning, requirements alignment, commercial coordination, and cross-company execution.

• Demonstrated success leading cross-functional initiatives in a matrixed organization and influencing stakeholders without direct authority.

• Ability to translate customer, market, and partner needs into clear product requirements, priorities, and business outcomes.

• Strong communication, business judgment, and stakeholder-influence skills.

Preferred Qualifications:

• Experience with HPC architectures, including parallel file systems, high-performance networking, data movement, and performance optimization for compute-intensive workloads.

• Understanding of AI infrastructure architectures, including GPU-based systems, training and inference data pipelines, storage performance requirements, and integration with the broader AI ecosystem.

• Experience with SDS, HCI, enterprise SAN or NAS, object storage, storage networking, infrastructure management, or automation.

• Experience working with major storage, server, silicon, cloud, or software partners to develop and bring joint solutions to market.

jobs.desc:
Liftoff is a leading AI-powered performance marketing platform for the mobile app economy. Our end-to-end technology stack helps app marketers acquire and retain high-value users, while enabling publishers to maximize revenue across programmatic and direct demand.

Liftoff’s solutions, including Accelerate, Direct, Monetize, Intelligence, and Vungle Exchange, support over 6,600 mobile businesses across 74 countries in sectors such as gaming, social, finance, ecommerce, and entertainment. Founded in 2012 and headquartered in Redwood City, CA, Liftoff has a diverse, global presence.

Liftoff is building a new e-commerce advertising platform, and we're looking for a Product Manager to own it from zero to one. Today the product drives app users to purchase directly on merchants' e-commerce sites. You'll take the product from its current early state through beta and on the path to general availability, partnering with a dedicated engineering team, our ML organization, and go-to-market teams to set strategy, prioritize the roadmap, and decide what's in and out of scope. This is a senior, largely individual-contributor role with real autonomy: you'll own the business case, the experimentation roadmap, and the platform's identity and attribution architecture, and you'll represent Liftoff directly with customers and partners.

Responsibilities

Own the strategy and the business case

  • Decide what stays out of scope. The possible surface area will always exceed team capacity, and disciplined scope-cutting is as important as anything you ship
  • Partner with GTM, sales, and account teams to define ideal customer profiles and go-to-market strategy, select and onboard customers, and turn customer intel into roadmap decisions. Represent Liftoff in customer conversations and strategic industry partnerships

Drive performance through ML partnership

  • Partner with Eng leads to own the experiment roadmap, interpret A/B results, and make Go/No-Go decisions
  • Diagnose full-funnel performance from ad impression through site session, add-to-cart, and purchase, and call out investigation opportunities
  • Set and enforce traffic quality and creative UX standards that protect advertiser outcomes, including suppression logic and inventory quality controls

Own identity, attribution, and platform integrations

  • Work with Legal to define product policy around consent handling, regional privacy requirements, customer data protection, and compliance (GDPR, CCPA, etc.)
  • Develop strategic partnership and integration opportunities to ensure robust measurement and attribution
  • Defend our attribution methodology and incrementality story with sophisticated performance marketers and agencies
  • Lead e-commerce platform integration work end to end: pixels, server-side event delivery, order attribution, catalog ingestion, and merchant-facing installation flows

Requirements

  • 8+ years of product management experience, with meaningful time in performance advertising: DSP, retargeting platform, measurement/MMP, or ad network e-commerce products
  • Hands-on depth in web and mobile identity and attribution: probabilistic matching (IP and device signals), pixels, server-to-server postbacks, and the practical constraints of browser privacy changes (ITP, fingerprinting protection) and ATT
  • A track record of carrying a product from beta to GA, inc

jobs.title: Lead Product Manager- Quote Management (CPQ)
jobs.desc:
Why UKG:

At UKG, the work you do matters. The code you ship, the decisions you make, and the care you show a customer all add up to real impact. Today, tens of millions of workers start and end their days with our workforce operating platform. Helping people get paid, grow in their careers, and shape the future of their industries. That's what we do.

We never stop learning. We never stop challenging the norm. We push for better, and we celebrate the wins along the way. Here, you'll get flexibility that's real, benefits you can count on, and a team that succeeds together. Because at UKG, your work matters-and so do you.

About the Role:

We're looking for an experienced Lead Product Manager to lead the product strategy, roadmap, and execution for Quote Management. You'll partner closely with Sales, Sales Operations, Finance, Pricing, Legal, Revenue Operations, Customer Success, and Engineering teams to deliver scalable, intuitive, and AI-powered solutions supporting net new sales, amendments, renewals, and contract management.

This role is ideal for someone with deep Quote-to-Cash expertise who enjoys solving complex business challenges, influencing cross-functional stakeholders, and building products that simplify enterprise selling.

Duties & Responsibilities:

  • Own the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for Quote Management across net new sales, amendments, renewals, and contract management.
  • Partner directly with Sales and GTM stakeholders to understand customer and business needs and translate them into scalable product capabilities.
    Define and prioritize product investments across Salesforce Revenue Cloud Advanced (RCA), Agentforce Revenue Management (ARM), Salesforce Agentforce, Salesforce CPQ, and related Quote-to-Cash technologies.
  • Lead product discovery through customer interviews, stakeholder workshops, process mapping, competitive analysis, and data-driven insights.
  • Create product requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, success metrics, and release plans that align with business objectives.
  • Collaborate with Engineering and Architecture teams to design intuitive, AI-powered seller experiences that increase productivity and reduce operational complexity.
  • Partner with Finance, Pricing, Legal, Revenue Operations, and Sales Operations to ensure products support pricing governance, approvals, contracting, compliance, and downstream business processes.
  • Drive Agile product execution by prioritizing backlogs, participating in sprint planning, validating delivered functionality, and ensuring successful product launches.
  • Define and measure key product metrics, analyze customer feedback, and continuously improve product capabilities based on business outcomes.
  • Present product strategy, roadmaps, and recommendations to senior business and technology leaders.
  • Stay current on emerging Salesforce platform capabilities, AI technologies, and industry trends to identify opportunities for innovation.


About You:

You are passionate about building enterprise products that solve meaningful customer problems. You thrive in fast-paced, highly collaborative environments and enjoy partnering with business and technology teams to deliver innovative solutions. You bring strong product thinking, customer empathy, analytical skills, and execution discipline to every initiative.

You are equally comfortable leading product discovery sessions with Sales leaders, writing detailed product requirements for engineering teams, and presenting product strategy to executive stakeholders.
Basic Qualifications:
  • 8+ years of product management experience delivering enterprise SaaS products.
    Experience building products supporting Quote-to-Cash, Quote Management, CPQ, Contract Lifecycle Manage

jobs.title: Staff Product Manager - Originations & Growth
jobs.desc:
At Koalafi, we believe in a world where no one has to put an important purchase on hold. That’s why we’re making it easier for more people to pay for big purchases over time.

Retailers across the country rely on us to offer flexible lease-to-own financing to their non-prime consumers, while increasing sales and strengthening customer loyalty. Their 2M+ customers love us because we provide a flexible way for them to make payments and give them an opportunity to improve their credit. Our 200+ Koalafi teammates enjoy inspiring and challenging work that accelerates their careers.

Interested in learning more about how we’re transforming the financing experience and joining our team?

About The Role 

We’re looking for a Staff Product Manager to lead and evolve Koalafi’s Originations product and drive growth across our end-to-end apply & checkout experiences. that serve as the front door to financing for every customer. This is a high-impact role at the center of Koalafi’s strategy to accelerate growth by making it easier, faster, and more intuitive for consumers to finance their purchases across both online and in-store channels.  

This role is ideal for a product manager who thrives working at the intersection of strategy, execution, and deep cross-functional collaboration. You’ll set the direction for Originations by aligning diverse partners, from Risk and Compliance to Marketing and Sales, around a cohesive strategy that accelerates growth while maintaining a unified vision. 

What You’ll Do 

Define and drive the Originations roadmap 

  • Lead product vision, strategy, roadmap, and execution for the Originations product as an engine for growth
  • Develop the product strategy for apply & checkout flows that are reusable across diverse merchant and consumer contexts – such as a consumer’s mobile phone to a store owner’s point-of-sale system or e-commerce checkout integration 

Grow and optimize the Originations funnel 

  • Drive continuous funnel optimization by identifying conversion opportunities using quantitative data and qualitative insights to ship rapid improvements while balancing profitability and compliance
  • Grow Koalafi’s distribution across channels by partnering with cross-functional teams to design and ship frictionless experiences that work for both merchants and consumers 

Shape the product for rapid insight generation and experimentation 

  • Partner with analytics and engineering to instrument the funnel, generate actionable insights, and run A/B tests to validate hypotheses and measure outcomes
  • Mentor other PMs and establish best practices for experimentation and funnel analysis across the broader organization 

Champion the customer experience 

  • Champion the customer, bringing curiosity and empathy to every decision to ensure the application experience meets real customer needs
  • Conduct user research and map consumer and merchant journeys to uncover usability gaps and unmet needs

jobs.title: Principal Product Manager (CMK/Encryption Platform)
jobs.desc:
Working at Atlassian

Atlassians can choose where they work whether in an office, from home, or a combination of the two. That way, Atlassians have more control over supporting their family, personal goals, and other priorities. We can hire people in any country where we have a legal entity.

Atlassian is looking for a product leader to own the strategy, delivery, and operating model for our Customer Managed Keys (CMK) and encryption platform portfolio. This role will lead a high-impact area at the intersection of enterprise trust, platform capability, regulatory readiness, and customer value. The Product Lead will define how encryption capabilities scale across Atlassian Cloud, clarify product and platform scope, and drive outcomes across CMK, encryption platform, bring-your-own-key patterns, and adjacent encryption services.

The CMK/Encryption Platform Product Lead is responsible for product strategy, roadmap definition, and cross-functional execution for Atlassian's encryption platform work. jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Search & Evaluate - StreetEasy
jobs.desc:
About the team

StreetEasy is the most-used local real estate platform in New York City - the place where millions of buyers and renters begin, conduct, and ultimately make one of the highest-stakes decisions of their lives. Unlike when searching for everyday items, our users aren't just looking for quick, easy results. They're navigating a complex market defined by co-op boards, neighborhood nuance, and inventory that moves fast and unevenly. Search & Evaluate sits at the center of that experience, where users spend the most time and where the most critical intent signals are generated.
This role owns the core shopping experience - search, browse, compare, evaluate - and the data and signals it produces that power personalization, agent matching, and growth across the platform.

About the role

We're looking for a Senior PM who has managed search tools for a marketplace. You understand that searching for a home is a long, thoughtful process, which is very different from searching for simple, everyday products or just browsing general content.You've lived the tension between relevance and monetization, between exploration and conversion, and between what users say they want and what behavioral data tells you they actually do.
This is a pivotal role where you'll elevate the product to the next level. There is massive potential to innovate through AI-assisted discovery, intent-aware personalization, and advanced agentic flows. You'll have the opportunity to define this roadmap and lead the team in building a more personalized decision-making journey for our users.

You Will Get To

  • Define and drive the search and shopping experience across web, iOS, and Android, from initial query through listing and building detail, saving and comparing.
  • Rethink how we personalize the process of finding a home-a high-stakes, infrequent decision. User intent shifts over months, so our sparse signals have to do more heavy lifting than in typical search contexts.
  • Partner with engineering and data science to lead the evolution of our search strategy, prioritizing high-impact AI-native opportunities that will transform how users navigate the market.
  • Own the property evaluation pages and experience, helping users navigate NYC-specific nuances like co-op policies and pricing.
  • Navigate the structural tension between organic relevance and advertising products that are core to the business model - not a side constraint, but a daily design problem.
  • Set the measurement framework for search quality in a non-deterministic, AI-powered experience - defining what "good" looks like when you can't rely on clean A/B tests alone.

This role has been categorized as a Remote position. "Remote" employees do not have a permanent corporate office workplace and, instead, work from a physical location of their choice, which must be identified to the Company. U.S. employees may live in any of the 50 United States, with limited exceptions.

In California, Connecticut, Maryland, Massachusetts, New Jersey, New York, Washington state, and Washington DC the standard base pay range for this role is $148,600.00 - $237,400.00 annually. This base pay range is specific to these locations and may not be applicable to other locations.In Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maine, Minnesota, Nevada, Ohio, Rhode Island, Vermont, and Virginia the standard base pay range for this role is $141,200.00 - $225,600.00 annually. The base pay range is specific to these locations and may not be applicable to other locations.

In addition to a competitive base salary this position is also eligible for equity awards based on factors such as experience, performance and location. Actual amounts will vary depending on experience, performance and location. Employees in this role will not be paid below the salary threshold for exempt employees in the state where they reside.

At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

This is a defining opportunity for a Senior Product Manager to own how every Samsara device comes to life.

Samsara ships hundreds of thousands of devices a year to fleets, construction sites, and depots worldwide. A single customer rollout can exceed 50,000 devices, where every minute saved per install compounds into weeks of deployment time. Each device has a five-minute window where it goes from a box in someone's hands to a live sensor feeding a customer's operation. You will own those five minutes and the multi-year vision for what they become.

Correctness today swings by several points depending on whether the installer uses the Samsara Fleet App, and closing that gap for every install is the first prize. Your target is an install under five minutes of active app time that confirms its own health before the installer walks away.

You are building for two people who each get the same five minutes. A contracted technician on their twentieth install of the day wants speed. A customer's shop mechanic on their first wants guidance that assumes nothing. Both are standing in a truck bay, holding a phone, sometimes without signal.

This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the US.

jobs.title: Staff Product Manager - Professional Experience
jobs.desc:
About ShiftKey

ShiftKey is a platform that is disrupting the way healthcare facilities find licensed and certified professionals to fill available shifts. Leveraging marketplace dynamics and deep industry knowledge, the company is playing a vital role in mitigating America's healthcare staffing shortages, enabling direct connections between facilities and healthcare professionals. By offering the opportunity to work as much or as little as they choose and putting the power back into the hands of healthcare workers, ShiftKey is bringing more licensed professionals back into the workforce, a solution that is solving a major crisis in healthcare. For more information, visit www.ShiftKey.com.

The role

ShiftKey connects healthcare professionals with facilities across diverse care settings, and our professional experience - from the first shift someone picks up to whether they're still picking up shifts three years later - is what keeps that marketplace healthy. Our Product Team operates in an augmented model - you will direct what we are building toward and our non-negotiables, while our delivery partners direct how it gets built.

Professionals who pick up shifts on ShiftKey have options - other platforms, direct facility work, leaving staffing entirely. This role owns the experience that makes ShiftKey the one they stick with: finding shifts, getting placed, seeing what they earn and why, building a reputation, and coming back. You'll own Professional Lifetime Value as the metric that tells you whether it's working, and you'll partner with the PM who owns the facility side to keep the marketplace healthy on both ends.

Where you'll work

This is a fully remote position based in the United States. You should be comfortable working asynchronously and partnering with teammates in different time zones.

What you'll be doing

  • Own the professional's experience end to end: discovery, placement, and what keeps them coming back.
  • Define and own Professional Lifetime Value, reporting on it up to leadership.
  • Build the retention strategy that keeps professionals active for years, not just their first shift.
  • Design how professionals build reputation and get discovered by facilities.
  • Make earnings clear - what they make, why, and how to make it better.

What you'll need

  • 7-9 years in product management, with meaningful time on the supply side of a marketplace or platform.
  • Experience solving for engagement, not just availability, in a marketplace or platform.
  • Comfort connecting product decisions to unit economics and talking through them with finance.
  • Sharp data instincts - you instrument before you build, and can diagnose retention vs. discovery problems.
  • A strong track record partnering across team boundaries you don't fully control.

Perks of working for ShiftKey

  • Inclusive and collaborative work environment where all voices are valued.
  • Hybrid-friendly office spaces designed to be fun and engaging.
  • Comprehensive health, vision, and dental coverage.
  • Benefits begin on your first day.
  • Generous PTO and company-paid holidays, including flexible floating holidays.
  • 100% 401(k) employer match up to 6%.
  • Paid parental leave.
  • Wellness support, including access to mental health resources.

ShiftKey is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to embracing diverse and individual perspectives shaping our culture and contributing to the solutions that transform the world. We actively work to create an inclusive environment for employees to thrive.

jobs.title: Principal Product Manager, Directed Workflows
jobs.desc:
About the team

At Zillow, we believe home should be more than just a dream. The Zillow Home Loans (ZHL) Product team delivers a home financing journey that gives consumers more confidence, transparency, and ease than they can find anywhere else. We partner closely with Engineering, AI, Design, Research, and Operations to bring holistic experience innovation to market. This team is building an AI-native operating model for service delivery - agentic systems that reason about the next best action, and durable workflow infrastructure that carries those decisions out reliably.

About the role

The Principal Product Manager, Directed Workflows drives the vision, strategy, and execution for how ZHL's sales and service process gets encoded as directed work. AI agents reason over each customer's situation, adapt that process to the specific opportunity in front of them, and determine the next work that should happen: the action, the outcome it is meant to create, the quality bar it must meet, and the skills required to execute it. You will own that loop across engagement and loan production. You design the AI harness (context, tools, memory, orchestration, escalation, guardrails) that determines what those agents reason over and what work they produce. You own the eval infrastructure that scores those decisions against the process you defined, learns from operator feedback, and uses experiments to decide what to keep, change, or retire.

  • Define and lead a multi-year product vision for Directed Workflows as an AI-first service system spanning engagement and loan production
  • Define, with Sales and Business Operations, the sales and service process this system encodes: customer jobs, value at each stage, and how that experience earns attention and advocacy
  • Design the AI harness that turns that process into AI agent behavior: context engineering, tool design, memory, orchestration, and guardrails, including where a model should reason, where deterministic systems should execute, and what requires a person. The work the agent produces names the action, intended outcome, quality bar, and skills required to execute
  • Own the eval infrastructure you build or integrate: score AI agent output against the intended process, learn from operator feedback in production, and run experiments that show whether the directed work moved the outcome
  • Sequence from high-leverage pilots to platform: prove outcomes in focused increments, retire or redesign what does not move the metrics, then expand successful patterns across the financing journey
  • Influence across Zillow so the customer experience, the real estate agent experience, and the home finance operator experience operate as one coordinated service, and represent that strategy with senior leaders including risks and trade-offs

jobs.title: Group Product Manager, Title Launch Management
jobs.desc:
At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode - pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next.

The Role

Behind every title a member streams is a complex content supply chain. Title Launch Management (TLM) is the team that helps design the systems and workflows that bring content, metadata, and rights into Netflix, validate and process them, and orchestrate their path all the way to launch on service. As Netflix expands into new content types and deal structures, this is the team that enables the business to move faster across a growing diversity of partners, formats, and volumes.

We are looking for a strong product leader to serve as Group Product Manager for the TLM Product. You will own the vision, strategy, and roadmap across a portfolio spanning content ingestion pipelines, content distribution and delivery, and the internal platform and tooling that our operations teams rely on every day. Your charter is anchored in three principles: make delivering to Netflix the easiest part of a partner's day, simplify the path between ingestion and publish, and manage risk instead of titles and assets.

Your team of Product Managers partners with Engineering, Operations, and Design to build and scale the platforms, services, and tools that move content through the business — while resisting the temptation to treat every new deal as a bespoke one-off. Just as importantly, you will be a close product partner to the operational teams who run these workflows, turning their hardest problems into a durable product strategy. This is a high-leverage role with direct impact on the speed, quality, and cost with which content reaches members around the world.

In this role, you will:

•
Set the strategy: define and drive the multi-quarter product vision for TLM, connecting ingestion, distribution, and platform investments to measurable reductions in manual intervention and turnaround time across content archetypes.

•
Own the products that make delivering to Netflix effortless: unified direct delivery via APIs, web portals, and standards-based feeds; spec-agnostic ingestion; partner onboarding and permissioning; metadata capture; and automated asset evaluation and QC.

•
Lead distribution & the path to publish: own the orchestration that simplifies the path between ingestion and launch — automation as the default launch path, an extensible catalog architecture that lets new content bets evolve safely, and reliable fulfillment to the platforms and systems the business depends on.

• Work side-by-side with GTM teams in Alpharetta to surface key customer insights and turn them into product improvements.

• Define success metrics, lead release planning, and champion post-launch measurement to ensure real customer impact.

• Build scalable frameworks for cross-regional communication, ensuring the next generation of Foxit products are truly global in design and delivery.

• 7+ years in SaaS Product Management, Technical PM, or Platform PM roles.

• Bachelor’s or Master’s in Computer Science, Engineering, or related technical field.

• Fluency in both English and Mandarin (verbal & written) — must be able to communicate technical detail to developers in Mandarin.

• Strong technical acumen: APIs, SDKs, cloud architecture, data flow, agile methods.

• Proven ability to translate between customer needs and engineering realities.

• Experience working with globally distributed teams and bridging cultural and time-zone divides.

• Willingness to travel regularly to Alpharetta (~1 week/month).

• Experience with document workflow, PDF editing, or SaaS developer tools.

• Background in software engineering or technical architecture.

• Experience supporting GTM and product alignment across US + APAC.

You’ll:

• Be the founding member shaping how Foxit’s global product organization integrates GTM and engineering.

• Build bilingual, bi-continental collaboration models that scale.

• Influence strategic priorities, roadmap decisions, and customer experience across the full product lifecycle.

You’ll be joining a company where innovation meets execution—and you’ll sit right at the intersection of both.

Screenpipe gives AI agents memory of your work. It keeps raw computer history local by default and makes that context available to the AI tools you choose.

We're looking for a senior PM who can make a powerful technical product simple and useful in everyday work.

You'll work directly with the founder and engineers, owning the path from understanding a customer's problem to shipping a change and seeing whether it helped.

What you'll own

  • Customer discovery. Talk to users regularly, watch them use the product, and understand what they are trying to get done.
  • The customer journey. Help people move from installing Screenpipe to getting a useful result and making it part of their routine.
  • Product priorities. Combine interviews, support feedback and product data to decide what matters next and what can wait.
  • Delivery. Turn problems into clear flows, prototypes and scoped work. Stay involved through implementation, release and follow-up.
  • Product outcomes. Define meaningful activation and retention measures, run focused experiments, and check whether changes improve real usage.
  • Trust. Treat privacy, permissions and clear explanations as part of the user experience.

What we're looking for

  • You've owned a software product end to end and can explain what you personally shipped, why you chose it and what happened afterward.
  • You have strong UX judgment and know how to test your assumptions with customers.
  • You're comfortable with product analytics, funnels and cohorts, including questioning how a metric is defined.
  • You can use AI tools to investigate problems and build prototypes, and work closely with engineers on technical tradeoffs.
  • You take ownership, communicate clearly and can make decisions with incomplete information.
  • You're based in San Francisco and want to work together in person.

Experience with early-stage products, desktop software, developer tools or AI agents is useful.

Why Screenpipe

This is a chance to shape how people use AI with the context of their actual work. You'll have direct access to users, a public codebase to learn from, and room to carry an idea from discovery through to a working product.

Benefits

  • Health and recovery: Personal health coach or trainer, gym membership, sauna and cold plunge access, and unlimited massages.
  • Health insurance: Top-tier health insurance.
  • Flexibility: San Francisco is our home base, with flexibility to work remotely from time to time, including trips abroad such as Thailand.
  • Learning: Unlimited books and audiobooks, on us.
  • AI tools: $20,000 per month in AI tokens to build, experiment, and do your best work.
  • Personal growth: Career and life coaching.
  • Team travel: Team trips and work retreats, including places like Hawaii.

Compensation

Base salary: $160,000 to $220,000 per year. Equity range: 0.25% to 1.00% on a fully diluted basis. Final compensation depends on experience and role scope. Any equity grant is subject to board approval, equity plan terms, vesting and definitive documents.

This role is full-time and in person in San Francisco. We are not offering visa sponsorship for this role.

Apply

Send us a product you helped build and a short explanation of your contribution. Include one example of a customer insight that changed what you shipped. Please use public examples or anonymize confidential details.

CRIO's eSource platform captures protocol-driven data directly at the point of patient interaction, catches mistakes before they happen, and gives sponsors and CROs real-time visibility into their sites. About Us

Axle Health builds AI scheduling and workforce management software to empower in-home healthcare providers to deliver exceptional, personalized care right where patients feel most comfortable—at home.

Some of the biggest providers in the country use our software (like Cityblock Health and U Penn Health System) to improve the utilization of their field teams by 17%+, and automate the operational burden of scheduling and dispatching.

Our platform includes proprietary logistics algorithms to optimize scheduling, a mobile app for field staff, an operations dashboard for office teams, engagement and booking tools for patients, and a wide range of integrations and external APIs for modular access.

We’re a team of top-tier engineers and operators, backed by $14m from top investors such as Y Combinator, Pear VC, and F-Prime, applying our intellect and logistics experience to upend how home healthcare is delivered.

About You

Axle Health is building the operating system for home healthcare - scheduling, route optimization, and patient engagement tools that give health systems and home-based care providers the infrastructure to run better, faster, and at greater scale. We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to own critical product initiatives end-to-end, working closely with engineering and GTM teams to ship features that meaningfully improve how clinicians deliver care and how operations teams run the day-to-day. This is a senior individual contributor role reporting to our Head of Product, where you'll have significant autonomy to shape what we build and how.

You're a true advocate for the customer and the user - someone who leans into the user experience and holds the bar on experience even when it's easier to ship something just good enough. You're equally comfortable digging into the data and riding along with our customers to understand what they actually need.

You've shipped B2B vertical SaaS products at early-stage startups and know what it takes to move fast with limited resources, make smart trade-offs without losing sight of the user, and build things people actually want to use.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, PBM Platform
jobs.desc:
**ABOUT THE ROLE:**

  

Rightway is looking for a Senior Product Manager to own claims adjudication, the system at the center of Rightway's PBM. Adjudication covers the full lifecycle of a pharmacy claim: eligibility, coverage, pricing, rejections, overrides, and coordination of benefits. It is one of the most complex and consequential product areas at Rightway, and this role owns its strategy, roadmap, and delivery.

You will develop deep expertise in how pharmacy claims adjudicate today and use that to define where the platform goes next — working through real claim behavior alongside engineering, writing requirements precise enough to build against, setting the bar for correctness, and owning the validation approach that proves the system is ready for production volume. The role reports to the Director, Product Management, and operates with a high degree of independence. It requires someone who can take full ownership of a major product initiative and work cross-functionally across product, engineering, operations, clinical, and compliance.

**WHAT YOU'LL DO:**

* Own the vision, roadmap, and delivery plan for claims adjudication, including how it scales with volume, new clients, and new lines of business
* Build deep expertise in how pharmacy claims adjudicate across eligibility, coverage rules, pricing, rejections, overrides, and coordination of benefits, and turn that into a structured, prioritized plan
* Define the long-term strategy for how the platform evolves to support operational scale, regulatory requirements, and new lines of business, including Medicare
* Write clear specs, user stories, and acceptance criteria that engineering and QA can execute against, and lead backlog refinement, sprint planning, and release coordination in an agile environment
* Partner day to day with the adjudication engineering team to sequence work, manage dependencies, and resolve ambiguity in claim behavior quickly
* Set the bar for correctness and own the testing and claim certification approach that proves the system is ready for production volume
* Own readiness and rollout planning, including validation against real claim volume, parallel testing, and phased release
* Coordinate go-live readiness across operations, clinical, client success, and compliance so changes land without disruption to members or clients
* Partner with PBM operations, clinical, legal, and client success teams to ensure the platform meets workflow and regulatory requirements
* Manage the drug data, formulary, and prior authorization dependencies adjudication relies on, treating the internal teams who own them as first-class partners
* Define and track KPIs for claim accuracy, system performance, and reliability
* Act as the primary product point of contact for adjudication across the organization and with external partners

**WHO YOU ARE:**

  

* Bachelor's degree required; 5 or more years of product management experience, preferably in healthcare or enterprise technology
* Experience with complex, rules-driven transaction processing systems such as claims adjudication, payments, or benefit administration, including responsibility for correctness and testing
* Experience leading a platform migration or major system transition from requirements through go-live
* Proven ability to lead cross-functional initiatives involving product, engineering, legal, and operations stakeholders
* Ability to work independently and drive execution with minimal direction
* Strong communicator who collaborates well across technical and non-technical teams
* Detail oriented and process focused, and comfortable in a domain where correctness is measured claim by claim
* Comfortable working across complex, data-heavy systems
* Curious and adaptable, willing to dig into unfamiliar and highly technical territory and find answers
* Experience working in or with PBMs, pharmacy claims, or pharmacy operations is a plus
* Familiarity with systems that support regulated healthcare markets

**About Beazley Security**

Beazley Security is a global cybersecurity firm committed to helping clients enable advanced cyber defenses that reduce risk with quantifiable results. We’re comprised of top talent from private industry, government, intelligence, and law enforcement who are specialists in threat detection, incident response, digital forensics, offensive security, risk management, and cyber resilience. As a subsidiary of a specialty insurance giant, Beazley Insurance, we’ve been at the forefront of cyber insurance management and breach response activities for business clients in the US, UK, and Europe since 2017. As Beazley Security, the company will have an expanded scope, leveraging nearly two decades of cyber incident experience, a strong services division, and a business strategy focused on growth, to realize our goals and deliver benefits to clients.

As a company, we are committed to upholding our core values of Belonging, Integrity, Service, Accountability, and Curiosity. We believe these values are essential to creating a strong and inclusive workplace culture, as well as to deliver world-class cybersecurity solutions to our clients worldwide. As Beazley Security, these values will continue to thrive, with an extra emphasis on expansion of our capabilities and capacity in helping solve unique client challenges.

**About Exposure Management**

Beazley Security’s Exposure Management platform provides continuous, automated visibility into organizations, internet-facing footprint: domains, IPs, exposed services, and externally accessilbe software. It goes b eyond simple asset discovery, integrating intelligence from Beazley Security Labs to highlight the exposures that matter most and guide focused, effective risk reduction. Exposure Management continuously scans organizations' externally-facing assets to provide a comprehensive view of their attack surface in near real time. By having near real time visibility to changes to

organizations' attack surface, along with proactive prompts and curated intelligence on known exploited vulnerabilities that affect environment’s assets, IT and security teams can take action to mitigate threats. This pre-emptive approach is essential to addressing potential risk before it can materialize.

As an extension of Exposure Management, Beazley Security launched two companion products: Dark Web Monitoring (DWM) and Third-Party Risk Monitoring (TPRM). TPRM evaluates key suppliers for security issues that could impact organizations. With TPRM, organizations can monitor vendor security posture in near real time with dynamic scoring based on vendors' access to their corporate systems, the sensitivity of data that they can access, and criticality to

business operations. DWM focuses on monitoring compromised user credential, notifying clients before attackers can exploit these credentials.

As Senior Product Manager for Beazley Security's Exposure Management (EM) suite, you will own the strategy, roadmap, and execution for the products that help clients continuously discover, prioritize, and reduce risk across their external attack surface.

competitively differentiated. You'll define what gets built and why, ensure delivery stays aligned with market needs, and actively shape how EM is positioned and packaged in the market.

At Playlist, life's richest moments happen when people step away from screens to move, connect, explore, and play. We're building the definitive platform for intentional living, connecting people with inspiring experiences in fitness, wellness, and beyond. With popular brands like Mindbody and ClassPass, Playlist empowers businesses and individuals, making it effortless for aspirations to become actions. Join us in reshaping technology's role to foster meaningful, real-world connections.

Mindbody equips wellness entrepreneurs with technology to support thriving businesses and create exceptional experiences. Innovation and curiosity drive our culture, connecting businesses and individuals through cutting-edge solutions. Join us if you're passionate about enhancing wellness through technology.

**The Opportunity**
-------------------

Mindbody is seeking a **Principal Product Manager, Agentic Experience** to define how AI transforms the way businesses use our industry-leading B2B software platform.

This role will own the vision, strategy, and execution for incorporating agentic workflows into Mindbody's business experience. Your mandate spans both sides of the opportunity: envisioning an AI-first user experience that meaningfully improves how customers operate their businesses, and establishing the underlying platform capabilities that allow Mindbody teams to build reliable agentic workflows quickly, safely, and at scale.

This is not a role focused on adding isolated AI features or conversational interfaces to existing workflows. You will determine where agents can fundamentally simplify work, coordinate actions across the platform, and help customers achieve outcomes with less effort. You will also define the quality, evaluation, trust, and governance systems necessary to make non-deterministic products dependable in real business environments.

As a Principal Product Manager, you will operate as a senior individual contributor and organizational leader. You will level up Mindbody's thinking about applied AI, align teams around a cohesive strategy, and create the platform and product patterns that shape one of the most important components of Mindbody's next evolution.

**The Role You'll Play**
------------------------

### **Define Mindbody's agentic product strategy**

* Establish a compelling vision for an **AI-first B2B user experience** across Mindbody's platform.
* Develop and own the product strategy and roadmap for agentic experiences and their enabling platform capabilities.
* Identify the workflows where agentic systems can create meaningful customer and business value—not merely add novelty or incremental convenience.
* Determine the appropriate interaction models for agents, including proactive assistance, workflow orchestration, recommendations, approvals, and autonomous actions.
* Translate rapidly evolving AI capabilities into durable product strategy grounded in customer needs, technical feasibility, economics, and risk.
* Define clear boundaries between deterministic software, AI-assisted experiences, and agent-led workflows.

### **Build trusted agentic experiences**

* Lead the development of agentic workflows designed specifically for B2B users and their operational needs.
* Create experiences that make agent reasoning, proposed actions, uncertainty, and outcomes understandable to users.
* Define when agents should act autonomously, request approval, escalate to a person, or decline to act.
* Ensure agentic workflows respect permissions, business rules, data boundaries, and customer-specific context.
* Design for user trust and control through confirmation patterns, reversibility, auditability, and effective recovery from errors.
* Partner with Design and Research to establish reusable interaction patterns for AI-first experiences across Mindbody.

Smokeball powers people-law. Our legal practice management software lightens the administrative burden, so legal professionals can serve those who need them most. We’re hiring a Senior Product Manager to help rebuild and expand Smokeball’s Personal Injury (PI) offering. This is a hands-on, end-to-end role where you’ll own a PI product area from discovery and strategy through delivery and iteration — working directly with US personal injury firms and our engineering team in Australia.

------------

  

OG.com is a fast-growing, CFTC-regulated Prediction Market platform powered by cutting-edge technology. We’re building an engaging marketplace where users trade on real-world outcomes - from major sports and elections to cultural and financial events. With a sleek mobile-first app and a passionate community, we’re redefining how people interact with news, probabilities, and financial markets. OG.com runs on the rails of North American Derivatives Exchange, Inc. (NADEX), a CFTC-regulated exchange operating since 2004 and was acquired by crypto.com in 2022.

**Role Overview**
-----------------

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to own the consumer prediction-market trading experience end-to-end - web and mobile - once someone can fund: discovery, order entry, positions, parlays / live, and the fan UX that makes OG the default place to trade on real-world outcomes.

Your mandate is to make OG fast, clear, and design-obsessive for sports and prediction users: the core trading surfaces that keep them coming back, the workflows that feel native to fans (and to retail traders), and the translation of that craft into regulated U.S. event contracts. Fiat, KYC, and payment rails sit with a partner PM. You own what they do after they’re funded.

You will run this roadmap with independence. You make the call on UX tradeoffs, what ships when design quality isn’t there yet, and which trading patterns we borrow from sportsbooks, prediction apps, or retail perps -and which we refuse. You report to the Chief Product Officer, who sets product strategy and priorities across OG. You own the how and the when.

  

**You can come from one of three product worlds:**

* Native consumer predictions - sports fluency, parlays / live, fan UX - and you can bridge that into regulated event contracts.
* Prediction / event markets -you’ve already shipped this category.
* Retail perps / derivatives / advanced trading -you know trader-grade workflows and can make them accessible for fans, not only power users.
* If you’ve shipped any of those, this will feel familiar. The difference is you’ll be doing it in regulated U.S. prediction markets -where sports energy, consumer accessibility, and compliance collide, and the playbook for “best consumer trading experience in the category” is yours to write.

### **What You'll Actually Do:**

* Own the consumer trading roadmap. You are the DRI for web and mobile trading on OG -from first funded session through confident, repeat use. You set milestones, sequence work, and resolve cross-team dependencies. Nothing in this charter goes live without your sign-off on product and UX bar.
* Ship the product fans actually use. You prioritize market discovery, order entry, positions, parlays / multi-leg, live, and the workflows that keep sports and prediction users engaged. You kill “nice ideas” that don’t move outcomes.
* Bridge native prediction (or perps) into regulated event contracts. You take patterns fans already know -sportsbooks, prediction apps, or retail advanced trading -and make them work under U.S. event-contract rules. You don’t copy a sportsbook blindly. You decide what translates.
* Hold the design bar. You champion usability and aesthetics as non-negotiable. You live in design reviews and give specific, actionable UX feedback -spacing, interaction patterns, information density, not vibes. Fan UX is a product skill, not a polish pass.

Sapience AI is the collective intelligence platform for professional communities. We sit above the CRMs, AMS platforms, and knowledge bases that organizations already run, and we turn the expertise scattered across them into something every member can search, act on, and share.

The intelligence a community needs is already inside it. Most organizations just cannot reach it. Knowledge lives in silos, in legacy systems, in the heads of a few experts, and in fragmented records no one can connect. We change that.

Our work is grounded in four commitments: technology elevates people and never replaces them, the best expertise is already inside the community, everything is built on trust, and every deployment is purpose-driven for the organization it serves.

**Let's achieve more, together.**

**Where this role sits**
========================

This role owns a product area end to end. Where the product marketer is the market lens, you are the person accountable for what we build, how it works, and whether it ships and succeeds.

You lead a cross-functional team of engineers, designers, and applied AI specialists to turn strategy into a product members rely on. You own the roadmap for your area, the decisions inside it, and the outcomes it produces.

You work at the center of the product organization, translating a clear point of view into shipped work that moves MINERVA and the COGENT architecture forward through each GR/GA milestone.

**Why this role exists**
========================

In an AI market where capabilities can be copied in weeks, the advantage goes to teams that decide well and ship fast. Someone has to hold the point of view, make the calls, and keep a team building the right thing.

Collective intelligence is hard product work: reasoning over messy knowledge, earning member trust, and fitting into how communities already operate. It needs an owner who can hold both the ambition and the details.

The Senior Product Manager is that owner. You set direction for your area, make the hard prioritization calls, and are accountable for whether the product succeeds with the people it serves.

**What you will own (Areas of Responsibility)**
===============================================

You hold eight areas of responsibility inside the product organization. Each one is yours to set direction on, build, and measure.

**1. Product strategy and roadmap ownership**
---------------------------------------------

* Own the strategy and roadmap for your product area, grounded in member needs, market evidence, and company goals.
* Make clear prioritization calls, and protect the roadmap from reactive churn.
* Sequence work so each release builds toward a strategy, not a list of features.

**2. Discovery and definition**
-------------------------------

* Run discovery with members, buyers, and internal experts to understand the real problem before committing to a solution.
* Write clear definitions of what to build and why, including the assumptions and the bet behind each one.
* Validate early and often, so the team learns fast and adjusts faster.

**3. Delivery and execution**
-----------------------------

* Lead a cross-functional team through delivery, unblocking decisions and keeping momentum.
* Own trade-offs on scope, quality, and time, and make them explicit.
* Ship reliably, and hold a clear bar for what launch-ready means.

--------------------------

* Make sound calls about where AI helps, where it fails, and how to design for its limits.
* Design for trust: provenance, guardrails, and honest handling of uncertainty in what the platform tells members.
* Partner with applied AI and research to turn capability into dependable product behavior.

**5. Member trust and outcomes**
--------------------------------

* Define the outcomes your area is accountable for, and measure them honestly.

Xometry's digital marketplace gives manufacturers the critical resources they need to grow their business while also making it easy for buyers at Fortune 1000 companies to tap into global manufacturing capacity.

Every custom part Xometry quotes has to be checked for manufacturability before it can become a job, i.e. Design for Manufacturing (DFM). This is a technical, cross-functional, high-ownership role at the intersection of manufacturing domain expertise, workflow design, and applied AI/ML — a critical component of our overall strategy.

* **Own the Intelligent DFM Workbench:** Lead the product that houses the single structured record of what each order requires to be built correctly — the source of truth read and edited by internal Staff, and viewed by Buyers and Partners through role-specific views

* **Lead cross-functionally:** Act as the hub between Engineering, Data Science, UX, Sourcing, Pricing, Order Systems, Quality, and DFM engineers/case managers, and present strategy, trade-offs, and ROI to executive leadership

**What You'll Bring to Xometry:**

* 8+ years of product management experience, including leading AI/ML-powered or technical products in a B2B, marketplace, or manufacturing/engineering environment
* Experience owning a system of record or complex data contract (e.g., a shared record consumed by multiple downstream systems and roles) and the human-in-the-loop workflows built around it

* Comfort operating across regions and stakeholder groups to hold a single global design standard, despite real pressure to add customizations
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to distill technical and operational complexity into a clear narrative for engineers and executives alike

About NavLogic AI

NavLogic AI is building an AI-native operating platform for freight forwarders and NVOCCs. Our platform helps automate complex workflows across emails, documents, data entry, shipment follow-up, exception handling, customer communication, and billing.

Our initial focus is U.S. ocean import operations, with plans to expand into ocean export, air freight, trucking, warehousing, and other logistics workflows.

The Role

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to turn complex freight-forwarding operations into reliable AI products.

You will work closely with freight operators, customers, design, engineering, and AI teams to identify high-value operational problems and take products from discovery through production launch and adoption.

Key Responsibilities

* Study and redesign end-to-end freight workflows, including ocean import, shipment creation, availability and LFD, customs and release status, pickup and delivery coordination, exceptions, customer updates, and billing handoffs.
* Define product strategy, priorities, MVPs, and roadmaps based on customer value, operational needs, automation feasibility, and business impact.
* Translate real-world business processes into AI and workflow automation products.
* Work closely with design, engineering, AI, data, and operations teams from product discovery through launch.
* Define product metrics and evaluate automation accuracy, adoption, productivity, and customer ROI.
* Interview customers and freight operators, manage product feedback, and turn customer needs into scalable product capabilities.

What We’re Looking For

* 6+ years of B2B, enterprise software, or complex workflow product management experience. Exceptional candidates with 5+ years and strong results will also be considered.
* Proven experience owning a product or major product area from discovery through production launch and adoption.
* Experience in either logistics, freight forwarding, supply chain, TMS/FMS, or enterprise AI/workflow products.
* Hands-on experience shipping at least one LLM, AI agent, document intelligence, or intelligent workflow product into production.
* Strong product skills including problem framing, workflow design, PRDs, prototypes, prioritization, and release management.
* Strong communication skills and ability to work effectively in an early-stage startup environment.

Preferred Qualifications

* Knowledge of U.S. ocean import, NVOCC, customs, trucking, warehousing, or freight exception management.
* Experience with FMS, APIs, EDI, webhooks, or third-party integrations.
* Startup or 0-to-1 product experience.
* Familiarity with AI workflow tools such as Dify, LangGraph, CrewAI, or n8n.

What We Offer

* Competitive base salary, performance bonus, and equity.
* Opportunity to shape the product and roadmap as an early product leader.
* Direct exposure to real freight operations and customers.
* AI-native working environment with modern AI tools.
* Opportunity to work with teams and customers across the U.S. and China.

Pay: $130,000.00 - $150,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Health insurance
* Paid time off

Work Location: In person

The role partners closely with Franchise Owners — who own content strategy for their franchises — and with the Senior Director, Platform Strategy on the definition of new products and major product revisions on Infobase’s platform.

Success depends on building alignment and driving outcomes through collaboration and influence rather than formal authority. jobs.desc:
Description:

Deep Sync is the industry leader in deterministic identity and AI-powered data solutions. Leveraging our 35-year foundation of compiling direct mail-grade datasets, Deep Sync develops data-first technologies that power marketing, measurement, AI, and business intelligence for agencies and brands with our fully deterministic identity graph, privacy-first audiences, comprehensive data solutions, and integrations with leading platforms and cloud providers.

**Position Overview**

Marketing depends on identifying the audience correctly. Deep Sync supplies the identity data that makes that possible, across offline and online channels, in both consumer and business marketing.

You will own the product surface on which a customer selects an audience, purchases it, and delivers it into the channel where the campaign runs, built on the platform now under development. The role also covers new product development: taking an idea from a hypothesis to a paid offering, and discontinuing the ones that do not justify further investment.

The products we build have to be ready for an AI first world. Customers increasingly reach data through agents and natural language rather than through a screen, which means what we ship has to serve a machine as readily as a person.

The position calls for a senior product manager fluent in advertising and in data, and equally at ease with AI. You should already understand what a match rate is worth to a buyer, the limits of lookalike modelling, and why one individual appears as separate records in separate systems, you should be able to go into the data and verify such questions yourself, and you should be building with current AI tools rather than reading about them. We run a flat organisation and a fast product development cadence. The position is based in Kirkland, WA.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Product ownership and delivery**

* **Surface ownership.** Own an area of the product from the problem through to the outcome: the case for doing the work, the requirements engineering builds from, and the usage it shows six months after release.
* **Requirements and written decisions.** We work in documents. A requirements document states the problem, the decision taken, what is in scope and what is not, and how success will be measured. Presentations are for reporting, not for deciding.
* **Scope discipline.** A rebuild invites reproducing every feature that exists today. Establish what is actually used, make the case for retiring the rest, and hold that position in review.
* **Release management.** Select the customers who receive each release first, define the test that closes a milestone, and report the result as it stands.
* New product development
* **Opportunity identification.** Attributes that have never been packaged, audiences that have never been priced, and questions customers are currently paying somebody else to answer.
* **Early validation.** A test with two or three customers, a measure agreed in advance, and a short written finding. Evidence before a long build rather than after it.
* **Applied AI.** Determine where a model or an agent belongs in the product and where it does not, specify how its output will be evaluated, and demonstrate the idea with a working prototype rather than a description of one. Design for consumption by machines as well as by people: predictable interfaces, described data, and output that a system downstream can act on without a person in between.
* **Progression or discontinuation.** Both are acceptable outcomes. An idea that remains a proposal for three quarters is not.

**Market and commercial**

* **Customer contact.** The sales, delivery and client facing teams hold most of the knowledge about what fails, and customers hold the rest. Time spent with them is part of the role.
* **Consumer and business marketing.** The two buy different things for different reasons, and both are Deep Sync customers. Understand what each is measured on.
