jobs.desc:
**The Company**

At CancerIQ, our technology is expanding access to precision cancer prevention, early detection and treatment to more patient populations. We build software and design services that make it easy for health systems to use genetic information to get ahead of cancer at scale. Our best-in-class, science-based platform is proven to double genetic counseling service capacity, quadruple genetic testing uptake and significantly improve screening compliance. To date, CancerIQ has raised over $26 million to deliver on our mission, with our Series B funding round led by Merck Global Health Innovation Fund and Amgen Ventures.

Our team is made up of a committed, all-in group of people who are as driven to ending cancer as we know it as the providers and patients we serve. This has led to a growing network of over 200 clinical locations across the country, with a robust ecosystem of partners in the diagnostic and genomics space behind us. But we're committed to scaling quickly. In this era of tremendous progress against cancer, we're looking for people to be just as tremendously committed to their work at CancerIQ. If you want your work to matter, join us.

**Role Summary**

CancerIQ is seeking a Senior Product Manager to own the product roadmap for the CancerIQ platform, the full set of workflows that power hereditary cancer risk assessment, genetic testing, and screening compliance for our health-system customers. This role sits at the intersection of clinical oncology, health-system operations, and software product development, translating a deep understanding of cancer risk assessment and genetic counseling workflows into product decisions that improve patient outcomes and drive measurable value for our 60+ enterprise customers.

You will work closely with Engineering, Customer Success, and Sales to define priorities, ship high-quality features, and ensure our platform continues to lead the market in precision cancer prevention. This is a highly cross-functional, highly visible role for someone who wants to build product that directly changes how cancer is caught earlier.

 **Requirements**

***Product Strategy & Roadmap***

* Own the end-to-end product roadmap for the CancerIQ platform, balancing customer needs, market trends, clinical best practice, and business priorities
* Translate company strategy into a prioritized, well-sequenced roadmap and clearly communicate trade-offs to leadership and cross-functional stakeholders
* Define and track success metrics for shipped features, using data to validate impact and inform the next iteration

***Oncology & Clinical Domain Expertise***

* Develop and maintain a deep working knowledge of hereditary cancer risk assessment, genetic counseling workflows, and genetic testing pathways
* Partner with clinical stakeholders — including genetic counselors, Oncology Service Line Leaders, and Directors of Breast Centers and Cancer Services to ensure product decisions reflect real clinical workflows and constraints
* Stay current on relevant clinical guidelines, payor policy, and industry trends in cancer genetics and screening, and translate them into product requirements

**AI-enabled product management**

We’re looking for a product manager with demonstrable proficiency using AI tools throughout the product lifecycle—from customer discovery and UX exploration to requirements, delivery, and validation. You should be able to show examples of how your use of AI improved the quality or speed of your product work.

* Use AI tools to synthesize customer interviews, support trends, product data, and market research into clear opportunities and product decisions.
* Use AI juries and simulated user feedback to explore UX concepts, identify confusing flows, and generate hypotheses to test with real users.
* Use AI to produce complete user stories with context, user value, workflow details, edge cases, dependencies, and measurable acceptance criteria.
* Create and iterate on prototypes, UX

jobs.title: Sr. Product Manager, Data Integrations (PST/MST)
jobs.desc:
**About Lively**

Lively set out to raise the bar on benefit solutions, because we believe no one should have to sacrifice personal wellness for financial wellness. While traditional benefits focus more on transactions and less on the humans using them, Lively harnesses user-centric design and innovative technology to deliver an effortless experience for employers and account holders alike. Our modern HSA is consistently top-rated, and we have since expanded our offerings to provide a full suite of other benefits and services for companies, consumers, and financial institutions.

Lively is a remote-first company, headquartered in San Francisco with employees across the US. Come join us and help make getting the value out of your benefits as simple as it should be.

#### **THE ROLE**

Lively is hiring a Senior Product Manager to own how data moves between our platform and the systems our customers and partners rely on — payroll and HR platforms, benefits administration systems, carriers, and third-party administrators. You will own enrollment and eligibility data, file-based and API-based exchange, and the integration roadmap that connects Lively to its ecosystem.

You will also own the AI agent experiences that sit on top of that data layer, with a focus on onboarding and validation: agents that help customers and partners get their data into Lively correctly the first time, interpret what arrives, surface problems in plain language, and propose corrections. Integration work at Lively is increasingly AI-assisted, and this role decides where that assistance belongs and where human review stays mandatory.

Alongside this, you will shape Lively's forward data integration strategy: how our connectivity model evolves as the ecosystem moves toward real-time exchange, where we invest in building versus partnering, and how we make each additional integration cheaper and faster than the last.

This is a technically grounded product role. You will work closely with engineering on system behavior, data design, and agent behavior, and you will be the person partners and internal teams come to when they need to understand how the data actually flows. You will own large initiatives end-to-end and operate as the primary subject matter expert for your areas.

**Please note:** As a majority of our engineering team sits in Pacific time, candidate preference will be given to those in the **Pacific** and **Mountain** timezones.

#### **WHAT YOU'LL DO**

Responsibilities are listed in order of anticipated time investment:

* Integration Ownership — Own the data exchanged between Lively and its partners: what moves, in what form, on what cadence, and what happens when something goes wrong. Define the contracts that both sides build against.
* AI-Assisted Data Onboarding & Validation — Own the AI agent experiences that accelerate getting partner and customer data into Lively: interpreting unfamiliar file structures, mapping fields, catching errors before they propagate, explaining what went wrong in language a non-technical administrator can act on, and recommending fixes. Define where the agent acts, where it advises, and where a human must approve.
* Enrollment & Eligibility Data — Own the enrollment data lifecycle end to end, including how changes, corrections, and exceptions are handled, and how Lively proves its records match the partner's.
* Reliability, Data Quality & Scale — Own the non-functional requirements of Lively's data integration platform: throughput, latency, availability, recovery, and the guarantee that data is never silently lost or partially applied. Define how failures are detected, communicated, and resolved. Plan capacity for the benefits industry's seasonal enrollment peaks and for growth in partner and record volume. Set the accuracy bar AI-assisted validation must clear before production use.
* Integration Strategy — Set the multi-year direction for how Lively connects to its ecosystem: the target architecture, the migrat

jobs.title: Senior AI Product Manager / Agent Builder
jobs.desc:
About the Opportunity

RK Industries is building an enterprise AI Agent capability using Microsoft AI technologies, and we’re looking for a Senior AI Product Manager / Agent Builder to help lead the journey.

This is a unique product leader + hands-on builder role for someone who can translate operational needs into scalable AI products that deliver measurable business value.

You’ll own enterprise AI Agents from business opportunity through prototype, production, adoption, and measurable business value—starting with RK Mechanical and expanding across RK as our AI capability grows.

About the Role

You are first and foremost an AI Product Manager. You’ll work directly with business leaders and frontline users to understand how work gets done, redesign workflows, define the right AI solution, establish evaluation and human-in-the-loop controls, and drive adoption and measurable outcomes.

What You’ll Do

* Discover high-value AI opportunities by working directly with business users.

* Own AI Agents end-to-end: problem product prototype evaluation production adoption value.

* Build and iterate agents using Microsoft Foundry / Azure AI Foundry, Copilot Studio, Microsoft 365 Copilot, and Microsoft Fabric.

* Design enterprise RAG, grounding, tools, integrations, and human-in-the-loop workflows.

* Personally create rapid prototypes, lightweight coded agents, integrations, and evaluation harnesses.

* Use AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot, Codex, and comparable coding assistants.

* Define evaluation datasets, acceptance thresholds, and production-quality standards.

* Partner with Engineering, Architecture, Data, Security, Responsible AI, MLOps/LLMOps, Change Management, and external AI development partners.

* Measure adoption and prove business value through revenue generation, time savings, cost avoidance, cycle-time reduction, quality improvement, or risk reduction.

* As RK builds dedicated AI/Agent Engineering capacity, production engineering will progressively transition to those specialists. You’ll continue to own the product, agent behavior, evaluation quality, adoption, and business value.

* We’re looking for a Product Manager who can build and not necessarily a full-time software engineer.

What We’re Looking For

* 5–8+ years of product-management experience in software, data, AI, enterprise SaaS, or related technology environments.

* 2+ years of meaningful AI, generative AI, or AI Agent product experience.

* Hands-on experience with Microsoft Foundry / Azure AI Foundry.

* Hands-on experience with Copilot Studio and practical understanding of Microsoft 365 Copilot.

* Working knowledge of Microsoft Fabric.

* Strong understanding of enterprise RAG, grounding, retrieval, and evaluation.

* Experience defining evaluation datasets, acceptance thresholds, and human-in-the-loop controls.

* Hands-on prototyping experience using GitHub Copilot, Codex, or comparable AI coding tools.

* Strong product discovery, workflow mapping, roadmap, backlog, adoption, and business-value skills.

* Ability to work comfortably with executives, frontline users, engineers, architects, data teams, security teams, and vendors.

Preferred Experience

* Experience in construction, MEP, specialty contracting, industrial operations, manufacturing, or related domains is a plus.

How We Lead

We expect this role to demonstrate seven leadership principles equally:

Ownership | Bias for Action | Earn Trust | Dive Deep | Have Backbone; Disagree and Commit | Invent and Simplify | Insist on the Highest Standards

The Opportunity

This is an opportunity to help shape how RK builds enterprise AI from the ground up—combining business-process understanding, product leadership, Microsoft AI platform fluency, hands-on Agent building, evaluation discipline, governance, adoption, and measurable business value

Location: Aurora, Colorado  
Working Model: Hybrid — approximately three days per week in the office, with periodic visits to RK

FIS Management Services, LLC seeks Agile Product Owner Sr Leads in Jacksonville, FL to lead all product owners and own the end-to-end team execution strategy from inception to production for new features functionality and enhancements. jobs.title: Principal Product Manager
jobs.desc:
On this journey for over 12 years, Qventus is leading the transformation of healthcare. We enable hospitals to focus on what matters most: patient care. Our innovative solutions harness the power of machine learning, generative AI, and behavioral science to deliver exceptional outcomes and empower care teams to anticipate and resolve issues before they arise.

Our success in rapid scale across the globe is backed by some of the world's leading investors. At Qventus, you will have the opportunity to work with an exceptional, mission-driven team across the globe, and the ability to directly impact the lives of patients. We're inspired to work with healthcare leaders on our founding vision and unlock world-class medicine through world-class operations. #LI-MB1

We're looking for a Principal Product Manager to work on exciting, high-growth products at the intersection of generative AI and healthcare . Using your product management expertise, combined with your drive and passion for making a difference, you'll work with multiple talented teams across Qventus to discover, define, execute, and launch new products & features, as well as to improve and optimize our existing products.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Lead a team of engineers, data scientists, designers, and clinical experts from discovery through launch
* Spend time with users and buyers, from frontline staff to C-suite executives, to find the problems worth solving
* Write clear requirements, stay involved through design and development, and manage the backlog
* Define success for each release, measure it, and keep improving the product after launch
* Mentor other PMs and help shape how we do product work at Qventus
* Build relationships with customers and outside experts that inform where the product goes next

**What success looks like**

* The PCC team, our key customers, and leadership trust you and support your roadmap
* You've shipped improvements to PCC and can show their effect on customer outcomes

**What We're Looking For:**

* Mastery of navigating enterprise products/solutions through the full product lifecycle
* 8+ years of product management experience, much of it on enterprise B2B or SaaS products
* A record of shipping quickly, with results you can point to
* Experience setting direction across multiple teams without having direct authority over them
* Hands-on experience building products that depend on data, analytics, and machine learning, including generative AI or LLM-based features

### **About This Team**

The Jobs team builds products to help job seekers find their perfect job, especially when it comes to remote work, WFH and flexible jobs. Our mission is to provide best-in-class tools that drive the best outcomes for our customers and long-term value for our brand. This role is specifically for our ExpertApply product. ExpertApply is our AI-powered job search automation product which applies to relevant job openings based on a candidate's profile.

* **Strategic Ownership:** Develop and execute a high-impact product roadmap for ExpertApply, partnering with leadership, Engineering, Design, Marketing, and Analytics to achieve core business goals.
* **Mobile-First Growth:** Champion a mobile-first strategy to optimize the application funnel, drive adoption and retention, and ultimately spearhead the launch of our dedicated mobile app.

* **Experience:** 6-10 years of consumer-facing Product Management experience.

* **Collaborative Leadership:** A history of cross-functional team building, exceptional communication skills, and the ability to thrive in a globally distributed, remote work environment.

jobs.title: Staff Product Manager, Student Experience
jobs.desc:
About Stepful :

Stepful is a workforce platform redefining how America's largest health systems build, train, and retain their talent. Since our founding in 2021, Stepful’s trained over 32,000 practice-ready healthcare workers.

Layering onto our successful direct-to-consumer training, Stepful partners with leading healthcare institutions to address the growing national shortage of healthcare workers. We’re improving access to quality healthcare for everyone, everywhere, and improving access to healthcare career ladders for those who need them most.

Our students form the talent pipelines for major employers such as NY-Presbyterian, Mt. Sinai, HCA, Providence, CVS, and Walgreens. We have partnerships with half of the top 10 health systems in the US and are in process with many more.

Stepful is backed by Y Combinator, Reach Capital, and AlleyCorp, with a recent $55M Series C led by Oak HC/FT. We were named the #1 EdTech company in the U.S. by TIME for 2025.

Our values :

We credit much of our success to our exceptional team. We’re looking for mission-driven builders who thrive in fast-paced, ambiguous environments, and embody our four core values:

  • Care first : We do whatever it takes for our students to succeed.

  • Learn quickly : We test, learn with data, and iterate.

  • Build together : We win when we rely on each other.

  • Own it : We show up, take initiative, and show pride.

The opportunity:

Thousands of adult learners come to Stepful to change their lives, often while balancing full-time jobs, families, and financial pressure. Our Student Experience teams build the classroom experience for all of our learners. Every step of their journey matters, from their first day of class through graduation, certification and final licensing exams. As the Product Manager for Student Experience, you'll own the product that carries them through that journey. You won't just optimize what exists. You'll question it, rethink how we deliver outcomes, and build experiences that help more students finish, get certified, and get hired.

This role reports directly to the Senior Director, Product Management and partners closely with the Student Experience team, including student success coaches, instructors, and career services, as well as design, engineering, data, and marketing.

This is a hybrid opportunity based out of our NYC office, requiring three days/week (Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday) in office.

What you'll do:

  • Own the product strategy and roadmap for the end-to-end student experience for both our D2C and B2B2C business, from onboarding and live instruction through graduation.

  • Challenge long-held assumptions about how students learn and progress, and bring bold, evidence-backed ideas for improving completion, certification pass rates, and job outcomes.

  • Partner closely with the Student Experience team to understand where students get stuck, and decide what should be solved with product, with process, or with people.

  • Talk to students regularly through interviews, usability sessions, and feedback loops so their real needs shape what we build.

  • Run a disciplined experimentation program with A/B tests and rapid prototypes to learn quickly and scale what works.

  • Collaborate with designers and engineers to ship intuitive, mobile-friendly experiences for learners who are often studying on the go.

Our Draper, Utah, location, nestled in the heart of the Salt Lake Valley, connects us to a rapidly growing tech ecosystem and provides access to the outdoor lifestyle and natural beauty the region is known for.

Join Our Team as a ***Senior Product Manager***

If you’re a product leader who is tired of slow decision-making, fragmented ownership, and ideas that never get implemented—this is your opportunity to do it differently.

At Orion180, Senior Product Managers don’t just manage and maintain insurance products. You own a portfolio, shape strategy, and directly influence growth and profitability in some of our most critical states. This is a role where your decisions matter—and where you will see the impact of those decisions quickly.

***Ideally this role will be located in Melbourne, FL, but we will consider hybrid/remote candidates***

* Own the full rate and product lifecycle across assigned states—from strategy through regulatory approval, if needed, to market impact
* Lead pricing strategy aligned with profitability goals, competitive positioning, and long-term enterprise growth

* Drive complex product initiatives that improve underwriting outcomes, quoting experience, and policy issuance efficiency
* Use data to win — leveraging internal analytics, competitive insights, and emerging trends to stay ahead of the market
* Build and execute a product roadmap that balances speed, rigor, and business impact
* Partner deeply across the organization (actuarial, underwriting, claims, data science, technology) to deliver scalable, integrated solutions
* Identify and unlock strategic opportunities across automation, data optimization, customer insights, and distribution expansion
* Mentor and elevate the team, helping develop the next generation of product leaders
* Continuously improve portfolio performance, driving measurable results in growth, loss ratio, and operational efficiency

This role will own one of our most important and visible states, making it a key driver of company performance and strategy.

**WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR:**

We’re looking for someone who wants more than execution — someone who wants ownership, influence, and impact.

* Bachelor’s degree in mathematics, business, statistics, economics, actuarial science, insurance, or equivalent experience

* 8–12+ years of P&C insurance experience in product management, pricing, actuarial, or similar roles
* Deep understanding of ratemaking, regulatory environments, and product lifecycle management
* Proven ability to lead complex initiatives end-to-end in a fast-moving environment
* Strong strategic thinker with the ability to translate data into actionable decis

jobs.desc:
**Hi! We're Forerunner.**
-------------------------

We're on a mission to help communities adapt to a changing world. Forerunner builds modern, easy-to-use software for the people who keep communities running. Local governments, federal agencies, and infrastructure operators use Forerunner to run inspections, enforce codes, manage public works, respond to disasters, and meet their regulatory obligations.

**About the role**
------------------

We're looking for a **Senior Product Manager** to lead product for the Field Intelligence team.

You’ll own the strategy and roadmap for how Forerunner helps field teams understand what needs attention, capture trustworthy information, and turn their findings into action. This includes mobile and offline workflows, AI-guided inspections, geospatial context, photo and voice capture, operational visibility, and the connection between field observations and downstream compliance or corrective-action workflows.

This is a high-ownership role for a hands-on product builder who enjoys getting close to users, making sense of complicated operational environments, and turning that understanding into clear product direction and tangible solutions. Depending on the problem, that might mean sketching a workflow, building a lightweight prototype with modern tools, digging into usage data, writing detailed product behavior, or working directly with customers to test the riskiest assumption.

You’ll work closely with Engineering and Design from discovery through delivery, while partnering with Customer Success, Sales, and Marketing to ensure what we build is adopted and creates measurable value.

**What you’ll do**
------------------

* Own the product strategy, roadmap, and outcomes for Field Intelligence, from work planning and data capture through review, follow-up, and resolution.
* Spend time with inspectors, field crews, program managers, and operational leaders to understand how work happens in practice.
* Identify the highest-leverage opportunities for AI to improve fieldwork while preserving user control, transparency, and trust.
* Partner closely with Engineering and Design to frame problems, evaluate tradeoffs, define requirements, and ship polished end-to-end experiences across mobile and web.
* Define how we measure success, including adoption, task completion, data quality, time saved, issue-resolution time, and customer outcomes.
* Lead product discovery through interviews, workflow observation, prototypes, pilots, usage data, and structured experimentation.
* Balance immediate customer needs with investments in shared platform capabilities, reliability, and long-term product differentiation.
* Develop thoughtful rollout and change-management plans for workflows used in regulated and operationally critical environments.
* Equip Customer Success, Sales, and Marketing with a clear product narrative, launch materials, demonstrations, and the context needed to support adoption.
* Communicate priorities, decisions, risks, and learnings clearly across the company.

**What we’re looking for**
--------------------------

* 5+ years of product management experience, including meaningful ownership of a complex product area from discovery through launch and iteration.
* Excellent product judgment. You can separate urgent requests from durable needs, make sound decisions with incomplete information, and turn ambiguous problems into focused product bets.
* A builder’s mindset. You don’t stop at setting direction or managing delivery. You use prototypes, data, workflow models, technical exploration, and other hands-on methods to learn quickly and help the team arrive at a better product.
* Experience shipping AI-powered product experiences to real users. You understand what it takes to make them trustworthy in production, including evaluation, failure modes, guardrails, and iteration based on real-world behavior.
* Strong customer instincts and experience learning from users whose work is operational

jobs.desc:
**The Role:**

As a digitally native company, Minted's Shopping Experience and commerce platform are core to the company's success. Minted's online shopping experience allows consumers to discover, customize, and purchase from an extensive assortment of products and categories, all designed by independent artists around the world. We are driven by creating a customer journey that serves both our artist community and the savvy e-commerce shopper.

We are seeking a Lead Product Manager to own the strategy for how customers find and choose products on Minted. Over the next two years, we are integrating a new product information management platform, which will give us structured, machine-readable data about our product catalog. That data supports a set of experiences we cannot build today: search and browse that understand what a customer is looking for, product detail and category pages generated from product attributes, and filtered navigation that is fully crawlable. Combined with parallel investments in analytics, customer data, and content management, it is the foundation for conversational shopping and for deep personalization later. This role decides what we build on that foundation, in what order, and why.

The role spans our discovery surfaces (search, browse, category, and product detail) and our conversion optimization program, with dependencies running into product data, customization and rendering, checkout, and marketing. You will set the strategy and objectives for your pod, lead initiatives that cross pod and functional boundaries, and raise the standard of product craft for the PMs around you.

### **You will:**

* Set the strategy for Minted's discovery experience in partnership with engineering and design: where to play and how to win across search, browse, category, and product detail. Derive it from business strategy, the competitive environment, behavioral data, test results, customer insight, and technical constraints and capabilities.
* Prioritize the growth levers that move our targets, then prioritize the customer problems that move those levers, then consider the solution space. Up-level the organization by holding that sequence when others want to start with solutions.
* Set the objectives, key results, roadmap, and initiative scope consistent with that strategy, along with the sequencing and the resourcing implications. Carry a two-year planning view alongside the near-term roadmap.
* Own and continuously maintain the prioritized list of customer problems across your surfaces, keeping it current with fresh behavioral data, user research, customer support and concierge signals, session replay, dogfooding, and competitive scans.
* Define the strategy for turning our new product data foundation into customer value, and lead its execution: attribute-driven search and browse, dynamic product detail and category pages, crawlable filtered navigation, and the groundwork for conversational shopping and deeply personalized discovery.
* Develop and lead initiative strategies that span multiple teams and functions, and resolve the dependencies and disagreements those initiatives create with other teams and with stakeholders.
* Shape solutions with engineering and design. You hold the business problem and the value case, design holds the experience, engineering holds feasibility and cost. Your job is to find the right-sized solution where the three meet.

Kiva is a global nonprofit, founded in 2005, with a mission to expand financial access and help underserved communities thrive. Kiva unlocks capital for borrowers through crowdfunded loans supported by individuals around the world. Impact first - This is why we exist. This is the drumbeat we march to. Every day.

jobs.desc:
Reports to: Chief Product Officer

Department: Product

FLSA Category: Exempt

Position Type: Full-Time, Senior level

Travel Requirement: 0-10%, Quarterly for meetings and customer engagements

Office Location: Remote, US Based

JOB SUMMARY

The Sr Product Manager, Growth will own the product strategy and execution required to acquire, activate, retain, and expand Clarvos customers. This leader will turn customer behavior, funnel data, and commercial priorities into product experiences that reduce churn, increase upsell and improve conversion across the customer lifecycle.

This role requires a hands-on growth product leader who has delivered measurable growth in an early-stage startup and can operate with limited structure, imperfect data, and changing priorities. The ideal candidate has built growth systems from the ground up, instrumented funnels, developed and tested hypotheses, and partnered directly with Engineering, Design, Data, Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success to convert insight into business results.

This is a high-autonomy individual-contributor role for a self-starter who can move fluidly between strategy, analytics, customer discovery, product requirements, experimentation, and delivery. The Sr Product Manager will be directly accountable for churn, upsell, and funnel performance, including acquisition-to-sign-up conversion, onboarding completion, activation, time-to-value, trial-to-paid conversion, engagement, renewal, and expansion.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS AND RESPONSIBILITIES

* Own the end-to-end growth product strategy and roadmap across acquisition, sign-up, onboarding, activation, engagement, retention, renewal, upsell, and expansion.
* Define the growth model, north-star metric, funnel stages, leading indicators, targets, and operating cadence required to improve customer and revenue outcomes.
* Instrument the customer funnel and establish reliable event definitions, dashboards, cohorts, and attribution methods in partnership with Data and Engineering.
* Identify the highest-impact growth constraints through quantitative analysis, customer research, behavioral data, support themes, and commercial feedback.
* Develop a prioritized experiment portfolio with explicit hypotheses, target segments, success measures, guardrails, sample-size considerations, and post-test decisions.
* Lead rapid experimentation across onboarding, education, feature discovery, pricing and packaging, upgrade prompts, lifecycle journeys, and re-engagement experiences.
* Reduce time-to-value and early-life churn by improving the path from account creation to the first successful campaign and repeat product value.
* Build product-led and assisted expansion experiences that increase subscription upgrades, add-on adoption, cross-sell, and customer lifetime value without degrading trust or product experience.
* Develop churn-prevention capabilities using health signals, cohort behavior, cancellation reasons, product usage, and predictive indicators of disengagement or renewal risk.
* Own detailed product requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, edge cases, rollout plans, and measurement plans for growth initiatives.
* Partner closely with Engineering and Design throughout discovery and implementation, making informed scope and technical tradeoffs while maintaining a high quality bar.
* Work with Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, Support, and Finance to connect acquisition sources, product behavior, assisted touchpoints, retention, expansion, and revenue performance.
* Create customer segmentation and cohort strategies that enable relevant onboarding, recommendations, lifecycle experiences, offers, and upgrade paths.
* Establish structured learning loops that turn experiment results, customer evidence, and operating data into roadmap and go-to-market decisions.
* Communicate growth strategy, priorities, tradeoffs, experiment results, risks, and realized business impact clearly to executive and cross-functional stakeholders.

For more than 65 years, we've turned big ideas into solutions that help protect homes, strengthen businesses and build a more resilient, efficient, sustainable energy future.

Ready to Power a Smarter World with us?

Working across marketing, sales, engineering, operations, and customer-facing teams, you will translate complex business needs into clear product requirements, build and prioritize epics, and drive execution with development teams. jobs.desc:
**About Pearl**

Founded in 2013, Pearl is a ratings and standards company building the national standard for home performance. Pearl SCORE™ rates every single-family home in the U.S. across five key pillars — Safety, Comfort, Operations, Resilience, and Energy — so homebuyers, homeowners, and real estate professionals can understand how a home performs in daily life.

Today, the value of a home is judged by its location, size, and aesthetics— but these factors overlook the home’s most important function: safeguarding the comfort, well-being, and finances of the people inside. Most American homes underperform in these regards because home performance is simply not on our radar. We can’t see it, quantify it, or put a value on it. Pearl aims to change that by making home performance a central part of how we view and value our homes.

We are not a home inspector, a contractor, a real estate platform, or a green-certification program — we rate homes against a transparent, evidence-based standard so that home performance becomes visible, measurable, and valuable in the real estate market.

As a Certified B Corporation, we're accountable not only to our shareholders, but also to the homeowners and communities we serve. For more information, visit pearlscore.com.

**About the role**

**Pearl PRO** is the professional side of Pearl's platform: the web and mobile app that real estate agents use to bring Pearl Score into their listings, client conversations, and daily workflow. As Pearl expands its footprint with agents and brokerages, Pearl PRO is a critical growth engine and one of the company's most active areas of product investment.

The **Senior Product Manager for Pearl PRO** will own the product end to end - strategy, roadmap, discovery, and delivery - for Pearl's real estate professional-facing app across web and mobile. Reporting to the SVP Product, this is a **full-stack product ownership** role: you are the **single accountable owner** for Pearl PRO's outcomes, not one contributor among several on a shared roadmap.

We're looking for someone who is genuinely energized by building consumer-grade digital products - clean, intuitive, fast experiences - and who wants to apply that bar to a professional, workflow-heavy user base. Real estate agents are busy, mobile-first, and unforgiving of friction; they'll only adopt a tool that fits how they already work and clearly makes them more effective with clients. This role requires a **sharp sense for professional user needs** alongside the product craft usually reserved for consumer apps.

You'll work closely with a dedicated designer and engineering lead/squad on Pearl PRO, plus Data Science & Standards (to translate Pearl Score and scoring concepts into clear, trustworthy agent-facing experiences) and Business Development/Customer Success (to keep the roadmap grounded in what's winning and losing deals with brokerages and agents).

**What you'll do**

Product strategy & ownership

* Own the Pearl PRO product strategy and roadmap, in partnership with the SVP Product.
* Be the single point of accountability for Pearl PRO's outcomes - adoption, engagement, and agent/broker satisfaction.
* Make and defend prioritization calls, balancing agent needs, business goals, and delivery realities.

### **Consumer-grade product craft**

* Set and hold a high bar for UX quality across both the Pearl PRO web app and mobile app - the app should feel as considered as the best consumer products agents use every day, not like enterprise software.
* Drive end-to-end discovery: research, define, and validate solutions before committing engineering resources.
* Write clear specs and requirements that let design and engineering move fast without re-litigating scope.

### **Deep user understanding**

* Build and maintain a sharp, current understanding of real estate agents' workflows, incentives, and daily pressures - from listing prep through closing.

jobs.title: Group Product Manager, Industry Solutions
jobs.desc:
**At Inriver, we help brands deliver better product experiences - everywhere their customers are. From the first product detail to the final purchase decision, we make product information work smarter.**
  
  
Now we're looking for a **Group Product Manager, Industry Solutions** to be our platform expert in front of customers and our voice for B2B Manufacturing back into Product. This is a hybrid role - part Sales Engineering, part Product Management, part Solution Architect - for someone who loves being close to customers and close to product decisions at the same time. You'll represent Inriver in customer conversations such as RFPs, check-ins and events, and you'll represent our Ideal Customer Profile, B2B Manufacturing, inside Inriver. You'll bring back what you hear, and you'll influence roadmaps across teams to act on it. In some cases that means shaping what dev teams build next. In others, it means building the answer yourself, configuring templates and solutions using the Inriver platform's own extensibility (including MCPs) to show what's possible, no dev resources required. This role reports to the SVP of Product Management.

### **Why you'll love this role**

* Be the platform expert in the room: Demoing Inriver, answering the hard questions, and representing product in RFPs, customer check-ins, and events
* Become our resident expert on B2B Manufacturing, our Ideal Customer Profile, and bring that signal directly into product decisions
* Work hands-on with the platform's extensibility features and prototyping tools to create solutions yourself, not just spec them for someone else
* Sit at the intersection of Sales, Partners, and Product, with real influence over what gets built.
* Join a company with strong product ambitions and a friendly, down-to-earth culture.

**What you’ll do**
------------------

* Represent the Inriver platform in customer-facing settings - RFP processes, existing customer check-ins, events, and partner conversations
* Deliver product demos that speak credibly to both business and technical stakeholders
* Gather structured feedback from customers and partners, and translate it into clear input for Product Management
* Build deep expertise in B2B Manufacturing as our ICP; their workflows, data challenges, and buying criteria
* Influence roadmap priorities across product teams by bringing evidence, not just requests
* Identify where customer needs can be met through configuration and templates rather than new development, and prototype those solutions yourself
* Partner closely with Sales, Partner teams, Marketing, and Customer Success to keep the product story sharp and consistent

**What you’ll bring**
---------------------

We don’t expect you to tick every box - but we think you’ll succeed here if you have many of the below:

️ 5-10 years of experience in a hybrid role spanning Sales Engineering, Product Management, or Solution Development, or strong exposure to more than one of these disciplines

️ Comfort presenting and demoing complex software to customers, from technical buyers to business stakeholders

️ A builder's mindset: you'd rather configure a working prototype than write a requirements doc about one

️ Experience within B2B Manufacturing

️ Familiarity with platform extensibility concepts (APIs, low-code configurators, MCPs, or similar), or eagerness to get hands-on with them

️ Strong communication skills: equally comfortable in an RFP response, a customer workshop, or a roadmap review

️ A collaborative mindset: you bring structure, curiosity, and follow-through

️ Willingness to travel occasionally for customer sites, team meet-ups and events

### **Why Inriver**

At Inriver, you'll join a global company with a product at the center - and people who genuinely care about building something meaningful together. Here you'll get:

* A role with real visibility: to customers, to partners, and to the product roadmap
* The chance to shape how B2B Manufacturing customers experience

##### **Integration meets Innovation**

At Celigo, we believe integration should empower — not exhaust — innovation. As a modern Integration and Automation Platform (iPaaS), we're on a mission to simplify how companies integrate, automate, and optimize processes. Powered by game-changing technology like runtime AI and prebuilt, mission-critical integrations, Celigo is redefining how businesses connect their world.

Celigo is looking for a **Principal Product Manager - Customer Zero** to own the highest-leverage program in the company: running Celigo on Celigo. When GTO operates on our own platform across GTM, CX, and G&A systems, we become our own best customer. We discover what's hard before customers find it, feed it directly into Product, and give Sales a credible, live reference in every deal. This role is the dedicated owner of that program, end-to-end.

##### **What would you do if hired?**

* Own the Customer Zero program as a funded initiative with a real roadmap, clear outcomes, and an operating rhythm that holds across competing priorities. You set the pace, define what done looks like, and keep the work alive without needing someone to push it. You measure yourself by business value delivered, not by meetings held.
* Drive adoption of Celigo's own products (agents, MCP, Ora/CLI, integrations) inside GTO's GTM, CX, and G&A systems. When you run into friction, you dig into it before being asked. Surface what's genuinely hard, prioritize it, and shepherd it into Product's roadmap in partnership with the CPO's org.
* Use Celigo's AI-powered platform as part of how you work every day. You will be one of the first people inside the company to push on new agentic capabilities, give Product honest feedback on where they deliver and where they fall short, and help define what "AI-first" actually looks like inside an enterprise workflow. Your daily use is part of the feedback loop.
* Bring product discipline to every workstream: defined requirements, clear success criteria, and prioritization grounded in adoption and business value. Committed dates should hold because you've done the thinking up front, shipping the smallest version that delivers real value and iterating from there rather than waiting for a perfect build.
* Operate in both hats simultaneously: design the underlying business processes and own the solution as a product manager. You're the person who figures out how the process should work and the person accountable for whether what ships delivers an outstanding experience.
* Weigh user needs against security, privacy, and governance considerations (RBAC, permissions, service accounts), making trade-offs deliberately rather than after the fact. Build the prescriptive playbook Product and Sales need: governance patterns, reference architectures, and proof points that hold up in enterprise conversations.
* Be the external face of how Celigo runs on Celigo. Present at flagship events, join key customer and prospect conversations, and package our internal use into references Sales can put in front of prospects and existing customers. Enable Product Marketing and Sales to scale the story beyond you.

##### **Who are we looking for?**

* You ship the smallest version that delivers real value and iterate on real feedback. A 10-slide internal use case that lands in one deal is better than a perfect playbook no one has read. You recover quickly when something doesn't land, without drama.

**About RocketRez:**  
RocketRez is the revenue maximization platform behind boat tours, theme parks, zoos, and other attractions and experience operators. Operators run their businesses on us: ticketing, capacity, memberships, point of sale, web stores, and the data that tells them how how to grow their business.
  
  
**The role:**  
**You'll own a product domain end to end:** its outcomes, its roadmap, its customers, and the case for where engineering time goes. You'll work in a trio with a designer and engineering, from discovery through launch and long-term growth.
  
This is not a backlog-grooming role. You'll be handed a business problem and held accountable for what moved, including what you chose not to build.
  
  
**Where it will sit:**  
**One idea runs through every domain:** operators move more of their business onto RocketRez when they trust us with their busiest day. Features earn that trust, and trust shows up as revenue. Your job is to find the changes that strengthen it and prove they did.
  
The domains you own will depend on where the business needs you and where your strengths fit. The outcomes below are illustrative. We'll set specific ones with you in your first weeks.
  
Core Ticketing. The fundamental building blocks operators use to turn their experiences into sellable products: single-use, multi-use and reloadable tickets; recurring products like memberships and donations; auto-renewing passes; timed, multi-date and multi-pack admissions; assigned seating; bundles and cross-sells. It also covers how those products are priced, from discounts and upsells to dynamic, usage-based and channel-specific pricing. For operators, this is how new products come to life, capturing more demand and maximizing the revenue of every sale. You'd answer for how quickly operators can launch new products and how much revenue each sale captures.
  
**Distribution. How operators' products get sold:** white-label ecommerce for each operator, RocketRez point of sale at the front gate, OTAs, and third-party sales partners. The work is building systems that make it as easy as possible for a guest to discover what an operator offers, find the best product for them, and complete the sale as quickly as possible. You'd answer for conversion by channel, attach rate, and throughput on peak days.
  
Ancillary Revenue. Revenue beyond admission, like food and beverage and retail, including the build-vs-partner calls that decide how we enter each line. You'd answer for ancillary revenue per guest, and for deals won because we can serve a broader range of operators.
  
  
**What you'll do:**  
**Strategy and roadmap• Own the roadmap:** sizing, sequencing, and what gets cut, even when the CEO or a major customer is asking for it. Engineering is a shared pool, not a dedicated squad, so make an evidence-backed case for your domain's claim on capacity and show that it paid off.
  

* Know the market well enough to say which gaps are worth closing, and shape pricing and packaging, not just scope.

Discovery, delivery and measurement• Spend real time with operators, like a zoo on a holiday weekend or a tour operator selling through OTAs. Tell a truly painful workflow from a merely unfamiliar one.
  

* Define success before you build, including instrumentation that doesn't exist yet. Measure behaviour change, not adoption.
* Write requirements engineering can estimate against, in plain language.
* Be willing to conclude that a thesis is wrong, and say so plainly.

As a Senior PM, you'll• Raise the decision quality of other PMs through review, pairing and mentoring, and contribute to hiring.
  

* Be the escalation point for cross-domain conflict, not the escalator.

We hire PMs who lean toward one of two archetypes. Tell us which one sounds like you.

jobs.desc:
Working at Atlassian

Atlassians can choose where they work whether in an office, from home, or a combination of the two. That way, Atlassians have more control over supporting their family, personal goals, and other priorities. We can hire people in any country where we have a legal entity.

About DX

DX is the developer intelligence platform. We help engineering leaders understand how work gets done, improve developer experience, and make better decisions about productivity and AI. DX combines self-reported insights from developers with data from the systems where software work happens, then turns those signals into insights teams can act on.

The role

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to lead DX's data platform and connector portfolio.

The data platform is the foundation beneath every DX insight. It connects to the tools our customers use, ingests and organizes their data, protects its integrity, and makes it available to the rest of the DX product. You will own the product direction and outcomes for Data Cloud, our connector ecosystem, core data integrity, and the data infrastructure behind our demo environment.

This is a deeply technical product role. You do not need to be an engineer, but you must be able to reason credibly about connectors, APIs, data models, database design, data lakes, reliability, enterprise data requirements, and data privacy/security. You will turn that understanding into a data platform that customers and internal product teams can trust.

What you'll do

  • Set the vision, strategy, roadmap, and measurable outcomes for DX's Data Cloud and connector ecosystem.
  • Prioritize connector investments using customer demand, market context, strategic leverage, and the needs of downstream DX products.
  • Improve the end-to-end connector experience, including setup, authentication, configuration, data mapping, sync health, and troubleshooting.
  • Define product requirements for data quality, freshness, completeness, reliability, and transparency.
  • Partner closely with Engineering on the evolution of DX's unified data layer while maintaining a clear boundary between product direction and technical design.
  • Own the product capabilities that keep DX's demo environment representative, reliable, and useful.
  • Build a deep understanding of enterprise data environments, security constraints, integration patterns, and the teams responsible for them.
  • Shape ambiguous opportunities with lightweight specs, prototypes, and clear written context before the team commits to a solution.
  • Know how the platform is performing across connector adoption, time to value, reliability, and customer satisfaction; investigate problems and drive the right improvements.
  • Partner with customer-facing and go-to-market teams on connector discovery, pilots, launches, documentation, and positioning.

**Company Description**

At Nielsen, we are passionate about our work to power a better media future for all people by providing powerful insights that drive client decisions and deliver extraordinary results. Our talented, global workforce is dedicated to capturing audience engagement with content - wherever and whenever it’s consumed. Together, we are proudly rooted in our deep legacy as we stand at the forefront of the media revolution. When you join Nielsen, you will join a dynamic team committed to excellence, perseverance, and the ambition to make an impact together. We champion you, because when you succeed, we do too. We enable your best to power our future.

 **Job Description**

This opportunity is for Nielsen’s Gracenote division - the premier entertainment metadata company in the world, powering the search, discovery, and navigation systems for the globe's biggest tech, automotive, and media giants.

As entertainment becomes more fragmented and AI reshapes the way people discover and engage with content, trusted data and technology are powering the future and are the foundation for better experiences. In partnership with our clients and by fully embracing AI, we are reinventing the business, products and teams to capture a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity which will significantly impact the media and entertainment ecosystem as a whole.

Gracenote's identifiers and normalized metadata have powered content identification, search, and discovery across the media ecosystem for decades. We are now extending that structured foundation from the title level down to the scene, chapter, and clip level, using multimodal AI to derive rich, queryable understanding directly from video.

We are looking for a Senior Product Marketing Manager to support this team and own go-to-market for the portfolio end to end: the portfolio narrative, the segment-level positioning, the launches, the enablement, and the market intelligence that shapes how we go to market. This is a build-it role, not a maintain-it role. You will help shape a market while it is still forming, and most of what exists twelve months from now will be work you created.

**Responsibilities:**

Positioning, narrative, and messaging

* Category definition. Author the market narrative for scene-level video intelligence: the problem, why now, why a shared platform beats point solutions, and why Gracenote is uniquely positioned to provide it.
* Segment-level value propositions. Translate one platform story into distinct, credible propositions for platform and distribution buyers, content owners, and the advertising ecosystem, each with its own economics, buying committee, and proof points.
* Messaging architecture. Build and maintain the messaging house, proof-point library, and terminology standards, and hold the organization to consistent language across product, sales, partnerships, and corporate marketing.

Market, customer, and competitive intelligence

* Competitive program. Maintain a living view of AI video-understanding vendors, platform-native capabilities, and adjacent metadata and ad-tech players. Frame the platform-versus-toolkit distinction in terms buyers actually feel: time to value, integration cost, and cost of ownership at full catalog scale.
* Voice of the customer. Run a structured discovery cadence with prospects, design partners, and internal commercial teams. Convert conversations into documented segment insight rather than anecdote.

jobs.title: Principal Product Manager - Data Products and Analytics
jobs.desc:
**About Vehlo:**

We started Vehlo in 2019 with a simple goal: to be the industry’s favorite provider of repair shop technology.

Across every part of the auto repair industry, Vehlo is igniting vehicle service success with software and financial solutions that unlock your potential. Our founder-led products power the entire service lane experience and keep customers coming back with streamlined tools that help you handle communication, workflow automation, touchless payments, valet pickup, and much more. We’re out to simplify the customer journey from start to finish and give power back to the people under the hood, making their jobs easier and your shop more profitable —just ask our over 30,000 customers, who generate more than 60M annual repair orders, and process over $12B in payments volume annually. At Vehlo, our only purpose is your success, and together, we’re reaching your goals faster than ever.

Being a Veep comes with more than a comprehensive benefits package—our biggest benefit is opportunity: Opportunity to make an impact, opportunity for growth, and opportunity for recognition and rewards. This is not a mega-corporation where you wonder what people are doing all day - every Veep is moving the ball forward day in, day out for our customers or for each other.

**About This Role:**

We're looking for a Principal Product Manager to own our customer-facing data, analytics and insights portfolio end to end. Most of our customers buy more than one Vehlo product and then cobble together other solutions to assemble the 360-degree view of their business that we don't yet give them natively.

Closing that gap is the starting point, but the bigger opportunity is what we build on top of it. We're not looking for someone to ship more dashboards. More value will come from AI-powered insights that tell an operator what's happening in their business and what to do about it, without them having to know what to ask.

At Vehlo, a Principal Product role is senior, highly visible, and hands-on, reporting to the SVP of Product. You won't have direct reports on day one, but that could change as we grow the business. You'll own strategy and set the pace of play while leading through partners in engineering, analytics, customer success and go-to-market. You'll drive the commercial model as well as the product: what it costs us to serve, what belongs in which tier, and what customers pay for.

**What You'll Do:**

* New AI-powered insight products, built zero to one: surfacing what an operator would never have thought to ask, explaining why a number moved, predicting what's coming, and recommending the next action, delivered inside the workflow rather than in a separate analytics destination.
* The premium analytics product line end to end: reporting and dashboard experiences, alerting, natural-language reporting, and meaningful additions to the basic reporting built into individual products.
* The cross-product view: one unified analytics experience spanning a customer's entire Vehlo footprint.
* Data delivery beyond the dashboard: APIs, MCP surfaces, exports, warehouse sharing, BI connectors, and the access model that governs which customer sees which data.
* The semantic layer and the metric definitions inside it, across products that were built separately and don't yet agree with each other.
* Pricing, packaging, and unit economics: cost-to-serve per location, what's free because it drives retention, and what's genuinely a paid tier.
* Aggregate benchmarking and market-intelligence products built from our repair data, along with the data-rights and aggregation model that makes them defensible.
* Data quality and customer trust as measured product outcomes, so we reinforce trust and value in the market.

**In your first 90 days**

* Align the teams on a governance model so everyone knows what every number in our analytics product means and where it comes from.
* Build a cost-to-serve model per location that our finance team accepts.

The team is solving hard product and technical problems across memory generation, freshness, retrieval, serving, evaluation, transparency, safety, privacy, latency, and cost.

**Description**

Recognized as the No. 1 site trusted by real estate professionals, Realtor.com® has been at the forefront of online real estate for over 25 years, connecting buyers, sellers, and renters with trusted insights and expert guidance to find their perfect home. Through its robust suite of tools, Realtor.com® not only makes a significant impact on the real estate industry at large, but for consumers, navigating the biggest purchase they will make in their life, by providing a user experience that is easy to use, easy to understand, and most of all, easy to make decisions.

Join us on our mission to empower more people to find their way home by breaking barriers to entry, making the right connections, and building confidence through expert guidance.

Every lead sent to our premium customers is vetted and live-transferred to an agent through our Concierge Call Center, and which agent gets that lead is decided by a matching model that increasingly encodes customer-specific business rules, for example price-point eligibility or agent tier restrictions.

This role owns that matching model and everything downstream of it: the agent handoff experience, and the smaller product issues premium customers currently experience as bugs in that flow. You'll have a dedicated engineering team building this with you, and you'll work closely with the teams that own the customer-facing applications where these rules surface.

**What you'll own**
-------------------

* The matching model: which agent receives a vetted lead, including customer-configurable eligibility and preference rules (e.g. price-point-based agent restrictions) that surface in customer-facing applications.
* Answer-to-Claim and the agent handoff experience: the flow from a vetted lead to a claimed, worked lead.
* Smaller improvements: fixes and refinements to issues premium customers currently perceive as bugs in the handoff experience.
* Claim Rate and Assignment Rate: the two funnel metrics that roll up, together with the Call Center Platform PM's metrics, into overall Live Transfer Rate.

**What you won't own today**
----------------------------

Call-center infrastructure sits with the Call Center Platform PM today. As the two roles mature this scope could expand to include call-center infrastructure.

**What you'll do**
------------------

* Own the roadmap for the matching mechanism in close collaboration with the customer experience teams, prioritized against Claim Rate and Assignment Rate impact
* Partner with engineering to turn customer-specific eligibility and preference rules into scalable configuration, not one-off logic per customer.
* Work with the teams owning customer-facing applications to ship the surfaces where customers set or see their matching rules.
* Triage and prioritize the smaller features premium customers experience as bugs in the handoff flow, and decide what's a quick fix versus a roadmap item.
* Track and report on Claim Rate and Assignment Rate, and how they roll up into overall Live Transfer Rate.
* Coordinate with the Call Center Platform PM to keep the boundary between matching logic and call-center execution clean, and help redraw that boundary if the role's scope expands.
* Represent this domain in planning, prioritization, and leadership reviews.

**Education & Experience**
--------------------------

* 8+ years of Product Management experience with a track record of owning complex business logic or decisioning systems, not just user-facing features.
* Experience working in marketplaces or lead-gen models where allocation, matching, or eligibility rules directly affect revenue.
* Comfort translating customer-facing configuration needs (pricing tiers, eligibility rules) into product and engineering requirements.
* A track record of driving measurable funnel metrics (conversion, claim, assignment, or similar) rather than shipping features and hoping they help.
* Strong cross-functional partnership skills. You'll coordinate closel

We’re excited about the future of moving, and if you’re passionate about delighting customers in a rapidly evolving space, this role is for you!

  

A Day in The Life

Here at PODS, our product teams work closely with engineering, design, and business partners to solve customer problems and deliver measurable results. You will turn a long-term vision into prioritized initiatives, clear requirements, and actionable user stories, working in an Agile environment to deliver improvements iteratively. You will use data, customer research, market insights, and frontline feedback to identify opportunities and test assumptions. Day to day, you will align stakeholders, make tradeoffs, manage dependencies, and support product launches and operational readiness. * **Authenticity** — The commitment to be steadfast and genuine with our actions and communication toward everyone we touch.
* **Curiosity** — The belief that a deep and fundamental curiosity (the "why") in our work is vital to company innovation and evolution.
* **Focus** — The collective will to remain completely devoted and ultimately accountable to our deliverables.

* **Happiness** — The decision to prioritize passion and love for what we do above everything else.

------------

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to own the strategy, roadmap, and delivery of our Regulatory Reporting products. You'll sit at the intersection of regulation, investment data, and technology, translating complex and changing regulatory requirements into scalable, client-ready product capabilities. You'll work closely with engineering and data teams and engage directly with internal teams and external clients to make sure our solutions meet their compliance obligations.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Data Infrastructure
jobs.desc:
For over 30 years, Angi has powered the future of the home services industry, creating an environment where homeowners and pros benefit from more jobs done well.

For homeowners, our platform is a reliable way to find skilled pros. For pros, we're a reliable business partner who helps them find the winnable work they want, when they want. For employees, we're an amazing place to call home. We can't wait to welcome you.

**Angi at a glance:**

* Founded in 1995 as Angie’s List and rebranded in 2021
* Global company with 9 brands in 8 countries and employees worldwide
* Homeowners have turned to us for 300 million home projects and counting

**About the Team**
------------------

Data Infrastructure builds the platform that every other data team stands on: access to shared data, orchestration, data ingestion, and the retirement of systems the company has outgrown. Every layer of this platform exists to make it easier for a homeowner to hire an Angi Pro, on one certified source of truth that people and AI agents can trust equally.

The team's strategy is built around one idea: this platform should feel like a self-service product, not a ticket queue, for the engineers and analysts who depend on it, and increasingly for the AI agents who depend on it too. Angi is moving toward AI agents as a normal way of building and operating, and every agent that touches company data comes through this platform first.

This role stewards that platform's product direction.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

**Product Management**

* Manage governed platform access - give engineers, analysts, and services safe, auditable access to shared data, and make the safe path the easy path.
* Streamline orchestration and scheduling - bring fragmented scheduling tools together into one system every team reaches for by default, and use AI-assisted tooling to migrate jobs faster, with less manual engineering effort.
* Drive data ingestion and replication - define what self-service ingestion looks like for teams who want to bring their own data onto the platform, and build toward that.
* Oversee legacy system retirement - close out systems that are no longer the source of truth, with clear ownership handed off at every step.
* Optimize compute cost efficiency - find where cost comes from habit rather than real need, and bring it down without anyone losing the developer experience they rely on.
* Advance compute strategy diversification - help move the platform toward a storage layer that works with more than one compute engine, so each workload runs on the engine built for it.
* Build the platform's AI-ready substrate - make agentic workflows safe by default, with the same governed access and audit trail for an agent as for a person.

**Execution and Individual Contribution**

* Use AI agents in your own daily work, set clear norms so the engineers and peers around you feel safe experimenting with agents and agentic workflows.
* Protect the team's focus and drive real rigor without micromanaging how the work gets done. Steward outcomes, not tasks.
* Build trust across engineering, domain teams, and leadership through empathetic, transparent, and clear communication when addressing complex challenges.
* Work closely with Data Engineering's other delivery teams - Data Mesh Enablement and Managed Data Products - and with the team building Angi's agentic workflows, toward one overall technical strategy.

**Who You Are**

**Position Summary**

The Senior Product Owner (PO) owns the vision, backlog, and delivery outcomes for one or more of Roeing’s public-sector software products. The Senior PO translates state and federal program requirements into a prioritized backlog, represents Roeing’s voice to the customer and the customer’s voice to internal delivery teams, and is accountable for maximizing product value across the full software development lifecycle. jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Airspace Monitoring Service
jobs.desc:
Hidden Level is building the future of airspace awareness. Our mission is to make the unseen visible by providing persistent, actionable awareness of the low-altitude airspace around critical infrastructure, borders, military installations, airports, major events, and communities.

Our technology brings together multiple sensing modalities and airspace data sources to detect and track cooperative and non-cooperative aircraft and UAS. Through our Airspace Monitoring Service (AMS), we transform that data into an operational picture that can be consumed directly through Hidden Level applications or integrated into the command-and-control systems our customers already use.

**Position Overview:**

As we expand, we are seeking a Sr. Product Manager, Airspace Monitoring Service (AMS) to own and advance the product vision, strategy, roadmap, and execution for one of Hidden Level's core offerings.

This role sits at the intersection of our customers, engineering teams, operations, and business. The Sr. Product Manager will develop a deep understanding of customer missions and workflows, translate those needs into scalable product capabilities, prioritize what we build and why, and work closely with cross-functional teams to bring those capabilities to market.

The successful candidate will be equally comfortable talking with an operator about how they use airspace data, working with engineers to define requirements and tradeoffs, analyzing product usage and performance, and communicating product strategy to company leadership.

**Location:**

This position may be based onsite or in a hybrid capacity at our Syracuse, NY office. Remote work may also be considered based on candidate location and business needs.

**Responsibilities:**

* Own the AMS Product Strategy and Roadmap

* Develop and maintain the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for AMS based on customer needs, market opportunities, company strategy, and technical capabilities.
* Define the problems we are solving, desired customer outcomes, and measures of success before determining specific product solutions.
* Prioritize product investments based on customer value, mission impact, technical feasibility, business value, and strategic differentiation.
* Maintain alignment between near-term customer commitments and the longer-term development of a scalable product.
* Represent the Customer and the Mission

* Develop a deep understanding of how defense, homeland security, public safety, and commercial customers use airspace awareness to support operational decisions.
* Spend time with customers and end users observing workflows, gathering feedback, and identifying unmet needs.
* Translate customer and operational requirements into clear product requirements and use cases for engineering teams.
* Distinguish between individual customer requests and capabilities that should become part of the broader AMS product.
* Drive Product Development

* Partner closely with Engineering Operations, Service, Deployment, Growth, and Customer Success throughout the product lifecycle.
* Define requirements, priorities, acceptance criteria, and desired outcomes for new capabilities.
* Make informed product tradeoffs when customer needs, technical constraints, schedule, and business priorities compete.
* Identify dependencies, risks, and decisions required to keep product development moving.
* Ensure teams understand not only what is being built, but why it matters to the customer.
* Measure Product Performance and Adoption

* Establish and monitor product metrics related to usage, adoption, performance, reliability, and customer outcomes.
* Use operational data, customer feedback, and product analytics to identify opportunities for improvement.
* Develop feedback loops between deployed systems, customers, and product development.
* Evaluate whether delivered capabilities are solving the intended customer problem and adjust the roadmap accordingly.
* Support Product Introduction and Growth

jobs.desc:
**Description**

Recognized as the No. 1 site trusted by real estate professionals, Realtor.com® has been at the forefront of online real estate for over 25 years, connecting buyers, sellers, and renters with trusted insights and expert guidance to find their perfect home. Through its robust suite of tools, Realtor.com® not only makes a significant impact on the real estate industry at large, but for consumers, navigating the biggest purchase they will make in their life, by providing a user experience that is easy to use, easy to understand, and most of all, easy to make decisions.

Join us on our mission to empower more people to find their way home by breaking barriers to entry, making the right connections, and building confidence through expert guidance.

**About the Role:**

We're seeking a **Senior Manager of Product** to lead multiple squads within Experience Delivery in the Client Product Management organization. You'll own the delivery, quality, and growth of a multidisciplinary team holding the craft and evidence bar, developing your senior ICs into leaders, and protecting the role boundaries that keep your team doing its highest-value work.

This role sits at the intersection of people leadership, craft quality, and delivery. You understand the strategic intent behind your area's work and translate it into team focus, staffing, and operating objectives. You'll drive decisions across your squads: where an IC is ready to stretch vs. where they need support, when the evidence bar has been met vs. when work is built on assumption, and when a craft miss is a coaching moment vs. when it stops a launch. You'll push back when work is committed without the evidence to support it, and when unstaffed functions start landing on your team. You build the team that owns the experience, you hold the gate on what ships, and you hold the line on what your team should never have to carry.

**What You'll Do:**

* Lead multiple squads and set their direction. Translate area vision into team focus and staffing, establish operating objectives across your squads, and coach ICs on strategic framing.
* Grow the people. Own 1:1s, coaching, performance management, growth, leveling and calibration input, and hiring for your team. Develop your senior ICs into leaders, and build a healthy critique and feedback culture. Escalate hiring gaps against plan, sustained under-performance without a plan, and attrition risk on a key surface rather than absorbing them quietly.
* Hold the evidence bar. Enable discovery and instrumentation across your team and unblock research and data access. Halt or escalate when a build is about to start without validated evidence or with instrumentation missing.
* Drive definition quality. Own experience definition-of-ready and acceptance-criteria guidelines for your squads, and intervene when acceptance criteria are unclear, a success metric is undefined, or functional intent isn't settled before tickets are cut.
Own squad-level delivery and the craft bar. Manage planning, hold the quality bar through critique that changes the work, and partner with engineering leadership to keep the design* execution process smooth.
* Own capacity. Own project-level staffing, balance Product Experience Lead and Design Technologist capacity across squads.
* Ensure launch quality. Ensure VQA sign-offs happen and the experience quality gate is met across squads, support the product-marketing partnership at team level, and escalate any launch proceeding without sign-off.
* Close the loop after launch. Review adoption and experience metrics and post-launch findings across your squads, hold ICs to a remediation plan when results miss, and feed what you learn back into your area's focus and capacity.

**What You'll Bring:**

* A track record of developing ICs into stronger ICs and into leaders. You've grown people through coaching, feedback, and performance management, and built teams that raise their own bar.
* The ability to raise quality
