**Location:** New York, NY (Hybrid), or Remote

**Who Are We:**

At Mutual of America Financial Group, we help people build the assets they need to achieve greater financial security. Our Company is built upon a solid foundation of integrity, excellence, and social responsibility. We were founded in 1945 to provide small and mid-sized nonprofit organizations with pension and retirement-related services, along with leading customer support. Today, we provide these services also to for-profit companies, as well as to governmental entities, Tribal enterprises, institutional investors, and individuals. We work diligently to understand the needs of our customers so we can help them achieve their retirement goals.

We are committed to bringing talented and motivated people together to help our customers achieve a financially secure future.

**Role Summary:**

The Office of Technology and Digital Services (OTDS) Department is seeking a Lead Product Owner to join the New Products and Corporate Functions product team. This role primarily supports the Finance department and is responsible for new product implementations, tax related processes, supporting fund trading operations/activities, and optimization of nightly batch processing. The position owns and prioritizes the product team backlog and works cross-functionally with business units, external business partners, and control functions (audit, compliance, legal). Success requires strategic thinking, technical expertise, and the ability to communicate complex ideas to senior leadership and cross-functional stakeholders.

**Responsibilities:**

* Partner with Business and IT Product Managers to define and communicate the product vision and roadmap for the product team.
* Own and prioritize the product backlog, ensuring clarity and alignment with strategic goals, and adjusting to evolving requirements.
* Lead and coordinate delivery of complex initiatives that cross multiple product teams, departments and vendors.
* Support the overall implementation of new products and services by leading OTDS’s activities, including planning and architecting related technology solutions.
* Support fund trading operations.

* Lead analysis and optimization of nightly batch process performance.
* Write detailed business requirements/user stories and acceptance criteria.

* Manage risk associated with new solutions and/or proposed enhancements.
* Ensure alignment with technology standards and industry best practices.

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Finance and/or Information Systems preferred.

* Advanced skills in Microsoft Office product suite, including Excel and PowerPoint.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.desc:
**Hi! We're Forerunner.**
-------------------------

We're on a mission to help communities adapt to a changing world. Forerunner builds modern, easy-to-use software for the people who keep communities running. Local governments, federal agencies, and infrastructure operators use Forerunner to run inspections, enforce codes, manage public works, respond to disasters, and meet their regulatory obligations.

**About the role**
------------------

We're looking for a **Senior Product Manager** to lead product for the Field Intelligence team.

You’ll own the strategy and roadmap for how Forerunner helps field teams understand what needs attention, capture trustworthy information, and turn their findings into action. This includes mobile and offline workflows, AI-guided inspections, geospatial context, photo and voice capture, operational visibility, and the connection between field observations and downstream compliance or corrective-action workflows.

This is a high-ownership role for a hands-on product builder who enjoys getting close to users, making sense of complicated operational environments, and turning that understanding into clear product direction and tangible solutions. Depending on the problem, that might mean sketching a workflow, building a lightweight prototype with modern tools, digging into usage data, writing detailed product behavior, or working directly with customers to test the riskiest assumption.

You’ll work closely with Engineering and Design from discovery through delivery, while partnering with Customer Success, Sales, and Marketing to ensure what we build is adopted and creates measurable value.

**What you’ll do**
------------------

* Own the product strategy, roadmap, and outcomes for Field Intelligence, from work planning and data capture through review, follow-up, and resolution.
* Spend time with inspectors, field crews, program managers, and operational leaders to understand how work happens in practice.
* Identify the highest-leverage opportunities for AI to improve fieldwork while preserving user control, transparency, and trust.
* Partner closely with Engineering and Design to frame problems, evaluate tradeoffs, define requirements, and ship polished end-to-end experiences across mobile and web.
* Define how we measure success, including adoption, task completion, data quality, time saved, issue-resolution time, and customer outcomes.

* Own refund logic — determining when a refund can be processed and through which channel

* Inform payment method strategy, processor relationships, and tradeoffs between available payment options for buyers

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Forwarded Deployed
jobs.desc:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century's most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril's family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

**ABOUT THE TEAM**

The Mission Command team is part of the Connected Warfare Division. We build the command and control (C2) tools that help warfighters understand what is happening around them, make faster decisions, and direct their forces. We spend a lot of our time with the people who actually use these tools: in the field, during exercises, wherever they are.

**ABOUT THE ROLE**

This is not a product manager who happens to spend some time forward. The forward work is the product work. As a Forward Deployed Product Manager, you own the path from a warfighter problem to a fielded solution. That covers applications, data models, user experiences, integrations, and infrastructure.  
  
Most of all, you work as a translation layer between the warfighter and the engineering teams. You embed with units, build real expertise in how they fight, and earn enough trust that influence runs both ways. You are there to solve their problems, not to sell them something, and you build an open, trusting relationship by doing exactly that. Sometimes an introduction is made for you. You have to be comfortable with walking into a unit that has never heard of Lattice, and earn your footing from the bottom up.  
  
The profile we are hiring for: a product manager who can walk into a formation, understand the fight, earn the trust of the people in it, map the workflow and the data underneath it, and then pull the right parts of Anduril together to solve it. You walk in with a strong sense of ownership and responsibility, but you back it up with real curiosity and humility.

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**

* **Own warfighter outcomes, not features.** Embed with units, learn the mission, find the problems that matter most, and own them through development, fielding, and the work that comes after.
* **Build real relationships with the people in the fight.** Earn the trust of warfighters, commanders, staff, and subject matter experts. Become a partner who understands how the unit actually fights, not just what shows up in a requirements document.
* **Do the research in the field.** Learn by watching, asking questions, and taking part in real workflows. Turn what you learn into clear priorities.
* **Connect the fight to the product.** Map the users, decisions, workflows, systems, data, and dependencies behind an outcome, and use that to drive what gets built and integrated.
* **Design across the whole stack.** Do not default to a new app or a new screen. Work out whether an outcome needs an application change, a new or richer data model, an integration, a workflow that spans applications, or a change in how data moves across the Mesh.
* **Use the data model as a product tool.** Get to know what data exists, how it is represented, where it comes from, who uses it, and what has to change to make a workflow possible.
* **Design for the tactical edge.** Understand how the network and the hardware affect what the user sees and does. Account for degraded conditions, bandwidth, latency, and compute when you define a solution.
* **Pull the right people together.** Get warfighters, engineering, design, and the other teams around the same problem, and drive them toward one coherent answer.
* **Make ambiguous problems workable.** Be just as comfortable writing

**About MacStadium**  
Founded in 2011 and headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia, MacStadium is the leading provider of private Mac cloud infrastructure, purpose-built for the Apple ecosystem. Our mission is to deliver cloud solutions that simplify Mac for business. We give enterprises, software teams, and independent developers dedicated access to genuine Apple hardware, without the overhead of procuring, racking, or managing it themselves, so they can build, test, and ship Apple platform software faster and more securely.  
Our product portfolio spans macOS virtualization and orchestration (Orka), private Mac cloud and bare-metal compute, Mac Virtual Desktop Infrastructure (VDI, including Citrix-based remote desktop access) for distributed teams, and dedicated Apple Silicon infrastructure for AI and machine learning workloads. We're trusted by organizations ranging from fast-growing startups to household names, and leading financial institutions, who rely on MacStadium to power their iOS, macOS, and cross-platform development pipelines at scale.

**The Opportunity**

We're hiring a Senior Product Manager to own and optimize the entire MacStadium user journey, ensuring customers easily discover the value of our Mac ecosystem, mobile development, and emerging technology solutions from first engagement through long-term retention. You'll focus on reducing churn, improving signup-to-meeting-to-purchase conversion, and strengthening the overall product experience by working cross-functionally with product domain experts, marketing, sales, and technical support and customer success.  
As part of both product experience and growth, you'll seed and shape innovation initiatives in areas such as AI, clustering, and automation. You'll also take ownership of where MacStadium focuses its product design projects, ensuring high impact, consistency, and usability across the platform, including the experiences our Orka, Mac VDI/Citrix, and mobile development customers rely on every day.

**What you will be doing**

**Product Experience:**

* Map and optimize the buyer and user journey, from first awareness to adoption, purchase, and retention, across MacStadium's Mac ecosystem and mobile development products.
* Identify friction points in product discovery and usability, ensuring customers can quickly see how MacStadium's Mac infrastructure, virtualization, and mobile CI/CD offerings solve their needs.
* Collaborate with marketing and sales to develop a strategic framework for product design that supports seamless continuity throughout the customer lifecycle.

**Growth and Retention:**

* Work across departments to understand, analyze, and address the drivers of churn, and implement retention-focused improvements.
* Lead an effort to improve signup-to-first-meeting and lead-to-purchase conversion rates, collaborating with marketing and sales on onboarding, messaging, and trial experiences for prospective Mac infrastructure and mobile development customers.
* Identify opportunities to increase customer engagement and expansion across MacStadium's product portfolio.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Procurement
jobs.desc:
As the most trusted global leader in data-first contract lifecycle management (CLM) software, Agiloft helps organizations manage the end-to-end process of proposing, negotiating, signing, and leveraging contracts using our flexible Data-first Agreement Platform (DAP). With contract data as the foundation, customers quickly and collaboratively reach agreement and leverage contract visibility to thrive with competitive advantage. Employing powerful, pragmatic artificial intelligence as a legal force multiplier, and robust integration capabilities as a data liberator, organizations around the world trust Agiloft’s certified implementers to deliver connected, intelligent, and autonomous solutions across the entire contract lifecycle.

Top analysts like Gartner, Forrester, and IDC agree, all showing Agiloft as a leader in the CLM space. Our no code platform is easily managed and administered by business users, which is why Agiloft is the contract you keep: nearly a full 100% of new customers are satisfied with their initial implementations, and some 97% of customers renew every year. Ours is a growing, vibrant, successful company that is at the forefront of a market that is becoming a must-have for all organizations.

We believe that the way to build the strongest, most vibrant place to work is to bring in individuals from all walks of life, and to support them in bringing their authentic selves to their day, every day. Our working philosophy is that “EX = CX”: when employee experience is excellent, so is customer experience. We support multiple Employee Resource Groups (ERGs), and offer a working environment that supports healthy work/life balance, including floating holidays and a quarterly, no-questions-asked wellness day.

### **Position Overview**

Decision making in contract technology is shifting. Procurement, CFOs, and CIOs are gaining influence alongside Legal, and they expect contracting outcomes they can measure that are directly connected to company level business strategy. Agiloft has built deep strength with legal personas that will be extended into procurement through additional investments in our products.

As Senior Product Manager for Procurement, you will accelerate the development of procurement-focused contracting motions on our platform. You will identify the highest value procurement scenarios, prioritize for emerging customer demand, and turn them into a roadmap Product builds against.

This is a high-agency, high-accountability product and business building role reporting directly to the Chief Product Officer. You will create and prove value for procurement customers in close partnership with the teams building our core platform and our connected, third-party experiences and generate the evidence that shapes further investment in this motion.

### **Job Responsibilities**

**Lead Product Strategy**

* Define and prioritize the procurement use cases with the clearest path to customer value building upon Agiloft's advanced and growing contracting platform.
* Own a roadmap spanning new capabilities, existing platform features, and integrations.
* Give particular attention to headless experiences and workflows orchestrated by AI agents.
* Ensure delivery of critical procurement product roadmap items in partnership with engineering.
* Partner with engineering and design to deliver the roadmap, and establish success measures such as shorter cycle times, identified savings, and adoption of automated recommendations.
* Project Agiloft's contract technology core into a procurement-facing value story, building upon and extending the strengths of the existing product stack.
* Track evidence from customer engagement and use it to shape investment.
* Translate platform capabilities into a clear procurement value proposition, using customer evidence to guide investment, pricing, and monetization decisions.
* Represent the product strategy in customer conversations, webinars, conferences, and other relevant industry forum

We design and build his robotic sculptures for the Venice Biennale, Rockefeller Center, the Fontainebleau in Las Vegas, Tiffany & Co. in New York, Dubai and Seoul, and private collections around the world. jobs.desc:
**About Foodsmart**:

Foodsmart is the leading Foodcare platform in the U.S., built to deliver nutrition-driven healthcare at scale. Powered by a national network of Registered Dietitians, Foodsmart combines personalized clinical nutrition care, behavior change tools, and food benefits to improve member health outcomes while lowering healthcare costs.

Our platform is designed to foster healthier food choices, drive lasting behavior change, and deliver sustainable health outcomes. Through our highly personalized, digital platform, we guide more than 3 million members—including those in employer-sponsored health plans, regional and national Medicaid managed care organizations, Medicare Advantage plans, and commercial insurers—on a tailored journey to eating well while saving time and money.

Foodsmart seamlessly integrates dietary assessments and nutrition counseling with online food ordering and cost-effective meal planning for the entire family, optimizing ingredients both at home and on the go. We partner with national and regional retailers across the U.S., many of whom accept SNAP/EBT, making healthier food more accessible. Additionally, we assist members with SNAP enrollment and management, providing tangible access to nutritious food. In 2024, Foodsmart secured a $200 million investment from TPG’s Rise Fund, which supports entrepreneurs dedicated to achieving the United Nations’ Sustainable Development Goals. This investment helps us expand our reach, particularly to low-income workers who are disproportionately affected by diet-related diseases.

At Foodsmart, our mission is to make nutritious food accessible and affordable for everyone, regardless of economic status. We are committed to a set of core values that shape our culture and work environment:

Customer First - You start with the member and work backwards.  
Make It Happen - You act with urgency, use data, and hold high standards.  
One Team - You collaborate with respect and commit as a group.

Whether you're a dietitian, a commercial leader, or a technologist, working at Foodsmart means being part of a team that is passionate, supportive, and driven by a shared purpose. Join us in transforming the way people access and enjoy healthy food.

  

**About the Role:**

Reporting to our Chief Product Officer, this Senior Product Manager will be responsible for driving Foodsmart’s member activation. Every outcome we deliver for our members and clients starts with that first visit. You will own the funnel from first outreach to first visit, including the messaging, the channels, and the incentive structure that motivate members to show up.

Your customers are our members and our clients, who depend on us to turn eligible lives into engaged ones. You’ll lead a cross-functional pod to build out the systems and capabilities to achieve this goal and will work closely with Marketing, Data, and Partnerships to find what moves members from “eligible” to “booked” to “showed up,” and to do it at a cost that scales. This role is ideal for a product manager who is as comfortable in a funnel dashboard and an experiment readout as they are in the details of a text-message delivery issue or a broken scheduling flow.

### **You will:**

*Lead the Activation Pod & Funnel*

* Lead a cross-functional pod of Engineering, Design, Data, and Marketing partners with a clear mandate: increase the share of marketable members who complete a first visit
* Own the Activation roadmap, from discovery through launch and iteration, including improvements and buildouts to key capabilities that drive activation (marketing tooling, sign-up / scheduling optimizations, incentive program structure)
* Define and track funnel metrics from outreach to first visit (reach, booking, and show rates) by channel, client, and member segment
* Run a disciplined experimentation program: clear hypotheses, fast readouts, and confident rollouts

*Drive the incentive structure*

* Shape our member incentive strategy end

jobs.title: Sr. Product Manager - Hybrid
jobs.desc:
Why Arcoro?

Want to work with a solid company that’s transforming HR for the construction industry? Our team of dedicated professionals helps construction, contracting and field services companies hire, manage and grow their workforce with a market-leading SaaS solution. As a member of the A-Team, you’ll enjoy a top-notch team member experience where you can embrace your problem-solving skills and innovation, work with a team of great teammates and see the impact of your contribution each day. Our culture is collaborative, and we believe strongly in training, growth and internal advancement. We offer competitive compensation including comprehensive benefits and a generous time-off policy. We offer both on-site and remote opportunities.

At Arcoro, you will help create software products that are cutting edge, easy to use, and that make an appreciated and notable difference in our customer’s daily lives.

About the Role

Arcoro’s Product Management team is a customer-obsessed group of experts. Our focus is on building products that customers love and that propel our business forward.

* We are full stack product managers, delivering end-to-end customer experiences that grow our business
* We are strategy-first, aligning priorities to company goals so that everyone can see the impact of their work
* We are outcome-oriented, driving positive results in our customers’ businesses and ours
* We are delivery-focused, setting a bold vision and then finding ways to ship fast and iterate faster
* We are curious, valuing feedback as a gift
* We are cross-functional leaders, from discover through delivery enabling teams to deliver lovable products

What You'll Do

We build products for the people who build our world. It is important work. We love it and we want you to as well. Your key responsibilities will be:

* Interacting directly with customers to understand what they are really asking for
* Collaborating with leadership and cross-functional teams to define the product roadmap
* Prioritizing and defining new features and product improvements based on business goals and customer needs
* Partnering daily with user experience and product engineering to design and build features that customers love
* Writing release notes that help others understand the impact of new features and how to market, sell, and support them exceptionally well
* Leading cross-functionally to coordinate on-time launches
* Measuring and improving product adoption, usage, and satisfaction

What Success Looks Like

* Clear product strategy and roadmap aligned to business objectives
* Successful and timely delivery of product features and releases
* Strong customer adoption, engagement, and satisfaction
* Measurable impact on business growth and product performance
* High-quality collaboration across Product, Engineering, and business teams
* Continuous improvement through data-driven decision-making
* Products that deliver meaningful value to customers

What We're Looking For

jobs.desc:
**Position:** Senior Product Owner / Senior Product Manager

**Location:** Remote – Work from anywhere in the United States

**Employment Type:** Full-Time

**Base Salary Range:** $110k-$166k

**Reports to:** VP of Product

**About Give Interactive**

Give Interactive is a fintech software company providing technology solutions to community foundations and philanthropic organizations across North America. Our platform supports donor-advised funds, complex asset donations, investment operations, and grantmaking through modern automation, intuitive user experience, and robust analytics.

**Our Mission**

We exist to inspire and facilitate world-changing generosity.

**Our Culture: The 3 C’s at Give Interactive**

Our culture is built on three pillars that guide how we work and lead.

**Character**

*Humility, integrity, ownership, respect, and assuming positive intent.*

**Commitment**

*Grit, growth mindset, ownership of outcomes, and a bias toward action.*

**Competence**

*Excellence, continuous learning, sound judgment, innovation, and mastery of craft.*

Together, Character, Commitment, and Competence enable us to lead through innovation and win through execution.

#### **Job Summary**

We are hiring a Senior Product Owner / Senior Product Manager who can run a product lane with minimal oversight. This is not an entry point into product management. You'll take ownership of scope, prioritize and sequence work, and make sound decisions independently without needing frequent escalation. You should already be comfortable operating in Scrum/Kanban-style agile environments and in fixed-scope/waterfall, contract-driven delivery, and know how to shift between the two depending on what the work requires. Our platform sits in a regulated, high-stakes financial domain, so precision and accountability matter as much as speed.

#### **Core Responsibilities**

* **Requirements Analysis:** Analyze client requirements, understand actual client workflow (not just what's asked for), and compare against similar client requests and existing system features. Know when a request is a one-off versus a pattern worth building into the platform.
* **Product Planning & Architecture:** Make product architecture decisions with real tradeoff awareness (build vs. defer, one-off vs. platform feature, technical debt vs. shipping now) while building a scalable platform for all clients.
* **Documentation:** Write user stories, feature specifications, system diagrams, wireframes, API documentation, and acceptance criteria clear enough for a developer to pick up without repeated follow-up meetings.
* **Testing & Sign-off:** Participate in product testing and sign off on user story completion. This requires understanding the underlying data and business logic well enough to catch a wrong result, not just checking a box.
* **Underlying Needs Knowledgebase:** Maintain and evolve the knowledge base for your lane, keeping user stories grounded in the real problems clients are trying to solve, not surface-level feature requests.
* **Roadmap Ownership:** Maintain the roadmap for your lane based on client feedback and market trends, balancing short-term needs against long-term strategy.

GovCIO is seeking a Senior Product Manager to own the delivery strategy and continuous improvement of a complex, high-visibility product — or closely related set of products — within the VA Telehealth portfolio. * Experience managing or overseeing subcontracted or vendor development teams

* Experience with Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe), including supporting or leading SAFe adoption or program increment planning
* Background in healthcare IT or patient-facing digital health

**Tabs is the AI Operating System for Revenue, built for modern finance and accounting teams.** It combines deep revenue and accounting expertise with the agents and applications needed to run revenue work end to end. Tabs understands customer and contract context, applies accounting logic, and executes critical workflows with built in controls, auditability, and human oversight. With Tabs, finance teams can move from manually managing revenue workflows to directing outcomes while the system executes the work.

### **About the Role**

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to own Revenue at Tabs: the system that turns performance obligations and usage data into recognized revenue a finance team can close the month on and an auditor can sign off on.

Audit-defensible revenue recognition is core to what Tabs does. You'll own the recognition engine across methods, the ASC 606 treatment that drives it (SSP allocation, variable consideration, contract modifications), and the audit trail and controls that make the numbers defensible. You'll report to the Director of Product and work every day with engineering, Solutions, and the finance teams who use Tabs.

**Why this role exists:** most revenue software is built by people who have never had to defend a number at close. We want someone who has, and who has also built software with engineers.

### **How We Work**

* **We work hard.** Two-week sprints, weekly ship goals, short feedback cycles. Built around intra-month product releases.
* **We work smart.** Get in front of the customer, use both data and customer feedback to drive decisions, while keeping the bigger picture in mind.
* **We work together.** In-office culture with people you want to work with. Lots of whiteboard space. Expense coffee, lunch, and dinner when in the office.

### **What You’ll Work On**

**Own the revenue recognition engine**

* Define how performance obligations convert into revenue schedules across methods — straightlined, point-in-time, usage-based, and milestone
* Ensure contract changes (amendments, renewals, terminations) flow through correctly to revenue schedules, including re-allocation and restatements
* Own recognized, deferred, and unbilled balances, and the movement between them each period

**Drive ASC 606 compliance**

* Own transaction price allocation across bundled performance obligations (SSP), variable consideration, and contract modification accounting
* Stay current on evolving accounting guidance and audit standards, along with the needs of active and prospective merchants, and translate them into product direction

**Build toward audit-defensible, SOX-grade revenue**

* Define the audit trail standard — what was recognized, when, why, against which obligation — so an external auditor can verify any number directly
* Build toward segregated permissions and approval workflows (RBAC) for revenue and journal entry changes

**Bring AI into the revenue workflow**

* Partner on AI-powered tooling that goes beyond answering questions — flagging anomalies before close, explaining what changed and why, and recommending the right recognition treatment as obligations and contracts evolve

**About You**

* Deep, practical ASC 606 fluency — comfortable reasoning through transaction price allocation, variable consideration, and contract modification accounting directly, not just at a conceptual level
* Comfortable translating complex accounting frameworks into product requirements and data models engineers can build against
* Highly analytical and data-driven; comfortable making decisions based on metrics and qual

**Reports to:** CTO  
**Type:** High-agency individual contributor  
**Products:** Single Brain + API Gateway  
**Location:** Full-time, remote (Los Angeles a plus, not required)  
**Comp:** $120,000–$150,000 USD / year

**One-liner**
-------------

Own what gets built and why across Single Brain and API Gateway — turn build build build into build measure iterate.

**About the role**
------------------

Single Grain combines marketing services, software, and AI. This seat owns product judgment for Single Brain and the API Gateway: which metrics matter, what is blocking them, and what engineering should build next.

Engineering owns **how** we build. You own **what** we build and **why**.

You report to the CTO. You work daily with a ~6-person engineering team. You do **not** manage that team as a people manager; you create clarity so their effort lands on the highest-leverage outcomes.

You should be an advanced AI user. Use AI for research, interview synthesis, analytics, specs, prototypes, experiment design, and competitive work so your product decisions get faster and better.

**What you will own**
---------------------

* Identify the highest-leverage product metrics across Single Brain and API Gateway (activation, usage, retention, expansion, revenue, time-to-value, Gateway/integration adoption).
* Diagnose what is limiting those metrics.
* Decide what engineering should build next, with clear hypotheses and success criteria.
* Run strong weekly sprint kickoffs so the team leaves knowing: what metric are we moving, what are we doing to move it, and how will we know it worked.
* Own customer discovery — talk to customers often; separate loud requests from high-leverage opportunities.
* Own product analytics and instrumentation quality; no major initiative ships without a measurement plan.
* Review launches against real results and choose iterate, expand, revert, or move on.
* Keep the integration / Gateway roadmap intentionally prioritized.
* Protect the team from low-impact or poorly defined work.

**What success looks like**
---------------------------

* **By day 30:** deep product understanding; customer discovery underway; core journeys/funnels mapped; analytics audited; clear view of which metrics matter and where the biggest opportunities are.
* **By day 60:** you own weekly sprint kickoffs; major initiatives have metrics and measurement plans; core funnels instrumented and visible.
* **By day 90:** prioritized roadmap tied to measurable outcomes; multiple complete build measure iterate cycles; measurable improvement in at least one meaningful product metric. Failure = features still shipping without hypotheses, instrumentation, or post-launch learning.
* **By 6–12 months:** durable product OS (Metric Diagnosis Hypothesis Build Measure Learn Iterate); customer discovery and post-launch measurement are standard; CTO is no longer the primary person deciding what engineering builds next; key product/business metrics improved materially.

**Evidence we want to see**
---------------------------

* Experience owning a technical software product (APIs, integrations, auth, data fluency).
* Metrics you personally owned and improved — with diagnosis, not feature lists.
* Sprint leadership / prioritization with engineering teams.
* Product analytics and instrumentation ownership (PostHog, Amplitude, Mixpanel, or similar).
* Advanced daily AI workflows for product work.
* High-agency ownership: you set roadmap direction; you are not a conduit or Jira admin.
* Ideal: early-stage / growth-stage; developer tools, API, infrastructure, or AI products.

**What this role is not**
-------------------------

Not a project manager, not a backlog clerk, not “collect feature requests,” not “feature shipped = success,” not waiting for the CTO to dictate the roadmap.

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to own Usage & Pricing at Tabs — one of the most foundational and fastest-evolving parts of the platform.

Usage- and token-based pricing are becoming standard across B2B technology companies, fueled by the high cost of LLM inference and the opportunity to pass through these costs to customers. Fluxx is looking for a strategic, systems-thinking **Senior Product Manager** to own and evolve our Grantseeker platform. This role is a great fit for someone coming from FinTech. **This is a full-time, exempt position open to candidates located along the East Coast, with a preference for candidates based in the New York City area. Candidates outside of New York City must be willing to travel to our Manhattan office for in-person meetings and collaboration as needed.**

**About Fluxx:**  
At Fluxx, our mission is to be the leading collaborative grant management platform in our global communities. We build technology that drives positive impact by helping foundations, government agencies, and nonprofits streamline their grants management process – on both the grantmaking and grantseeking side – helping to accelerate impact across the communities we serve.

Today, Fluxx supports a global community of 500+ customers who collectively manage and distribute more than $39B in grants annually.

**About Fluxx Grantseeker:**

Grantseeker was originally launched by Fluxx in 2017 to help nonprofits manage the grantseeking process—a market traditionally underserved by grants management software. After serving more than 3,000 nonprofits, the platform was strategically divested in 2023, rebuilt as Grantseeker Pro for larger nonprofit and public sector organizations, and re-acquired by Fluxx in November 2025.

Today, Grantseeker helps nonprofits, higher education institutions, and government organizations manage grant portfolios, deadlines, budgets, reporting, documents, and compliance in one platform. Combined with Fluxx Grantmaker, it delivers a complete end-to-end solution for organizations that both award and receive grants.

**The opportunity**

This role owns Grantseeker's product direction at a genuine inflection point - having been re-acquired by Fluxx. Grantseeker has real traction, a durable data asset, and a newly dedicated product and engineering team — and it also has a two-platform architecture to reconcile, a free-to-paid conversion motion to sharpen, and an unrealized strategic advantage in being the only grantseeker platform owned by a major grantmaker platform.

You will be the person who decides what Grantseeker becomes over the next several years. This is a builder's role, not a caretaker's.

#### **What you'll do:**

**Own the roadmap.** Set and defend a 12–18 month product strategy grounded in customer evidence, funnel data, competitive reality, and commercial goals and keep the org aligned to it.

**Resolve the platform question.** Grantseeker Classic and Pro run in parallel. Own consolidation end to end —feature parity, migration tooling, customer communication, sunset timeline — balancing speed against long-tenured customers' trust.

**Sharpen the product-led motion.** Own activation, conversion, retention, and expansion as product metrics. Find where free accounts stall, build what converts them, and decide what sits above/below the paywall.

**Win competitive migrations.** Own import tooling, data mapping, onboarding, and the first-week experience that determines whether a migrated account survives.

**Connect funders and seekers**. Turn Fluxx's two-sided position into a shipped product — data flow, reduced duplicate entry, shared visibility — partnering with the Grantmaker team on shared data models.

**Build on the data asset**. Turn Grantseeker's public filing data into better matching and applied AI that saves grant writers real hours, with hones

jobs.desc:
### **About the Company**

We are a renewable energy and ocean technology company committed to rapidly developing and deploying technologies that will ensure a sustainable future for Earth by unlocking the vast energy potential of its oceans. Our focus is on capturing civilizational levels of ultra-low-cost renewable energy for applications including computing and affordable renewable fuels delivered to shore.

The company is a public benefit corporation headquartered in Portland, Oregon, and backed by leading venture capitalists, philanthropic investors, university endowments, and private investment offices. We operate as an idea meritocracy in which the best ideas change the company's direction on a regular basis.

Our staff have worked at organizations such as SpaceX, Blue Origin, Boeing, Tesla, Apple, Virgin Orbit, Astra, Google, Amazon, Microsoft, New Relic, Bridgewater, Raytheon, Disney Imagineering, and the US Army and Air Force, as well as research universities, startups, and small companies across a range of industries.

### **About the Job**

Our core technology is the node, a device that produces energy in the ocean's harshest conditions for years at a time without human maintenance or intervention.

We've proven we can build Nodes in small quantities. This role exists to make the path to repeatable production move faster. Manufacturing Technology defines the qualification requirements for each Node manufacturing process and owns delivery of the qualified process set. You will track readiness against those requirements — maintaining visibility into where each process stands, what evidence is still outstanding, and what is blocking it — and coordinate the cross-functional execution planning that closes the gaps. Your primary deliverable is velocity: sequencing process development work, surfacing constraints before they bite, and keeping engineering effort pointed at the qualification gates that matter most to the pilot program

This role is based at our new Pilot Manufacturing campus in Vancouver, Washington — the facility where Ocean-3 Nodes stop being drawings and start being steel. We're standing up heavy fabrication, blast and coatings, and full Node integration, which means the process development work happens feet away from the weld seams and the paint booth. You'll help build the line that builds the fleet.

Candidates should have strong interpersonal skills and be able to thrive in a creative, scrappy, and collaborative environment in which the best ideas change the company's direction on a regular basis.

* Manage project milestone schedules for pilot manufacturing process development, ensuring clear communication of status, risks, and dependencies to internal stakeholders.
* Lead design and test sprint planning for the internal manufacturing team, balancing resource constraints and competing priorities across projects.
* Drive clear-to-build decisions, closing gaps across engineering release, material availability, tooling, and work instructions ahead of build start.

* Monitor and escalate program risks, while proactively contributing to mitigation strategies.
* Develop and maintain documentation and tools that support production execution and scaling, in alignment with TPM best practices.

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering or a related technical field.

jobs.title: Product Manager, Billing (Senior Staff)
jobs.desc:
**Are you ready to unlock intelligence?**

If you don’t think you meet all of the criteria below but are still interested in the job, please apply. Nobody checks every box - we’re looking for candidates that are particularly strong in a few areas, and have some interest and capabilities in others.

**The Mission**
---------------

Kong is building the future of AI connectivity, empowering developers to connect, secure, and scale their applications with speed and intelligence. We are hiring a Product Manager, Billing to lead the product and systems work behind how Konnect makes money: entitlements, metering, checkout, invoicing, provisioning, and the enterprise and marketplace motions that surround them.

In this role you are the product owner of Konnect's commercial operating layer: the systems that translate what Sales sells and what customers use into what ends up on an invoice. That means plan and entitlement design, the usage metering pipeline, self-serve checkout and subscription lifecycle, customer organization and billing admin experiences, enterprise billing workflows (CPQ sync, custom contracts), and cloud marketplace billing. You will work hand-in-hand with Product Growth, Pricing & Packaging, Finance, GTM, Sales, and Engineering.

This role reports to the Sr Director, Product (Platform) and sits at the intersection of two multi-year transformations: Kong's move from a single-product API gateway company into a multi-product enterprise, and Monetization's company-wide overhaul of pricing and packaging. The Billing, Provisioning, and Fulfillment program has historically been manual and relationship-driven. Your job is to turn it into a product, so Sales can sell more, Finance can bill more accurately, and customers get an experience that matches the quality of what they are paying for.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

* **Platform Vision:** Set a multi-year direction for how Konnect prices, meters, entitles, and invoices. Decide what becomes shared platform capability versus what stays feature-specific, and sequence delivery so near-term work lands without creating long-term drag.
* **Unified Entitlements:** Build the entitlements model that determines what every customer can access within Konnect. Make entitlements a first-class concept that is consistently defined in contracts, enforced in-product, honored by provisioning, and reflected in billing.
* **Pricing & Packaging Delivery:** Act as the product and systems counterpart to Monetization. Translate pricing and packaging decisions into production reality: configuring plans, reshaping metering, updating contracts, coordinating customer migrations, and making sure a rollout doesn't disrupt existing revenue.
* **Metering & Usage Visibility:** Run the event pipeline, aggregation layer, and reporting experiences that show customers what they consumed and what they are being charged. Hold a financial-grade bar on accuracy, auditability, and reconcilability.
* **Checkout & Subscription Lifecycle:** Own how customers self-serve onto a plan, change plans, renew, lapse, and recover. That covers plan discovery, checkout, the underlying payments integration, subscription state, retries and dunning, and the admin surfaces where customers manage their own billing.
* **Enterprise & Marketplace Motions:** Connect Kong's enterprise sales and channel motions to the billing stack: CPQ-to-entitlement sync, bespoke contract handling, invoice-based billing, and marketplace billing across AWS, GCP, and Azure as we expand our presence there.
* **Fulfillment Automation:** Replace today's manual, high-touch provisioning and fulfillment processes with productized, automated workflows. This includes migrating off our current metering and billing system onto a target stack that supports the new pricing and packaging framework.
* **Outcomes & Measurement:** Define the health metrics for the domain, including net revenue retention, billing-driven churn, invoice dispute rate, collections

The Team + The Role

Software is being written faster than ever, and AI coding agents are accelerating how teams build and ship. Novus is Pendo's answer to what happens after software ships: helping fast-moving teams understand what is actually happening in their products and where to focus next. This is a new product, in a new category, for an audience Pendo has not traditionally sold to before: product engineers and application owners building AI-native software.

As Lead Product Marketing Manager for Novus, you are the marketing lead and GTM owner for the product. You own the narrative, positioning, demand strategy, community presence, launch moments, and early commercial outcomes end to end. This is a 0-to-1 role for someone who can write the playbook, execute it hands-on, and drive clarity across product, sales, marketing, and leadership.

This is a remote role in the US. We have offices in San Francisco, CA, Raleigh, NC, or New York, NY.

What this looks like day-to-day

  • Narrative and positioning: Own the messaging, positioning, and talk tracks for Novus, including the breakthrough narrative, category story, and positioning documentation. Keep product, sales, marketing, and leadership aligned as the product and market evolve.
  • End-to-end GTM ownership: Build and run the full go-to-market plan across audience targeting, channel strategy, campaign strategy, sales readiness, launch moments, and success metrics. Own the outcomes rather than handing strategy off to another team.
  • Top-of-funnel and conversion: Partner with revenue marketing to define the acquisition channel mix, run campaigns, and drive early-access signups. Connect demand activity to free-to-paid conversion and early commercial signals.
  • Community building: Build Novus' presence where builders already spend time, including developer forums, social channels, influencer relationships, and event-driven activation. Earn trust with audiences that are skeptical of traditional marketing.
  • PLG motion: Partner with product and growth to design self-serve onboarding, activation flows, and freemium-to-paid conversion paths. Use data and feedback to improve how users discover, try, activate, and expand with Novus.
  • Novus and Pendo positioning: Define how Novus and Pendo exist together in the market. Shape the path for customers moving from fast-moving AI-native teams into more complex product organizations.
  • Sales and partner enablement: Build the materials, messaging, and proof points that help sales and partner teams have credible conversations with product engineers. Translate the product for a buyer that is meaningfully different from Pendo's traditional PM audience.
  • Metrics and commercial impact: Work with revenue marketing to define and track the metrics that connect Novus activity to pipeline and early revenue outcomes. Focus on activation, free-to-paid conversion, marketing-sourced ARR, and other signals that show whether the motion is working.

Who You Are

Beyond the qualifications, we hire through a specific lens. These aren't buzzwords; they're the things we'll actually look for in how you talk about your work.

You're a builder, not a maintainer.

You're most energized when there isn't a clear path yet, and you get to define it. You don't wait for direction; you identify gaps, shape solutions, and drive them forward. At Pendo, great Product Marketing Directors don't just follow instructions; they operate as strategic advisors, influencing decisions, guiding stakeholders, and elevating how we work.

Our mission is to empower local lenders with innovative, reliable technology that upholds community values while enabling access to national markets.

At LendKey, our strategic partnerships are central to how we bring lending solutions to market. Our product teams are organized by lending vertical, with end-to-end ownership of the borrower and partner experience, from initial loan discovery and application through origination and servicing.

As **Senior Product Manager, Home Improvement Lending (HIL),** you will lead the strategy, development, and performance of the HIL product experience across the full loan lifecycle. This includes overseeing product relationships with key strategic partners, expanding our aggregator and distribution channels, and owning the merchant portal that connects contractors to our lending solutions. You will play a critical role in shaping how borrowers, contractors, and partners engage with LendKey's home improvement lending platform.

**What You'll Do**

* Lead the HIL product strategy and roadmap, with end-to-end accountability for the lending experience, from borrower acquisition and application through loan origination and servicing.
* Drive product strategy for key strategic partnerships, including roadmap alignment, requirements prioritization, and resolution of product-related challenges.
* Lead product development for HIL's aggregator and distribution channels, identifying opportunities to expand reach, improve integration, and enhance the partner experience.
* Own the merchant portal experience, ensuring contractors have intuitive, effective tools to offer financing and support their customers.
* Shape the borrower, contractor, and partner experiences, translating business needs and customer insights into clear product requirements and priorities.
* Partner with platform and servicing product teams to align shared capabilities, dependencies, and delivery priorities with HIL business needs.
* Collaborate closely with HIL business leadership to align product investments with commercial priorities, partner needs, and growth opportunities.
* Establish and monitor product success metrics, using data and feedback to evaluate performance, identify opportunities, and drive continuous improvement.

**What You'll Bring**

* 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex products and strategic partner-facing initiatives.
* Experience in consumer lending, fintech, or financial services; point-of-sale financing, contractor-driven lending, or home improvement financing.
* Experience working in B2B2C environments, balancing the needs of business partners, distribution channels, and end consumers.
* Demonstrated ability to develop product roadmaps, prioritize competing demands, and deliver measurable business and customer outcomes.
* Strong cross-functional leadership skills, with the ability to influence and drive execution across Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, and other stakeholders.
* Excellent communication and relationship-management skills, with the ability to engage effectively with technical teams, business partners, and executive leadership.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Digital Strategy | Contract | Remote, USA
jobs.desc:
**About us:**

Working at Tech Holding isn't just a job, it's an opportunity to be a part of something bigger. We are a full-service consulting firm that was founded on the premise of delivering predictable outcomes and high-quality solutions to our clients. Our founders and team members have industry experience and have held senior positions in a wide variety of companies – from emerging startups to large Fortune 50 firms – and we have taken our combined experiences and developed a unique approach that is supported by the principles of deep expertise, integrity, transparency, and dependability.

#### **The Role:**

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager, for a project based assignment, with deep experience in digital strategy, customer journeys, and conversion optimization. This person will define actionable digital acquisition roadmaps, translate business needs into functional requirements, and partner closely with engineering and analytics teams to drive execution.  
The ideal candidate can move comfortably between executive-level strategy and detailed working sessions with technical teams. You should be able to analyze funnel performance directly, establish clear priorities, and design operating models that help teams manage competing requests effectively.

#### **Key Responsibilities:**

* Develop and manage digital acquisition strategies and roadmaps tied to measurable business goals
* Translate customer, business, and technical needs into clear functional requirements
* Partner with engineering teams to ensure requirements are understood, accepted, and successfully delivered
* Analyze funnel and customer journey data to identify conversion gaps and growth opportunities
* Work directly with analytics teams to define metrics, evaluate performance, and guide decisions
* Facilitate working sessions with business, product, analytics, and technology stakeholders
* Present recommendations, progress, and strategic priorities to executive leadership
* Design intake processes, prioritization frameworks, and operating models for teams managing a high volume of requests
* Align stakeholders around clear priorities, ownership, and execution plans
* Track roadmap progress and adjust priorities based on data, business needs, and delivery constraints

#### **Requirements:**

* 10+ years of experience across digital strategy, customer journey optimization, product management, or conversion-focused work
* Demonstrated experience building digital acquisition roadmaps and driving them through execution
* Strong experience writing functional requirements that engineering teams can confidently build from
* Ability to work directly with funnel and performance data without relying solely on prepared reports
* Experience designing operating models, intake processes, or prioritization frameworks for high-demand teams
* Strong executive presence and the ability to communicate strategic recommendations clearly
* Ability to collaborate effectively in detailed working sessions with engineering, analytics, and IT teams
* Strong organizational, analytical, and stakeholder-management skills

#### **Nice to have:**

* Experience with membership, subscription, or recurring-enrollment acquisition models
* Experience working within nonprofit, federated, or franchise environments where national and local organizations share a customer journey
* Experience supporting offerings with multiple participation tiers, products, or enrollment paths
* Familiarity with youth or family audiences and the privacy requirements associated with minors

**Employment Type:**

* Contract

* **Applicants must be authorized to work for ANY employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa at this time**

Tech Holding is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and is committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and experiences, and we consider qualified applicants

You'll partner directly with Business Technology directors and their stakeholders to turn underspecified platform demand into a single, clear, prioritized roadmap spanning both BTS and Workato. You'll bring real technical depth — enough to own the platform's API contracts, versioning, and integration-pattern decisions (Workato versus custom AWS-native build, sync versus event-driven) yourself — while partnering with Enterprise Architecture and the team's Staff Integration Engineer on deep systems design.

* Partner with Enterprise Architecture on platform-vs-domain scope calls, including how BTS integration flows feed the Databricks data lakehouse and support the broader data mesh
* Review and recommend the approach to requirements for MCP servers and AI agents supporting the BTS ecosystem, in partnership with AI Productivity
Contribute to standing up the Integration & Automation Engineering team, partnering with the Director on team structure, hiring, and the transition from contractor-led to FTE-led delivery

jobs.title: Principal Product Manager - Vertical Partnerships
jobs.desc:
At Constant Contact, we are seriously awesome people who take ownership and make an impact by operating with the mindset, integrity and courage of a small business owner. *There's something so profoundly rewarding about knowing that your work is empowering people everywhere to pursue their dreams*. Here, we all play an integral part in helping business owners, entrepreneurs, non-profits and individuals to succeed by giving them all the help and tools they need to grow online. We're energized by new challenges and new possibilities-and we're just getting started!

We have an opening for a **Principal Product Manager** who will shape and grow Constant Contact's partner ecosystem through product innovation and strategy. This is not a Sales or Business Development role; you'll focus on identifying which partnerships create the greatest opportunities, prioritizing the integrations and experiences we build, and developing a product roadmap that connects our platform to new customers and drives meaningful business growth.

Your focus is **Vertical Partnerships**: tailoring our platform and partner experiences to the needs of specific industries, then repeating that success across several of them. Real Estate is one example. It's a vertical where our value proposition is resonating today, and it shows the kind of work involved: identifying the right partners, shaping an experience that fits the industry's workflows, and landing and expanding quickly. Our priorities will follow where the evidence is strongest, so the specific verticals will change as we learn. What stays constant is the goal of a repeatable model for entering, validating, and scaling vertical partnerships across several markets with strong market size and similar customer needs.

You'll share company goals for user acquisition, revenue, and average selling price (ASP) with Strategic Partnerships (our business development team), and you'll work across the company to deliver them. Expect daily collaboration with Design, Engineering, Sales, Sales Engineering, Customer Support, Customer Success, Marketing, Legal, Finance, and Data teams, as well as external partners.

This is an individual contributor role with company-wide scope. You'll succeed by building trust and alignment with teams that have their own priorities.

**What you'll do:**

* Own the product strategy, roadmap, and launch of partner-driven experiences across multiple industry verticals
* Build a reusable vertical model: define how we identify, validate, and enter a new vertical, and which components carry over from one to the next

Operators ask us questions every day. How did yesterday go? Which channel actually converts? Did the new pricing pay off, or did it just move demand around? Your job is to turn those questions into data, reports, and visuals that answer them clearly and lead to a revenue maximizing decision.
  
**You'll own Reporting & Analytics end to end:** the reports, dashboards, and insights operators use to run their business, from the general manager checking yesterday's attendance to the finance lead reconciling a month of revenue across channels, and the data models and metric definitions behind them. You'll own its roadmap, its customers, and the case for where engineering time goes. Your job is to prove that reporting can be the front door to RocketRez: where operators start their day, and what moves them to act. You'll be measured on usage, and on the revenue operators earn from the decisions reporting drives.
  
  
**What we're building:**  
Operators move more of their business onto RocketRez when they trust us with their busiest day, and that trust depends on the numbers. If the reporting is wrong, late, or confusing, nothing else we build gets believed.
  
First, reporting operators trust. Core reporting on par with the best in hospitality.
  
Next, a revenue engine. Operators set revenue targets and campaigns, track their pace against them and against past seasons, and get clear options when they fall behind.
  
Then, automated revenue management. Automation keeps tracking and planning running without the operator asking. It recommends actions grounded in the operator's own history and in how similar operators are performing, and makes acting on them a single click. Season pass sales dipping? Here are three options based on this season and the last two.
  
  
**What you'll do:**  
Understand the question• Spend real time with operators across roles, from general managers and finance leads to marketers and front-gate supervisors. Learn the decisions they make and the questions they need answered to make them.
  

* Design reporting that leads to a decision. Every report should make clear what it means and what to do next.

Data fluency• Prototype with real data. Write your own SQL to mock up a report or metric and put it in front of operators before engineering builds it.
  

* Own the metric definitions the platform runs on: revenue, attendance, capacity utilization, and conversion mean the same thing in every report, in every domain.
* Apply statistical judgment: seasonality, small samples, cohorts, fair comparisons, and forecasting.
* Choose the right visual for the question, and hold a high bar for clarity, accuracy, and honest scales.
* Treat data quality as product quality.
* Work with other domains so new products capture the data reporting needs before they ship.

**Strategy and roadmap• Own the roadmap:** sizing, sequencing, and what gets cut.
  

* Shape how automation and AI turn insights into recommended actions: which recommendations are trustworthy, when a human should decide, and the guardrails around both.
* Define how cross-operator benchmarks work: peer sets, minimum sample sizes, and anonymization that operators trust enough to opt into.
* Make the build, buy, and partner calls on analytics tooling, and know the market well enough to say which gaps are worth closing.

**What we look for:**  
The trait we care about most is adaptability. The tools and methods of product management are changing, so we hire people who have already reinvented how they work on their own initiative and will do it again.
  

* You've rebuilt how you work without being told to, including becoming AI-na

jobs.desc:
**Senior Product Manager (Data Cooperative & Activate)**

**Company Overview**

InfutorData, an ActiveProspect company, delivers privacy-compliant consumer identity and data solutions that help marketers find, understand, and reach the right people. Our identity graph covers roughly 250 million US consumers and 120 million households. We are now building a transparent, consent-based data cooperative for consumer lead-generation publishers, and we are looking for a Senior Product Manager to lead it from concept to launch.

**Job Summary**

As Senior Product Manager, Data Cooperative & Activate, you will own a new publisher data cooperative and the Activate product line it powers. Publishers contribute on-site and form data under clear, documented terms. In return, they receive member services such as industry analytics and benchmarking, data appends, fraud and bot detection, and identity resolution.

This is a 0-to-1 build with a direct line to revenue on an established product line. You will design the member value exchange, sign and onboard publisher members, align other product teams around a shared member offering, and work with Engineering and Data to deliver the collection script, data feeds, and member services. You will work closely with Legal, Privacy, Sales, Finance, and an outside consulting firm, with regular exposure to executive leadership.

The role is an equal blend of partnership and product management. You should be as comfortable negotiating a data-sharing agreement with a publisher as you are writing acceptance criteria with an engineer.

**Responsibilities:**

**Co-op Strategy & Member Value Exchange**
------------------------------------------

* Own the vision, strategy, and roadmap for the publisher data cooperative.
* Define what members contribute and what they receive, including tiering (for example, Core and Premium) based on publisher discovery.
* Build and test member value propositions; decide which benefits lead and how to prove their value.
* Scope and launch member industry analytics (benchmarking and trend reporting) with the Data team, protecting each member's data in aggregate reporting.
* Model co-op economics and data-licensing value to inform packaging, pricing inputs, and investment decisions.

**Publisher Partnerships**
--------------------------

* Own the publisher pipeline from discovery through signed member agreement and onboarding.
* Lead conversations with publisher members and prospects on value exchange, integration, and data-use terms.
* Facilitate a Publisher Advisory Board to validate the model and gather ongoing feedback.
* Work with Legal and outside advisors to standardize member agreements and data-use terms.
* Select and launch pilot publishers, then scale membership month over month.

**Cross-Product Collaboration**
-------------------------------

* Inventory existing products that can be offered to members (for example, API data appends, identity resolution, fraud and bot scoring).
* Partner with other product managers on what is included, at what tier, and on what timeline.
* Define packaging, entitlements, and member-facing positioning for bundled services.
* Identify new data products and member services that can be built on co-op data.

**Activate Product Line**
-------------------------

* Own the Activate roadmap, pricing inputs, and inventory health.
* Plan the transition of current Activate data sources into the co-op model so inventory holds during cutover.
* Partner with Sales and Finance on revenue attribution and commercial performance.

**Execution & Delivery**
------------------------

* Write clear requirements and acceptance criteria with Engineering and Data for the collection script, scheduled data feeds, and member services.
* Define POC scope and success criteria with Data and Engineering.
* Work through dependencies across data infrastructure, identity, and integration teams.
* Build privacy into the program by design, including publisher notice

The Senior Product Owner is responsible for conveying product vision and roadmap to an Agile delivery team by defining user stories and prioritizing product backlog. The Senior Product Owner, Workforce Management is accountable for translating complex workforce management, enterprise product, and operational needs into measurable technology outcomes. This role serves as a critical connection point between multiple stakeholders, product leadership, technology teams, and vendor partners.

The Senior Product Owner translates business needs into actionable product requirements, manages the product backlog, prioritizes work based on strategic objectives, and partners closely with development teams to deliver solutions that improve workforce planning, forecasting, scheduling, real-time management, reporting, and operational efficiency. This role exercises considerable independent judgment and operates with minimal direction while supporting enterprise workforce management initiatives and capabilities.

Education has power – a power that changes lives forever. It creates opportunities that lift up individuals, their families, and sparks societal change that echoes through generations to come. We want our team members to have the well-being and confidence they need to do their best work, in an environment where both they and ACT thrive. To support this, our total rewards include company paid life insurance, medical, dental, vision, flexible health and dependent spending accounts, 401(k) retirement savings with company match, paid holidays, paid time off, and so much more. You can find a comprehensive list of our benefits here.

This role blends platform-level leadership with data strategy and product management, reporting to the VP of K12 Education. This role will also be responsible for contributing to and reviewing RFPs as needed for areas of expertise.

* Maintain ongoing knowledge and training in Interoperability standards for education technology to build and maintain a strategic roadmap for data services

jobs.desc:
**Senior Technical Product Manager, Platform & Partnerships – Job Description**

**Position Overview**

As a Senior Technical Product Manager for Platform & Partnerships, you will play a pivotal role in scaling our EdgeRX ecosystem as we bring AI Agents to market. This is a dual-focus role. Roughly half of your time will be spent building technology partnerships and integrations with CMMS, ERP, and other enterprise systems so that our Agents can be deployed directly into customers’ maintenance and operations workflows. The other half will be spent as an extension of the core product team, working closely with our engineering team in Pittsburgh to drive requirements, priorities, releases, and resolution of field issues across a rapidly growing base of deployments. This is a senior role reporting to the Head of Product, with a strong preference for candidates based in Southern California.

**What We Do**

We build AI-powered industrial solutions that help manufacturers monitor equipment health, prevent downtime, and improve efficiency. Our EdgeRX platform delivers real-time insights from vibration, TMR, and multi-signal data, while EdgeRX Vision adds computer-vision-based defect detection to catch issues early and reduce scrap. Together, these products turn raw factory data into actionable intelligence for sectors such as semiconductor, electronics, and automotive. With the upcoming launch of our AI Agents, we are extending that intelligence into action: connecting insights to the systems where maintenance and operations work actually gets done.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Technology Partnerships & Integrations (~50%)**

* Work with the Partnerships team to identify, evaluate, and prioritize technology partners, including CMMS/EAM, ERP, MES, and industrial data platforms, whose integration is critical to deploying our AI Agents.

* Own the technical scope of each partnership: define integration use cases, data flows, APIs, and success criteria jointly with partner product and engineering teams.

* Define how our Agents read from and act on partner systems, such as creating and updating work orders, synchronizing asset hierarchies, and using maintenance and production history.

* Write integration requirements and specifications, and work with engineering to deliver connectors, APIs, and integration frameworks on the EdgeRX platform.

* Lead technical evaluations, joint solution design, and pilot deployments with partners and customers.

* Create partner-facing technical documentation and integration guides, and enable Sales and Field teams to position and deploy partner integrations.

* Track partnership outcomes, including integrations delivered, deployments enabled, and partner-influenced pipeline.

**Product Management & Execution (~50%)**

* Act as an extension of the core product team, working closely with the Pittsburgh engineering team to translate the roadmap into clear requirements, user stories, and priorities.

* Drive release planning and coordination, including scope, readiness, release notes, and communication to customers and field teams.

* Triage field issues from a growing base of deployments, work with support and engineering to prioritize fixes, and feed learnings back into the roadmap.

* Monitor progress and remove blockers to keep execution on track against an aggressive roadmap.

* Engage directly with customers to understand real-world workflows, validate pain points, and gather detailed product requirements.

* Define and track KPIs, using data, field feedback, and user insights to guide decisions and continuous improvement.

**Stakeholder Engagement**

* Serve as the connection between product, engineering, partnerships, sales, and field teams across locations and time zones.

* Communicate product and partnership plans, progress, and outcomes clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders, including external partners.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.desc:
Seven Starling is revolutionizing women's behavioral health through our clinically-validated virtual care platform. As a venture-backed, rapidly scaling startup at the forefront of maternal healthcare innovation, we've developed a groundbreaking clinical model that combines specialized therapy, peer support, and medication management to effectively treat perinatal mood disorders. Our approach delivers exceptional results — 90% of patients experience clinically significant symptom improvement.

We've established strategic partnerships with leading health plans including UnitedHealthcare, Cigna, Blue Cross Blue Shield, and Aetna, plus a growing network of OBGYN clinics nationwide, positioning us for accelerated growth in the $50B+ women's behavioral health market.

### **About the role**

We’re hiring for a **Senior Product Manager** — a strategic, execution-minded builder who will be a core member of our Product team. This is a high-impact role reporting directly to the VP of Product and partnering closely with the engineering team and cross-functional roles to design and scale the systems and experiences that power our precision mental health care model.

The ideal candidate has at least 5 years of experience in product management and thrives in fast-paced, ambiguous environments. We're looking for a mission-driven and resourceful self-starter who excels at turning complex problems into clear, scalable solutions. You should be a strong communicator, deeply curious about user needs, and comfortable experimenting with AI tools to build systems and documentation from the ground up. Experience in digital health and early stage startup environments is strongly preferred.

If you're an experienced product professional with a strong commitment to our mission, we want to hear from you. Join us in paving the way for expanded access to high-quality women's mental healthcare!

### **What you'll do**

* **Own our end-to-end product development process**, from user research and scoping to execution, QA, and post-launch measurement and iteration
* **Conduct deep user research** with patients, clinicians, referring providers, and internal team members to understand their pain points and needs
* **Develop clear, actionable PRDs and prototypes** to define product specs and workflows that meet the needs of cross-functional stakeholders and set clear objectives for the engineering team to execute on
* **Lead product launches,** partnering closely with engineering, operations, and clinical leads on training, documentation, and process updates to ensure seamless rollout and adoption of new products and tools

* **Own the tools that run our patient journey,** from third-party survey and communication platforms, to EHR templates and the automations tied to scheduling, screening, and care coordination

* **Use AI tools** to accelerate your own work and continuously innovate on how we build as a team, from research and documentation to prototyping and design

* **Define and monitor success metrics** for core tools and services that we build, including data analysis, dashboard creation, and company-wide impact reporting

* **Partner with our VP of Product and other senior leaders** to inform roadmap planning and strategic prioritization

### **Who you are**

* You are a **senior-level individual contributor (IC)** with 5+ years of experience in product management, ideally with a significant portion of that time in digital health
* You have a track record of **owning complex, cross-functional products** from problem definition to launch
* You’re comfortable with **ambiguous, early-stage environments**, and excited to be a part of a small team developing product strategy, process, and tools
* You’re both **empathetic and systems-oriented** — equally energized by speaking with users and by designing scalable, backend workflows

* You actively **use AI tools to move faster** — you’ve used agentic tools to actually build or prototype, not just ask questions
