jobs.title: Senior Technical Product Manager
jobs.desc:
### **Who We Are**

Cobalt was founded on the belief of a fundamental human aspiration: the desire to live better and safer. It all started in 2013, when our founders realized that pentesting can be better. Today our diverse, fully remote team is committed to helping organizations of all sizes with seamless, effective and collaborative Offensive Security Testing that empower organizations to OPERATE FEARLESSLY and INNOVATE SECURELY.

Our customers can start a pentest in as little as 24 hours and integrate with advanced development cycles thanks to the powerful combination of our SaaS platform and an exclusive community of testers known as the Cobalt Core. Accepting just 5% of applicants, the Cobalt Core boasts over 400 closely vetted and highly skilled testers who jointly conduct thousands of tests each year and are at the forefront of identifying and helping remediate risk across a dynamically changing attack surface.

Cobalt is an equal-opportunity employer, and we strive to build a diverse and inclusive workforce. At Cobalt, we aspire to engage with diverse individuals, communities, and organizations to continue to nurture our unique, rich, diverse culture. Join our team, and be your true self to do your best work.

**Description**

Modern software demands continuous security validation. Cobalt is pioneering the evolution beyond legacy, point-in-time PTaaS through our Autonomous and Continuous pentesting platform-providing continuous, scalable, and AI-driven security coverage across enterprise environments.

In the role of **Senior Technical Product Manager**, you will shape the strategic product vision, steer live initiatives, and spearhead 0-to-1 feature development to drive business ROI across Cobalt's Autonomous and Continuous Pentesting portfolio. You will conduct deep product discovery, instill scalable PM leadership practices, and redefine how continuous, autonomous offensive security is delivered to modern enterprises.

You will combine strong business acumen with technical rigor, driving clear feature ownership from discovery to delivery. Operating as a proactive cross-functional leader, you will challenge existing processes and communicate transparently to ensure our continuous pentesting platform solves critical customer security problems with measurable impact.

**What You Would Do**

As a member of a growing team of product managers your responsibilities include:

* **Strategic PM Leadership & Business ROI:** Own the product vision, roadmap, and delivery for the Autonomous and Continuous pentesting portfolio. Align feature scope directly with customer value and measurable business outcomes, tracking clear adoption and retention metrics.
* **Product Discovery Excellence:** Lead continuous customer discovery and market validation to identify high-impact customer problems in the continuous security testing space. Translate complex user needs into actionable, validated product requirements.
* **End-to-End Feature Ownership:** Take full operational ownership of product features across the entire lifecycle—from initial ideation and specification to execution, deployment, and post-launch evaluation.
* **Proactive Leadership & Process Innovation:** Actively challenge inefficient workflows, implement scalable product processes, and foster high alignment across engineering, design, marketing, and executive stakeholders.
* **Transparent & Structured Communication:** Maintain standard executive-level visibility into roadmap progress, product decisions, and operational metrics through regular updates and clear artifact documentation.
* **Domain Expertise in Autonomous Security:** Serve as the internal subject matter expert on continuous vulnerability management, AI-driven offensive security techniques, and automated pentesting workflows.
* **Data-Driven Performance Management:** Define and monitor rigorous success criteria, evaluating product performance against strategic business metrics and customer satisfaction outcomes.

jobs.desc:
Beacon is building the essential technology infrastructure for the everyday economy: the businesses, organizations, and services that make real life work, and that mainstream tech has largely left behind. We acquire, operate, and grow vertical market software companies — niche, founder-built businesses serving industries that are often overlooked and too profitable to ignore.  
  
Our model is simple: we seek out founders who have built their business by spending years understanding their market and prioritizing their customers' specific needs. We buy great businesses, invest in their continued growth, and hold them permanently — accelerating that growth with an AI-native platform built specifically for vertical market software. No mandate to cut, flip, or roll up into something unrecognizable.  
  
We are not a financial firm. We are technology entrepreneurs and operators who believe the most important businesses in the world are already running quietly in industries most people never think about. Our job is to find them, support the people who built them, and make them better.  
  
Beacon is backed by a diverse base of investors, with $550M+ raised to date, including General Catalyst, Lightspeed, D1 Capital, CPMG, the family offices of the founders of Stripe, DoorDash, and Ramp, and evergreen funds built for the long game.

**About the Role:**
-------------------

You'll join Beacon's Portfolio Product team — a cross-functional group of Product Managers, Engineers, Designers, GTM experts, and Data Scientists working directly with our 40+ portfolio companies and counting (at roughly one new acquisition per week) to drive measurable outcomes through AI and software.

At the core, every PM at Beacon owns product outcomes for 2 to 5 portfolio companies at a time, acting as a hands-on, founding product leader embedded in each business. You'll sit close to the GM, the operators, and the customers, figure out where the leverage is, and ship software directly into the business. The best PMs don't just deliver for the companies they're deployed at — they compress what they learn into reusable playbooks that spread to every other portfolio company in the same vertical. The ultimate objective is to transform our portfolio companies into unicorns!

For the right candidates, this role grows beyond individual ownership. As your vertical scales, you may build and lead a team of PMs, take on hiring and coaching responsibilities, and become the person who sets product vision and standards across an entire industry segment — partnering directly with GMs, founders & operators, and driving planning across the whole portfolio. How much of that path applies to you depends on your background and trajectory, and we'll shape the role around what you bring.

This is not a consulting role. We ship software, not slides. The deliverable is a running system.

**Key Responsibilities:**
-------------------------

* Own product outcomes for 2 to 5 portfolio companies simultaneously, acting as a fractional/founding product leader embedded in each business
* Lead quarterly and annual planning, helping teams set product visions and translate them into achievable goals
* Build and maintain roadmaps that balance customer needs, business goals, and technical constraints
* Drive sprint planning and execution, improving team velocity and predictability over time
* Develop prioritization frameworks that help CEOs and operators make better product decisions
* Build customer feedback systems that turn qualitative inputs into actionable roadmap decisions

* Distill learnings into cross-portfolio playbooks that scale impact beyond your assigned companies

The Staff Product Manager is a senior individual contributor responsible for shaping product strategy, guiding product development, and partnering with stakeholders to deliver meaningful outcomes across complex digital services and technology initiatives.  
  
In this role, you will work closely with government customers, delivery teams, designers, engineers, researchers, and internal leadership to establish product priorities, define roadmaps, and help teams deliver solutions that meet user and organizational needs.  
  
As a trusted product leader, you will bring a strategic perspective while remaining connected to the day-to-day product work. You will have the autonomy to influence product direction, navigate complex challenges, and help multidisciplinary teams make informed decisions.  
  
This is an individual contributor position with no direct people management responsibilities. The role emphasizes product ownership, strategic collaboration, and stakeholder partnership rather than formal team management.

NOTE: this position can be remote anywhere within the United States.

As the Principal Product Manager for ClickHouse Cloud, you will be responsible for leading the development and delivery of the product working closely with engineering, customers, and stakeholders.

What you will do:

  • Define and drive the product roadmap for ClickHouse Cloud, with a focus on cloud-native database capabilities such as multi-region replication, distributed query execution, fault tolerance, storage tiering, and schema evolution.

  • Collaborate with engineering to prioritize and deliver improvements to the core database engine, storage layer, and query optimizer, ensuring the Cloud offering keeps pace with open-source and enterprise use cases.

  • Engage directly with customers, gathering insights through interactions, feedback, and market research to guide product decisions.

  • Work alongside design, marketing, operations, and sales teams to support feature launches, contribute to blog posts, and help shape product positioning and messaging.

  • Define and track key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure product success.

  • Act as the primary point of contact for all product-related communications, effectively managing expectations and keeping stakeholders informed.

About You:

  • Minimum 8+ years of product management experience with a strong background in cloud-based SaaS products. Deep familiarity with database systems, distributed systems, or real-time analytics platforms is strongly preferred.

  • Hands-on experience with SQL and strong understanding of query execution, indexing strategies, partitioning, and performance tuning.

  • Experience working with databases such as ClickHouse, PostgreSQL, MySQL, Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, or other columnar databases.

  • Understanding of modern data infrastructure: data lakes, ETL pipelines, CDC and data orchestration frameworks.

  • Demonstrated ability to work with engineering on low-level technical topics, such as schema management, query planning, storage engines, schema design.

  • Experience designing and delivering features such as database replication, consistency models, and backup/restore workflows.

  • Strong leadership skills with the ability to influence cross-functional teams and drive execution in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, capable of simplifying deep technical topics for non-technical audiences.

Bonus Points:

  • Experience working and scaling open source technologies

  • Prior experience at a startup

 
 

Perks

  • Flexible work environment - ClickHouse is a globally distributed company and remote-friendly. We currently operate in over 25 countries.

  • Healthcare - Employer contributions towards your healthcare.

  • Equity in the company - Every new team member who joins our company receives stock options.

  • Time off - Flexible time off in the US, generous entitlement in other countries.

  • A USD$500 Home office setup if you’re a remote employee.

  • Global Gatherings – We believe in the power of in-person connection and offer opportunities to engage with colleagues at company-wide offsites.

Culture - We All Shape It

As part of a rapidly scaling start-up, you will be instrumental in shaping our culture.

Are you interested in finding out more about our culture? Learn more about our values

**Company Description**

VERSANT (Nasdaq: VSNT) is an industry-changing media and entertainment business and home to trusted brands that shape culture, inform audiences, and build lasting connections. It operates across four core markets: political news and opinion, business news and personal finance, golf, and sports and genre entertainment. These markets are served through a powerful portfolio of iconic and innovative brands, including CNBC, MS NOW, USA Network, Golf Channel, Oxygen, E!, SYFY, and Versant's sports division USA Sports, along with complementary digital assets including Fandango, Rotten Tomatoes, GolfNow and GolfPass.

 **Job Description**

**The Opportunity:**  
  
GolfNow is seeking a Principal Product Manager to help shape the future of our B2B golf technology portfolio. You’ll work across multiple products that help golf course operators manage their businesses, improve customer experiences, and drive growth.  
  
In this role, you’ll combine deep customer understanding, strategic thinking, technical fluency, and strong execution to translate business priorities into meaningful product improvements and innovations. You’ll partner closely with Engineering, Design, and business leaders to navigate complex decisions and drive initiatives from discovery through measurable results.

You will work closely with external stakeholders — restaurant owners, GMs, head chefs, managers, accountants and bartenders — and translate their pain points to the MarginEdge engineering, design, operations, sales, and marketing teams. Overview:

**Working at Atlassian**

Atlassians can choose where they work – whether in an office, from home, or a combination of the two. That way, Atlassians have more control over supporting their family, personal goals, and other priorities. We can hire people in any country where we have a legal entity.

Responsibilities:

**About the team**
------------------

Confluence is where organizations write down what they know: decisions, architecture, process, and policy. But a company's work does not happen in one tool. It happens in file drives, chat, code hosts, CRMs, and data platforms.

The Aggregation team makes Confluence fill and organize itself from those tools. Content arrives with its source system's permissions intact, gets organized so a team can navigate it, and stays current as the underlying work changes. That content is what Confluence's AI answers are built on, which makes its coverage and quality the difference between an answer a team acts on and one they go verify by hand.

**About the role**
------------------

You will own how Confluence turns connected content into knowledge that maintains itself: what a space pulls in, how it gets organized, how it stays current, and when it flags that something important is missing. Vision through launch and iteration, on problems that arrive undefined.

Quality is the job here, not a stage of it. Content that is stale, mis-grouped, or wrong does more damage than content that was never connected at all, because a team will have already acted on it.

You are building for three audiences, and the role requires you to name which one you are serving in every decision: the admin who approves connecting a system of record and will disconnect it the moment trust breaks, the space owner accountable for a body of knowledge staying current, and the end user who wants the answer without knowing which tool it came from.

### **What you'll do**

* Own the strategy and roadmap for what connected content becomes inside Confluence: what gets pulled in, how it is grouped, titled, and summarized, and what happens to content that has gone stale or contradicts a published page.
* Define how messy inputs become usable structure. Documents, spreadsheets, meeting transcripts, chat threads, and CRM records do not arrive as pages, and deciding what shape they take in Confluence is the core of the work.
* Own freshness and decay. Decide what updates on its own when a source changes, what needs a human to confirm, and how a user can tell which one they are looking at.
* Set and defend the quality bar for retrieval: permission fidelity to the source, accuracy, and latency. Decide what does not ship, and hold that line when a date is at risk.
* Own the quality evals for the parts of the experience powered by a large language model. Define what a correct output looks like, build the test sets, catch regressions as models and content change, and decide when output is good enough that a user stops double-checking it.
* Decide where AI belongs in the experience and how it behaves when it is wrong. A suggestion that costs nothing to ignore and a suggestion that hijacks what someone was doing are the difference between a feature teams keep and one they switch off.
* Drive execution across Engineering, Design, Data Science, Research, Marketing, Partnerships, and Security and Trust. Bring clear recommendations to executive forums.
* Set the product bar. Mentor PMs and raise the quality of specs and decisions across the team.

### **What we're looking for**

* 8+ years in product management, including at least one product where content, retrieval, or a model-powered experience was the core value rather than a feature added later.
* You have taken a 0 to 1 product from strategy through launch and past the first disappointing metric.
* You have shipped features powered by large language models and owned their evals. You can walk through how you defined a correct answer, built and maintained the test set, cau

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.desc:
Ready to be a Titan?

At ServiceTitan, we're building the operating system for the trades. As we continue to scale, we're looking for a Senior Product Manager to join our Data & AI Platform team and own the algorithmic systems that sit underneath dozens of downstream product features and quietly decide what gets prioritized, surfaced, and trusted across ServiceTitan.


This is a senior individual contributor role for a product leader who thinks in statistics, not just user stories. The specific problems you'll own will shift based on what domain teams and our customers need most — today that might mean ranking methodology, deduplication logic, or causal inference; tomorrow it could be a different statistically-driven problem entirely. What stays constant is the kind of thinking: translating ambiguous, statistically messy problems into clear product requirements that engineering and ML can build against with confidence. This is a heavily stats-driven PM role: you'll be evaluating model tradeoffs, defining what "correct" means for a given system, and defending methodology choices to a technical audience as much as you'll be writing a roadmap.


What you'll do:

  • Define and own the roadmap for whichever algorithmic systems — ranking, deduplication, causal inference, or similar — are highest-priority based on domain team and customer need.
  • Translate real customer pain (bad matches, untrustworthy rankings, wrong conclusions drawn from correlated data) into statistically rigorous product requirements.
  • Co-author PRDs for statistically ambiguous problems where the "right answer" isn't obvious — you're defining the evaluation criteria as much as the solution.
  • Partner with ML and engineering to evaluate model tradeoffs (precision/recall, false positive cost, explainability vs. accuracy) and make the product call when there's no clean answer.
  • Set measurable, multi-quarter goals for algorithmic system health and lead cross-functional teams toward them with rigor.
  • Lead discovery with domain product teams and customers to understand where algorithmic errors actually cost time, money, or trust.
  • Proactively identify and resolve disagreements over methodology, ownership, and model quality before they stall multiple teams building on your systems.

What you'll bring:

  • 5+ years of product management experience, strong track record in enterprise B2B SaaS; experience with at least one of ranking/recommendation systems, entity resolution, or causal inference — this role will likely touch more than one over time.
  • Genuine statistical fluency — comfortable with precision/recall tradeoffs, confounding vs. causation, and model evaluation, regardless of which specific problem you're applied to.
  • Demonstrated ability to define evaluation criteria and "what correct looks like" for a new statistical problem from scratch, rather than working from an existing rubric.
  • Comfort context-switching between different algorithmic domains as customer and business priorities shift.
  • Experience translating customer-reported problems (bad matches, low trust in recommendations, wrong conclusions) into statistically defined product work.
  • Strong communication skills — explaining model tradeoffs to domain PMs, ML engineers, and customers who each need a different level of technical detail.
  • Self-starter who takes initiative and holds themselves accountable to outcomes — "mostly works" isn't good enough when customers are trusting your systems with real decisions.
  • Bachelors degree in Computer Science, or equivalent work experience.

Why This Role Matters:
Ranking, deduplication, causal inference — and whatever comes next — quietly decide what

jobs.title: Principal Product Manager, Agentic AI
jobs.desc:
Principal Product Manager, Agentic AI

REMOTE, United States

JOB OVERVIEW

Legion is building AI agents that carry out workforce management work, not agents that describe it.

Much of what is presented as AI in workforce management today is a conversational layer over an existing scheduling screen. The more substantial problem — software that reasons over demand, labor regulation, and employee preferences, then acts, with a person in the loop wherever the stakes require one — remains unsolved across the category. Legion intends to solve it, and this role leads the product work to get there.

You will take an agent surface from operational research through specification, prototype, evaluation, and enterprise deployment, working hands-on throughout. You will work closely with Legion's AI Lab engineers and with our CEO, who is engaged in this work daily.

 

RESPONSIBILITIES AND DUTIES

Agent definition. Determine what an agent is responsible for, which tools it may call, what it must escalate, what it must never do, and what a manager sees when it acts. These decisions affect employee pay and legal compliance. Much of this work is pre-launch, so you will shape the direction rather than inherit it. 

Problem selection. The hardest judgment in agentic product work is identifying which workflows suit an agent and which do not. You will spend substantial time inside customer operations — district managers, store managers, labor operations, frontline employees — and return with a ranked, defensible view of where an agent creates measurable value and where it does not.

The human-in-the-loop contract. Scheduling decisions affect income, childcare arrangements, and legal protections. For each agent action you will define where autonomy is appropriate, the escalation thresholds, how a manager overrides the system, what is logged, and how a compliance team audits the outcome. Legion treats this as a first-class design problem.

Build quality. You are accountable for what ships, not for what was specified. That means staying engaged through implementation: reviewing the build against the specification as it comes together, using the product yourself before anyone else is asked to, joining bug triage and design review, catching drift from intent while it is still cheap to correct, and holding a release when the quality is not there. Our customers experience the build, not the document. A well-written specification that produced a product managers do not trust is failed product work, and we assess it that way.

Evaluation. Build and maintain the evaluation sets that determine whether an agent is ready to ship and whether it is degrading in production — writing the cases, reviewing failure traces, setting the pass criteria. You will be the person who holds a release when the demonstration is persuasive and the evaluation is not.

Specifications. Legion uses Functional Requirements Documents as its ground-truth specification layer; release notes, enablement material, and sales content are generated from maintained specifications rather than reconstructed from code or institutional memory. Write FRDs that meet that standard and keep them accurate after release. A specification is where the work begins, not where your responsibility ends.

Commercialization. Partner with go-to-market on packaging, metering, pricing inputs, and field readiness. Agentic products raise difficult commercial questions — what unit to meter, what a customer is paying for when software performs work a person previously did — and you will be expected to hold a considered position on them.

About Foxit

Foxit is a global leader in PDF and digital document software—powering over 700 million users and hundreds of thousands of businesses worldwide. As we expand our SaaS platform and evolve our customer-centric product strategy, we’re building a new generation of product leadership.

This is a founding Technical Product Manager role, created to bridge the gap between Product, Go-to-Market, and Engineering teams across continents. You’ll shape how Foxit listens, translates, and delivers for customers at global scale.

The Opportunity

You’ll serve as the technical heartbeat of our global product organization—connecting real customer feedback from our Alpharetta GTM teams and enterprise clients directly to our engineering centers in China and Asia-Pacific.

Fluent in both English and Mandarin, you’ll ensure nothing is lost in translation—from nuanced customer pain points to detailed developer requirements. You’ll turn ambiguity into clarity, accelerate decision-making, and drive high-impact product outcomes.

Initially, you’ll own the Foxit Editor platform roadmap. Over time, your remit will expand to other Foxit SaaS products as business priorities evolve.

What You’ll Do

* Be the founding technical bridge across global teams—aligning Product, Engineering, and GTM functions around a shared roadmap.

* Translate enterprise customer needs (captured by Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success) into clear, technically feasible requirements for our China-based engineering teams.

* Communicate in Mandarin with developers to ensure accuracy, context, and priority alignment—closing feedback loops faster and reducing misinterpretation.

* Partner with Engineering & Architecture to validate technical feasibility, manage trade-offs, and influence design decisions.

* Work side-by-side with GTM teams in Alpharetta to surface key customer insights and turn them into product improvements.

* Define success metrics, lead release planning, and champion post-launch measurement to ensure real customer impact.

* Build scalable frameworks for cross-regional communication, ensuring the next generation of Foxit products are truly global in design and delivery.

* 7+ years in SaaS Product Management, Technical PM, or Platform PM roles.

* Bachelor’s or Master’s in Computer Science, Engineering, or related technical field.

* Fluency in both English and Mandarin (verbal & written) — must be able to communicate technical detail to developers in Mandarin.

* Strong technical acumen: APIs, SDKs, cloud architecture, data flow, agile methods.

* Proven ability to translate between customer needs and engineering realities.

* Experience working with globally distributed teams and bridging cultural and time-zone divides.

* Willingness to travel regularly to Alpharetta (~1 week/month).

Nice to Have:

* Experience with document workflow, PDF editing, or SaaS developer tools.

* Background in software engineering or technical architecture.

Why This Role Matters

This is not just a job—it’s an opportunity to define a new capability at Foxit.

* Influence strategic priorities, roadmap decisions, and customer experience across the full product lifecycle.

**About Technosylva**

Technosylva is a global leader in wildfire and extreme weather risk mitigation software. The Company’s market-leading solutions, enhanced by AI and machine learning capabilities, provide real-time and predictive insights to support electric utility, insurance and government agency customers.

Technosylva has provided critical solutions for the past 26 years. In 2022 the organization entered a period of significant growth and transformation with investment from TA Associates, a leading growth PE firm, scaling to about 175 employees and offering its product in over 10 countries. In 2024 General Atlantic, a leading global growth investor, announced a strategic growth investment in Technosylva to support the company in its mission.

**Role Overview**

Technosylva’s products help our customers protect people and assets by making high quality and timely decisions. They use our software to apply world class fire, weather, and climate modeling and simulations to pressing operational and planning decisions.

As a Senior Product Manager at Technosylva you will be responsible for driving the product vision, strategy, and execution for key functionality within our core SaaS Operations product line. You will lead the discovery and delivery of these functions within the product that solve real customer problems while helping scale the business. This role requires deep customer empathy, strong analytical skills, and collaboration across product, engineering, design, and business teams.

The people at Technosylva are passionate, expert, and welcoming. You’ll find this to be an environment where you can grow, while working to address some of the most urgent and challenging problems we face.

**Responsibilities**

* Lead product discovery through customer interviews, data analysis, and market research to identify valuable, usable, and feasible solutions for our utility and agency customers
* Create and maintain product artifacts while driving the process from conception through go-to-market, including beta testing and rollout strategies
* Partner with engineering teams to define technical solutions and success metrics that align with business objectives
* Develop and maintain the product roadmap and vision based on customer needs, market opportunities, and business strategy
* Build strong relationships with utility and other customers to deeply understand their workflows and pain points
* Collaborate across sales and customer success teams to gather feedback and market requirements
* Continuously refine product features based on customer feedback and emerging market needs
* Assist with product pricing and packaging strategies

  

**Required Skills**

* 4+ years of product management experience, including experience leading B2B/enterprise SaaS products
* Track record of driving product discovery and validation, including leading research programs and developing systematic approaches to customer feedback
* Expertise in SaaS metrics, unit economics, and business strategy
* Experience managing large-scale enterprise deployments with utility companies or similar regulated industries
* Advanced analytical skills with the ability to develop frameworks for complex decision-making
* Demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders and align cross-functional teams

  

**Preferred Skills**

* Product development experience in ClimateTech, wildfire and/or utility software
* Deep understanding of utility operations and regulatory frameworks
* Experience with ML and advanced analytics
* Experience using AI tools to manage product roadmaps, requirement writing and wireframing or UI/UX design

***About The Position***

The Senior Product Owner has a key role in Agile development, responsible for maximizing the value of a product. The Senior Product Owner acts as the voice of the customer and stakeholders, translating their needs and vision into actionable tasks for the development team. This position is responsible for executing the product vision, managing the product backlog, and collaborating with various teams to ensure the product meets customer needs and business goals.

***Key responsibilities include:***

***Connect with the Customer***

* Conduct research and connect directly with internal and external customers to gain a comprehensive understanding of their needs
* Leverage research, tools and techniques to build product solutions and features that enhance experiences for customers and co-workers
* Develop and maintain high-trust relationships with key stakeholders

**Product Vision & Roadmap**

* Partner with Product Managers to develop business cases and product roadmaps that accurately represent the investment and benefits of the products or features to be developed or enhanced

**Manage & Prioritize Backlog**

* Capture and translate project requirements into user stories ensuring they are well-formed, aligned with product strategy, and in compliance with regulatory requirements
* Accept stories and ensure elements such as quality and design have been effectively incorporated
* Foster collaboration with other Product Owners, Architects, Technical Leads and Managers across the agile and dependent teams to ensure successful delivery in accordance with project timelines and budget

**Deliver Value**

* Define, track, and communicate key product metrics to stakeholders, ensuring data-driven decision-making and continuous improvement across the product lifecycle
* Set quality assurance standards for agile teams, ensure test results adhere to standards and accept product deliverables on behalf of the customer
* Balance short-term and long-term goals, make strategic decisions that will benefit the product and drive business value

**Receiving and Applying Feedback**

* Champion products and features, present during demonstration and retrospective meetings, and other opportunities to provide updates and sustain alignment with stakeholders.
* Serve as primary liaison and contact for communication.

***Qualifications***

* Bachelor's degree required, master's degree preferred.
* 5+ years of experience with project/process improvement work required
* 2+ years full-time Product Owner or similar agile team experience required

### **Description**

**The Opportunity**

The Senior Product Manager owns a KWI product area end to end. You will evolve what clients run today and define where the product goes next. You are accountable for what it delivers, not only for what ships: adoption across the client base, measurable gains for the retailers using it, and a delivery pace the team can hold.

This is a hands-on role on a small product team. You will work directly with the retail teams who use your product every day, with engineering and design, and with the client-facing teams who see the problems first, in an AI-led, spec-driven development model.

**The Company**

We are a small team with a big vision: to be the premier provider of cloud technology solutions for retailers. KWI offers a complete, unified commerce solution, specifically designed to help specialty retailers grow their business. Our portfolio of customers includes Pandora, Bluemercury, Tom Ford and many other globally recognizable brands.

We combine Point of Sale, Merchandising, Order Management, CRM, and Loyalty into one cloud-based platform. We are a values- and mission-driven organization, and we believe that if we develop and demonstrate leadership in our strategy, operations, and people, we will continue to drive product innovation and service excellence.

**AI at KWI**

We are serious about AI. Not as a buzzword, but as a real part of how we work. We expect every member of our team to actively use AI tools to work smarter, move faster, and do more with less. We are not looking for someone who has heard of AI. We are looking for someone who can walk us through how they use it day to day: in their current role, in how they organize their work, and in how they solve problems. Curiosity and a willingness to experiment are non-negotiable.

* **Retail Domain Depth** –You understand how your domain works in practice, whether point of sale, merchandising and inventory, order management and fulfillment, or platform and integrations, and what breaks downstream, in stores and across channels, when the data or the process falls out of sync.

* **Spec-Driven Thinking** – You write structured, unambiguous specifications that engineering and AI coding agents can build from without guessing at intent.

* **Autonomy** – You operate independently on a small team where the roadmap, the process, and the answer are often yours to define.

Cybercrime is growing, and more businesses are getting hit by threats that used to target only the biggest organizations. That pushes defenders like us to operate at the highest level, and it deepens our need for good people who want to make a meaningful impact.

Founded in 2015 by former NSA cyber operators, Huntress is a remote-first team working to make enterprise-grade cybersecurity accessible to businesses of all sizes. We work closely with security teams and service providers protecting complex environments, often without the time or headcount to handle it all. That's why we build our technology in-house and back it with a 24/7 human-led Security Operations Center (SOC). As a result, our platform is never disconnected from the experts who manage it, ensuring our customers' protection.

Huntress now secures more than 6M endpoints and 16M identities worldwide. Those numbers keep growing because more businesses rely on us to help carry the load and operate with more confidence. Every day, you can see that commitment in how we stand with our customers and how we show up for each other.

**Location: Remote US**

**Compensation: $190,000 to $220,000 base plus bonus and equity**

**About The Role:**

We are building a product management organization to own and drive our product strategy, and we are looking for an experienced product manager to own a new team focused entirely on Security tooling for the Huntress SOC.

Our SOC is the cornerstone of the Huntress Security Platform, serving SMB and mid-market clients through MSP/MSSP and Reseller channels. Your users are professional security analysts, and they are down the hall. You will get direct, immediate, unfiltered feedback on everything you ship from people who do this work for a living.

You will be building internal-facing systems where the return is measured in analyst throughput and time-to-close rather than ARR, and you will need to make that case clearly to executive stakeholders.

**Who We Are**
--------------

Pindrop is a cybersecurity company delivering continuous identity verification across voice, video, and digital interactions. Powered by the Pindrop Intelligence Network, our unified trust platform helps enterprises answer three critical questions:

**Is this identity synthetic?** Detect AI-generated and manipulated voice and video.  
**Is this identity risky?** Identify fraud, suspicious behavior, and other risk signals.  
**Is this identity known?** Authenticate identities using voice, device, behavioral, and other signals.

Pindrop brings this intelligence together across purpose-built trust engines to help organizations make informed decisions in real time — protecting customers, workforce interactions, and emerging AI-driven interactions.

Pindrop protects billions of high-risk interactions for enterprises, including leading financial institutions, insurers, and healthcare organizations. Its technology is informed by more than 8 billion real-world interactions annually and protected by 300+ patents.

Recognized by TIME as one of the 10 Most Influential Software Companies of 2026 and by Inc. for Best in Business for Innovation, Pindrop is backed by leading investors including Andreessen Horowitz, IVP, and CapitalG.

### **What you'll do**

AI agents are becoming participants in customer and enterprise interactions. Organizations need more than a signal that a caller or participant is AI: they need to establish who the agent is, whom it represents, what it is permitted to do, and what evidence supports that decision. Pindrop is extending its real-time identity trust platform to help enterprises safely service authorized AI agents across communication channels, with verifiable identity, delegated authorization, risk-based controls, and auditable proof of access.

As Senior Product Manager, Agent Identity Management, you will take primary ownership of this emerging product area-from customer validation and product strategy to MVP execution, customer adoption, and commercialization. You will work autonomously with Research, Engineering, Security, Design, and go-to-market teams, making informed technical and commercial trade-offs while building a scalable enterprise offering. This is a hands-on individual-contributor role for someone who owns outcomes, not just a feature backlog.

* Own the product vision and roadmap for agent identity management: agent identification, identity verification, authorization signals, and secure servicing decisions, beginning with real-time voice interactions and expanding as customer needs validate.
* Lead customer discovery with enterprises, contact center leaders, security and identity teams, and agent ecosystem partners; translate workflows, threat models, and trust requirements into prioritized product opportunities.
* Define end-to-end experiences for agent registration or discovery, verified agent claims, delegated user or business authority, risk-based step-up, policy integration, and evidence-rich audit trails - with clear boundaries between Pindrop and enterprise decisions.
* Partner with Research, Engineering, and Security to evaluate technical approaches such as cryptographic identity assertions, public-key verification, anti-spoofing, replay protection, and trust signals; make pragmatic tradeoffs across security, usability, interoperability, and time to market.
* Drive early-access programs, prototypes, and customer pilots; establish hypotheses, measurable success criteria, and fast feedback loops to validate product-market fit and a repeatable deployment model.
* Work with adjacent Pindrop product teams to connect agent identity capabilities with deepfake detection, authentication, risk intelligence, and real-time policy/orchestration workflows.
* Shape integrations and ecosystem strategy across enterprise contact center platforms, agent providers, and identity infrastructure. Partner with Product Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success on differentiation

HuFriedyGroup is a leading manufacturer of dental instruments and infection prevention products. Our 10,000-plus products, hand-crafted by highly skilled artisans, are known for their precision, performance, longevity, reliability, and quality. To help dental professionals be The Best in Practice, HuFriedyGroup provides a unique combination of world class products, value-added services, clinical education, and dental community platforms that result in superior clinician performance and enhanced safety for dental professionals and their patients. Working at HuFriedyGroup is so much more than a job, as every employee has a part in driving and supporting the organization’s inspirational vision to be a global force in advancing dental performance through Best-In-Practice dentistry that improves lives around the world.

**About the job**
-----------------

HuFriedyGroup is creating a new Senior Digital Product Manager role dedicated to our Dental Service Organization (DSO) customer segment. DSOs are among the fastest-growing and most strategically important customers in dentistry, and they buy, operate, and measure value differently than independent practices: through multi-location parent/child account hierarchies, centralized procurement, contract pricing, and system-to-system integration. This individual will own the roadmap for implementing digital solutions for DSO customers, which may include eProcurement, eCommerce, DSO portals, and DSO-specific digital service offerings. This is a foundational role: there is no DSO digital roadmap today. The right person will immerse themselves in the business, learning how HuFriedyGroup serves DSOs and how DSOs operate, while building a backlog of digital opportunities that evolves into a living DSO roadmap. The work is agile and iterative, not linear: this role will launch near-term proofs of concept and pilots to learn quickly, pivot based on what is learned, and keep driving toward longer-term outcomes at the same time. The role reports to the Director, Digital Solutions Management.

This Senior Digital Product Manager will own the end-to-end product lifecycle from discovery and prioritization through delivery and optimization, working closely with Strategic and National Accounts, Commercial Excellence, Customer Care, Enterprise Technology, and external partners. They will develop a deep understanding of how DSO corporate teams (procurement, supply chain, operations, and clinical leadership) and the practices beneath them work, and use data, experimentation, and AI-enabled approaches to inform decisions. Success in this role requires strong B2B product judgment, fluency in enterprise account structures and integration patterns, and the ability to translate complex commercial and clinical workflows into clear, scalable solutions aligned with HuFriedyGroup's premium brand and long-term digital strategy.

**Responsibilities**

* Owns the DSO digital roadmap and backlog, building it from the ground up and continuously evolving it as the business, customers, and learnings change
* Builds a working understanding of the DSO segment, including how DSOs are structured, how they buy, and how corporate and practice-level teams work, through ongoing discovery with DSO customers, Strategic and National Accounts, Commercial Excellence, Customer Care, and Operations
* Captures and evaluates digital opportunities across eProcurement, eCommerce, DSO portals, and DSO-specific digital service offerings, assessing customer value, business impact, feasibility, and effort
* Balances near-term proofs of concept and quick wins with longer-term platform outcomes, pursuing both in parallel rather than in sequence
* Uses evidence from pilots, experiments, and customer feedback to validate, reprioritize, or pivot, and is willing to stop work that isn't delivering value

Arable brings sensing technology, agronomic modeling, and machine learning together to turn field data into practical decisions. Our crop intelligence system helps growers, agronomists, and global agriculture enterprises optimize water use, improve productivity, reduce risk, and scale sustainable practices with confidence.

We believe agriculture deserves tools as advanced and intuitive as the growers who rely on them. By connecting hardware, data science, and software, we turn complex information into clear insights. Our team works every day to bring that vision to life.

**Role Overview**
-----------------

We’re seeking a Senior Product Manager with AgTech experience who enjoys solving complex challenges at the intersection of agriculture, hardware, firmware, data science, and software. You’ll own end-to-end product execution, working across disciplines to deliver integrated solutions with real-world impact.

This role calls for an analytical, creative, and adaptable product leader who can quickly understand new challenges, establish priorities, and move initiatives forward independently. You’ll bring experience delivering technical agricultural products and a strong understanding of how hardware, software, and data work together to meet customer needs.

### **What You Will Do:**

* Own product execution from discovery and development through launch and ongoing improvement.
* Collaborate with hardware, firmware, data science, software, operations, and commercial teams to deliver integrated solutions.
* Turn customer and business needs into clear product requirements and actionable initiatives.
* Apply agile and lean methods to support rapid iteration and keep teams aligned.
* Work directly with growers and agronomists to understand their workflows and inform product priorities.
* Use data to guide decisions, validate product direction, and measure results.

### **Required Qualifications:**

* 2+ years of experience in AgTech, building or managing technical products for agriculture.
* Experience building products that span hardware, firmware, data science, and software.
* 5+ years in product management, including 3+ years in fast-growing startups.
* Demonstrated ability to get up to speed quickly, take ownership, and drive execution with limited guidance.
* Strong cross-functional leadership and communication skills.
* Experience working effectively in lean, agile, and iterative development environments.
* Creativity, curiosity, and sound judgment when navigating ambiguity.

### **Additional Experience We Value:**

* An agronomy background.
* Experience in precision agriculture, sensing, irrigation, or environmental intelligence.
* Experience in commercial or customer-facing roles.
* Operational experience, including leading operational teams or building products that support their work.

**Location and Travel:**
------------------------

* U.S.-based, with California preferred. Candidates in Nebraska, Oklahoma, Kansas, and Texas are also encouraged to apply.
* Willingness to travel up to 20%.
* If based in the San Francisco area, availability to work in the office three days per week.

**What We Do:**
---------------

At Arable, our goal is to connect all the world’s farms to help optimize the global food system. This is an ambitious goal, but the need has never been greater to rethink how we will feed an ever-growing population and reduce our impact on natural resources. We believe the heart of the solution is digitizing the analog world with high-fidelity data to help food producers optimize their operations. We hope the impact of our work will improve the lives of farmers everywhere and be a major contribution to securing the global food supply for decades to come.

* Giving produce growers in California the tools to optimize yields and minimize waste.

jobs.desc:
Vantor is forging the new frontier of spatial intelligence, helping decision makers and operators navigate what’s happening now and shape what’s coming next. Vantor is a place for problem solvers, changemakers, and go-getters—where people are working together to help our customers see the world differently, and in doing so, be seen differently. Come be part of a mission, not just a job, where you can: Shape your own future, build the next big thing, and change the world.

To be eligible for this position, you must be a U.S. Person, defined as a U.S. citizen, permanent resident, Asylee, or Refugee.

*Export Control/ITAR:* Certain roles may be subject to U.S. export control laws, requiring U.S. person status as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3).

**Please review the job details below.**

Vantor is seeking a Product Manager to lead its Direct and Rapid Access Program offerings for defense and intelligence customers. This role will shape strategy and guide products from concept through launch and ongoing support, advancing Vantor’s low-latency capabilities and driving profitable growth.

The Product Manager will translate customer and market needs into a strategic roadmap, align business priorities with technical delivery, and build strong partnerships across customers, sales, engineering, operations, marketing, finance, and external providers. The role calls for a strategic perspective and the ability to drive complex, technically demanding initiatives to measurable outcomes.

Key Responsibilities

* Set product strategy and maintain a roadmap aligned with customer needs, corporate priorities, and market opportunities.
* Gather and synthesize requirements with customers, sales, and business development; identify product gaps and opportunities to improve customer experience and grow market share.
* Align product and technical roadmaps, translating business requirements into product, operational, and system requirements.
* Partner with engineering, architecture, and operations teams to evaluate solution options, define work packages, and manage scope, schedule, budget, and delivery.
* Develop business cases and cost-benefit analyses, including capital, production, and sustainment costs; maintain forecasts and support financial and asset-management processes.
* Ensure solutions meet business requirements and are ready for production and the market; coordinate change management and communicate delivery status, risks, and dependencies.
* Develop competitive, pricing, positioning, and go-to-market strategies with product marketing; support sales through customer engagements and industry presentations.
* Establish product KPIs and reporting with Finance, and communicate product vision to internal teams and external partners.

Minimum Qualifications

* U.S. citizen or permanent resident.
* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, computer science, business, earth science, information systems, or equivalent practical experience.
* At least five years of product management experience building enterprise software or AI products.
* Proven experience taking technical products from concept through development and market adoption.
* Demonstrated ability to influence cross-functional teams and deliver complex initiatives in ambiguous environments.
* Experience with software development tracking tools such as Jira or Rally, and project management tools for scope, schedule, and budget.
* Strong written, verbal, and presentation skills.
* Ability to travel domestically and internationally up to 20%.
* Ability to obtain a TS/SCI security clearance.

Preferred Qualifications

* Active TS/SCI clearance.
* Experience with product lifecycle management, agile development, and bringing products to market.
* Strong analytical skills, including the ability to develop hypotheses, design experiments, interpret results, and make evidence-based decisions.
* Experience with business and technical requirements, process modeling, methodology development, or data modeling.

### **About the role**

Proven builds an integrated EHR platform: clinical documentation, scheduling, billing, reporting and integrations, all on one system. We're hiring a remote Senior Technical Product Manager to own it: decide what we build, in what order, and what we don't build yet.

You'll be the person who sees the whole system. When the business asks for something, you'll know what it touches and what it risks. You'll know whether now is "the right time", and you'll have the standing to say, "not yet" and back it up.

### **What you'll do**

* **Own the roadmap.** Weigh customer requests, sales commitments, compliance deadlines and technical health, and turn them into a plan the team can actually deliver.
* **Push back.** Tell the business "no" or "not now" when a request doesn't fit, with clear reasoning and tradeoffs.
* **Protect the system.** Before anything is built, assess what it touches across clinical, billing, scheduling, permissions, integrations and customer configurations. Identify downstream risks and define the level of review and testing required.
* **Write requirements developers can build from:** workflows, acceptance criteria, edge cases and dependencies.
* **Own quality standards.** Write test cases and UAT guides that prove a feature works and didn't break anything else. Establish consistent testing standards and help improve AI-assisted regression testing, working with Operations to identify coverage gaps and validate results.
* **Drive release readiness.** Ensure testing results, unresolved defects and material risks are reviewed and documented before release decisions are made.
* **Partner with the Chief Software Architect** and developers on scope, design tradeoffs and release readiness.

### **What you bring**

* 5+ years in product management on complex, multi-module software, ideally after time as a BA or QA.
* A track record of owning a roadmap and defending it under pressure.
* Strong requirements and test-case writing.
* Systems thinking: you instinctively ask, "what else does this touch?"
* The technical depth to work closely with engineers without writing the code yourself.
* Comfort with AI tools, and the judgment to know when not to trust them.
* The ability to balance product priorities, quality, and risk without creating unnecessary process or slowing delivery.

### **Nice to have**

* Healthcare IT experience: EHR, revenue cycle or behavioral health.
* Familiarity with ONC certification, HIPAA or other regulated environments.
* Experience as an early or first product hire at a growing software company.
* Establish a practical risk-review and release-readiness process, including clear testing expectations and documented exceptions.

### **Your first 90 days**

* Put a requirements and test-case standard in place that every new ticket meets.

jobs.desc:
**About Property Meld**
=======================

Property Meld's mission is to radically improve how the property management industry handles maintenance, through our Intelligent Maintenance platform. If you have ever had a maintenance issue at a rental, you know how painful it can be to get fixed. It does not have to be this way. We are rethinking the entire experience to drive maintenance cost toward the minimum and make residents and owners want to stay with their property manager, not leave.

### **The role**

We are hiring a Senior Product Manager to own outcomes for a meaningful part of our product. You are accountable for solving problems that create real value, for our customers and for the business, not for shipping features. A shipped feature is a bet, not a result. Your job is to make the right bets and to carry them through to value customers actually recognize.

This is a role for someone who wants to own the whole arc of a problem: understanding it deeply, deciding what to do with your design and engineering partners, and staying with the work through launch and beyond to confirm it landed. If your ideal job is writing requirements and handing them off, this is not it. If it is living with a problem until customers rely on the answer, it is.

You will often be the only product person in the room, and what you decide there holds.

### **What you will own**

**Outcomes, not output.** You hold two questions at once: do customers get real value (desirability), and does the business (viability, which in our subscription model means strengthening why customers subscribe, expand, and stay).

**The "why" behind every bet — including the ones nobody asked for.** Before work earns a place on the roadmap, you make the case for it in writing: the problem, the job the customer is trying to get done, the outcome you expect, and why the bet will work. Responding well to inbound requests is table stakes at this level, not the job — you connect your work to where the business needs to be beyond the current cycle.

**Recognized value, not satisfaction.** A happy customer is a weak signal. You push past sentiment to whether customers recognize value they cannot do without, because that is what earns renewal.

**Carrying the "why" to everyone.** You are the face of the product trio to the rest of the company, and to customers directly. You package the reason, the outcome, and the value so the team, our customer-facing teams, and customers can each act on it. Value that is never understood is never realized.

### **How you will work**

**In a product trio.** You discover and decide alongside design and engineering, before the build, not by passing specs over a wall. The strongest solutions come from value, usability, and feasibility being reasoned about together.

**Close to customers, continuously.** Staying grounded in first-hand customer reality is a standing habit, not a kickoff phase.

**Across the whole lifecycle.** You stay engaged from the problem through delivery, rollout, and measurement. Staying close to the build and to QA is how you earn the technical fluency that makes you sharper at the job over time.

**Through influence, not authority.** You rarely manage the people you work with. Your job is to create clarity, alignment, and momentum in every direction without relying on positional power.

**What we are looking for**

We hire for how you work, not where you have worked, and we hire for culture add, not culture fit: people who bring something we do not already have.

**Deep customer curiosity.** You listen to understand, stay close to the people who use the product, and dig for the value they recognize, not just whether they seem content.

**Evidence over ego.** You hold your convictions strongly but loosely, and you change course when the evidence says a bet will miss.

**Priority discipline, earned.** You protect focus, can say no in a way earned by consistently delivering, and push for better evidence before the t

We are seeking a Senior Product Manager to drive the vision, strategy, and execution for a key product area within the Auth0 Identity Security product line, with a focused mandate on the rapidly evolving domain of Agentic Security. We are the team that builds solutions that protect our customer's Auth0 environments. Our group delivers features such as attack protection, bot detection, adaptive MFA, identity security for AI Agents and related analytics / insights on the effectiveness of our solutions in thwarting attacks from bad actors.

The ideal candidate brings direct, hands-on experience in agentic security product management, with a deep understanding of how AI agents are built, orchestrated, and secured. This includes practical knowledge of agentic workflows, MCP servers, agentic tooling, and their use through productivity applications such as Claude Code.

A core focus of this role is runtime security & AI agent classification: building real-time detection, behavioral analysis, and protection capabilities for agentic systems. The successful candidate will have command of the OWASP Top 10 for Agentic AI attack vectors and mitigations, and will bring experience in identifying and responding to threats such as prompt injection, agent intent anomalies, and rogue agent detection — including scenarios where an agent may have been compromised or infiltrated.

Beyond agentic-native threats, this role demands strong fluency in fraud and risk mitigation, spanning both traditional and emerging attack surfaces. jobs.title: Senior Software Product Manager - Factory Systems
jobs.desc:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century's most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril's family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

**ABOUT THE JOB:**

The Software Product Manager for ArsenalOS will own multiple Factory-touching platforms: software that enables stakeholders such as production managers, manufacturing engineers across disciplines, and automation and controls engineers to map the physical world to a digital one (its locations, work centers, stationed tools, assets, and more) and to execute workflows at the speed we require. These platforms sit within ArsenalOS Connected Factory and will start by unifying how locations, work centers, tools, and assets are modeled across the warehouse management system (WMS), manufacturing execution system (MES), and asset management system (AMS), along with multiple different types of sensor systems, into a seamless operating environment, replacing manual processes with purpose-built systems designed for how Anduril actually builds.  
  
You will build this product from the ground up, from vision through MVP to scaled adoption. You must be able to zoom all the way in to improve how a single user stands up a station or commissions a smart tool, sensor, tester, controller, etc., and zoom all the way out to design the systems, data models, and integrations that connect all manufacturing systems. At Anduril's build rate, every gap between the digital model of the line and its physical reality is where production quietly slows down, and closing that gap is the whole job.

**WHAT YOU'LL DO:**

* Define and own the product strategy and roadmap for the Forge Factory, with a clear point of view on the what, why, and why now.

Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. Reddit is looking for an experienced Product Manager to help build a safe experience for the next generation of experiences for younger users while preserving a high-quality consumer experience. You will own ambiguous, zero-to-one product problems at the intersection of consumer product, safety, identity/age assurance, and global regulation. You will work closely with legal and cross-functional partners to determine what is truly required, frame clear options and tradeoffs, and ship scalable experiences that can adapt as laws and expectations evolve across markets.

Responsibilities

  • Own strategy, roadmap, requirements, launch, and measurable outcomes for Youth product initiatives.

  • Develop youth-specific product protections and controls, including age-gated content experiences, parental-control flows, and appropriate restrictions on product mechanics such as notifications, personalization, or chat where required.

Must-have qualifications

Company Background

Censys’ mission is to be the one place to understand everything on the internet. Frustrated by the lack of trustworthy Internet intelligence, we set out to create the industry’s most comprehensive, accurate, and up-to-date map of the Internet. Today, Censys delivers real-time Internet intelligence and actionable threat insights to global governments, over 50% of the Fortune 500, and leading threat intelligence providers worldwide.

We are hiring a Senior Product Manager to scale execution of the Censys Internet Map: the most continuously updated view of every asset, port, service, and certificate we can find across the public internet. Building it means running one of the largest internet-wide scanning operations in the world - 400+ Protocols providing access to 3Trillion+ scans in our APIs, 10PetaBytes+ of historical data, scanning 250Million+ IPs across 65K ports daily, resolving 8Billion+ names every 24 hours and tracking DNS at scale, tracking 18B+ certificates, fingerprinting 100K+ technologies behind what we find, enriching all of it with human readable labels, and third-party context so it becomes actionable intelligence rather than raw data.

This role is anchored in disciplined delivery, translating complex coverage and enrichment priorities into requirements engineering can build against. You'll define business and customer priorities, run the delivery cadence, and keep engineering and cross-functional stakeholders aligned on what's shipping and why it matters.

What You’ll Do

Internet Map Execution: You will define the business and customer priorities behind what goes into the Internet Map and how it stays best-in-class. This is the lever that enables Censys to be successful across every product and every segment we operate in.

  • Coverage: How do we grow the map, how often we refresh it, and how comprehensively? This spans expanding IPv4/IPv6 scan scope, adding and prioritizing ports and protocols, increasing scan and DNS resolution frequency, and improving certificate and host discovery. You'll define this data collection work as detailed engineering requirements and acceptance criteria, and track coverage against baselines to identify and close gaps.
  • Context: How do we enrich data into actionable intelligence? You'll define enrichment priorities based on customer and product needs: technology fingerprinting, risk scoring, and third-party data integrations. This includes evaluating external/third-party data sources for accuracy, coverage, and cost; defining the metrics used to judge data and enrichment quality; defining the schema that structures how coverage and context data is represented; and writing the documentation that makes both understandable and usable internally and externally.

Cross-Team Alignment and Execution:

  • Drive cross-functional data prioritization across the Censys suite and provide business priority input into sequencing for new protocols and enrichments, ensuring data investments align with company goals, resolve multi-product conflicts, and provide roadmap transparency to other product managers and EMs.
  • Engineering partnership and data quality: You ensure Engineering teams working on scanning infrastructure, data pipelines, and enrichment systems have well-defined requirements, clear acceptance criteria, and the context they need to make good architectural decisions. Track coverage and context quality against baselines. Identify gaps between current state and target, and translate findings into concrete engineering work to close them.

jobs.title: Staff Product Manager, Manufacturing Software
jobs.desc:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century's most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril's family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

### **ABOUT THE TEAM**

Maritime Digital Production (MDP) is the software and digital systems function within Anduril's Heavy Metal division. We build the software-defined shipyard. That means the full technology stack running Anduril's shipbuilding factories: the data infrastructure that makes every machine and sensor visible in real time, ArsenalOS (our manufacturing execution system that workers and planners use every shift), the scheduling engine that replans production in minutes instead of days, and the AI systems that eliminate manual toil from both the shop floor and business operations.  
  
This work is anchored by Arsenal-2, our software-defined shipyard being built in Baltimore County, Maryland. It's part of a new $6.6 billion investment in America's submarine industrial base. ArsenalOS is the digital backbone of that yard. It connects fabrication and outfitting to material movement and inspection. Planners get one real-time view of production. We aren't waiting for the yard to open. Development is already underway here in Orange County, California. The team is proving out the manufacturing methods and digital workflows that will scale across the shipyard network.  
  
MDP operates at the boundary between Operational Technology and Information Technology. Our systems live where factory-floor machines, edge compute, and OT networks meet enterprise platforms and cloud infrastructure. We incubate solutions close to the production line, validate them with real operators building real hardware, harden them for reliability and security, and then scale them across multiple sites. The environment is fast, physical, and consequential. When our systems go down, production stops. The output of our work is not a dashboard: it is a ship.  
  
This is not a support function. It is a strategic investment by Anduril in the premise that digitizing the manufacturing lifecycle end-to-end, from engineering definition through scheduling through execution through field feedback, is how Heavy Metal will out-build, out-adapt, and out-scale the traditional defense industrial base. MDP is scaling from a founding team to 70+ engineers across multiple U.S. sites. You will be joining early, working on hard problems with real operational stakes, and shaping how manufacturing software is built at Anduril from the ground up.

### **ABOUT THE JOB**

As a Staff Product Manager for Manufacturing Software, you will lead product for the entirety of Maritime Digital Production. Rather than owning a single line of effort, you will set product vision and strategy across MDP's domains: the factory data platform, the manufacturing execution applications, the scheduling and optimization engine, and the AI systems that remove manual toil from the shop floor and business operations. You will be the senior product voice for the function, balancing investment across these domains, raising the product bar, and guiding the other product managers on the team.

jobs.desc:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century's most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril's family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

### **ABOUT THE TEAM**

Maritime Digital Production (MDP) is the software and digital systems function within Anduril's Heavy Metal division. We build the software-defined shipyard. That means the full technology stack running Anduril's shipbuilding factories: the data infrastructure that makes every machine and sensor visible in real time, ArsenalOS (our manufacturing execution system that workers and planners use every shift), the scheduling engine that replans production in minutes instead of days, and the AI systems that eliminate manual toil from both the shop floor and business operations.  
  
This work is anchored by Arsenal-2, our software-defined shipyard being built in Baltimore County, Maryland. It's part of a new $6.6 billion investment in America's submarine industrial base. ArsenalOS is the digital backbone of that yard. It connects fabrication and outfitting to material movement and inspection. Planners get one real-time view of production. We aren't waiting for the yard to open. Development is already underway here in Orange County, California. The team is proving out the manufacturing methods and digital workflows that will scale across the shipyard network.  
  
MDP operates at the boundary between Operational Technology and Information Technology. Our systems live where factory-floor machines, edge compute, and OT networks meet enterprise platforms and cloud infrastructure. We incubate solutions close to the production line, validate them with real operators building real hardware, harden them for reliability and security, and then scale them across multiple sites. The environment is fast, physical, and consequential. When our systems go down, production stops. The output of our work is not a dashboard: it is a ship.  
  
This is not a support function. It is a strategic investment by Anduril in the premise that digitizing the manufacturing lifecycle end-to-end, from engineering definition through scheduling through execution through field feedback, is how Heavy Metal will out-build, out-adapt, and out-scale the traditional defense industrial base. MDP is scaling from a founding team to 70+ engineers across multiple U.S. sites. You will be joining early, working on hard problems with real operational stakes, and shaping how manufacturing software is built at Anduril from the ground up.
