jobs.title: Director, Regional Product Management
jobs.desc:
**Company Description**

It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.

Join us to put AI to work for people.

 **Job Description**

**Position overview**

A Regional Product Manager (RPM) connects global product strategy to execution in a specific market. Product managers build features and own the core roadmap with engineering teams. An RPM takes that roadmap into one market, adapts it to local customers, regulations, and buying patterns, and owns its commercial success there. At ServiceNow, RPM markets are defined by geography, industry, or customer segment.

In this role, you will own one industry or customer segment in the Americas. You will be the person responsible for how ServiceNow's AI products are positioned, sold, adopted, and improved in that market. This is an individual contributor (IC) role, reporting to the leader of Regional Product Management for the Americas.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Regional strategy and adaptation**

* Translate the global AI product roadmap into a plan for your industry or segment
* Tailor use cases, solution packages, and messaging to the operational problems your customers care about most
* Account for industry regulations and compliance requirements in how solutions are positioned and deployed
* Track AI adoption trends in your market and adjust priorities as they shift

**Go-to-market and sales enablement**

* Partner with sales, marketing, and channel partners to launch AI products into your market
* Run discovery on priority deals and shape buying criteria and deal sizing toward AI early in the sales cycle
* Build discovery guides, use case catalogs, demo stories, and value stories that sellers can reuse
* Make sure AI use cases go live after every win, working with customer success, professional services, and partners on success criteria, go-live dates, and adoption metrics

**Commercial strategy and financial targets**

* Own the commercial strategy for your market, including product mix, packaging, and deal structure, to meet revenue and margin targets
* Set and own quarterly targets for deals in motion, AI attach, and discovery completed before close
* Work with pricing teams on packaging and discount guidance suited to your customers

**Voice of the customer**

* Act as the technical and commercial expert in the field for your market
* Gather customer feedback and turn repeated needs into solution requirements for product teams
* Test emerging AI ideas with customers and bring the ones with traction to the teams that build new products
* Represent ServiceNow with customer executives, at industry events, and in customer advisory sessions

**Competitive intelligence**

* Monitor competitors selling AI into your market, including industry-specific vendors and horizontal AI platforms
* Analyze win/loss data to find patterns in why deals are won, lost, or stalled
* Equip sales teams with positioning and responses to competitor claims

  
**Qualifications**

To excel as a Regional Product Manager (RPM), you need a unique blend of commercial acumen, cross-cultural leadership, and technical credibility. Because you sit between global development teams and local sales teams, your skillset must balance strategic thinking with ground-level execution.

**Commercial and strategic skills**

* You design and run launch plans suited to how your market buys, including the partners, procurement processes, and executives involved
* You

jobs.title: Director of Product & Cloud Engineering
jobs.desc:
Our Corporate Product Development team is seeking interest for a Director of Product & Cloud Engineering.

The Director of Product & Cloud Engineering leads Product Development, the engineering team that builds and runs BI WORLDWIDE's recognition and rewards platform. This role is responsible for leading and mentoring engineering managers and teams while owning how BI WORLDWIDE governs, secures, and manages the cost of its cloud environment as the organization moves out of its data center.

The ideal candidate is a proven engineering leader who develops managers, stays technical enough to make the hard calls, and brings strong cloud (AWS) governance, security, and cost management experience.

**Responsibilities**

* Lead product engineering managers, UX designers, and Cloud Engineering team; hire, develop, and retain strong talent.
* Mentor and coach engineering managers as they own their areas and run a sprint-based SDLC.
* Set cross-team priorities and make the trade-offs that keep the product roadmap predictable.
* Own product platform health, including reliability, performance, and disaster recovery.
* Partner with Product, Client Services, Sales, and offshore engineering teams to deliver roadmap commitments.
* Own Cloud governance across teams, including cost management (FinOps), tagging, account structure, and access management.
* Partner with BI WORLDWIDE's Security team to keep the cloud environment secure, monitored, and compliant.
* Establish and lead a Cloud Center of Excellence that sets shared cloud standards cross functionally.
* Oversee the task force moving applications from private data center to the cloud.
* Provide director-level communication, status reporting, and escalation management to leadership.

**Qualifications**

* 10+ years of software engineering experience, including 5+ years leading engineering teams and leading engineering managers.
* Proven leader and mentor of direct reports, with a track record of building strong teams.
* Experience leading multiple teams through a sprint-based SDLC with predictable delivery.
* Deep software engineering background; highly technical and credible with engineers and architects.
* 5+ years of hands-on cloud (AWS) experience and strong knowledge of cloud engineering and DevOps.
* Cloud governance experience, including FinOps, tagging, IAM, and security baselines, with strong knowledge of cloud and infrastructure security.
* Ability to influence teams and leaders who do not report to you.
* Strong communication and presentation skills, including experience with executive audiences and clients.
* BA/BS in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent experience.
* Experience migrating applications and databases from on-premise data centers to the cloud is a plus.

**What Success Looks Like**

* Maintains a strong product engineering team whose managers grow and own their areas.
* Delivers the product roadmap predictably while keeping the platform stable and secure.
* Brings cloud cost, tagging, and security standards under clear, centralized governance.
* Makes the Cloud Center of Excellence the go-to source for cloud standards across the organization.
* Moves applications out of the data center on plan, without disruption to clients.

Base Salary Range: $160,000.00 to $210,000.00. The final salary and offer will be determined by the applicant's background, experience, and skills.

More details about our company benefits can be found at the following link: https://www.biworldwide.com/careers/benefits-page/

jobs.title: VP, Product Management
jobs.desc:
***Lead with Purpose, Unlock Your Team’s Passion***

At LPL, people leaders hold the key to the employee experience — shaping culture, driving performance, and guiding individuals to new heights. Because when that happens, we all win – clients, LPL, and most importantly our, employees.

If you're ready to lead with intention and discover what’s possible, LPL Financial invites you to apply today.Job Overview

**Job Overview**:

The Vice President, Product Management, Financial Planning Technology will lead a product team responsible for helping more than 30,000 financial professionals, including 6,000 CFP® professionals at LPL, deliver advice and financial planning to their clients. This role will shape and deliver technology experiences that enable advisors to incorporate planning more effectively into their practices and serve their clients’ needs.

This role combines financial planning knowledge with hands-on product management, owning initiatives from strategy and discovery through delivery, testing, launch, and ongoing improvement. The VP will directly manage and develop product team members while collaborating closely with LPL’s Financial Planning team, Technology, Compliance, Sourcing, Marketing, and other groups to align priorities and deliver integrated planning experiences.

The ideal candidate understands how financial planning software works, how advisors use it, and how it connects with the broader wealth management technology ecosystem. They bring sound judgment, clear communication, and the ability to move work forward independently while developing their team and building strong cross-functional partnerships.

**Responsibilities**

* Define product strategy and roadmaps for financial planning technology, aligning advisor and client needs with business priorities and measurable outcomes.
* Lead, coach, and develop a team of product professionals, establishing clear goals, accountability, development opportunities, and ownership across initiatives.
* Lead product discovery through advisor interviews, workflow analysis, user feedback, competitive research, and data analysis to identify problems and validate opportunities.
* Translate opportunities into clear business cases, product requirements, features, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
* Own and prioritize the product backlog, making informed tradeoffs across business value, user experience, technical complexity, risk, and dependencies.
* Partner with Technology, Design, and business teams within a SAFe Agile delivery environment, supporting planning, refinement, execution, and release readiness.
* Guide integration of financial planning platforms with advisor workflows and related systems, partnering with technical teams on data requirements, connectivity, and user experience.
* Develop testing approaches and lead business validation and user acceptance testing to confirm solutions meet requirements and address advisor needs.
* Partner with the Financial Planning team to align technology capabilities with planning strategy, advisor needs, and the practical delivery of advice.
* Lead go-to-market efforts, coordinating with Marketing, Training, Service, and other partners on positioning, communications, education, launch readiness, and adoption.
* Manage relationships with financial planning technology providers, partnering with Sourcing and other stakeholders on vendor evaluations, commercial considerations, roadmaps, integrations, and issue resolution.
* Establish and monitor product success measures, using adoption, engagement, user feedback, and business results to guide ongoing improvements.
* Partner with Risk, Compliance, Legal, Information Security, and Operations to address applicable requirements throughout the product lifecycle.
* Communicate priorities, progress, risks, dependencies, and decisions clearly to stakeholders and leadership.

**What Are We Looking For?**

We’re looking for strong collaborators who deliver exceptional client experience

**Overview**
------------

The Director of Product is responsible for how Nebraska Journalism Trust connects its journalism with the people we serve.

This organizational leader sits at the intersection of editorial, audience, technology, development and events. They will oversee the systems, products and strategies that help more Nebraskans discover our journalism, become loyal users, attend our events and ultimately become supporters of our work.

Great journalism only creates impact when people experience it. At the Nebraska Journalism Trust, we believe in our bones that serving audiences means stories are a first step, not a final product. Serving audiences means creating products, experiences and relationships that earn trust over time. We believe that great journalism is the foundation on which we build relationships however Nebraskans demand. A killer story can be a longform piece on a website, a short form video, a mailer, value for our print partners, a live event and who knows what else. This role is intended to make sure we use every part of the buffalo.

**The Role**
------------

Part strategist, part operator and part builder, this person will guide everything from newsletter strategy and website development to audience analytics, marketing, live events and emerging products. They'll help ensure our journalism reaches the right people in the right ways while continually experimenting with new approaches to deepen engagement.

This leadership role works closely with the Executive Director, News Director and Advancement Director and supervises the staff responsible for audience engagement, marketing and events. The Director of Product will help shape how Nebraskans encounter our journalism for years to come.

------------------

* Lead experimentation around new products and distribution channels, whether that's podcasts, video, print publications, creator partnerships or ideas we haven't imagined yet.
* Use audience data and analytics to identify opportunities, measure success and guide organizational priorities.
* Own the roadmap for the products our audience experiences, and guide major platform initiatives, including website improvements, newsletter infrastructure, CMS evolution and emerging audience technologies.
* Lead projects such as migrating newsletter providers or processes, our planned transition to Newspack and future technology investments, ensuring our technology serves our audience.
* Manage the organization's audience technology ecosystem, including newsletter platforms, website infrastructure, analytics tools and audience engagement software.
* Serve as the primary organizational leader for evaluating, implementing and improving new technology, working closely with vendors, developers and internal teams to ensure systems integrate effectively.

jobs.desc:
Wood Mackenzie is the global leader in analytics, insights and proprietary data across the entire energy and natural resources landscape.

For over 50 years our work has guided the decisions of the world’s most influential energy producers, utilities companies, financial institutions and governments.

Now, with the world’s energy system more complex and interconnected than ever before, sector-specific views are no longer enough. That’s why we’ve redefined what’s possible with Intelligence Connected.

* Inclusive – we succeed together

**About the role**
==================

Wood Mackenzie's trading customers act on our forecasts and analytical models every day, across power, gas and oil markets. We are turning that modelling estate into a portfolio of products in its own right: versioned, documented, commercially packaged, and consumable by machines as readily as by analysts.

The Director of Modelling Products owns that portfolio. You set the strategy for what we model and why, you own the commercial case for investment across commodities, and you lead the product leads who hold each market. You will not build the models yourself and you will not own the engineers who implement them. You decide what the portfolio should contain, hold the standard it is judged against, and make the case for what we invest in next.

**What you will own**
=====================

* **The portfolio strategy.** Which models we build, rebuild, retire or acquire across power, gas and oils. You own the investment case and the sequencing, and you defend both.
* **Productization of analytical assets.** Moving models and their underlying features from research outputs into products, with versioning, documented methodology, reproducible outputs and a defined release cycle. This is the central program of the role.
* **The modelling product leads.** Senior product people holding market specific depth in their commodities. You hire them, develop them, set their objectives, and hold a consistent methodological standard across them.
* **Methodology governance.** One standard for validation, change control, backtesting and documentation, so that a colleague or a customer can understand what a model does and how much to trust it.
* **Commercial packaging and distribution.** How modelling assets reach customers: in applications, through APIs and data platforms, and as inputs to our own analysts. You work with commercial teams on pricing and packaging.
* **The partnership with central engineering and modelling functions.** Development capacity is provided centrally and built to your specification. You set requirements, review implementations and hold the quality bar without managing the developers.

**What we are looking for**
===========================

* **A quantitative background you can draw on.** A degree in a mathematical, engineering or scientific discipline, and real experience with linear programming, econometric or machine learning modelling. You need to be able to discuss, validate and challenge a methodology on its merits rather than take it on trust.

dot.cards is building the platform for what happens after people connect in the real world. We began by making it effortless to share a digital profile with a tap. Our next chapter is to turn that foundation into a configurable software platform. Reusable building blocks, including profiles, contact exchange, payments, messaging, booking, data capture, digital credentials, analytics, and integrations, will power focused products for different cohorts and industries. The opportunity spans individuals, teams, events, businesses, and the physical places where connections happen, with hardware and software working together as one seamless experience. We are a revenue-backed, fast-growing company based in Los Angeles, and this role will help define the product category we become.

**THE ROLE**
============

We are hiring our first Head of Product to lead this evolution. You will work closely with our Founder & CEO, executive team, and Product, Design, and Engineering leaders to shape the long-term vision, understand where dot.cards can create the greatest customer value, and turn that opportunity into a focused portfolio strategy and roadmap.

You will bring an independent product perspective, deep customer understanding, and strong strategic judgment to the partnership. Together, you will turn ambitious ideas and market insight into clear priorities, a coherent platform, and products customers love. This is a high-impact builder role with meaningful influence over company strategy, product craft, organizational design, and the direction of dot.cards. You will stay close to customers and the product details that matter while building a product organization capable of operating at greater scale. Experience with connected hardware is valuable, but exceptional software product judgment and systems thinking are most important.

**About Clarify**
-----------------

Clarify is building the AI-native CRM — a platform designed from the ground up for how modern go-to-market teams actually work. We raised $22.5M and assembled a team of ~27 people who believe the CRM category is overdue for a complete rethink: less manual data entry, smarter automation, and AI that actually understands your pipeline.

We're early and moving fast. The work you do here will directly shape how we grow.

**About the Role**
------------------

Clarify has shipped a lot in a short time: our AI Rep, permissions, reporting, and integrations with HubSpot, Stripe and Salesforce, with Signals launching in December. What we don't have yet is a product leader whose whole job is deciding what we build next, for whom, and making sure it lands. Today the founders do that alongside everything else.

You'll own the roadmap, set the planning rhythm with engineering and design, and build a product team that great people want to join. jobs.title: Director of Product
jobs.desc:
**Role Summary**

The Director of Product leads Greenshades' product organization — owning roadmap strategy, delivery execution, and product experience quality across our payroll, HR, and tax compliance solutions. This role carries a specific mandate to reorient product strategy for the AI era: identifying where AI can reshape workflows, unlock new efficiencies, and differentiate the platform. This role manages a team of Product Managers and a Product Experience/UX designer, and partners closely with Engineering, Customer Experience, and Product Marketing to ensure the roadmap reflects real market and customer signal. As part of an integrated Product and Marketing organization, this role is central to tightening the loop between what customers need and what gets built.

**Responsibilities**

* Lead, mentor, and develop a team of Product Managers and the Product Experience/UX function; set clear priorities, coach on craft, and manage performance and growth.
* Own and maintain a groomed, prioritized product roadmap that reflects the highest-value initiatives across Greenshades' product lines, grounded in customer and market signal.
* Drive Greenshades' product strategy into the AI era — evaluating where AI/ML can create step-change efficiency and experience improvements across the product line, and ensuring roadmap prioritization reflects that lens going forward rather than treating AI as a bolt-on feature.
* Own Product Experience: ensure usability, design consistency, and overall product quality are considered alongside feature delivery, not treated as an afterthought.
* Drive day-to-day product delivery in close partnership with Engineering, ensuring features ship on time, within scope, and aligned with roadmap priorities.
* Partner with Customer Experience to strengthen how customer and market signal flows into intake, triage, and prioritization — bringing structure and clarity to how requests become roadmap decisions.
* Serve as a key product escalation point for significant customer and internal issues, working with Support, TPE, and Engineering to resolve or route issues appropriately.
* Partner with Product Marketing to ensure roadmap priorities, positioning, and launch timing are aligned and well-sequenced.
* Build and maintain deep working knowledge of payroll, HR, and tax business processes, including how AI is reshaping those domains, through customer research, competitive analysis, and ongoing industry engagement.
* Partner with the CMO on Product team budget, resourcing, and prioritization tradeoffs; report on progress against roadmap and team capacity.
* Other duties as assigned.

**Requirements**

* 5-7 years of product management experience in B2B SaaS or enterprise software, including 5+ years leading a team of Product Managers or equivalent ICs.
* Experience managing a complex domain (payroll, HR, tax, compliance, or similar), or a track record of quickly mastering a new business domain, with a specific example you can describe.
* Have shipped AI or ML-enabled capabilities in a B2B product, or led a roadmap shift toward AI.
* Experience hiring, coaching, and developing product talent, including managing performance and supporting career growth.
* Experience balancing roadmap strategy with hands-on delivery, including keeping features on schedule and in scope alongside Engineering.
* Experience working day to day with Engineering, Customer Success/CX, and Marketing to align product decisions with business priorities.
* Strong written and verbal communication, including explaining product strategy and tradeoffs to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Experience presenting product strategy, roadmap progress, and resourcing tradeoffs to executive leadership, with the judgment to tailor depth and framing for an ELT audience.

Travel Required: Up to 15%  
Location: This is a remote position.

jobs.title: Director of Product, Mobile
jobs.desc:
CLEAR is building THE secure identity company of the future. Our mission is to make experiences safer and easier—physically and digitally. With more than 43 million Members and a growing network of partners across the world, CLEAR's secure identity platform is transforming the way people live, work, and travel. Whether it's at the airport, stadium, or throughout your everyday life, CLEAR unlocks the magic of frictionless experiences.

We are looking for a visionary, customer-obsessed, and technology-focused product management leader with expertise in building and scaling consumer mobile experiences. As Director of Product, Mobile, you will own the strategy, roadmap, and outcomes for CLEAR's mobile app, shaping it from a collection of features into an intelligent, trusted travel companion that helps members prepare, navigate, and recover throughout their journey.

You will build the mobile app into the most helpful digital layer of the travel day and be accountable for driving adoption, engagement, and member value. You will connect CLEAR's identity capabilities, real-time travel context, airport operations, member relationships, and partner-enabled services into experiences that are personalized, proactive, and genuinely useful before, during, and after travel. This includes helping members understand airport conditions, find the right path through the airport, discover food and lounge options, and access relevant CLEAR and partner services in the moments that matter.

The ideal candidate has a proven history of setting bold product visions, leading through ambiguity, and delivering scalable, high-quality technology solutions that create meaningful customer value and support rapid learning and iteration. This role will initially lead a small product team with one direct report and will operate as a player-coach: setting a high bar for product thinking and execution while developing talent and scaling the team over time.

***What You'll Do:***

Come join our team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world!

You will be the connective force between research, engineering, go-to-market, and our OEM and AV developer customers—shaping how the industry uses NVIDIA's simulation technology to reconstruct real-world driving data, generate safety-critical synthetic scenarios, and close the loop between AV policy training and real-world deployment. • Build deep partnerships with OEMs, robotaxi operators, and AV software developers to understand their simulation pipelines, surface unmet needs, and co-develop platform capabilities that directly accelerate their path to safe deployment.

• Partner closely with research and engineering teams to translate fleet data workflows, sensor modeling requirements, and policy evaluation needs into well-scoped, executable product requirements.

• Collaborate with go-to-market, developer relations, and solutions engineering to drive platform adoption, shape developer programs, and articulate the value of NVIDIA's simulation stack versus competing approaches.

• Lead, mentor, and grow a team of Product Managers focused on AV simulation, establishing best practices and raising the bar for PM excellence across the organization.

• Represent NVIDIA's simulation vision at industry events, safety and standards forums, and executive briefings—communicating the technical depth and strategic importance of simulation to both engineering and business audiences.

jobs.title: Product Operations Manager - PICO Store
jobs.desc:
About the Team
PICO, ByteDance's XR brand, is on a mission to build the most immersive and content-rich extended reality platform in the world. We are seeking a driven and commercially minded Product Operations Manager to own and grow our Entertainment vertical across streaming video, sports, and music. This is a pivotal role within our PICO Store Operations team, with a focused remit on the Content distribution– responsible for defining and executing apps and content traffic strategy across PICO eco services channels that will define how users discover, engage with, and consume content on the platform.You will work at the intersection of content, technology, and platform strategy, you will collaborate closely with Product, Data, Business Development and Developer teams to continuously refine discovery mechanisms, improve conversion efficiency, and scale global distribution capabilities — ultimately shaping a more engaging, personalized, and scalable XR content ecosystem.

The PICO Store Operations team oversees the global lifecycle of apps and games across both established and emerging VR scenarios. Our mission is to help users discover high-quality content effortlessly, ensuring they find consistent value through diverse and meaningful platform experiences.
The team identifies growth opportunities in high-frequency, high-retention usage scenarios. By managing the full content lifecycle—from onboarding and distribution to sustained engagement—the team continuously enhances platform value while supporting a healthy and thriving developer ecosystem.

Responsibilities
- Own content distribution for the PICO Store: Define and execute apps & content traffic strategy across PICO eco service channels(Feed, Store, Browser, Push, etc.), including the optimization of homepage layout and featured sections. Enhance app discoverability and user reach across both China and global markets through data-driven logic.Refine store displays based on user behavior data and platform goals.
- Campaigns & Social Engagement: Design and launch high-impact campaigns to drive user engagement and retention, such as online multiplayer events, limited-time challenges, and user-generated content (UGC) programs. Support Discord initiatives, including community challenges and social events, to foster a vibrant developer-user ecosystem. Leverage social features to strengthen user interaction and platform stickiness.
- Testing & Data Optimization: Partner with Product teams to suggest and test new store features or tools. Synchronize with Content and Developer teams on how we distribute and promote new apps. Collaborate with Data teams to support analytics frameworks, reporting dashboards, and experimentation pipelines.
- Drive cross-functional collaboration: Partner closely with Product, Content Operations, Developer Operations, Legal, and Data teams to ensure the effective execution of platform initiatives and new feature rollouts.

Minimum Qualifications
- Education: Bachelor’s degree or higher
- Professional Experience: 5+ years of experience in App Store Operations, Advertising Traffic Strategy, Organic Traffic Strategies, Content Operations, or related roles within the technology or media industry.
- Growth & Distribution Expertise: Proven track record in traffic distribution strategy, placement management, A/B testing, and analyzing user behavior to drive measurable operational improvements.
- Full-Lifecycle Content Operations: Proven track record of managing the full content lifecycle for games, apps, or video platforms—from developer onboarding and global launches to post-release updates and long-term retention. This includes leading strategic curation, optimizing metadata and creative assets for discoverability, and managing title-specific campaigns to drive sustained user engagement and platform impact.
- Collaboration & Execution: Expertise in global project management and cross-functional leadership, adept at synchronizing with EMEA and APAC teams

jobs.title: Product Manager for Medium Voltage Static Frequency Converters (f/m/d)
jobs.loc: Flexible / Remote, Madrid, Spain, Milan, Italy
jobs.desc:
The opportunity

As part of a Global Product Management team, you will be accountable for the long-term profitable growth and marketing of the SFC offering to target market segments, by developing and managing the portfolio through its life cycle phases, according to market needs, the business strategy and targets. The Hitachi Energy portfolio for medium voltage SFCs includes advanced solutions designed to efficiently convert electrical frequencies and voltages for a wide range of industrial and railway applications. These SFCs are engineered to ensure high reliability, flexibility, and seamless integration with existing grid infrastructure. The portfolio features modular converter platforms, advanced control systems, digital monitoring capabilities, and robust safety mechanisms, supporting sustainable operations and enabling the transition to greener energy systems.

How you'll make an impact

  • Manage the entire product life cycle for the portfolio, including hardware and software
  • Lead market intelligence analysis to identify trends, opportunities, and competitive positioning
  • Define and maintain the portfolio roadmap, including new developments, enhancements, and phase-outs
  • Prioritize and oversee product development in collaboration with cross-functional teams
  • Define value propositions per segment and channel to support effective marketing strategies and product launches
  • Continuously improve product management processes and tools such as configurators, training, and lifecycle management
  • Drive cross-functional innovation initiatives and provide input to R&D for patents and intellectual property protection

Your background

  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or similar
  • Postgraduate qualification in Marketing, Strategy, or Business (e.g., MBA) preferred
  • 5-10 years of experience in product marketing, product management, or product technology in a technology-based organization
  • Proven ability to influence and work with cross-functional and cross-cultural teams across geographies and time zones
  • Solid knowledge of industrial hardware and software development
  • Familiarity with medium voltage market, customers, competition, and standards preferred
  • Strong analytical and decision-making skills to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment
  • Collaborative, solutions-oriented approach with excellent interpersonal and communication skills
  • High level of fluency in English

*Ideal locations are Madrid or Milan. Other countries within Europe could be considered.

More about us

We believe great work thrives in an environment where people feel genuinely supported and fairly rewarded. Our benefits are designed to create real value for every individual-fueling engagement, performance, and growth. By prioritizing well-being, we build a workplace where personal and organizational success grow together.

jobs.desc:
Who are we?

Equinix is the world's digital infrastructure company®, shortening the path to connectivity to enable the innovations that enrich our work, life and planet.

A place where bold ideas are welcomed, human connection is valued, and everyone has the opportunity to shape their future.

A career at Equinix means being at the center of shaping what comes next and amplifying customer value through innovation and impact. You'll work across teams, influence key decisions, and help shape the path forward. You'll find belonging, purpose, and a team that welcomes you-because when you feel valued, you're empowered to do your best work.

Job Summary

Designs, develops and manages the lifecycle of a product or group of products from concept to launch to end of life. Translates market opportunities and customer demand into viable products and services that differentiate Equinix in the market. Sets the vision and strategy for their product ensuring it is competitively positioned and customer-centric. Manages the product roadmap including features, upgrades and maintenance of the product or product line. Works cross functionally with user experience, engineering, operations, solution architects, marketing and others to design, build and launch new products and/or product features.

Responsibilities

Product Lifecycle Management

  • Identifies improvements to existing product processes; develops a strong understanding of processes and technology

Product Strategy, Vision and Roadmap

  • Completes ad-hoc assignments that assist in the development of product strategy and roadmap

Market, Competitive and Customer Analysis

  • Researches competitors and verticals; prepares atypical reports related to financial position, competitive position and market potential

Business Case Development

  • Collaborates on and may create the financial business models, conducts compelling business opportunity reviews with more senior team members

Product Performance

  • Defines metrics that will be used to inform product success and help drive user experience improvements

Cross Functional Collaboration

  • Designs product training curriculum; participates in cross-functional trainings and meetings

New Partner Identification and Engagement

  • Identifies partners to enhance or extend the product

Backlog Prioritization

  • Supports with backlogs, working regularly with the team to refine and add detail where needed • Collaborates closely with technology teams

Test Case Definition and UAT Coordination

  • Refines definition of allowable configurations, test cases and executes UAT

Stakeholder Management

  • Manages stakeholder expectations within and/or across functions
  • Identifies and proactively includes correct stakeholders and communications effectively

Qualifications

  • 5+ years experience preferred
  • Bachelor's degree preferred

Position Summary

Are you a strategic thinker with a passion for innovation and customer-centric solutions? Do you thrive in fast-paced environments where your ideas shape the future of technology? Join us as a Product Leader and help drive the success of our Cloud and Training product lines within our Technology Solutions business unit.

As a Product Leader, you'll be responsible for the full lifecycle of your product/service line - from concept launch to ongoing optimization. You'll be at the forefront of designing, launching, and evolving products and services that make a real impact. You'll collaborate across teams, engage with customers, and lead initiatives that fuel growth and deliver exceptional value. We're looking for someone who is a visionary, a builder, and a champion for excellence.

This position is required to work onsite at least 3 days per week.

Key Responsibilities

Product Strategy & Roadmapping

    • Define and maintain the product/service vision and roadmap.
    • Analyze market trends and customer feedback to identify opportunities for new offerings or enhancements.
    • Collaborate with internal stakeholders to align product strategy with business goals.

Product Development & Lifecycle Management

    • Lead the design and launch of new products/services and features.
    • Manage the lifecycle of existing offerings, including updates and retirements.
    • Own assigned back-office systems that support product functionality and user experience.

Customer & Market Engagement

    • Gather and prioritize customer requirements through direct engagement and market research.
    • Represent the company at industry events to promote offerings and gather insights.
    • Monitor and improve customer satisfaction, loyalty, and retention metrics.

Cross-Functional Leadership

    • Partner with Development teams throughout the product lifecycle, including backlog grooming and prioritization.
    • Work with Marketing and Portfolio Management to develop pricing strategies and go-to-market plans.
    • Collaborate with Sales to ensure offerings are packaged and positioned effectively.

Performance & Financial Accountability

    • Drive revenue growth and meet launch objectives for assigned product lines.
    • Manage budgets and expenses in alignment with departmental and corporate goals.
    • Track and report on key performance indicators, including Customer Loyalty Index results.

Qualifications

Experience

  • 4+ years in a product/service design, product/service manager, or project management role, preferably for a commercialized customer-facing offering.
  • Prior experience working with business software applications, preferably including business-to-business websites and back-office systems.
  • Demonstrated experience in writing requirements for business software applications, including business-to-business websites and back-office systems.
  • Prior experience in a leadership role strongly preferred.

Education

  • Bachelor's degree required in Marketing, Business or a Technology field.
  • In lieu of degree, may consider an additional 4 years of experience in a product management or project management role.

jobs.title: Product Manager, Sports Experience
jobs.desc:
At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode - pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next.

The Team

The New Content Exploration product team is leading the strategy to shape how Netflix members discover and engage with new content types. This includes 0 to 1 areas such as Live events, Podcasts, Creator content, Games discovery and more. Our team is responsible for building the end-to-end member experience for Live and delivering innovative Sports features to market. Our work spans all platforms (TV/living room, mobile, tablet, and web), and includes features and experiences across discovery/browse, player, profiles, and new surfaces.

In the past two years, Netflix has been home to record-breaking NFL Games, Boxing Events, and the World Baseball Classic Tournament. Netflix is accelerating its ambitions to capture real-time, unscripted magic of Live events looking ahead to the Women's World Cup and beyond. As the ambitions for Live and Sports are growing bigger and bolder in the years to come, a truly innovative product experience plays a critical role in bringing the magic to our members.

The Role

As Product Manager for the Sports Experience, you will own the end-to-end execution of new features for our Sports content slate. You will work in close partnership with the Product Lead for Live and Sports to align on the overall roadmap and priorities. You will directly own portfolio features across the roadmap spanning the Discovery and Playback experience. As we look to onboard new content experiences, you will be at the forefront of scaling our Sports features to those partners. You’ll interface closely with a broad cross-functional team including Design, Engineering, Data Science, Marketing, Content and Product.

You must be comfortable at the hub of a fast-paced environment where you interface daily with cross-functional experts across both the tech and entertainment sides of the business, with proven success in balancing requirements/tradeoffs effectively. You must be passionate about building alignment, while not being afraid to push ahead when there remain some critics, influencing and keeping momentum in the face of ambiguity.

What You’ll Do

• Launch new features by owning workstreams end-to-end, from framing the problem through launch, measurement, and the next iteration. You drive your areas independently with strong responsibility.

• Influence a team of stunning colleagues across design, engineering, consumer insights, merchandising and data science to deliver outstanding products

• Proactively identify new investments by leveraging consumer insights, market trends, and platform data to uncover new product opportunities for Sports, actively shaping the broader strategic roadmap for our rapidly expanding live ecosystem.

• Working through open-ended problems and identifying opportunities for evolution of existing or conceptualizing new discovery, capability or feature requirements

• Build business cases and measure the impact of your product innovation, with your data science partners

• Run A/B tests and set the success metrics before launch, run the tests with your data science partners, and interpret the results.

What You’ll Bring

As Product Manager, Sports Experience, you’ll be passionate about the work, bringing:

• 6+ years of experience developing consumer products and features and comfortable operating with complex tradeoffs

• Experience working on Live Sports streaming products at scale, and a great understanding of the Sports lifecycle

• Very high attention to detail, with an ability to connect the smallest experience elements to the big picture goals at the company and team level

• Excellent bias to action, shipping

jobs.title: Product Manager, Core Discovery
jobs.desc:
At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode - pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next.

With more than 283 million members in over 190 countries, Netflix continues to shape the future of entertainment around the world.

We want to invent entertainment experiences the world can’t live without, connecting people with stories they’ll love. The Member Experience Product Management team is accountable for making the core Netflix experience better every day for our members around the world. Our work spans all platforms (TV/living room, mobile, tablet, and web), and includes experiences and ranking/recommendations strategy across discovery/browse (shows, movies, live programming, and games), search, player, identity/profiles, and new surfaces.

You will work on developing experiences and solutions that make choosing feel simple and intuitive, and help members quickly find something they want to watch or play. At JINGDONG Logistics (JD Logistics), part of JD.com, we are a leading technology-driven supply chain and logistics solutions provider under JD.com. Joining JD Logistics means helping shape the future of global supply chain and logistics. At Netflix, we have an insatiable desire to continually improve our products and deliver new experiences to delight and entertain our quickly growing membership. Now, we are making game night a whole lot easier by bringing Netflix Games to the biggest screen in the house. We are building a future where playing a game with friends and family requires no extra hardware. Just your TV, Netflix, and your phone.

As a Product Manager for TV as a Platform, you will drive the end-to-end cloud gaming experience on connected TVs. You will own the ambitious roadmap for our "mobile-as-a-controller" experience, ensuring that going from watching a hit show to playing a game feels as effortless as hitting "Play." You will sit at the intersection of streaming technology, 10-foot UI design, and interactive gameplay, ensuring our members experience seamless, high-quality entertainment.

What You Will Do:

•
Own the TV Games Product Strategy: Develop and execute the product roadmap for playing cloud-streamed games on connected TVs, focusing on creating frictionless, "zero-setup" experiences for our members.

•
Innovate the Mobile Controller Experience: Lead the development of the Netflix game controller app/feature. You will define how a user's mobile phone transforms into a dynamic, intuitive gamepad for living room play, supporting everything from solo adventures to 8-player party games like Boggle Party and Pictionary.

•
Bridge Viewing and Playing: Create seamless user flows that allow members to fluidly transition from watching Netflix content (e.g., Knives Out) to playing a related game (e.g., Dead Man’s Party) without ever leaving the Netflix ecosystem.

•
Champion Quality of Experience (QoE): Partner closely with cloud gaming engineering and streaming technology teams to optimize latency, input lag, and video fidelity. You will define the metrics for a successful, high-quality TV gaming session and relentlessly drive improvements.

•
Design for the Living Room: Collaborate with Product Designers to optimize the "10-foot UI" for game discovery, multiplayer onboarding, and in-game overlays on the TV.

•
Lead Cross-Functional Execution: Act as the central node between Game Studios, Platform Engineering, Mobile App teams, and Data Science to deliver complex, multi-device features on time and at scale.

Requirements:

•
5-8+ years of experience in product management, with a proven track record of shipping complex, consumer-facing software.

•
Direct experience with Connected TV (CTV) platforms (e.g., Roku, tvOS, Android TV, Smart TVs), cloud gaming platforms, or multi-device ecosystem products.

•
A deep understanding of mobile app product development (iOS/Android) and how to leverage native mobile capabilities (haptics, gyroscopes, touch interfaces) to drive user engagement.

•
Technical background or strong understanding of video streaming technologies, real-time networking, and cloud computing principles.

•
A history of achieving product outcomes through user testing, rapid prototyping, and data-driven decision-making.

•
Passion for the digital gaming space, particularly local multiplayer, social deduction, and "party" game genres that bring people together in the living room.

Does this sound uncomfortably exciting? Please don’t self-select out; let’s figure it out together. We’d love to talk to you!

Location: West Coast, with some travel to Los Angeles or Los Gatos, CA as needed

We have ambitious plans, an enormous scale of opportunity, and the passion to be the best in customer experience - which now includes Games. Netflix is rapidly scaling our Games initiative, bringing a growing library of games on mobile devices, TVs, and the Web to our audience of 283 million paid members in 190 countries. To succeed, we are continually improving the experiences that our members have when playing games on Netflix.

We are seeking a selfless, curious, and passionate Product Marketing Manager to join the Netflix Member Experience PMM team. You will have the opportunity to learn and grow quickly in this space, work closely with a highly cross-functional, global team, and contribute to one of the most impactful transitions we’ll have made in a decade. The ideal candidate will quickly become a thought-partner to cross-functional teams and drive a unifying thread between business goals, product goals, and our positioning with consumers in the market. Key Responsibilities:

•
Develop the positioning statement for key member experience product launches.  What is the value we are offering to the customer?  How do we stack up to competitor capabilities?  How does this launch tie back to our brand differentiators?

Build marketing strategy for launches.  Pull together business goals, technical considerations, and expertise of the marketing teams to align on audiences to target, channels to employ, countries to activate, etc.

Work across teams to align on product or feature naming and brand architecture.

Assess upcoming product and feature launches to identify bigger stories or position multiple launches in a clear way for consumers and tie those launches back to the broader Netflix overall and Games value proposition.

Work with product and comms partners to clearly define marketing needs and coordinate various parts of the marketing organization to execute against those needs (e.g. brand design, organic social, paid social, partner marketing, etc).

•
Partner with content design to ensure coherent and consistent language and narrative between in-service and off-service messaging.

Requirements

•
7+ years of experience in Marketing or related fields with an emphasis on core product marketing

•

•
Experience partnering with product development teams to make insight-informed decisions that impact developers

•
Proven ability to galvanize and influence teams and partners across departments at all levels with ability to work across both highly technical and highly creative teams.

Strong project management skills

•
Experience in developing consumer messaging, positioning, and targeting, and in handling multi-country product launches

High tolerance for change, and the capacity to accomplish enormous amounts of work in a fast-paced, ever-changing environment

Respect, understanding and enthusiasm for Netflix culture

jobs.desc:
================================================================================

ABOUT HITPAY

================================================================================

HitPay is the payments and business operations platform for small and medium

businesses across Southeast Asia and beyond. We process card, e-wallet, bank

transfer, PayNow, QR and card-present payments for tens of thousands of

merchants across Singapore, Malaysia, the Philippines, Hong Kong, Australia and

the United States — through a single onboarding flow, a single dashboard, and a

single API.

Payments is a regulated business. We hold a Major Payment Institution licence

from the Monetary Authority of Singapore and operate under a spread of local

regimes, scheme rules and partner-bank obligations. Today, most of our risk,

fraud and AML capability exists to keep us safe. We believe a meaningful share

of it should also be a product our merchants pay for.

That is the job.

================================================================================

THE ROLE

================================================================================

You will own risk, fraud and compliance as a product line — not as a cost

centre. You are being hired to design, build and ship products that reduce loss,

shorten onboarding, and generate revenue: fraud screening our merchants opt into,

chargeback and dispute tooling they will pay for, underwriting and KYB

capabilities we can sell or embed, monitoring and reporting our larger merchants

and platform partners need in order to grow on us.

This is a builder's role with a regulator's discipline. You will spend your week

between a compliance officer, a backend engineer and a merchant, and you will be

the person who can hold all three conversations without a translator.

================================================================================

WHAT YOU WILL OWN

================================================================================

Revenue products

  • Define, price and ship monetisable risk and fraud products: fraud scoring

    and screening tiers, chargeback protection and representment tooling,

    dispute automation, merchant-facing risk dashboards, KYB / identity

    verification as a paid capability, and risk services for platform and

    marketplace partners.

  • Build the commercial case: attach rate, pricing model, loss economics,

    payback. Own the P&L logic of what you ship, not just the roadmap.

  • Work with Sales and Partnerships to take these products to market — you will

    be in customer calls, and you will lose some of them and learn why.

Compliance and risk engineering

  • Own the product surface of transaction monitoring, sanctions and PEP

    screening, merchant onboarding and KYB, prohibited-industry and MCC policy

    enforcement, and chargeback and fraud loss controls.

  • Turn regulatory obligations and internal policy into shipped system

    behaviour: rules, thresholds, queues, audit trails, evidence packs,

    escalation paths and reporting.

  • Drive rule tuning and alert quality as a product metric. False positive

    rate, analyst minutes per alert and precision at the top of the queue are

    yours to move.

  • Evaluate, integrate and manage third-party vendors — fraud engines,

    screening providers, device intelligence, identity — including build vs.

    buy calls and commercial negotiation support.

Stakeholder leadership

  • Be the trusted counterpart to the Compliance and MLRO function. You will not

    ship around them, and they will not be surprised by what you ship.

This is the surface a controller reconciles against and an auditor has to accept. When it is right, a firm can confidently run its finances with us. WIP, unbilled, and deferred balances treated as reportable, reconcilable objects rather than numbers derived at report time. GL and ERP integrations. Starting with QuickBooks and extending to the major mid-market and enterprise accounting systems, with bidirectional reconciliation and error handling a finance team can trust. AI-native finance workflows. Agents that run the recognition cycle, drive the close checklist, reconcile subledger to GL, and explain every exception in language an accountant accepts. jobs.title: 1st Product Manager
jobs.desc:
The company

Ooak Data turns company data into training data for AI agents.

Frontier labs can train models to reason. They cannot train them to work: navigating a real company's Slack threads, half-finished Notion docs, contradictory Jira tickets, and permission boundaries. That requires real enterprise data, and you cannot synthesize it. You have to source it.

We plug into enterprise tools, anonymize everything into a structurally identical digital twin, and generate reinforcement-learning environments with expert-level tasks calibrated against frontier models.

We are a Y Combinator company with 7 figures signed contracts with three frontier AI labs, and we are scaling delivery aggressively over the next twelve months. Three founders, full-time since December 2025: Pierre-Louis (CEO, ex-COO in edtech, sold data to frontier labs), Grégoire (CPO, first PM & head of Ops at Epsor through Series B), Thomas (CTO, ex-Head of Data at PayLead, ex-Samsung AI lab).

Why this role exists

Our engineering team ships faster than founders can specify. We have four product surfaces, most of them internal, all of them technical, and every one of them decides whether an environment ships this week or next.

We are hiring our first Product Manager to own the product: what gets built, in what order, and whether it actually made us faster.

What you will own

The full chain, from the moment a CEO agrees to share their data to the moment a frontier lab receives an environment.

Partner experience

  • The Data Hub, onboarding and export tutorials a CEO sees when they hand us their company's history. Trust and speed at the top of the funnel.

The data pipeline

  • Connectors, ingestion and anonymisation. How raw Slack, Drive, mail and CRM exports become a clean digital twin. You will spend a lot of time with Thomas (CTO) here.

Pharos, our delivery platform

  • The internal tool our Ops team lives in to run QA and delivery. Throughput is the metric. This is where 3 env a week becomes 10.

RL environments

  • The thing the labs buy. Task design, calibration, what separates a dataset from a real agent training ground.

You will run two kinds of work at once: short projects that need tight coordination across Tech, Ops and GTM this week, and long ones where nothing exists yet and you get to decide what should.

Who you are

  • A doer. You know the product methodologies and you use them when they help, not by the book. Your instinct when something is slow is to fix it, not to schedule a workshop about it.
  • AI-pilled. You vibe code. You prototype before you write a spec. You design your own mockups. You are curious about how the models themselves are built and trained.
  • UX taste, ROI brain. Our workflows have to be brutally efficient. You judge a piece of software or a workflow by efficient it allows us to be or what value it brings to our customers.
  • You keep pace. Our engineers ship a lot. You turn that into something coherent rather than slowing it down.
  • 7+ years in product, at least some of it technical: data, infra, ML, developer tools or ops platforms. Founders and first PMs who built the function from nothing are very welcome.
  • Fluent French and English. Our customers are American, our data partners spread worldwide, our team speaks both.
  • Based in Paris.

The extra that make the difference

  • A research streak: you read papers, you have opinions on RL, you have trained or fine-tuned something.

Terms

  • Compensation: €70-90k + bonus, and 0.2% to 0.5%

jobs.desc:
**The role**

Allocortech does not need a backlog janitor. We need someone who understands why four-quadrant FOC, voltage class, SWaP-C, and certification timeline are the product — and can turn that into a roadmap OEMs will buy.

Taurus motor controllers, Clio power/comms hubs, and the surrounding battery/PDU work already power eVTOL, hybrid cargo aircraft, and electric hydrofoils. Your job is to productize that stack.

**What you will do**

* Own the propulsion backlog: Taurus variants, voltage/power SKUs, firmware feature flags, packaging, accessories.
* Sit with EE, FOC firmware, and customers and turn “400 V, regen, eight-week MOTS” into sequenced work.
* Write requirements hardware and firmware can actually build. Kill nice-to-haves that blow SWaP or schedule.
* Partner with sales on positioning, spec sheets, and which custom asks become catalog.
* Keep the 18-month versus 24-month product bets honest.

  

**What you bring**

* 5+ years owning a technical product on power electronics, motor drives, avionics, or vehicle propulsion.
* Enough EE/firmware literacy to argue current loops, isolation, and CAN without hiding behind Jira.
* Comfort in front of aerospace, defense, or advanced-vehicle OEMs.
* Judgment on COTS vs. MOTS vs. custom — and the discipline to say no.
* Bonus: eVTOL/UAS, hybrid-electric, or maritime electric programs.

Fifty-plus people, revenue already tripled, and a propulsion line that is on vehicles instead of slides. You will set what gets built next — not write tickets for a platform team in another time zone.

***APPLY NOW***

  

This position may require prolonged periods of sitting, standing, walking, computer work, and occasional exposure to moderate levels of noise, dust, and fumes in production and lab areas.

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.desc:
**At Obie, we don’t just insure properties — we ensure progress.** With advanced technology, real-time data, and a vast network of agents and partners, we help real estate investors and landlords get insurance coverage whenever and wherever they need it. Thousands of owners nationwide trust us to be the insurance experts, so they don’t have to be.

Joining our team means embracing a fast-moving environment driven by innovation, collaboration, and constant progress. We learn quickly, iterate often, and celebrate wins together. If you're passionate about driving change and eager to impact the real estate and insurance market, Obie is the place for you.

Our Chicago based employees are hybrid, and expected to be in office on Tuesdays and Thursdays.

**Brief Summary of Role**

We’re looking for an experienced, hands-on Product Manager who loves figuring out how things work and can’t wait to make them better. You’ll join our growing team as an individual contributor, turning messy, technically complex problems into solutions and products that people actually use - and checking that they made a difference! You don’t need prior insurance experience; curiosity, ownership, and strong product judgement matter most.

You’ll own a meaningful product area end-to-end: bring your own point of view, get clear on why it matters to customers and the business, and build it with Design and Engineering. You enjoy turning “could we…?” into a working first version. You’ll think across customers, agents, internal teams, and interconnected systems. Initial ownership is open, with room to contribute access domains as priorities evolve.

You’re the person who asks, “What does the data say?” and then goes looking, talking to customers and teammates along the way. You can explain tradeoffs, make timely decisions with incomplete information, and follow through on results after launch. You’re curious beyond the current tools and playbook. If you find a smarter way to do something, you’re eager to try it with the team and share what worked (and what didn’t).

**What you'll Do**

* **You’ll be a product owner:** Take a problem from “we should…” to shipped, used, and improved. The backlog is a part of the job, not the finish line. Shape the vision, strategy, and roadmap for your area, define KPIs and success upfront, and use business and customer evidence to prioritize. You can point to work you’ve owned through multiple iterations and explain what changed as you learned.
* **You’re the best listener in the room:** Seek out customer insight, relevant data, and cross-functional input without treating every request as a requirement. Weigh options, make tradeoffs visible, and explain both what you recommend and what you choose not to do. You know which decisions need a deeper dive and which need a sensible call so the team can keep building.
* **You get that product building is a team sport:** Build trust across Engineering, Design, Technical Project Management, QA, operations, and business partners. Bring people into decisions early, navigate disagreement, and create clarity that helps others execute with confidence. You’re happy to own the hard call, share the credit, and jump in when a fellow PM needs a hand. Making the team better is part of the fun.
* **You’re mission first:** You get stuff done. Help the team turn business priorities into clear work that’s ready to build, without getting stuck in planning limbo. Balance larger bets with smaller, high-leverage improvements, remove avoidable process drag, and keep attention on outcomes. You’ve improved the flow, clarity, or quality or work reaching engineering and can show how you evaluated results after launch.
* **You can get your hands dirty:** Turn complex problems into clear, buildable work with Design and Engineering. jobs.desc:
### **ABOUT OUR COMPANY:**

The crushing weight of debt is something that we believe holds people back from reaching their dreams and making a splash in the world. So in 2013, after seeing our friends and family struggle with student loans, we created Splash Financial.

Over the years, our mission has expanded to include helping people with other forms of debt - such as refinancing credit cards, which are at all time highs in the US. And we've been able to refinance $6+ Billion in loans through our network of Splash, powered credit union and bank partners who leverage our marketplace and automated loan processing technology. And we've raised over $135 million from investors like partners of DST Global, Citi Ventures, TruStage Ventures, Northwestern Mutual Future Ventures, Detroit Venture Partners, and more.

But at our core, we're still that little company from Cleveland with a big dream: to make people more powerful than their debt and we're just getting started..

### **ABOUT OUR WORKPLACE:**

Splash is remote-first, and proud of it — though our collections team works in-person at our Arizona location.

We spend our days simplifying financial products and getting them into the hands of people who need them most. Right now, we're focused on building financial technologies that fundamentally transform how the industry lends.

Although Splash has been around since 2013, we still operate like a startup — fast-paced, nimble, and full of heart. We're good people who care deeply about doing meaningful work and we approach challenges with creativity, passion, and urgency.

And to hire the best, we provide the best: great health insurance, competitive salaries, and unique benefits like quarterly meet-ups and access to engagement tools that keep us connected — even from afar.

At Splash, everything we do is guided by our values:

**Own It** – We take full accountability and follow through on commitments.

**Raise the Bar** – We move fast, innovate faster, and push through barriers.

**Say the Hard Thing** – We speak up with honesty, respect, and a desire to solve problems and make things better.

**Elevate Each Other** – We win as a team by lifting each other up.

These values show up in how we work and how we connect — whether we're collaborating on big projects or bonding over everyday moments. Yes, we even have Slack channels for #kids-and-pets and #food because we believe being human makes us better teammates.

-------------------

You'll also play a key role in improving the operational processes and partner onboarding that sit behind those experiences.

This isn't a support role. You'll own your domains end to end: running discovery, writing requirements, partnering with engineering, design, and business stakeholders, and using data to make better decisions faster.

* Drive initiatives that reduce delinquency and improve payment behavior, including self-service improvements, payment plan optimization, and enrollment experiences.
* Use AI tools to accelerate your own workflow, including drafting documents, synthesizing research, analyzing data, and automating repetitive tasks.

Synkwise is a rapidly growing healthcare SaaS company dedicated to improving how residential long-term care providers operate and deliver care. Our platform helps adult family homes, assisted living communities, memory care providers, and other residential care organizations simplify daily operations, strengthen compliance, reduce administrative burden, and improve care quality.

As Synkwise continues to grow nationally and expand our platform’s capabilities, we are looking for an experienced product leader to help us accelerate our offering.

**About the Opportunity**

Synkwise is hiring a full-time Senior Product Manager to help shape and guide the continued evolution of our platform. This is a highly cross-functional and hands-on role for someone who can move comfortably between product strategy, customer needs, UI/UX, business requirements, technical specs, and engineering execution.

We are looking for a strong product thinker and operator who can understand a real-world problem, translate the solution into clear requirements, and work closely with design and engineering to carry it through release.

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.desc:
Rapidly growing software company in San Fernando, CA (over 22,562 companies use our GPS tracking software) is looking to add a Product Manager to our team.

Product management is a newer function at our company. Until recently it was handled part-time across engineering, operations, and leadership, and it has outgrown that arrangement. The scope and workflows of the role are still being defined, and you'll have a hand in defining them.

We need someone who can take a project from "we should build this" all the way to "customers are using it and understand it": talking to the right people, getting the requirements right before engineering starts building, and seeing it through to launch.

If helping shape a role rather than stepping into a fully mapped-out one sounds exciting, keep reading. If you'd rather join an established product org with a playbook already written, this probably isn't the role for you.

**What You'll Own**

Every project you take on, you own end to end:

* Discovery and requirements. Sit with support, sales, operations, and customers directly. Understand the real-world task the customer is trying to complete, break it into steps, and turn those steps into features and functional requirements. Produce wireframes that show how the workflow will look on screen.
* Tickets engineering can actually build from. Write well-formed Jira tickets with clear acceptance criteria and data requirements: what's displayed live in the UI, and what needs to be stored for later reporting.
* Keeping projects moving. Coordinate with engineering leadership, design, and operations to determine where each ticket fits in overall priorities. Work with engineers on estimates, own the project timeline, make scope trade-offs to hit dates, and surface risks and slips early rather than late. Monitor tickets so nothing sits waiting for a decision that nobody knows they need to make.
* UX quality. Make sure the user can complete the task in the order they naturally think about it, and that information on screen is clear and legible.
* Testing before and after release. Test on staging and production. Find the bugs, the lag, the rough edges, and document exactly what needs to change. Retest until it feels production-ready.
* Internal rollout and training. Write up how each release works, train internal staff, and be the go-to person for questions. Coordinate staff testing of new features and channel that feedback back to engineering.
* Launch. Draft customer-facing announcements and coordinate final release timing with the development team.

Discovery, requirements, and keeping projects moving are the core of the job. Testing, internal training, and launch communications are also part of it, because on a small team the person who owns a feature sees it all the way through; if those parts sound like a chore rather than part of shipping well, please don't apply.

**The Technical Bar**

You don't need to write code. You do need to be able to hold a productive conversation with an engineer about what's possible, what's hard, and what the trade-offs are, and you need to understand why something that sounds like a simple feature may actually be difficult. You should be comfortable looking at how the application behaves and at its data model well enough to specify what should be shown on screen versus stored for reporting.

Our product is GPS fleet tracking, which means physical devices in vehicles, firmware, cellular connectivity, and a lot of data arriving in near real time. Prior experience with a product that includes hardware or devices is a real plus.

Our stack, for context: Golang and MySQL on the server, Vue.js on the web, Swift (iOS) and Kotlin (Android) for mobile, on AWS.

**Ramp-up and the 60-day review**

Nobody expects you to know our system on day one. Your first weeks will be spent learning the product alongside support and operations before you take ownership of a project.

At Nicolet National Bank, our culture is based on the principles of community banking, putting the needs of our customers at the forefront of our decision-making. Our Core Values drive everything we do, and we are committed to serving our customers with excellence. We believe that every job in our organization is critical to our success, and we are dedicated to creating a work environment where our employees feel valued, respected, and supported. With locations in Wisconsin, Michigan, Minnesota, Iowa, and Florida we are proud to service our local communities and make a positive impact on the lives of our customers. At Nicolet National Bank, we believe that our people are our most valuable asset, and we are committed to investing in their growth and development.

The **Product Owner** is accountable for ensuring the effective delivery of the product vision established in collaboration with business stakeholders and the technology team by leveraging business applications, connected custom/proprietary and third-party systems. The Product Owner is responsible for understanding the business across all aspects of our sales and service teams in their respective focus area end to end, helping define process, gathering requirements, and prioritizing the team’s backlog to streamline the execution of strategic priorities while maintaining the conceptual and technical integrity of the features or components for the team.  
A successful person in this role will become intimately familiar with our business processes, then collaborate closely with business and technology teams to strategically align as the liaison for product delivery. Keep things organized, plan what will be worked on by cross functional teams in the form of features and user stories and will be able to drive delivery with confidence in a fast-paced environment. This role will work closely with subject matter experts, third parties, design teams, and technology partners to ensure functionality is delivered end-to-end that meets business objectives.

  

**As a Product Owner, you will:**

* Day-to-day management and execution around the backlog of the Treasury Management product category (Commercial deposit products, treasury management/cash management services, and collaboration with cross functional customer relationships).
* Guide teams in the implementation of functionality through prioritization of the product category backlog and distribution of work amongst cross functional teams.
* Obtain business requirements from stakeholders around desired deliverables.
* Be the voice of the customer and end users.
* Translate business requirements and product strategy into detailed requirements for prototype construction and final product development by engineering teams where applicable.
* When development is required, write user stories and corresponding documentation based on business requirements to inform the build team on functional requirements for a given prototype, product, or project.
* Write release notes in conjunction with delivered functionality.
* Lead Quality Assurance (QA) efforts on functionality to be released to ensure user needs are met.
* Collaborate with training stakeholders to roll out functionality. Help end users and training teams understand why something is being rolled out and how it was built to support a great end user training experience.
* Keep up to date with all Treasury Management and related business applications, as well as be up to date on technologies in the industry.
* Able to exercise independent judgment and take the lead role on enterprise level projects with minimal direction from a manager or senior leader.
