**About Clair**
---------------

If you can send your friends money in seconds, why does it still take your employer two weeks to send your paycheck?

At Clair, we are on a mission to create financial freedom for America's workers by giving them a digital banking platform that allows them to get paid as soon as they clock out of work. But we're not just another digital bank or on-demand pay provider. We meet Americans at their place of work by embedding our products within the scheduling, workforce management, and payroll apps they already use every day.

Learn more about us at getclair.com/about

**About the Role**
------------------

We’re looking for a Product Manager to help bring one of Clair's next products to life.

The product you'll initially work on exists today in successful private beta and is actively being expanded. That means you'll have a unique opportunity to join early in the product journey and help shape how we take an idea from concept to a real-world product and experience.

This isn't a role where you'll inherit a perfectly defined roadmap or be handed a clear playbook for success. We have a direction, a problem we're working to solve, and a vision, but there is still plenty to figure out. You'll help turn ambiguity into action, make smart decisions with imperfect information, and work alongside a small, highly collaborative team to build, test, learn, and iterate quickly.

At Clair, building products is uniquely complex. We're an embedded fintech company, which means great product decisions require balancing the needs of our users with partner priorities and internal business demands, all while operating within a regulated environment. You'll work closely with engineering, design, data, finance, regulatory, operations, go-to-market, and partner teams to navigate those competing inputs and find the best path forward.

We're looking for a builder who is comfortable with gray areas, thinks outside the box, and isn't afraid to try something that might not work. You know how to move quickly without being reckless and understand that failing fast is only valuable if you're learning fast, too.

You won't be joining a team with every answer already mapped out. You'll help us find them.

**If you need someone to tell you exactly how to win, this probably isn't the role for you.**

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Identify, evaluate, and help define opportunities for new Clair products and experiences, often before the problem or solution is fully understood.
* Define and execute product strategy and roadmaps in ambiguous, fast-moving environments.
* Partner closely with engineering and design to move quickly from concept to experiment to product, balancing speed with thoughtful execution.
* Build, test, learn, and iterate quickly—knowing when to invest further and when to fail fast and move on.
* Balance user experience and needs with partner priorities, business requirements, and the realities of operating an embedded fintech product.
* Spend time with partner management and go-to-market teams to identify new opportunities, uncover unmet needs, and develop new product concepts when necessary.
* Develop a deep understanding of Clair users through feedback, behavioral data, research, and direct conversations—and push for new ways to learn when existing data isn't enough.
* Work closely with data and analytics teams to develop hypotheses, evaluate product performance, and make informed decisions without becoming paralyzed by incomplete data.
* Collaborate with design and support teams to create intuitive, elegant experiences that help users understand and confidently engage with financial products.
* Partner with regulatory, finance, operations, and other internal stakeholders to navigate complex requirements without losing sight of the user experience.
* Bring the voice of the customer into product strategy, roadmap discussions, and day-to-day product decisions.

jobs.desc:
**What are we building?**

Hard Rock Digital is a **fiercely focused** team working to become the best online sportsbook, casino, and social gaming company in the world. We're building a **deeply curious** team with a passion for learning, operating, and building new products and technologies for millions of consumers. We're **customer-obsessed** — we care about each customer interaction, experience, behavior, and insight, and strive to ensure we're always acting authentically.

Rooted in the kindred spirits of Hard Rock and the Seminole Tribe of Florida, Hard Rock Digital taps a brand known the world over as the leader in gaming, entertainment, and hospitality. We're taking that foundation of success and bringing it to the digital space - ready to join us?

Our **Games Studio** is at the heart of this mission, building world class proprietary casino games for Hard Rock Bet Casino. Across **Slots, Card & Table, and Arcade games**, we are creating differentiated experiences that combine proven player appeal, outstanding creative execution, innovative mechanics, and the quality expected from the Hard Rock brand. You’ll have the opportunity to help shape these games from the ground up, working across our internal team and external development partners to create content that can become a meaningful part of our casino portfolio and player experience.

**What’s the position?**

We’re looking for a **Product Manager / Game Producer, Casino Games** to help build the next generation of proprietary games for Hard Rock Bet Casino. This is a high impact role combining **Product Management, Game Production, Game Design,** and commercial product thinking. Depending on Studio priorities and individual experience, you may lead games across Slots, Card & Table, Arcade, or multiple categories.

You will own games from the first concept through development, certification, launch, and performance review. Working closely with the Senior Director, Studio leadership, internal stakeholders, RGS and platform partners, and external game development studios, you will turn player and market insights into high-quality games that drive engagement, differentiation, and revenue. The role requires someone equally comfortable discussing game mechanics and player experience with creatives, math and requirements with development teams, delivery with external studios, product strategy and performance with senior stakeholders.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* **Own the Full Game Lifecycle**: Lead casino games from concept and business case through game design, development, QA, certification, launch, and post launch performance.
* **Build and Drive the Roadmap**: Develop and manage a strong game roadmap across Slots, Card & Table, and Arcade based on player needs, market opportunities, business priorities, and portfolio gaps.
* **Act as Product Manager and Game Producer**: Translate strategy into clear game concepts, GDDs, requirements, priorities, milestones, and actionable development plans.
* **Champion Creative and Game Quality**: Guide gameplay, mechanics, math, features, art, animation, audio, UI/UX, and overall player experience to deliver polished, compelling games.
* **Drive Innovation with Purpose**: Analyze successful games, suppliers, mechanics, player behavior, and adjacent gaming categories to identify opportunities worth adapting, improving, or reinventing.
* **Lead Internal and External Development**: Work closely with external studios, RGS and platform partners, Product, Engineering, Art, Math, QA, Compliance, Release, Analytics, Marketing, and Casino Operations to deliver games successfully.
* **Manage Delivery and Risk**: Own game priorities, development milestones, dependencies, risks, decisions, and stakeholder communication while maintaining quality and speed to market.
* **Deliver for Regulated Markets**: Ensure game design, math, functionality, documentation, testing, and implementation meet applicable regulatory and certification requirements.

When you join the Sandalwood team, you’ll join an engaging and inclusive group with a mission to help our customers identify, assess, and reduce work-related risks to quality, productivity, and employee health.

We are seeking a passionate support associate to lead the functional definition, lifecycle development, plant integration, and operational rollout of next-generation computer vision and automated inspection solutions.

In this role, you will own and advance a portfolio may include multiple advanced vision integration projects. You will work at the intersection of manufacturing, quality, software engineering, machine learning, controls, and plant operations to turn complex production challenges into scalable digital products.

Your success will help manufacturing teams improve first-time-through quality, reduce scrap, strengthen defect containment, and prevent quality issues from reaching customers.

This is an opportunity to shape products that directly influence manufacturing quality, production performance, and customer protection. You will have meaningful ownership of the roadmap while working closely with the teams that design, deploy, operate, and depend on these systems every day.

**What You'll Do**

Own the Product Backlog and Roadmap

* Define, prioritize, and manage the product backlog for camera and sensor based solutions.
* Align roadmap priorities with plant quality objectives and the broader digital manufacturing strategy.
* Translate manufacturing requirements, business needs, and quality risks into actionable user stories, acceptance criteria, and product increments.

Partner with Manufacturing Stakeholders

* Collaborate with Assembly, Stamping, and Powertrain teams to understand inspection challenges and operational requirements.
* Engage plant-floor technicians, quality leaders, controls engineers, plant management, software developers, and system integrators.
* Define functional specifications for applications such as visual defect detection and part presence or absence verification.

Lead Agile Product Delivery

* Serve as the primary product authority throughout the Agile delivery lifecycle.
* Lead or actively participate in sprint planning, daily stand-ups, backlog refinement, sprint reviews, and retrospectives.
* Provide direction and timely decisions to software engineers, machine learning engineers, and system integration teams.
* Keep delivery teams focused on the features and capabilities that create the greatest manufacturing and quality value.

Define Quality and Performance Criteria

* Establish clear acceptance criteria and quality-gating logic for automated inspection applications.
* Define false-positive and false-negative thresholds based on manufacturing requirements.
* Support inspection strategies for applications and critical vehicle build verification.

Guide Deployment and Production Validation

* Lead User Acceptance Testing, line-side validation, commissioning runs, and run-at-rate trials.
* Coordinate with plant and technical teams to verify that solutions are ready for production deployment.
* Support manufacturing launches and help resolve deployment issues in plant-floor environments.

Measure Results and Drive Continuous Improvement

* Establish, monitor, and communicate key performance indicators, including:
* First-time-through quality
* False rejection rate
* Inspection accuracy
* Cycle-time impact
* System uptime
* Mean time to detect and resolve issues
* Communicate product performance and improvement opportunities to plant and executive leadership.
* Use operating data and stakeholder feedback to continually improve product capabilities and deployment standards.

Enable Adoption and Operational Readiness

* Champion change management and product adoption across manufacturing operations.
* Support the creation of standard operating procedures and operational documentation.
Coordinate training for line operators, plant quality leads, and controls technicians.

**About Mariana Minerals**
==========================

Mariana Minerals is a software-first, vertically integrated minerals company on a mission to supply the critical minerals powering modern energy, AI, and defense technologies. We’re reimagining the minerals supply chain by combining deep industry expertise with advanced software, automation, and data-driven decision-making.

**The Role**
============

Mariana Minerals is a software-first, vertically integrated minerals company supplying the minerals critical to modern energy, AI, and defense technologies. Our data systems don't live in a vacuum — they feed process simulators, drive site automation, and are the substrate the business runs its decisions on.

We're hiring a Technical Product Manager to be the single product owner for the data engineering family — the data platform, analytics, data science, and the AI and agentic workflows built on top of them. Today this work is spread across technical leads and absorbed informally, with no one setting direction across the whole. Your job is to change that: decide what the data organization builds and why, get stakeholders aligned behind it, and make sure engineers can stay heads-down on the work that matters.

This is a hybrid Pioneer/Settler role: you'll get lightweight demos and PoCs built on ambiguous problems, and you'll bring order and cohesive ownership to data work streams that already exist. You'll prioritize ruthlessly and visibly — being explicit about what will not be worked on — and set direction rather than waiting for it to be handed to you.

**What You'll Do**
==================

* Talk to our internal teams constantly — operators, machine learning engineers, software developers, analysts, and data users are your users, and their problems set the roadmap.
* Own the roadmap for the data platform, analytics, and data science tooling: what gets built next, for whom, and why.
* Write the product specs, KPIs, and success metrics that turn ambiguous asks into scoped, shippable work.
* Own prioritization and stakeholder alignment so engineers stay focused on deep technical work.
* Make the build-vs-buy calls for BI and analytics, and prioritize tooling that lets stakeholders answer their own questions instead of adding headcount.
* Own where agents fit versus conventional software, and drive AI and agentic workflows from demo to adopted tool.
* Decide which new data streams get integrated, when, and to what standard as new sensors and sources come online.
* Set the bar for what "supported" and "correct" mean as tools graduate from scripts and spreadsheets, and be explicit about what won't be migrated.

**How You'll Operate**
======================

* **Structure from ambiguity:** Bring direction to cross-disciplinary initiatives and align stakeholders rather than waiting for direction.
* **Ruthless, visible prioritization:** Be explicit about what will not be worked on, not just what will.
* **Hybrid Pioneer/Settler:** Get initial prototypes built with stakeholders, then write the roadmap to validate the use case and, if worth it, take it to production.
* **Ecosystem fluency:** Understand where Mariana's data sits relative to the systems that consume it and relative to the current frontier of LLM capability, so prioritization calls stay well-calibrated.

**What We're Looking For**
==========================

**Must have**

* 4–8+ years in technical product management, data platform or analytics product roles, or equivalent experience leading cross-disciplinary technical programs
* Comfortable being the only PM in a highly technical room — you know when to drive a decision, when to defer to engineers, and how to build credibility without being the most technical person there
* Enough depth in data infrastructure and analytics to earn credibility with data engineers, data scientists, and analysts, and to know when a technical answer is a good one
* Working fluency with the current LLM/foundation-model landscape and whe

jobs.title: Manager, Product Telemetry Lead
jobs.desc:
**About the role:**

LSEG Analytics has been trusted for over 30 years by portfolio managers, risk teams and quantitative analysts. These clients want to access analytics where they're already working. This happens in spreadsheets, notebooks, BI dashboards, automated workflows and increasingly in AI assistants and agents.

Every one of those interactions is evidence: what customers actually use, how often, through which surface, and whether it worked. Today that evidence is uneven, which means the teams who build, sell and support our analytics have an incomplete picture of how customers experience them. This role owns closing that gap.

You will lead telemetry strategy across our analytics platform, owning what gets captured at the point of use, what it means, how it is surfaced, and working with the central telemetry team to ensure that the reporting is meaningful and consistent with D&A standards. That spans instrumentation standards, product adoption analytics, the usage evidence that supports commercial decisions, and the reporting our product, commercial and client service teams rely on.

This is a horizontal role. Telemetry cuts across every analytics vertical and every delivery channel, which means broad exposure to the LSEG estate and to the teams behind it.

This is a hands-on role. You will run your own discovery, own your roadmap, work directly with engineering to deliver, and stay accountable for the success of what you ship.

  

**Responsibilities:**

* Own the strategy and roadmap for analytics product telemetry, from instrumentation at the gateway through to the reporting and visualization built on top of it
* Collaborate with product teams to define what gets captured and what it means: the event schema, the identity and entitlement dimensions, and the rules that make usage comparable and actionable across products surfaces
* Partner with the cloud data platform teams who own storage and pipeline, translating product requirements into what the platform needs to capture and retain
* Inform the consumption layer: dashboards, usage reporting and the visualizations that make customer behaviour legible to the teams who act on it
* Turn usage data into an account of the customer experience — where workflows succeed, where they stall, and which surfaces customers are actually choosing
* Run discovery with your internal consumers across product, commercial, client service and engineering, and treat them as customers of what you build
* Hold the line on data quality and consistency, and be the person who can say what a number means and where it came from
* Act as the subject matter expert on usage data for commercial, client service and internal stakeholders
* Track how consumption patterns are changing, particularly agentic and AI-assisted usage, and make sure measurement keeps pace with them
  

**Background Experience/Skills:**

* Product management experience, or an equivalent background owning a platform, data or API product for internal or external consumers
* Technical fluency: comfortable with APIs, event data and data structures, and able to hold a credible conversation with engineers. You don't need to write production code, but you should be able to read it and be competent with SQL
* A feel for how data gets presented: you can tell the difference between a dashboard people open once and one they use to make decisions
* Data-driven in practice, not just in principle: you define what success looks like before you build, instrument for it, and change course when the evidence says to
* Judgment about measurement itself: you know the difference between a metric that is easy to collect and one that is worth acting on
* Working familiarity with AI tooling and how agentic consumption differs from human consumption
* Experience in financial data and analytics
* Comfortable operating in a matrixed organization
* Degree or equivalent in: Bachelors Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering/Operations Research

Description:

At CSpring, we believe in the power of data to drive decisions and real-world impact. We’re a purpose-driven consulting firm specializing in data strategy, data engineering, and data analytics. Our clients span the public and private sectors, and our work helps them solve complex problems, gain insights, and achieve measurable results.

We're seeking talented professionals who are collaborative, curious, and committed to making a difference that thrive at the intersection of data, technology, and business strategy. Whether you're passionate about transforming public programs, enabling executive decision-making, or modernizing legacy systems, you'll find meaningful work and purpose here.

**Why You’ll Love Working Here**

* **Purposeful Projects** – Improve systems that serve real people by delivering smarter data, streamlined processes, and strategic insight.
* **People-First Culture** – We’re as committed to your growth as we are to delivering high-impact solutions. You’ll find support, autonomy, and community here.
* **Strategic, Hands-On Work** – From data architecture and documentation to client workshops and solution delivery, you’ll influence every step of the process.
* **Collaborative Trust** – Our clients rely on us to listen carefully, deliver consistently, and guide wisely. We partner with integrity, curiosity, and heart.

**What You'll Do**

You'll work with clients to turn their enterprise data vision into a defined, sequenced, and communicated plan of record:

* Own product definition for the data portfolio — reporting and analytics, privacy-by-design, segmentation, predictive models, and the platform capabilities underneath them.
* Maintain the roadmap: a rolling view of what the data team is delivering across the next two to three quarters, kept current, and defensible to any executive who asks why something sits where it does.
* Write the product vision documents, acceptance criteria, and release notes that let engineers build without guessing and let stakeholders know what they are getting.
* Define what success looks like for every product, instrument it, and report on it — usage, adoption by department, time to insight, model performance in production, and the business result it was built to move.
* Say plainly when something isn't working, and change or retire products that don't earn their usage.
* Run the planning and execution rhythm: monthly planning, standups, and the working agreements that keep a small senior team moving on a Kanban flow.
* Keep BAU visible and bounded so it doesn't quietly consume delivery capacity.
* Sit with every function that touches fan, revenue, or venue data, understand what each is trying to accomplish, translate that into data product requirements, and close the loop when something ships.
* Serve as the standing connection between the data team and the rest of the organization.
* Write status that executives can read in one pass, launch communications that drive adoption, and documentation that makes the portfolio legible to people who weren't in the room.

Requirements:

* Seven or more years in product management, with meaningful time on data, analytics, or platform products.
* Experience with a modern data stack, enough to hold a credible conversation with engineers about tradeoffs without needing to write the code.
* Demonstrated ability to run planning and delivery for a technical team, and a track record of setting and reporting on product metrics rather than tracking output.
* Strong written communication, specifically the ability to write for executives.
* Working fluency with AI tooling in daily practice.
* A track record of taking data products from vision to adoption.

**Bonus Experience**

* Sports, entertainment, media, or consumer businesses with large customer bases.
* Defining AI-enabled product capabilities — conversational access to data, agent-driven insight delivery, or models embedded in business workflow.
* Privacy-by-design or data gove

**The Role**

We're looking for a Product Manager to own the Wag! Services web experience end to end. Wag! is a mature two-sided marketplace run with a startup mentality. Our web surface touches both sides of it: the booking funnel where pet parents find caregivers and the onboarding funnel our caregivers apply in. You will own the web roadmap and communicate the strategy and impact to leadership. Day to day, you draft tickets, approve designs, and run the experiments that tell us what to roll out. This is a hands-on role working directly with engineering, design, and analytics. This role is full-time and in-person 5x a week in our downtown Miami office. Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States at the time of hire. This position is not eligible for current or future employment visa sponsorship.

**How You’ll Make an Impact**

Booking Funnel and Experimentation

* Own the pet parent web booking funnel from page landing through service completion for new and returning customers
* Run the web A/B testing program end to end
* Find and fix conversion leaks across landing pages, signup, and booking flows

Growth Surfaces

* Own our SEO and marketing pages: page structure, speed, internal linking, and click through rate
* Partner with Marketing on new landing pages and acquisition surface improvements

Caregiver Onboarding Funnel

* Own the caregiver onboarding funnel from sign-up to approved application
* Balance dev resources between supply-side and demand-side work

Core Responsibilities

* Maintain a quarterly roadmap broken into weekly sprints
* Draft PRDs and tickets with requirements and acceptance criteria for engineering
* Leverage dashboards and reports to own daily and weekly performance reporting
* Use AI tools to draft initial designs and prototypes before looping in the designer

* Experience running A/B tests end to end, including sizing, instrumentation, and ship/revert decisions
* Comfortable working with data, Excel, and basic BI tool proficiency

* Strong sense of ownership and eagerness to make an impact across teams

* Ability to work in-person 5x a week in our downtown Miami office

  

**Purr-furred Paw-lifications**

* Experience with a feature-flag or experimentation platform such as Split, LaunchDarkly, or Optimizely
* Familiarity with Snowflake, Mixpanel, or a comparable analytics stack

jobs.desc:
Zlayt AI is a litigation automation platform built exclusively for personal injury law. From demand letters and deposition summaries to discovery responses and case analysis, Zlayt equips law firms with intelligent tools that draft faster, think strategically, and deliver results without friction, setup, or compromise.

We're an early-stage, product-led company building the category-defining product for legal AI in a large, underserved niche. This is a rare opportunity to shape what the product becomes — working directly with the founding team, real PI lawyers, and real case data.

**The Role**

Zlayt AI is hiring a Product Manager to own the product from problem to shipped feature. You'll work directly with the founders and engineering to decide what we build, why, and in what order — then make sure it ships and actually works for the lawyers and legal assistants who use it every day.

This is a builder's role, not a caretaker's role. There is no product org to step into. You'll be writing the first specs, running the first structured discovery, and setting up how product decisions get made.

**What You'll Do**

* Own the product roadmap: talk to PI lawyers and staff, find the highest-value workflow problems, and turn them into a prioritized plan
* Write clear specs and acceptance criteria that engineers can build from without guesswork
* Work hands-on with AI: define how features should behave, test outputs against real legal work product, and set the quality bar for what "good enough to ship" means
* Run discovery and feedback loops with early customers, including Zinda Law Group as the first major client
* Define and track the metrics that show whether a feature is working (adoption, time saved, output quality, retention)
* Operate with significant ambiguity in an early-stage environment, making decisions with incomplete information and adjusting quickly

  

**Who You Are**

* **A builder, not an inheritor:** You've shipped a 0-to-1 software product or major feature as the accountable PM — you know what it takes to build something from nothing, not just run an existing roadmap
* **Technical enough to be dangerous:** You've worked directly with engineers day to day, can read a technical design, and don't need a translator to discuss APIs, data models, or model behavior
* **AI-native:** You've shipped or worked hands-on with LLM or AI-powered features, and you use AI tools yourself to do your own work faster
* **Workflow-obsessed:** You've built software for a demanding professional user — legal, healthcare, finance, or similar — where the details of the workflow decide whether the product gets used
* **Startup-tested:** You've worked in small, fast-moving companies where you had to build process yourself, not step into one that already existed
* **Self-directed:** Your track record shows work you personally drove — not just team results you were adjacent to
* **Experienced but still hands-on:** Roughly 4–10 years of total professional experience, with at least 3 in product management
* **Stable but not stagnant:** A track record of meaningful tenure at each stop, with job changes that make sense (promotions, acquisitions, layoffs, or clear career logic — not a pattern of short stints)

  

**Our Philosophy**

We firmly uphold the value of every individual within our team, ensuring they have the chance to build a rewarding career both financially and personally. Our firm's structure is designed to offer exceptional prospects for growth and advancement. At Zlayt AI, every team member leaves at the end of the day with the satisfaction of knowing they have diligently served our clients and positively impacted the lives of others. Join us and experience a remarkable work environment at our organization!

At Wellthy, we dream of a world where everyone has the care infrastructure they need to manage their own health and the health and well-being of their loved ones.  
  
We're building something new in the care space - reimagining how care is delivered, accessed, and supported by families around the globe. As we grow, we're seeking collaborative, curious, and purpose-driven teammates to help us expand what's possible.  
  
Our work is grounded in the expertise of seasoned care professionals who deeply understand families' real challenges paired with agile, tech-powered solutions that deliver support efficiently and at scale. Tools like AI and other innovations are accelerators, enabling us to scale our impact, work smarter, and stay at the forefront of care delivery.

Through Wellthy, millions of families have access to support to help them manage care during every stage of life, with hands-on experts guiding families through caregiving or backup care journeys. And with the acquisition of Patch Caregiving, Wellthy continues to expand how care shows up for working families by pairing care navigation and coordination with on-site and near-site employer-based childcare. This combination allows us to support families not just in navigating care decisions, but in accessing real, hands-on help when and where they need it most. Together, we're building a more connected, comprehensive care experience for families and caregivers alike.

We partner with leading companies including more than 40 Fortune 500 companies to support the care needs of their workforces globally. We also work alongside health plans and carriers to embed care support into their offerings, enhancing the experience and outcomes for members.  
  
We're building, evolving, and expanding the market category for care, and we're looking for responsive, collaborative, curious, and purposeful colleagues to join us.

**As our Product Manager II**, you will work in a management capacity to shape the future of our product. You will help build and deliver solutions to better support our caregiving members, enable our internal care teams to more efficiently deliver a world-class experience, and showcase the value of our service to our clients. You will lead efforts around product vision, prioritization, and scoping.

**You will report directly to the Chief Product Officer.**

* **Ownership & Impact:** Defining success metrics, tracking product performance against key business goals, and taking full ownership of the product lifecycle from launch to sunset.
  

**Qualifications**

To be successful in this role, you'll need to be open to learning, experimenting, and evolving. Comfort with emerging technology and curiosity around how tools like AI can support your workflow or help families more effectively is a plus.

* You are a builder who is energized by learning, experimenting, and evolving. You actively seek to apply emerging technologies, especially AI, to enhance your workflow, build smarter products, and more effectively support the members we serve.

jobs.title: Product Owner - Enterprise Data
jobs.desc:
The Product Owner works on a cross functional team to create meaningful and simple experiences for their product’s customers. They own the direction-setting, discovery, and prioritization of customer wants and needs. A PO-I typically is new to the role of Product Owner, and as such likely manages products with limited scope and impact.  
  
The Product Owner role is highly collaborative working closely with several key partners. The Product Owner articulates, translates, and executes the Product Manager’s long-term strategy and vision of the product through tactical strategies and solutions to drive necessary business outcomes. This requires the right alignment and regular, transparent communication to ensure both roles deliver on their goals.
  
  
Additionally, the Product Owner works closely with stakeholders, end users, and functional and technical team members to rapidly deliver quality solutions to customers.  
  
This role is part of Thrivent's Enterprise Data Products organization and supports enterprise data products serving Corporate Functions including Operations, Risk, Compliance, HR, Legal, and other shared services. The Product Owner partners with business stakeholders, data engineers, architects, and governance teams to deliver trusted, scalable data products that improve decision-making, operational effectiveness, analytics, governance, and AI-enabled experiences across the enterprise.  
  
Enterprise Data Products at Thrivent are focused on creating trusted, reusable, and measurable data products that enable analytics, operational decision-making, governance, and AI-powered experiences across the enterprise.

**DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Works as a key team member on a cross functional team, responsible for continuous delivery of value to the customer through compelling and empowering customer experiences.
* Collaborate with Product Manager and stakeholders to ensure work prioritization is aligned with Thrivent’s priorities and overall product roadmap as well as to provide product development feedback and direction.
* Continuously innovates and evolves the product in alignment with strategic priorities. Is responsible for creating, maintaining, and evolving the product roadmap.
* Maintain and refine product backlog: Create user stories and acceptance criteria and prioritize all stories to ensure work focuses on those with maximum business value that align with product strategy.
* Ensure stories clearly communicate the customer and stakeholder needs to meet key business objectives and strategies for the product. Is available for consultation during agile team planning and grooming sessions as needed.
* Works with other product teams/owners to align product roadmaps and sprint plans, and to focus on delivering the maximum business value to the organization.
* Working as a part of an agile team, ensures the team is aligned around similar goals and objectives and attending all team meetings.
* Engages with customers and users on a regular basis to uncover implicit and explicit needs.
* Develop and track key value drivers that measure effectiveness of product discovery and overall product performance and communicate these to stakeholders and business leaders on a regular basis.
* Foster a sense of urgency to achieve goals and leverage resources to overcome unexpected obstacles.
* Inspire others to achieve challenging goals and high standards of performance while committing to the organization’s direction (Product/Agile/DevOps).
* Models Thrivent’s leadership competencies – courage, collaboration, and commitment by demonstrating resiliency, working together to make the best decisions, and holding yourself and others accountable.

jobs.title: Product Owner Policy Management
jobs.desc:
CopperPoint has an exciting opportunity for a Product Owner - Policy Management to lead the strategy, roadmap, and delivery of technology-enabled business capabilities that enhance the commercial policy lifecycle. In this role, you will serve as a key connector across business, technology, data, and operations, translating business priorities and customer needs into measurable outcomes.

As the Product Owner, you will shape and prioritize the product vision, guide an agile squad, and ensure capabilities align with enterprise objectives, regulatory requirements, and evolving customer expectations. You will play a critical role in driving continuous improvement, optimizing policy management experiences, and delivering solutions that create meaningful value for our customers and our business.

**Job responsibilities:**

* Accountable for defining and executing the squad vision, strategy, and multi-year roadmap aligned to enterprise and operating model priorities.
* Own translation of business strategy into clearly defined objectives and measurable key results (OKRs).
* Lead and maintain an agile, adaptable squad capable of responding to market, regulatory, and performance changes.
* Own the end-to-end lifecycle of product capabilities, from intake through delivery, adoption, and optimization.
* Ensure seamless integration and alignment across adjacent product domains and end-to-end value streams.
* Drive consistent and high-quality customer and operational experience across all journeys.
* Deliver measurable business outcomes and value realization aligned to defined objectives.
* Own and prioritize the product backlog, ensuring alignment with business value, risk, and compliance requirements.
* Balance delivery across feature development, technical debt, regulatory mandates, and operational stability.
* Ensure delivery readiness through clear, timely user stories with defined requirements, acceptance criteria, and business value.
* Serve as the primary business owner and decision authority for the product, ensuring alignment across key stakeholders.
* Partner closely with technical product management, engineering, architecture, UX/design, and data & analytics to deliver scalable solutions.
* Accountable for agile delivery of high-quality, scalable, and compliant product capabilities.
* Influence architecture and platform decisions to support long-term product and enterprise scalability.
* Ensure auditability, traceability, and governance are embedded within product design and delivery.
* Foster and enable a data-driven culture in partnership with analytics teams.
* Drive continuous improvement across product performance, delivery effectiveness, and team outcomes.

  

**Qualifications/Competencies:**

Warby Parker is on the lookout for a motivated Product Manager to join our Business Systems Product Management team. In this role, you’ll support the product roadmap and business outcomes for a cross-functional product team concentrating on supply chain and operations. Key areas of focus for this role will include leading and optimizing technology solutions that support our Manufacturing, Distribution, Inventory Control, Logistics, and Order Management functions. As the Product Manager of Business Systems, you’ll find yourself at the crossroads of much of what we do—you’ll influence and impact not only our internal operations but also the customer experience through the support of new product launches. Sound like your dream gig? Read on!

**What you’ll do:**

* Manage the product team responsible for features used by our Business Systems teams
* Help identify and lead the end-to-end lifecycle of features based on our business objectives, metrics, and analyses, ensuring timely delivery of effective solutions
* Partner closely with stakeholders to launch new features and products that create efficient business operations, always with the goal of delivering the best possible customer experience
* Build out a prioritized roadmap by collaborating and building strong relationships with stakeholders across our Supply Chain and Operations teams
* Lead, work closely with, and mobilize other members of our Digital Product and Technology teams to execute cross-functional projects

**What you’ll learn:**

* The nitty-gritty of executing against strategic business concepts
* How to translate high-level objectives into effective product solutions
* A lot—or a lot more!—about supply chains, lab and warehouse management, and transportation and logistics
* How top-quality glasses are made!

**Who you are:**

* 5+ years of professional experience
* Experience owning a product roadmap for backend systems, internal tools, operations-supporting products, or supply chain
* Equipped with experience in supply chain management or an understanding of ERP order management or warehouse management concepts
* Quick to act and able to make tough decisions when called for, leaning on your own background and knowledge of strategic business concepts
* Naturally curious and decisive—you dive into any available information and use those learnings to inform your decisions
* A well-rounded communicator, collaborator, and presenter who loves to share findings and actionable insights
* A team player who’s at ease acting as a leader on certain projects and a contributor on others
* Eager to help others and passionate about creating stellar products
* A strong analyst with basic knowledge of SQL
* Not on the Office of Inspector General’s List of Excluded Individuals/Entities (LEIE)

**Extra credit:**

* Experience as a software engineer
* Experience in Oracle ERP
* Experience working at a direct-to-consumer or retail company

jobs.desc:
At Exacta Systems, we’re not just shaping the future of gaming—we’re redefining it. As a leader in historical horse racing (HHR) technology, we create cutting-edge gaming solutions that power thrilling player experiences nationwide. Now part of the Churchill Downs family, we’re backed by a storied legacy of excellence in racing and gaming. This new chapter brings exciting opportunities for growth, stability, innovation, and impact. If you're looking for a career where technology meets tradition and where your ideas drive the future, let’s explore the possibilities together!

**JOB SUMMARY**
---------------

This role sits directly under the Sr. Director, Product Management in a small, high-visibility product organization. The Product Owner will own the backlog for a defined product area, with real latitude over day-to-day delivery decisions, direct access to product leadership, and a clear line of sight from the work to how operators run their business. For someone who wants to build durable expertise in a complex regulated domain and see their decisions reach production quickly, this is a more substantive seat than an equivalent role inside a large product org.

The Product Owner is responsible for translating Exacta’s product strategy and roadmap into clear, actionable work for software development teams. Serving as a key connection point between Product leadership, Engineering, Quality Assurance, Operations, and other business stakeholders, this role owns and prioritizes the product backlog and ensures development teams have the requirements, context, and clarity necessary to deliver high-quality solutions.

The Product Owner works closely with technical teams throughout the software development lifecycle to define requirements, develop user stories and acceptance criteria, clarify business needs, prioritize work, and validate that completed functionality achieves its intended outcome. This position requires a strong understanding of Exacta’s Historical Horse Racing (HHR) products, customers, operational environments, and business processes.

This is a hands-on, delivery-focused position. The Product Owner operates within the product strategy and roadmap established by Product leadership and is expected to exercise strong independent judgement on day-to-day prioritization, scope, and sequencing.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**
-----------------------------------------

Product Backlog Ownership & Prioritization

* Own, maintain, and refine the product backlog.
* Translate product strategy, roadmap priorities, business needs, and customer requirements into actionable development work.
* Prioritize work based on business value, customer impact, dependencies, regulatory requirements, and defect severity.
* Ensure backlog items are defined, sequenced, and development-ready.
* Exercise independent judgment on daily priorities; escalate decisions materially affecting scope, roadmap, or strategy.
* Ensure development teams understand priorities and business rationale.

Requirements & User Story Development

* Translate business, customer, operational, and technical needs into user stories, use cases, business rules, and acceptance criteria.
* Clearly define problems, desired functionality, expected behavior, and intended outcomes.
* Identify gaps, dependencies, edge cases, and conflicts before development.
* Break larger initiatives into appropriately sized, actionable work and maintain accurate documentation.

Agile Delivery, Quality & Release

* Serve as the primary Product representative for assigned development teams and participate in Agile ceremonies.
* Partner with Engineering, developers, Scrum Masters, and QA throughout development to ensure alignment on requirements and intended outcomes.
* Clarify requirements, resolve ambiguities, and address dependencies, risks, constraints, and competing priorities.
* Partner with QA to ensure acceptance criteria are testable; review completed functionality and participate

HUD is building infrastructure to create RL training data and evals for frontier AI agents, as well as a marketplace to sell these to frontier labs through the HUD marketplace. Our platform is used by frontier labs, Fortune 500 companies, and startups. We’ve raised $16M from top VCs and were YC W25.

About the role

We’re looking a Product Manager to own product work for our data marketplace. You’ll make it easier for data vendors to bring high-quality RL environments and training data to HUD, and for research teams to discover, evaluate, and use them. You’ll work closely with engineering, research, and GTM to turn technical and operational needs into product decisions.

jobs.title: Product Marketing Manager
jobs.desc:
**About Improvado**
-------------------

Improvado is a marketing data and AI analytics platform for enterprise brands and agencies. We connect 500+ marketing and sales data sources, normalize them through a governed data model, and put an AI agent on top so marketing teams can ask questions of their own data without going through BI or IT.

**What we sell:** extraction and 500+ connectors; data transformation (SQL and dbt-compatible); Marketing Data Governance — taxonomy, naming, data-quality rules; warehouse and storage; dashboards; AI agent and MCP access to live marketing data; DECS, data engineering as a service on a 2 to 4 week SLA.

**Who buys it:**

* *Economic buyers:* CMO, VP Marketing, VP Demand Gen, agency COO and ops leadership
* *Technical evaluators:* VP or Director of Marketing Analytics, marketing analysts, data engineering, sometimes IT and security
* *Segments:* enterprise brands, mid-market, agencies
* *Verticals:* pharma and healthcare, financial services, retail and eCommerce, gaming, agencies

**Why this role, now**
----------------------

* **Our messaging is not aligned.** Positioning, web, sales pitch, product and content each carry a different version of what Improvado is. The market categorizes us as "marketing ETL" while we position as an AI marketing analytics platform. That gap costs us deal quality and price.
* **The category is crowded and moving fast.** Battlecards exist but decay, and nobody owns keeping them true.
* **Attribution, incrementality and causal measurement is where deals are won and lost** — and it is the hardest thing to argue credibly without hand-waving.
* **Analyst firms are a silent blocker.** When an enterprise buyer asks Gartner or Forrester about Improvado, there is no briefed narrative waiting for them.

You would not start from a blank page. We already have a positioning registry, roughly 11 documented buyer personas, a pain-point and value-prop library, competitor intel reports and about 10 battlecards. They are inconsistent and under-used. Your first job is to make one version true and make people use it.

**What you'll own**
-------------------

* **Positioning and messaging.** Core positioning, category framing and message hierarchy across ICPs and personas. ICP and persona documentation that is used, not filed. The messaging layer of new product and feature launches, including the internal rollout that makes the field able to sell it.
* **Competitive intelligence and win/loss.** A structured win/loss interview program with quarterly readouts. Living battlecards. Monitoring competitor positioning, pricing and product moves, and driving our counter-positioning.
* **Sales enablement.** The core pitch narrative, demo storyline and objection-handling framework. The messaging components of new-rep onboarding. A standing weekly cadence with Sales leadership — not quarterly check-ins. Direct support on competitive and enterprise deals: RFPs, security and technical evaluations, displacement plays.
* **Market and analyst relations.** The Improvado narrative for Gartner, Forrester and category influencers, so that a buyer's analyst call becomes an accelerator rather than a blocker. Feeding structured market and buyer insight back into product prioritization.

**What we're looking for**
--------------------------

* 4 to 8 years in product marketing, or an equivalent blend of product marketing with marketing analytics, marketing or data ops, sales engineering, analytics consulting, or product management on a data product.
* Category fluency in marketing data and measurement: attribution models, incrementality testing, MMM, data governance and taxonomy, warehouses and ETL/ELT — including where each is honestly weak.
* B2B SaaS sold to marketing or data buyers. Marketing analytics, martech, measurement, CDP, BI and data-infrastructure vendors are the reference profile.
* Proof you have shipped, not just documented: positioning that changed the website and the pitch, battlecards

============

Accord is a breakout Series A startup (funding announcement) founded by proven leaders from Stripe, LinkedIn, and Google. Accord’s high-bar for execution has quickly led to big wins, including:

* Driving 100+ paying customers under 12 months of launching
* Partnering with industry leaders such as Samsara, Harvey.ai, Decagon, Xactly etc.

The company is on a mission to transform how Revenue Leaders drive Execution Excellence. From setting and enforcing standards for how their GTM team sells, onboards, and expands with customers, ambitious leaders use Accord to up-level the craft of Sales.

With hubs in Toronto & San Francisco, Accord is bringing on passionate builders who sweat the details and want to build something special.

If you’re interested in being part of a collaborative, high-velocity team that is dedicated to excellence in its craft, apply.

**The Role**
------------

Accord is the execution layer for value-selling and this is the first PM role in Accord’s history. More of our product decisions now involve AI: when an agent should act, when a person should, and what it costs. We need a PM who makes those calls with evidence. We also need to close the loop on what happens after launch.

We're looking for a **Product Manager** to close this gap: align priorities, keep engineering unblocked, and make sure the roadmap reflects what customers and the business actually need for our category-defining product. You'll report to Divya, VP, Product and work closely with product design, engineering, customer success, and product marketing. You'll work directly with customers to ground your decisions in what they actually need. And since this is the first PM role in Accord's history, you'll have real room to shape what it becomes.

**What success looks like:**
----------------------------

* **First 3 months:** You understand the product and the personas it serves and the pain it solves for our customers.
* **By 6 months:** You own the CS–product relationship outright. You've built real relationships across engineering, you're confidently setting and driving the roadmap, pulling in stakeholders to prioritize rather than waiting to be told what's next, and you're comfortable running AI evals and data analysis, including cost models included.
* **By 12 months:** If you're excelling, there's room to grow into a more senior, strategic seat by shaping company-wide prioritization and acting as a thought partner to leadership, not just executing against a roadmap someone else set.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* **Own and drive the roadmap.** Set priorities and pull in stakeholders to make the calls.
* **Own the CS–product relationship.** Drive the feedback loop from Customer Success, prioritize what comes in, and make sure engineering always has what it needs to act on it.
* **Scope and sequence delivery with engineering**. Decide what can ship, sequence the work, and adjust when estimates change.
* **Close the loop after launch.** Track how features land with users after we ship them, and focus on increasing adoption to close the gap.
* **Collaborate with product marketing.** Own release timelines and launch coordination end to end.
* **Contribute to user research alongside design**, and talk directly to customers.
* **Demonstrate User Empathy.** Understand the user before you propose anything. Contribute to user research alongside design, and talk directly to customers.
* **Run AI evals and data analysis** to support real decisions, like cost modelling, agent framework evaluation, and the judgment calls that come with them.

**Who You Are**
---------------

* **Startup experience:** You’re comfortable in high-velocity and can manage multiple competing priorities with ease.
* **0 1, then close the loop.** You ship fast and track what happens after launch.
* **Data fluent.** You run AI evals and cost models yourself and validate your assumptions

jobs.desc:
About Caret Health

Caret Health runs care coordination for rural and critical-access hospitals. Rural hospitals are accountable for value-based-care outcomes and eligible for reimbursable programs — remote patient monitoring, chronic and transitional care management, annual wellness visits, quality-gap closure, cancer navigation — that they have nobody to staff. We supply both: the platform the programs run on, and, where a customer wants it, the people who run them.

That combination makes us unusual. The clinical platform is licensed and used directly by hospital care teams, and it is also the system our own staff work when we deliver programs on a customer's behalf. It carries real clinical operations across 50+ hospitals and a large rural patient panel — quality measures tracked, discharges worked against a 48-hour clock, monitoring alerts triaged, billable time documented.

This role owns that platform.

**The role**

You will own the **Care Operations Platform**: the system care teams work in every day to run every program we deliver. Patient records and statuses, protocol and tasking engines, work queues, task outcomes, the team inbox, multi-program logic, roles and access — plus the integrations that feed it.

The bar is high. These are people doing clinical work under deadlines, on patients with real conditions, in organizations that are already short-staffed. A confusing screen costs time that a rural care team does not have. A broken data feed means a care gap nobody knows about.

This is an execution-heavy product role with room to grow into strategy. You'll run discovery, write the specs, own the planning, run the release train for your area, and be accountable for whether what you shipped actually got adopted. You'll report to the Chief Product Officer, who currently carries this scope directly — your first job is to take it off their plate and run it better.

**What you'll own**

**Platform ownership.** The clinical platform end to end: roadmap, backlog, specs, and outcomes. You decide what gets built next in your area and say no to the rest, using a simple test — does it protect revenue, improve our cost-per-outcome, or advance our AI and data position?

**Discovery and research.** Run a continuous loop with the care teams, team leads, and operations managers who use the platform. Watch the work as it actually happens and turn observations into a ranked, evidenced problem list rather than a wish list. You'll be the person who can say what actually slows a care team down, with numbers attached.

**Integrations.** Clinical data arrives from EHRs, payer sources, monitoring devices, telephony and messaging providers, and partner platforms. You own the product side of these: what we ingest, how it maps, what happens when a field is missing or a feed goes quiet. Integrations must be **seamless for the user and observable for us** — a care team should never have to think about where the data came from, and we should know a pipeline is degraded before a customer tells us.

**Hypotheses and metrics.** Every meaningful thing you ship starts as a stated hypothesis — what we believe, what we expect to change, how we'll know — and ships with success metrics defined before the build. You'll instrument the work, read the results honestly, and kill what didn't work. Our product analytics stack is already in place and under-used; you'll change that.

**Planning and delivery.** Break quarterly direction into epics, specs, and well-written tickets. Own sprint planning and the backlog with the engineering leads. Keep cross-team dependencies visible and resolved before they become slips.

**Release management.** Own the release train for your area: scope, readiness, regression coverage with QA, release notes, rollout, and what happens when something goes wrong. Our cycle is slower than it should be — shrinking it, safely, is one of the things we'll measure you on.

Toshiba Global Commerce Solutions is seeking a Product Manager to help unify and scale our agentic AI platform, the shared foundation that grounds every solution built on it in two decades of accumulated retail expertise. The near-term work is getting the platform's first capabilities launched and consolidating what exists today onto a common core across intelligence and knowledge services, the developer platform, and the fleet of agents that runs on both. It serves teams across Toshiba and the customers and partners who build on it.

This is a build-and-ship role: writing specs, working alongside engineering to get capability out, putting it in front of the teams who use it, and bringing back what you learn. You will work closely with platform and engineering leadership on direction, own turning it into well-defined, shipped work, and supply the evidence from real use that shapes what comes next.

**What Success Looks Like**

Toshiba's twenty years of retail expertise lives in its products, its architecture, and the judgment behind both. The platform brings that together in one place and puts it to work for anyone who needs it, whether they are building something, answering a question, or delivering for a customer.

Success is how far that reaches: engineers shipping faster, expertise available without waiting on the expert, people doing work that used to need a specialist, and customers and partners building on the same foundation.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own the shared platform backlog across intelligence and knowledge services, the developer platform, and the agent fleet.

* Write clear product requirements and specs, translating business use cases from internal stakeholder teams into actionable work.

* Ship the curated workflows, skills, and reference patterns that make the platform faster to use and more reliable in what it produces, along with the onboarding documentation that lets a team get going without the platform team in the room.

* Operate with a builder mindset: use the platform yourself, prototype what you are asking for, and drive adoption directly with the teams rather than only through documentation.

* Close the loop: gather feedback and usage signals from the teams on the platform, turn friction into concrete backlog items, and bring the evidence that informs the roadmap.

* Build the instrumentation and reporting behind the platform's KPIs, so progress is visible to the teams and to leadership: adoption and breadth of use across teams, onboarding time, the share of portal usage that reaches merged and deployed code, developer experience, agent and retrieval quality, and usage cost and attribution.

* Ability to write clear product requirements and specs, and to prioritize a backlog.

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.desc:
Tilt (check us out here) is looking for a Product Manager to join our Product team and help us scale our business. You'll be part of a cross-functional feature team, partnering closely with Engineering and Design to discover, build, and evolve capabilities across the Tilt platform. Our goal is to make sure employees, managers, and HR administrators have a seamless, supportive experience throughout their leave journey. This is a full-time role reporting to the Group Product Manager. We want you to be successful here at Tilt! Below is a description of your role and responsibilities, including the things you will be held accountable for and the virtues, behaviors, and competencies expected in this role.

Responsibilities will include:

* Own a defined product area end-to-end, from understanding the problem and shaping the solution through delivery, launch, measurement and iteration.
* Identify and prioritize product opportunities based on:
* Customer needs and real-world leave workflows
* Business goals and measurable impact
* Long-term product strategy, platform scalability, and operational efficiency
* Take an ambiguous customer or business problem, create structure around it, identify what you need to learn, and move the work forward without waiting for step-by-step direction.
* Distinguish a request from an underlying problem and use customer, business, and product evidence to recommend what should be built.
* Partner closely with Engineering, Design, Customer Success, Sales, and Operations to deliver high-quality solutions and experiences
* Create clear visibility into your product area by communicating progress, decisions, risks, tradeoffs, and changes in a way that teammates and business partners outside the day-to-day work can understand
* Think AI- and automation-first when solving problems and looking for opportunities to eliminate work, improve decisions, personalize experiences, and create new product capabilities rather than simply digitizing existing workflows
* Engage directly with customers and internal teams to understand workflows, uncover pain points, and validate solutions in production
* Define success metrics and use data, experimentation, and qualitative feedback to continuously improve product outcomes
* Evaluate and introduce new capabilities (e.g., automation, AI-assisted workflows, and decision support) that reduce friction, increase efficiency, and improve user trust
* Support go-to-market readiness by ensuring features are well-positioned, understood, and adopted

**You'll be successful in this role when:**

* You can independently lead a product area without requiring constant direction
* Engineering and Design have the context and clarity they need to make good decisions with you
* Customers and internal partners feel heard, but their requests are translated into thoughtful product decisions rather than simply added to a backlog
* Risks and changes are surfaced early, and stakeholders understand what's happening without having to chase you
* You're measuring whether what we ship actually solved the problem
* You're increasingly bringing forward opportunities and recommendations—not just executing work assigned to you

You’re a great fit if

* You bring 3+ years of hands-on product management experience, with demonstrated ownership of products or meaningful product areas from discovery through launch and iteration.
* You have experience building and shipping B2B or SaaS products
* You have experience owning platform, infrastructure, workflow, communications, or other foundational product capabilities
* You’re skilled at balancing customer needs, business priorities, and technical constraints
* You collaborate effectively with engineers and designers, even if you’re not deeply technical yourself
* You have high levels of empathy and can connect deeply with Tilt’s mission
* You are comfortable working in ambiguous environments and know that we need your help to figure things out

jobs.desc:
**Overview**
------------

A career with us means you’ll work alongside exceptional people and be empowered to reach your professional and personal goals. Our employees are at the foundation of what enables MassMutual to deliver on our purpose to help people secure their futures and protect the ones they love.

We embrace the idea that we all are stronger and better through our support for one another. We strive to create a culture where employees feel valued and are celebrated for who they are.

  

**Job Description**
-------------------

Product Owner- Workflow Orchestration

Shared Services & Enablement

Full-time, Springfield, MA

  
  

**The Opportunity**

As the **Product Owner- Workflow Orchestration,** you will create the strategy, determine the business goals, formulate scope and develop a roadmap for the implementation of the Salesforce customer relationship management (CRM) platform and other large-scale strategic MassMutual initiatives intended to transform how we deliver service to our advisors and customers for years ahead.

In this role, you will partner with all levels of leadership and cross-enterprise parties (e.g. Operational areas, MMLIS, ETX, Legal, Compliance, Human Resources, etc.) on the execution of the advisor and customer engagement strategy.

  
  

**The Team**

As a key member of the Shared Services & Enablement Team—a highly collaborative group that drives engagement strategy across the enterprise—the Product Owner will shape the long‑term vision for how MassMutual equips its advisors and delivers service to customers. This role blends strategic thinking, cross‑functional leadership, product planning, and operational alignment to ensure that large‑scale initiatives deliver meaningful, future‑ready capabilities that elevate the overall service experience.

  
  

**The Impact**

This role defines and prioritizes product features that meet current and future customer and advisor needs. It partners across business areas—Operations, ETX, vendors, and subject matter experts—to deliver tools that optimize technology, improve service interactions, and drive business value. The position leads prioritization, scope, and timing of Salesforce deliverables; develops business requirements aligned to strategic outcomes; removes obstacles; evaluates risks; and makes key decisions that guide project direction and timelines. It also ensures each business area is operationally ready for transitions with minimal service impact.

Success in this role requires strong project leadership, data analysis, business knowledge, agility, resilience, and consistent stakeholder communication to maintain transparency on strategy, status, decisions, and challenges throughout the multi-phase effort.

  
  

**The Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree or 10+ years equivalent work experience in business consulting or project management in lieu of degree

jobs.desc:
**About Luma Financial Technologies**

Founded in 2018, Luma Financial Technologies (“Luma”) has pioneered a cutting-edge fintech software platform that has been adopted by broker/dealer firms, RIA offices, and private banks around the world. By using Luma, institutional and retail investors have a fully customizable, independent, buy-side technology platform that helps financial teams more efficiently learn about, research, purchase, and manage alternative investments as well as annuities. Luma gives these users the ability to oversee the full, end-to-end process lifecycle by offering a suite of solutions. These include education resources and training materials; creation and pricing of custom structured products; electronic order entry; and post-trade management. By prioritizing transparency and ease of use, Luma is a multi-issuer, multi-wholesaler, and multi-product option that advisors can utilize to best meet their clients’ specific portfolio needs. Headquartered in Cincinnati, OH, Luma also has offices in New York, NY, Miami, FL, Zurich, Switzerland and Lisbon, Portugal. For more information, please visit Luma’s website.

**About the role**

Luma Financial Technologies is expanding into asset management, and is seeking a Product Owner to help lead that expansion. This role owns product delivery for ETF, Actively Managed Certificate (AMC), Separately Managed Account (SMA) and other related product types that will be supported across Luma's Lifecycle Manager and Product Marketplace, and for the data connectivity that underpins them — integrations with ETF ecosystem partners, such as DTCC, custodians, transfer agents, index provides, sub advisors and other market participants.. The role requires strong organizational discipline, the ability to quickly reprioritize as situations evolve, and the judgment to balance near-term execution with longer-term platform objectives.

The ideal candidate brings 7+ years of experience with ETF, AMC, SMA or other similar products and understands the workflows of Asset Managers, ETF Providers, Custodians, DTCC, and other market participants. A background working at an Asset Management Company that creates and manages ETFs (e.g., Invesco, BlackRock, or similar) is strongly preferred, alongside experience at a fintech platform, custodian, or similar capital-markets institution.

**What you'll do**

**AI-DLC Execution and Delivery**

* Own end-to-end execution of Luma's AI-DLC (AI-Driven Development Lifecycle) across discovery, design, development, QA, release, and post-launch evaluation for asset management capabilities.
* Apply Luma's AI-DLC process as the standard delivery methodology which is followed by all Luma Product Owners, using it to accelerate discovery, requirements drafting, and delivery.
* Translate complex asset management workflows into clear, detailed requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
* Manage multiple high-priority initiatives at once across Lifecycle Manager and Product Marketplace, ensuring each remains on track through structured planning and active communication.
* Demonstrate strong flexibility and real-time reprioritization as new information, constraints, or business needs emerge.

We're ~160 people, fully remote, building an AI marketing platform. Our main product is OTTO, which runs a site's SEO on its own - it reads live search data and pushes the technical and on-page fixes itself, nobody queues them up. Around that we've got ad automation for Google and Meta, GBP management for multi-location brands, content gen, and LLM visibility tracking (whether ChatGPT and co are citing you). Autotrader, Hyundai, P&G, Vendasta are some of our customers.
Work happens in pods, 1 PM and 2-4 engineers. You own your pod's roadmap and ship it with them, no veteran PM signing off on your specs first. That's the part most PM roles won't hand you.
Looking for 3+ years PM in B2B SaaS with an actual technical background - eng or QA before PM, or a PM who's been getting into the codebase themselves. You should be able to read Python and TS, write your own SQL, find your way around an API, and not need an engineer to tell you what a stack trace says. We're Django on the back, React/Next on the front. QA is yours end to end including release sign-off, people tend to underestimate that bit. And you're already using Claude Code or similar daily, not "open to it".
A few notes before you apply:
- Experience: we're looking for people with a few years of hands-on product or engineering work behind them. The role is autonomous from the first week, so we need you ready to take the wheel. - Recruiting agencies: we hire in-house and manage every application ourselves, so there's no need to send candidates or reach out about partnerships. Thank you for understanding! - If your stack matches, please do reach out. Django/DRF/Celery/Postgres with React/Next, Python automation work around SEO: if that's your day-to-day and you're using AI coding tools (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, whatever you like) in your real workflow, I want to hear from you. Don't talk yourself out of it because the title isn't an exact fit; tell me what you've built.
Recruitment process is screen with me, a take-home that runs about 75 mins, technical round with one of our senior PMs, then a call with our Director of Product (who you'd report to). I usually come back to people within 2 business days.
Our ATS forces us to list specific ywhere as long as you can do EST hours, so apply even if yours isn't
P.S: Not a PM, or the PM role isn't quite your thing? Have a look at everything else we have open at https://careers.searchatlas.com and apply directly to the role that suits you best (preferred route). If you're not sure which one that is, email me with a short line on what you do and I'll point you to the right one.

jobs.title: Product Manager (Revenue Cycle Managment)
jobs.desc:
**About Alpaca Health**
-----------------------

Alpaca Health enables clinicians to become entrepreneurs, starting in autism care.

We help clinicians launch and scale their own clinics by providing AI-powered software, payer contracting, and full back-office infrastructure. Our goal is simple: shift power in healthcare away from large consolidated entities and back to clinicians.

We are growing quickly (30% MoM) and expanding into new states this year. The problems we are solving are operationally complex, high-stakes, and deeply meaningful for families.

We've raised over $14M in funding from early-stage investors like Core Innovation Capital, Adverb Ventures, and South Park Commons, and are building for long-term category leadership.

**The Role**
------------

We're hiring a Product Manager to own the buildout of several critical internal functions. You’ll lead the planning, implementation and rollout of internal tools and automations used by the Alpaca team to better service clinicians.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* **Get to the bottom of hard problems.** You’re going to be thrown into complex and ambiguous problems, clearly define the problems to be solved, and identify the 80/20 drivers and pursue them relentlessly.
* **Rethink how the work gets done.** You’ll have a chance to look at workflows with fresh eyes and design novel, industry first, high leverage solutions that work at scale. You’ll have a high degree of autonomy to select the best automation, integrations, product changes, and AI solutions.
* **Design how work flows.** You’ll map complex processes across people, systems, and outside partners, and design better ones that will stand the test of scale (as we grow 10x YoY).
* **Build it yourself.** Prototype and ship tools, automations, and workflows using code, AI-native tools, and design. You won't need to wait on engineering to prove an idea works.
* **Own the outcome.** You’ll work closely with our Head of Operations & Strategy to define success, then own the metrics and outcomes.

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

* **[REQUIRED]** 4 - 8 years of Product Management experience, preferably having previously owned a function at a venture backed mid-stage startup (Series B - D)
* **[REQUIRED]** Hands-on technical ability: comfortable writing code (Python, SQL, JavaScript, or similar), building with AI tools, and working with APIs and data
* **[REQUIRED]** Experience designing or rebuilding end-to-end processes in a regulated or operationally complex environment, such as healthcare, fintech, or logistics
* A track record of world class problem solving. You’ve been able to solve problems that 99% of people were not able to with meaningful outcomes
* Exceptional written and verbal communication. Ability to clearly communicate complex ideas in a clear and concise way. Ability to tailor your message based on the audience you’re speaking to (i.e. clinicians, internal stakeholders, our investors).
* Ownership Mindset: Self starter that can identify the highest leveraged problems to solve, and someone who has a relentless drive to solve them.
* AI Native. You have a clear understanding of the current model strengths and weaknesses and know when best to solve a problem. You function at AI speed, completing high quality work in days that previously would have taken weeks or months.

**Why Join**
------------

* The opportunity to materially impact the health outcomes of the most vulnerable populations
* Join one of the fastest growing healthcare startups in the world (between 30% - 50% monthly growth)
* Join a team of rockstar performers who are taking a new tech first approach to building a scalable digital health platform
* Competitive salary
* Meaningful equity
* Health benefits
* Flexible PTO
* Dinner when working late

Compensation Range: $160K - $200K

Digital Pharmacy will serve as an incubator for new pharmacy capabilities—rapidly testing and launching MVPs, learning from customer behavior and business outcomes, and evolving successful solutions into reusable components, services, APIs, and platform capabilities that can support multiple clients, channels, and pharmacy experiences.
