**Summary:**  
The Product Owner will collaborate with business partners, IT partners, and delivery/engineering teams to build and execute a strategy in alignment with business priorities. Ownership of the product roadmap and a quality backlog will ensure teams deliver the highest-value outcomes with clear priorities and well-defined work. The Product Owner is responsible for maintaining strong relationships with a variety of partners to facilitate discussions, identify dependencies or areas of efficiency, and ensure successful execution of features.

In addition, the Product Owner will build and document requirements in the form of initiatives, epics, features and user stories, communicate daily with the delivery/engineering team, run team meetings and ceremonies, and accept or reject work results.

The Product Owner is an excellent communicator who excels when coordinating efforts, setting expectations, and driving results.

**Responsibilities:**

* Product Strategy & Planning
* Define and maintain the product vision, goals, and roadmap in alignment with high-value outcomes.
* Partner with stakeholders to define outcomes, success metrics, and sequencing.

**Backlog ownership**

* Own and refine the product backlog: initiatives/epics/features/stories, prioritization, and readiness, ensuring business direction leads to prioritized, well-shaped work.
* Work with IT teams to manage and prioritize technical debt, ensuring proper allocation of time between maintenance and feature work.
* Define and enforce standards (e.g., Definition of Ready, Definition of Done, clear acceptance criteria, intake process, backlog hygiene).

**Discovery & Stakeholder Alignment**

* Drive discovery to surface and clarify problems while presenting high-value solutions.
* Facilitate tradeoff decisions by presenting clear options (scope, sequencing, dependencies, risks).
* Manage and report on critical metrics.

**Delivery Partnership:**

* Partner with IT partners and delivery/engineering teams to plan and manage flow.
* Support a balance of Scrum practices (e.g., sprint goals/planning).

**Position Requirements (Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities):**

* Experience as a Product Owner (or equivalent) owning prioritization and backlog quality for enterprise platforms. Customer portal experience is preferred.
* Strong skills in backlog creation (epics/stories), acceptance criteria, and prioritization methods.
* Proven ability to run discovery and align stakeholders around outcomes and tradeoffs.
* Experience working with Kanban teams, scrum teams, agile ceremonies, etc. Experience with Jira is preferred.
* Strong facilitation and communication skills, including operating effectively with a variety of stakeholders and technical/data teams.
* Experience coordinating efforts across business units and technical teams.
* Knowledge of program, project and change management practices.

**ABOUT LINXUP, LLC**

If you are looking for “the right opportunity” with a fast-growing company, with great people, doing great work, look no further. Linxup offers products and solutions that help thousands of field service fleets solve real business problems. If you’re looking for an opportunity to help make a difference for small businesses, you’re in the right place. Linxup helps businesses get more out of the vehicles, equipment, tools, and workers in the field through its robust, easy to use tracking and dash cam solutions. Linxup delivers class-leading reliability, flexibility, and live, US-based onboarding, support, and coaching to ensure customers get the most out of their investment. That’s why more than 30,000 businesses trust Linxup to help them improve the safety, security, productivity, and efficiency of every vehicle, asset, tool, and worker in the field. Founded in 2004 and based in St. Louis, MO, Linxup serves customers in a wide range of industries, including field service, construction, trucking, transportation, and other enterprises that rely on mobile workers and equipment to get the job done.

**ABOUT THE POSITION**

This is the product role for someone who likes the layer where software meets hardware.

You’ll own the parts of Linxup that customers rarely see but depend on completely: our public API and the partner

integrations built on it, the pipeline that ingests telemetry from a quarter-million devices in the field, and the OTA

firmware and device management tooling we use to configure, update, and troubleshoot that hardware at scale.

You’ll also own initiatives in our core web and mobile products, so you stay close to the end customer and the day-to-

day experience — this is not a pure infrastructure role, and the mix is part of what makes it interesting.

Your engineering team is technical, and so are many of your customers: partner developers reading your API docs,

integration engineers at ERP and dispatch vendors, and internal teams who need visibility into a fleet of devices. Your

job is to understand what they actually need, decide what gets built and in what order, and write requirements

precise enough that engineers don’t have to guess.

You don’t need to write production code. You do need to be the kind of product owner who reads the API response,

runs the query, and looks at the device logs before forming an opinion.

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS – RESPONSIBILITIES:**

**APIs & Partner Integrations:**

* Own the roadmap for our public API and the partner ecosystem built on it — requirements definition, endpoint and payload design, authentication, rate limits, versioning, and deprecation
* Work directly with partner developers and integration engineers to scope, launch, and unblock integrations
* Treat developer experience as a product surface: clear documentation, predictable payloads, useful error messages, sandbox access, and sensible defaults

**Device Data & Telemetry:**

* Own product requirements for ingesting data from GPS trackers, dash cams, and asset and equipment trackers deployed in the field
* Partner with engineering on how device data is normalized, enriched, stored, and exposed — both to customers and to downstream features and reports
* Work through the real-world messiness of field hardware: intermittent cellular coverage, buffered and out-of- order messages, power and duty-cycle tradeoffs, and data that is missing or ambiguous
* Define the reporting, alerting, and rules behaviors that customers rely on that data to drive
* Help build the operational visibility the business needs into device state, connectivity, and firmware versions across an installed base of 250,000+ devices

* Own initiatives in our core web and mobile products alongside the platform work — the features customers touch every day

As a global company, we have offices in nine countries and can insert advertisements around the world.

**Job Summary**

Responsible for the product management activities of the Freewheel Streaming Hub Programmatic Module team. Primary focus on building programmatic OpenRTB Spec and API integration with demand partners within FreeWheel's SSP platform Programmatic Module. This role will own a product area within the Programmatic Module product but will also partners with other FreeWheel product managers to design and implement key features underpinning the Freewheel programmatic strategy across areas. Supports the Programmatic Module team in reaching the team objectives and keeps leadership team informed of key developments and issues in their areas of responsibilities. Partners with other product team members across Freewheel to successfully deliver on dependencies. Responsible for the relationship with engineering peers within the Programmatic Module team.

**Job Description**

**What You'll Do**

* Support the conception, design, and implementation of capabilities that offer our customers unique opportunities to sell CTV advertising, with a particular emphasis on OpenRTB integration and API integration with demand partners. * Collaborate closely with our engineering team to guide products to launch and beyond
* Work with stakeholders, internal and external, to help drive high-quality decisions and outcomes
* Help showcase product launches in release trainings, client emails, and company webinars

**Who You Are**

* 2+ years of product management experience, ideally on the sell-side of advertising products
* Familiarity with, and interest in, building and scaling a SSP
* Some exposure to Connected TV and television advertising
* Strong ability to understand customer needs and translate them into product requirements
* Experience working directly with engineering stakeholders
* Growing track record of taking product initiatives through the full lifecycle
* Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written, with the ability to adjust communications style based on your audience

**Responsibilities:**

* Analyzing product management activities, defining product concepts, and justifying product-related expenditures
* Assisting other product managers in solving semi-complex problems and guiding them through larger project initiatives
* Managing profit and loss or budgetary aspects for assigned products, ensuring alignment with company goals
* Evaluating market trends, consumer needs, and technological advancements to inform product strategy
* Developing detailed product features, requirements, and implementation plans, prioritizing based on market needs
* Envisioning new product features through participation in cross-functional teams, fostering innovation and collaboration
* Coordinating with external vendors and strategic partners to ensure timely, on-budget delivery of product initiatives

* Ensuring seamless coordination among cross-functional teams to achieve product launch and lifecycle objectives
* Consistent exercise of independent judgment and discretion in matters of significance.
* Regular, consistent and punctual attendance. Must be able to work nights and weekends, variable schedule(s) as necessary.
* Other duties and responsibilities as assigned.

Product Manager  
  
Digitalzone is a B2B marketing company building the demand orchestration systems that connect buying signals to revenue. Our products turn scattered signals into pipeline our customers can act on. As we continue to grow, we are looking for a Product Manager to join the product team and help shape where these products go next.  
  
**POSITION OVERVIEW**  
As a Product Manager, you own the strategy and delivery of our demand orchestration products. Your deep understanding of B2B marketing and lead generation, combined with strong product management craft, will be central to aligning product strategy with business objectives. You will work closely with engineering, data science, design, and marketing; make decisions grounded in data; and keep a clear line of sight from customer problems to revenue outcomes.  
We also expect a modern toolkit. Product managers here use AI tools in their daily work to move faster: to synthesize research, to build a rough prototype that makes an idea concrete, and to tighten the loop between an idea and real user feedback. Those tools support the fundamentals, they do not replace them. *Judgment is still the job.*  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* **Product strategy:** Own the roadmap for demand orchestration and align it with company objectives, connecting product decisions to outcomes such as SQLs, high intent leads, and marketing sourced and influenced revenue.
* **Customer and market understanding:** Conduct market research, track competitors and industry trends, and maintain a deep working knowledge of lead generation and B2B marketing processes.
* **Discovery and user research:** Talk to customers regularly, run interviews and usability sessions, and turn what you learn into prioritized product decisions.
* **Requirements and definition:** Write clear PRDs, user stories, and acceptance criteria. Where a prototype communicates the intent better than a document, build one.
* **Prioritization:** Make explicit trade-offs about scope, sequence, and what will not get built, and explain the reasoning to stakeholders.
* **Cross-functional collaboration:** Partner with engineering, data science, design, sales, and marketing to take products from concept through launch and adoption.
* **Agile delivery:** Run disciplined iterative development: short cycles, working software each sprint, and steady progress against the roadmap.
* **Data-driven decision making:** Define success metrics before launch, instrument what you ship, and read the results honestly afterward.
* **Go-to-market partnership:** Support launches with positioning input, enablement material, and a clear view of the customer value being delivered.
* **Communication:** Articulate product vision and requirements to audiences ranging from engineers to executives to customers.
* **Problem solving:** Break down ambiguous problems, including the newer ones that come with building AI powered features.

**Ways of Working We Value**  
The fundamentals above are the core of the role. These practices are how we expect a PM to apply them today.

* **Prototyping:** Comfort turning an idea into something tangible within days, whether that is a wireframe, a clickable Figma flow, or a rough working prototype. A prototype in front of a user answers questions a specification cannot.

Dorsia is at the forefront of hospitality-tech innovation, redefining how the world gains access to the most in-demand restaurants, events, and experiences. * Turn wireframes and agent behaviors into testable builds in days, then refine them through live traces and usability testing.

* Help build a reusable agentic payments platform with shared tools, policies, evals, and observability.

Clinical Ink is the global life science company that brings data, technology, and patient science together to unlock clinical discovery. With offices in the United States and Denmark, Clinical Ink is rewriting the clinical development experience.  
  
**Job Description**  
Clinical Ink is seeking a ***Product Owner*** to join our Product Management team based remotely across the United States! The Product Owner manages the roadmap and backlog for an assigned product stream, translating business and stakeholder needs into prioritized requirements and actionable user stories. This role drives delivery by setting sprint and release goals, coordinating dependencies, removing roadblocks, and tracking performance against key objectives. The Product Owner partners with development teams and internal and external stakeholders to communicate progress, incorporate feedback, and support successful releases through documentation and training. This role's responsibilities include:

* Create and manage product roadmap for given product stream
* Drive execution against roadmap by setting sprint and release goals, tracking KPIs, and removing team roadblocks
* Manage all aspects of the backlog from use case drafting, requirement/user story creation and prioritization, to grooming, and acceptance
* Effectively manage cross team dependencies with fellow product team members
* Schedule and conduct agile meetings (daily scrums, grooming, and planning) with Solutions Development team members to ensure successful execution against requirements and feature deliverables
* Regularly communicate with internal and external stakeholders to ensure transparency about deliverables and gain feedback as input to feature definition and development
* Contribute to release notes, product documentation, and training of cross functional team members for release readiness
* Advocate for Agile software development practices amongst your team.
* Regularly present to and communicate with senior leadership about team progress

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree required
* 3+ years’ experience as a Business Analyst or Product Owner, with a strong emphasis on specification/ requirement writing
* Proficiency writing user stories and functional specifications for software applications
* Understanding of basic software design concepts and user interface controls
* Basic understanding of the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) and Agile methodology
* Previous experience using Confluence, JIRA, and/or similar tools required
* Strong interpersonal communication skills; ability to write in a clear and concise style
* Proficiency with basic computer skills, including spreadsheets and word processing
* Proactive attitude, analytical reasoning, and problem-solving skills; strong time management and organizational skills required

**Additional Information**

The mission of the Augustine Institute is to serve the formation of Catholics for the New Evangelization. Through our graduate school, media, and parish programs, we equip Catholics intellectually, spiritually, and pastorally to renew the Church and transform the world for Christ.

* Monitor project progress, identify risks, and take proactive measures to address challenges.
* Optimize the user experience by analyzing feedback, usability data, and industry best practices.
* Clearly communicate product developments, updates, and changes to internal and external stakeholders.
* Monitor product performance and implement optimizations to enhance user engagement.
* Serve as the primary point of contact for product-related inquiries and initiatives.
* Develop training and documentation to support product maintenance.
* Stay informed about industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices.
* Other responsibilities as directed by the Vice President, Product and Marketing.

Boelter participates in every aspect of the restaurant supply, hospitality, and beverage industries. Digital Product Manager
  
Boelter | Pewaukee, WI
  
  
Belong to the Boelter community that brings people together...
  
We value the individual where your unique perspective builds a stronger community and fuels our passion for authentic relationships.
  
  
For 95+ years, Boelter has helped customers create unforgettable experiences across the restaurant supply, hospitality, and beverage industries — from commercial kitchen design to tabletop styling. We're looking for a Digital Product Manager to join our Digital Product Team and drive commerce, growth, and revenue outcomes across our digital ecosystem.
  
About the Role
  
This role owns the digital experiences that grow online revenue, improve conversion, and deepen customer lifetime value across Boelter's B2B and B2C channels — from the
  
moment a customer discovers Boelter online through final purchase.
  
What You'll Do
  

* Own the product roadmap for commerce and growth, tying features directly to revenue, AOV, and acquisition targets
* Manage a scrum team within a SAFe environment, owning backlog prioritization, sprint planning, and PI Planning
* Serve as the key liaison between business stakeholders and product/engineering teams
* Manage the end-to-end funnel — discovery, consideration, and purchase — optimizing each stage to reduce friction and drive conversion

* Lead a continuous experimentation roadmap using analytics, heatmaps, and user research

* Online revenue growth, funnel conversion by stage, search conversion rate, recommendation-attributed revenue, AOV, customer acquisition/retention, CLV, and experiment win rate

jobs.title: Product Manager, File and Remit
jobs.desc:
Anrok is the leading tax automation platform enabling businesses to expand globally without compliance complexity.

As the digital economy has grown 6x over the last decade, software businesses have gone from not worrying about sales tax to needing to monitor exposure, calculate rates, and file returns across 50 US jurisdictions and 100+ countries. This creates a critical bottleneck for companies that should be able to transact with customers everywhere.

Anrok eliminates this complexity by connecting with billing and payment systems to automate tax monitoring, calculations, and filing end-to-end. Our unified platform handles the ever-changing maze of tax laws at municipal, state, and federal levels—so companies can focus on growth, not compliance.

Our customers include:

* 40% of Forbes Top 50 AI companies
* 20% of Forbes Top 100 Cloud companies
* Top companies like Notion, Anthropic, and Cursor

We're making compliant digital commerce a reality for companies big and small, backed by over $100M from leading investors including Sequoia, Spark, Index, and Khosla Ventures.

Every month, Anrok files more tax returns than ever before, and the next month beats it. Behind each return is a company counting on us to file it correctly, on time, and get the money to the right government. Nobody else is set up to do this at our scale.

As the **File & Remit Product Manager**, you'll own the last mile of tax compliance: from preparing a return until the money reaches the tax authority. Everything else Anrok does builds up to this. You'll be solving two problems that shape the company:

**File every return in the world.** Our filing volume keeps setting records. The systems that got us here won't carry us through the next 10x. You'll define the filing platform that can file every return for every company in every jurisdiction. It should run itself, with automation that monitors and repairs its own problems and humans involved only for edge cases.

**Open Anrok to the world.** Today, a company based outside the US has to open a US bank account before it can remit through Anrok. For great international companies, that's often the last thing standing between them and Anrok. You'll build the remittance infrastructure that lets them pay from their local bank account in top international markets.

Our vision: tax filing is handled like magic, and sellers never have to think about it.

**In this role you will**
-------------------------

* Build a filing platform that scales to every return in the world, with most filings fully automated and zero human touches
* Put AI at the center of filing, with agents that write filing automations, catch problems before a filing period opens, and repair them automatically
* Unlock international sellers by making remittance work from their local bank accounts, in local currency
* Own money movement end to end, from collecting seller funds to landing payments at thousands of tax authorities across currencies, banking partners, and jurisdictions
* Build tools for our in-house TaxOps team, your power users, so they can do more jurisdictions with less effort
* Make the returns experience that sellers trust completely: every filing on time and accurate
* Drive the metrics that matter: cost per filing, 100% on-time filings, and fewer amendments
* Identify the next frontier, including whether Anrok's filing engine becomes a standalone platform of its own

**What excites us**
-------------------

* 4+ years of product management experience, with 2+ years building B2B products
* Experience in payments, fintech, money movement, or high-volume operational systems
* Systems thinking: you design for 100x, not just for next month
* Comfort going deep technically alongside engineers building automation infrastructure
* High standards in places where a mistake costs a customer money
* A GM mindset with strong product and business instincts
* Clear, concise communication, verbal and written
* Strong cross-functional work with

**Job Title:** Technical Product Manager

**Location:** Remote

**Company:** BrandRank.AI

**Duration:** Full Time

**Reports to:** Chief Product/Operations Officer

**About BrandRank.AI**

BrandRank.AI is an AI brand intelligence platform. We measure how AI answer engines such as Gemini, Google AI Overviews, Claude, Perplexity, Grok and Meta AI describe, rank and recommend brands, and we show brands where they are visible, where they are vulnerable, and what to fix first. Our customers include some of the largest consumer brands in the world. We are a small but growing team engaged in exciting work on a new frontier of brand building.

**The Role**

You will report to the Chief Product/Operations Officer and sit alongside the engineering team. You will translate the voice of the customer into product requirements and turn those requirements into working application solutions. You will own the connective tissue between what we build and what the rest of the company says about it, communicating product capabilities to the Sales team, the Marketing team and the customer in plain language. This is a hands-on role at an early-stage company. You will write the spec and help the engineers work through trade-offs to reach product-market fit.

**What You Will Do**

* **Partner with engineering.** Act as the day-to-day product counterpart to our engineering leads. Define requirements, scope features, write Linear specs, and keep the backlog honest.
* **Own product communications.** Write release notes, platform change documentation, and internal product updates. Set the cadence and keep it.
* **Run the roadmap.** Maintain the product roadmap with engineering. Translate technical initiatives such as data-pipeline changes, answer-engine coverage expansion and scoring-method updates into roadmap items with clear customer value.
* **Translate for the business.** Explain metric definitions, scoring logic and platform behavior to Sales, Customer Success and Marketing in plain language. Make sure what we tell customers matches what the product does.
* **Close the feedback loop.** Collect product feedback from the team and customers, track what is and is not on the roadmap, and report back on where each item stands.

**What We Are Looking For**

* 3+ years of product management experience on technical products: APIs, data platforms, AI/ML products or core infrastructure.
* **A technical foundation.** A degree in computer science or engineering, or equivalent hands-on experience. You can read a schema, follow a pipeline diagram and ask engineers good questions.
* **Fluency with LLMs.** Hands-on experience with LLM-based products, including how they are prompted, evaluated and integrated into applications.
* **Strong technical writing.** You have a track record of release notes, documentation and internal updates that people actually read.
* **Fluency in agile delivery and modern engineering workflows.** Linear or Jira, sprints, and working directly with engineers every day.
* **Comfort with ambiguity and small-team pace.** You would rather own the outcome than wait for a process.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience with search, or ranking and scoring systems.
* Experience working with large consumer brands or enterprise customers.
* Exposure to AI answer engines and how they source, cite and rank content.

**Why Join Us?**

* **Innovative Environment:** Be part of a cutting-edge startup that is revolutionizing brand strategy through AI-driven insights.
* **High-Impact Ownership:** Work directly with engineering and company leadership, with meaningful responsibility for how the product is defined, prioritized and communicated.
* **Small-Team Pace:** Join an early-stage environment where decisions move quickly, ownership is visible and everyone contributes to shipping.
* **Customer Proximity:** Work on product decisions that directly affect leading consumer brands and enterprise customers.

Pay: $100,000.00 - $125,000.00 per year

jobs.desc:
Join ABC Fitness and become part of a culture that’s as ambitious as it is authentic. Let’s transform the future of fitness—together!

Our Values

**Best Life**

We believe great work begins with great people. That’s why our culture is built on respect, trust, and belonging. We create an inclusive environment where every team member can bring their authentic self to work—because diverse perspectives drive innovation and meaningful impact.

**Growth Mindset**

We are doers, thinkers, and dreamers. At ABC Fitness, your growth is our investment. Through continuous learning, mentorship, and professional development opportunities, we empower you to reach new heights—personally and professionally.

**One Team**

From day one, you’ll be part of a team that collaborates, celebrates, and cares. We move fast, support one another, and have fun along the way. Because when you thrive, we all thrive.

**Product Manager, Billing & Collections**

**ABC Fitness · Product · Remote-first**

**Billing and collections sit at the center of gym operators' revenue, retention, and customer trust.** This role owns the product strategy and roadmap for billing, subscriptions, payments, and collections across ABC Fitness, turning complex payment workflows into reliable, intelligent experiences for operators and their members.

**What you'll do:**

* Own the long-term vision, strategy, and multi-quarter roadmap for Billing & Collections; make clear trade-offs across customer value, revenue, risk, and engineering complexity.
* Build deep customer and market understanding, using operator feedback, competitive insight, and product data to identify the highest-impact problems and opportunities.
* Partner closely with Engineering, Design, Data Science, Finance, Legal, Compliance, Customer Success, and GTM to shape and launch reliable billing experiences.
* Drive improvements across subscriptions, recurring payments, invoicing, dunning, notifications, payment recovery, and automation - including AI where it can materially improve outcomes.
* Define the product metrics that matter, use experimentation and analytics to guide decisions, and measure impact on payment success, involuntary churn, recovery, adoption, and cost efficiency.

**Who you are:**

* 10+ years of product management experience, with a track record of owning complex products from strategy through launch.
* Experience in payments, billing, fintech, SaaS subscriptions, commerce, or a closely related domain.
* Strong customer empathy, business judgment, and analytical skills; you turn ambiguous problems into clear product bets and measurable outcomes.
* An effective cross-functional leader who can align technical and non-technical stakeholders, navigate competing priorities, and maintain momentum through complexity.
* An excellent communicator who writes clearly, frames trade-offs precisely, and can influence executives, engineers, and customer-facing teams.
* **Especially valuable:** Hands-on experience with subscription billing, dunning or payment recovery, payment routing, risk/fraud, API-based platforms, or data/AI-powered product capabilities.

**How we measure success:**

* Billing-related involuntary churn decreases and payment recovery improves.
* Customers see more reliable, intuitive billing and collections experiences, reflected in product adoption and customer feedback.
* Roadmap investments produce measurable revenue, efficiency, or risk-reduction outcomes.
* Products launch with clear success metrics and strong cross-functional execution.

**Why ABC Fitness:**

ABC Fitness is a global fitness management platform serving members in 100+ countries. Our Commerce platform supports significant payment volume for fitness businesses, giving this role meaningful scale and direct impact on operator revenue and member experiences.

*ABC Fitness is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to building an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work.*

**Who We Are**

Peaksware is the investment company that owns and operates industry-leading brands MakeMusic, Alfred Music, and formerly TrainingPeaks and TrainHeroic. Our software platforms maximize the potential of expert instructors to reach and impact the lives of the world’s committed performers. We operate at the intersection of technology, finance, and human performance, and we acquire businesses to own and operate them for the long term, not to flip them.

Position Summary

We are hiring a Product Manager to accelerate product development across Peaksware, starting inside Music Brands and expanding to the businesses we acquire next.

For the first twelve months, you will own high-priority special projects inside Music Brands, working monthly on-site with our product and engineering team in Boulder to move important work faster than it would otherwise go. Over the following twelve to eighteen months, the role evolves: you become the product manager we place into newly acquired businesses, arriving early, diagnosing what the product needs, and setting the agenda. This role demands two distinct muscles: the patience to dive deep into technical and domain edge-cases, and the versatility to context-switch across multiple projects and products without missing a beat. You will range across a multi-brand ecosystem rather than staying in a single lane, and you are genuinely energized by dropping into an unfamiliar business, diagnosing what it needs, and driving immediate impact.

Key Responsibilities  
Accelerate Music Brands and Financial Analysis (First 12 Months)

* Own High-Impact Platform Initiatives across our Music Platforms: Drive high-priority product initiatives inside Music Brands from definition through launch, in partnership with the Boulder product and engineering team.

* Accelerate Financial Analysis through AI-enabled automation and productization.

Product Leadership in Acquired Businesses (12–18 Months Out)

* Identify High-ROI AI Opportunities: Evaluate where AI creates real economic value across our businesses, then drive those opportunities through to shipped, measured outcomes. Build and defend a clear view of where AI changes unit economics and where it is merely noise.
* Step into New Businesses and Diagnose Quickly: Serve as the product manager we place into newly acquired companies. Form a view on what should be centralised and what stays brand-specific.

jobs.title: Technical Product Manager
jobs.desc:
We are looking for a **Technical Product Manager, Integrations** to join the product team and take ownership of complex integrations connecting the creator ecosystem, customer experience, and external platforms.  
This is a highly technical product role focused on **APIs, SDKs, authentication, data flows, and third-party integrations**.
  
You will act as the product owner for the bi-directional flow of third-party data and authentication, working closely with engineering teams, enterprise customers, partners, and internal stakeholders.  
  
**Location:** San Francisco, Chicago, Los Angeles, New York, Seattle, Texas (Remote)

**What you’ll be responsible for:**
-----------------------------------

* Define and drive the **integration strategy**, standards, and technical capabilities across the platform.
* Own the product lifecycle of **Integrations and SDK products** — from strategy and discovery through roadmap, development, launch, and continuous improvement.
* Oversee the integrations development process, ensuring that implementation meets customer needs, technical standards, and business objectives.
* Drive both **inbound data ingestion and outbound data publishing/syndication** across third-party platforms.
* Analyze customer requirements and translate them into scalable integration architectures in collaboration with technical leads.
* Define clear product requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and prioritized backlogs for engineering teams.
* Lead technical discussions with **enterprise customers, ecosystem partners, developers, and integration marketplaces**.
* Translate complex technical concepts — such as payload structures, authentication mechanisms, data models, and latency — into clear product decisions and requirements.
* Partner with Sales, Customer Success, Marketing, and Enablement teams to understand customer needs and incorporate the **Voice of the Customer** into product strategy.
* Develop and support the go-to-market strategy for attracting **third-party integration users, developers, and technology partners** to the ecosystem.
* Identify opportunities for product improvements and new integration capabilities based on customer feedback, market trends, analytics, and industry best practices.
* Apply a strong **security and DevSecOps mindset** when defining integration solutions and technical requirements.

**What we’re looking for:**
---------------------------

* **5+ years of overall software industry experience**, including at least **3+ years working with product APIs**.
* Strong experience as a **Technical Product Manager, API Product Manager, Integration Product Manager, or similar technical product role**.
* Hands-on understanding of designing and managing workflows involving:

  + **REST APIs**
  + **GraphQL**
  + **Webhooks / real-time integrations**
* Strong understanding of **bi-directional data flows and data structures**, including JSON and XML.
* Practical knowledge of modern authentication and authorization mechanisms such as:

  + **OAuth 2.0**
  + **JWT**
  + **API Keys**
* Experience designing solutions with or for **Integration Platform as a Service (iPaaS)** products such as Workato, MuleSoft, Zapier, or similar platforms.
* Experience working directly with customers to design and implement technical solutions based on their business requirements.

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.desc:
**Who we are**
--------------

**We are Payactiv, a Fintech company in the heart of Silicon Valley, devoted to giving workers access to their earned wages when they need them. Payactiv is the pioneer and industry leader in Earned Wage Access. We are the only Certified B Corporation and Public Benefit Corporation in our industry. Our app provides millions with financial services that help them avoid debt, manage their finances, and regain flexibility to pay for things on their own schedule.**
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**The Mission**
---------------

American workers are not OK. A few not-so-fun facts:

* More than half of the workers in the US live paycheck-to-paycheck
* 40% of Americans would not be able to come up with $400 in an emergency
* There are more payday loan stores in the US—some charging interest rates upwards of 600%—than there are McDonalds restaurants

But there's hope. For workers on a tight budget, timing is everything. Getting paid promptly for hours worked instead of waiting for twice-monthly paychecks to arrive can mean the difference between building up an emergency fund or spiraling deeper into debt.

That's where Payactiv comes in. Payactiv is a Certified B Corp that pioneered Earned Wage Access (EWA) in 2012. EWA allows workers to access the money they've earned in-between pay cycles (when their bills are actually due), helping them avoid late fees, overdraft fees, and the need for costly payday loans.

**What we are looking for**
---------------------------

Payactiv is looking for a Product Manager who wants to build fintech products that make a real difference in people’s lives. You’ll work from our Milpitas, CA office, tackling complex problems at the intersection of technology, financial services, and the everyday needs of workers and employers.

You’ll probably enjoy this role if you are a strategic product leader, a strong customer advocate, and someone who knows how to bring people together to get things done.

**What you will do**
--------------------

* Represent the voice of the customer through user research, product data, and direct feedback
* Lead products from early ideas through launch, adoption, and continuous improvement
* Bring design, engineering, compliance, and go-to-market teams together to deliver seamless and impactful solutions
* Translate user needs into product requirements and keep teams aligned around what matters
* Partner with Legal, Compliance, and Information Security to find the right balance between regulatory requirements and user experience
* Explore emerging fintech trends, AI/ML-driven personalization, and other technologies that can make our products better
* Define success, track the right KPIs, and use what you learn to improve performance, engagement, and adoption

**What you need**
-----------------

* 2+ years of product management experience in fintech, payments, lending, or financial services
* Care deeply about building user-centered financial wellness products
* Use data to make better decisions—but know when judgment and customer insight matter too
* Know how to keep Agile, cross-functional product teams moving forward
* Look for the win-win by balancing user goals and business goals
* Communicate clearly, manage stakeholders well, and influence at every level
* Are comfortable going deep with engineering teams on APIs, integrations, data flows, and mobile products
* Understand fintech products, compliance, and the U.S. regulatory landscape
* Are curious about emerging fintech technologies, including stablecoin and AI

**ABOUT ORGANOX:**

OrganOx is a commercial stage organ technology company dedicated to developing technologies to improve outcomes for patients with acute or chronic organ failure. The company was established as a spin out of the University of Oxford in 2008 and is now part of the Terumo Group. OrganOx is a pioneer in normothermic machine perfusion (NMP). It's flagship platform, the metra®, is available for use in the U.S., Europe, Canada, and Australia. jobs.desc:
**About us**

Shorthand exists to empower creative teams to produce and publish beautiful, transformative content radically faster. We’ve begun our journey by creating an easy-to-use platform for one of the most creatively and technically demanding use cases on the web — immersive feature stories — and we’re proud to count many of the world’s best known and most discerning publishers, brands, not-for-profits, and universities as loyal customers.

Shorthand is a growing, investor-backed company with customers on every continent (except Antarctica!), and there’s never been a more exciting time to join our band of geeks with art and heart.

We’re looking for a **Product Marketing Lead** to join our team on the US West Coast on a fully remote basis. The role comes with a high level of responsibility and autonomy and is a fantastic opportunity to join an ambitious but down-to-earth team making an outsized positive impact in the digital publishing space.

**What you’ll be doing**

You’ll own Shorthand’s story: who it’s for and how we talk about it. You’ll shape our positioning with the CEO and VP of Growth & Marketing, give Sales the narratives and proof to close deals, lead our launches, and write copy that has a point of view. We’re looking for someone who believes a product should stand out, and who’s experienced in crafting a distinctive narrative that cuts through.

You’ll be our sole product marketer, joining a small, fast-paced Growth & Marketing team that already covers content, demand gen, community, and design. This is a senior but hands-on role, with real influence over how Shorthand is seen, sold, and built.

Anyone can sign up and start building stories in Shorthand. Most of our business comes to us inbound, and our sales team works each deal from first conversation to signed contract. Your job is to make sure every step tells the same clear, compelling story.

You’ll know it’s working when Sales reaches for your materials first and we see stronger conversion and shorter sales cycles. Bonus points when people can tell a piece of Shorthand marketing is ours before they see the logo.

You’ll report to the VP of Growth & Marketing and partner with the CEO, Head of Sales, and Product team. Much of the team you’ll work with is in Australia and New Zealand, and our Head of Sales is in California. We collaborate async-first, and live calls with the ANZ team usually fall in your afternoon (Australia’s morning).

**In this role, you will:**

* Shape Shorthand’s positioning, segmentation, and core value propositions with the CEO and our Marketing, Sales, and Product leaders, giving Shorthand a distinctive voice and point of view
* Develop a deep understanding of our buyers, users, market, and competitors, and turn it into tools the whole company uses
* Build messaging frameworks, use cases, and proof points that support a sales-led motion, from first touch through to expansion
* Work with customers to learn how they measure the value of Shorthand, and turn that evidence into reusable proof
* Make Sales more confident and effective, with sharper deal narratives, objection handling, competitive positioning, and supporting decks and one-pagers
* Make sure people who sign up to try Shorthand understand its value quickly, and help turn that early interest into sales conversations
* Lead product and feature launches end-to-end — strategy and KPIs, the narrative, and coordinating execution across the company
* Bring customer, market, and competitive perspective to decisions on pricing and packaging
* Keep our voice and messaging consistent across the website, product pages, sales materials, lifecycle emails, and in-product touchpoints
* Work with Product and Design on how features are framed, named, and introduced to customers
* Feed market insight and customer feedback back into product strategy and roadmap discussions
* Use Shorthand to tell Shorthand’s story — your own launches and enablement should show what the product can do

**WHO ARE WE?**

RealTime eClinical Solutions is a Global Leader and rapidly growing SaaS technology company that provides comprehensive Software Solutions to the clinical research industry.

Our Vision is to reshape the global clinical research industry with innovative solutions that help advance medicine and save lives. Our cloud-based solutions are dedicated to solving complex problems and simplifying clinical research processes to be more organized, efficient, and cost-effective. We are based in San Antonio, TX, but we're truly a remote, telecommuting company.

**WHAT ARE WE LOOKING FOR?**

The Product Owner is responsible for translating prioritized product initiatives and epics into well-defined functional and technical requirements that enable efficient and predictable delivery by engineering teams. Working closely with Product Managers, Engineering, Design, and Quality, the Product Owner ensures that product initiatives are decomposed into clear user stories, acceptance criteria, and supporting documentation that allow development teams to execute effectively.

This role serves as the operational bridge between product strategy and engineering execution. The Product Owner owns backlog quality and delivery readiness for their assigned product domain or engineering team, ensuring that stories entering development are well understood, actionable, and aligned with product objectives. The Product Owner plays a key role in maintaining backlog health, supporting agile delivery practices, and enabling consistent, high-quality product releases.

**WHAT WILL YOU BE DOING?**

* Translate prioritized product initiatives and epics into detailed functional and technical requirements, including user stories and acceptance criteria
* Maintain and manage the product backlog for assigned product areas or engineering teams, ensuring items are clearly defined, prioritized, and ready for development
* Partner closely with Product Managers to ensure product strategy and roadmap initiatives are accurately reflected in backlog priorities and delivery plans
* Work collaboratively with Engineering, Design, and Quality teams to clarify requirements, answer questions, and support effective implementation of product functionality
* Lead or facilitate backlog refinement sessions to ensure stories meet established Definition of Ready standards before sprint planning
* Ensure functional and technical documentation remains accurate, current, and aligned with delivered product functionality
* Participate in sprint planning, reviews, and retrospectives to support effective agile delivery practices
* Collaborate with QA and engineering teams to ensure acceptance criteria are clearly defined, and solutions meet expected functionality and quality standards
* Identify and communicate risks, dependencies, or ambiguities that could impact delivery timelines or solution quality
* Support continuous improvement of delivery processes, documentation practices, and backlog management standards within the Product Delivery organization
* 25% of your time may include travel for client visits, conferences, and networking

**WHAT DO YOU NEED?**

* 2–5 years of experience in a product, business analysis, delivery, or technical role within a SaaS or technology environment
* Experience working with agile development teams and familiarity with Scrum or similar iterative delivery frameworks
* Demonstrated ability to translate business or product requirements into clear functional specifications or user stories
* Strong organizational and analytical skills with attention to detail in documentation and requirements definition
* Experience working with tools such as JIRA or similar backlog management platforms
* Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams, including Product Management, Engineering, and Design
* Strong written and verbal communication skills

jobs.desc:
Trek Travel provides global cycling, hiking, and walking vacations of a lifetime with the goal of helping more people actively explore and experience the world. This is Trek Travel's first dedicated product management seat, owning the website and every other digital product across the business — the guest portal, booking and reservation flows, email infrastructure, campaign landing pages, CRM and data analytics, dashboards, and internal tooling.

This is a hands-on role that combines building the product operating model with running it day to day, across a delivery team of internal staff, fractional specialists, and agency partners. You'll bring product instincts, customer understanding, and marketing fluency to everything you spec, coordinate, and ship, with real autonomy to shape how product gets built. This is your opportunity to join the Trek Travel team and leave your mark on our company, on the active travel industry, and on the world at large.

**POSITION RESPONSIBILITIES INCLUDE, BUT NOT LIMITED TO:**

Product Strategy & Roadmap

* Own the roadmap for the website, guest portal, and all other digital products
* Run quarterly product strategy reviews and monthly roadmap reviews with leadership
* Stand up the product development lifecycle end to end: idea intake, sizing and prioritization, PRDs, spec documents, and release readiness

Delivery & Team Management

* Run the delivery cadence across teams: sprint planning, grooming, stand-ups, retros, and dependency tracking
* Plan team availability and capacity, aligning people's hours against company priorities and the annual marketing and business initiatives calendars
* Manage a mixed delivery team of internal staff, fractional specialists, and agency partners

Marketing & Campaign Support

* Support and coordinate digital ads, organic and paid social, digital campaigns, and email — bringing strategy, creative, copy, build, and deployment together through to launch  
  Support SEO/GEO and business development with the digital and technical work they depend on: landing pages, tracking, campaign infrastructure, and site health

Technical Execution

* Write PRDs and translate approved designs into build-ready specs that engineering partners can execute without back-and-forth
* Anticipate downstream effects of changes across backend, frontend, and data, and prevent scope creep before it lands in a sprint

CRM & Analytics

* Own CRM and marketing data analytics: HubSpot, campaign tracking, dashboards, GA4, segmentation, and lifecycle data
* Monitor product and business health daily: conversion, funnel drop-offs, feature usage, and campaign performance
* Report on metrics leadership can act on

Cross-Functional Coordination

* Coordinate across sales, marketing, guest services, guest experience, forecasting, field, logistics, and the trip product and design teams to turn feedback into prioritized product work
* Use AI to improve workflows, both for personal productivity and across the functions you coordinate — including drafting PRDs, scoring and sizing intake, and running AI-accelerated, spec-driven development with engineering

The top priority in this role is the end-to-end customer funnel: ads that run efficiently and carry awareness, retargeting, and re-engagement for new and repeat guests; an email program with meaningful segmentation that improves over time; and a website that converts on both. CRM and analytics support all three, and building a product process the team can run inside is central to the job.

* 5+ years in product management, including experience as a technical product manager or product owner working directly with engineers

**Are you looking to Optimize your life? Start your exciting path to a rewarding career today!**

We are Optimum, a leader in the fast-paced world of connectivity, and we're seeking driven and enthusiastic professionals to join our team, empower lives, fuel businesses, and drive innovation. Connectivity is no longer a luxury, but a necessity. A career at Optimum means you'll be enabling progress and enhancing lives by providing reliable, high-speed connectivity solutions that keep the world connected. Our successes, now and in the future, are powered by our amazing product, a commitment to our people and culture, and the connections we make in our communities.

---------------

Optimum delivers a full suite of connectivity products — Internet, TV, Phone, and Mobile — seamlessly connecting residential and business customers at home, at work, and on the go. Overview:

**Overview:**

**Our Culture and Impact**

Cvent is a leading meetings, events, and hospitality technology provider with more than 6,000+ employees and 34,000+ customers worldwide, including 60% of the Fortune 500. Founded in 1999, Cvent delivers a comprehensive event marketing and management platform for marketers and event professionals and offers software solutions to hotels, special event venues and destinations to help them grow their group/MICE and corporate travel business. Our technology brings millions of people together at events around the world. In short, we’re transforming the meetings and events industry through innovative technology that powers the human connection.

Cvent's strength lies in its people, fostering a culture where everyone is encouraged to think like entrepreneurs, taking risks and making decisions confidently. We value diverse perspectives and celebrate differences, working together with colleagues and clients to build strong connections.

**AI at Cvent: Leading the Future**

Are you ready to shape the future of work at the intersection of human expertise and AI innovation? At Cvent, we’re committed to continuous learning and adaptation—AI isn’t just a tool for us, it’s part of our DNA. We’re looking for candidates who are eager to evolve alongside technology. If you love to experiment boldly, share your discoveries, and help define best practices for AI-augmented work, you’ll thrive here. Our team values professionals who thoughtfully integrate AI into their daily work, delivering exceptional results while relying on the human judgment and creativity that drive real innovation.

Throughout our interview process, you’ll have the chance to demonstrate how you use AI to learn, iterate, and amplify your impact. If you’re excited to be part of a team that’s leading the way in AI-powered collaboration, we’d love to meet you.

We are seeking a **Product Manager** to lead planner enablement strategy and execution for Cvent’s Attendee Hub, reporting to the Director of Product Management. You will own the roadmap and outcomes for a suite of AI-powered experiences, anchored in the Cvent Assistant, that help event planners accomplish their jobs faster and with greater confidence. You will run a dedicated sprint team and partner closely with engineering, design, and data science to define what gets built, why it matters, and whether it’s working.

In This Role, You Will::

* Own the end-to-end roadmap and execution for planner-facing AI experiences in Attendee Hub, extending the Cvent Assistant across configuration, designer, and core workflow surfaces.
* Embed AI as a default lens in discovery, asking how AI improves the job to be done before writing requirements.
* Own end-to-end development of AI-powered features, defining what “good” looks like through structured evals: building eval datasets, writing LLM-as-judge prompts, and monitoring quality in production.
* Use AI fluently in your daily PM work for research, synthesis, prototyping, and analysis, and model that behavior for the team.
* Run continuous discovery: weekly customer conversations, early assumption testing, and working prototypes rather than slide decks.
* Make prioritization decisions using Mixpanel, Sigma, and ProductBoard, answering your own questions rather than waiting on analyst support.
* Lead a dedicated sprint team, running backlog prioritization, sprint planning, and delivery cadence.
* Write short, opinionated specs paired with working prototypes and evals, with clear acceptance criteria ready before sprint start.
* Act as the single point of accountability for product decisions in your domain, surfacing deviations with a proposed remedy.
* Partner with Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success on go-to-market launches and post-release adoption.

  
Here's What You Need::

* Bachelor’s degree required.
* 5+ years of product management experience, ideally in B2B SaaS.
* Experience designing and shipping AI-powered features

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.desc:
DENT Instruments, located in Bend, Oregon, is hiring a full-time Product Manager to own the product strategy and roadmap for our submeters, current transformers, power loggers and cloud software. You'll work closely with sales and customers to understand the market, keep our portfolio competitive, and make sure our products support our growth strategy. Day to day, you'll serve as DENT's first Scrum Product Owner, turning that strategy into clear priorities for engineering.

**Two Paths Into This Role**

* Industry Expert: You know energy metering, building automation or electrical equipment inside and out, and you're ready to move into product. We'll coach you on product management and Scrum.
* Product Management Pro: You've owned the strategy and roadmap for a technical B2B product, ideally as a Scrum Product Owner. You haven't worked in our industry, but you learn fast. We'll get you up to speed on our products and customers.

Either way, we'll pay for your Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO) training or a similar certification. Where you land in the pay range depends on the path you come from and the experience you bring. Someone who walks both paths may justify a salary above the posted range.

**Who You Are**

* Decisive: You make the call with the information you have, and you can explain why.
* Customer-Focused: You'd rather pick up the phone than guess. You're comfortable on customer calls, building relationships with key accounts and asking for honest feedback.
* Market-Minded: You follow customers, competitors and market trends, and turn what you see into product decisions.
* Technically Curious: You can hold your own with engineers on hardware, firmware and software.
* Clear Communicator: Your requirements and business cases are easy to read and act on.
* Builder: You enjoy building out a function, not just running one.

**What You'll Be Doing**

* Owning product strategy and the roadmap across meters, current transformers, software and cloud, aligned with our growth strategy
* Working closely with sales to understand customer needs, wins and losses, and where the market is heading
* Running market and competitive analysis to keep our product portfolio competitive, including the standards and certifications that shape it
* Getting in front of customers: joining sales calls, building relationships with key accounts and OEM partners, and reaching out for feedback
* Building business cases, making value-based product decisions and giving input on pricing
* Managing the full product lifecycle, from new product ideas and customer beta testing through end-of-life decisions
* Partnering with our Marketing Manager on launches, positioning and sales training
* Serving as Scrum Product Owner for the engineering team: backlog, priorities and acceptance

Requirements

* Bachelor's degree in engineering, business, or a related field (or equivalent experience)
* 2+ years in product management or Scrum Product Owner work on a technical B2B product, or in a technical role in energy metering, building automation, HVAC/controls or electrical equipment
* Comfort with products that combine hardware, firmware and software
* Experience working directly with customers, sales teams or partners

**Nice-to-Haves**

* Product marketing or launch experience
* Market research, competitive analysis or product strategy experience
* Experience with OEM or private-label partners
* Cloud or SaaS products tied to connected devices
* Familiarity with building communication protocols such as Modbus or BACnet
* Familiarity with UL, CE or ANSI certification
* Scrum or Agile experience, or a CSPO (or more advanced) certification

**Benefits**

* 401(k) and 401(k) matching
* Medical insurance: health, dental and vision
* Employee assistance program
* Flexible spending account
* Paid time off
* Parental leave
* Professional development assistance, including CSPO training
* Relocation assistance
* Tuition reimbursement

We make frontline teams more engaged and more productive so their lives improve while contributing to positive business outcomes. Our mission is protecting the world's water. We work every day to support the sustainability of our most precious resource, so our people know what they're doing matters.

Join our team and do work that matters. Visit www.orenco.com/jobs to learn more or check out the official job description (below).

**Company Description:**

Orenco Systems, Inc. (subsidiary of Infiltrator Water Technologies) is a manufacturer of innovative onsite and decentralized wastewater collection and treatment technologies. Every month, hundreds of thousands of orders and renewals flow through Book of the Month's in-house software systems, and we are seeking a Technical Product Manager to own two of the most mission-critical pieces of software at the business: our Order Management System and our Renewal Management System. These mission critical systems are purpose built by our in-house product and engineering teams to support our subscription service and deliver the best new books to our members every month.. **What you'll do...**

*Order Management*

* Own our Order Management System (OMS), which manages the entire lifecycle of an order from the moment a member clicks Ship to the moment it is delivered to our members.

*Monitoring & Reporting*

**About you...**

* Bachelor's degree, likely in a technical discipline.
* Strong technical skills and deep experience working with engineers to spec technical systems.
* Excellent at communicating technical information to different audiences.

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.desc:
**Product Manager**

Southfield, MI (Hybrid) · Full-time · Reports to VP of Product

**Who We Are**

We believe in small businesses and the people who grow them. At Credibly, we combine data science, technology, partner relationships, and customer support to give business owners fast access to right-sized capital — from working capital loans and merchant cash advances to lines of credit.

Founded in 2010 and headquartered in Southfield, Michigan, with offices in New York and Arizona, Credibly has provided access to more than $3 billion in capital to over 65,000 small businesses nationwide.

**The Opportunity**

The Product Manager will drive product planning and execution across Credibly's lending platform: the experiences our merchants and broker partners use to apply and get funded, the internal tools our sales, underwriting, funding, and servicing teams rely on every day, and the data and integrations that connect it all.

You will connect customer needs, business goals, and technical feasibility; decide what to build and why; and lead cross-functional teams through discovery, delivery, and launch. You will use data to measure what works, and you will look for practical ways that automation and AI can make our products faster, smarter, and easier to use.

**What You Will Do:**

* **Own outcomes.** Define the goals and KPIs for your product areas (conversion, time-to-fund, operational efficiency, partner and merchant satisfaction) and use them to guide priorities and measure success.
* **Lead the product lifecycle.** Take initiatives from ideation and discovery through requirements, design, testing, launch, and iteration.
* **Understand our users.** Spend time with merchants, ISO and broker partners, and internal teams to understand their workflows and pain points, and turn what you learn into clear problem statements.
* **Own the integration and data-vendor portfolio.** Evaluate third-party data, verification, and banking-data providers on hit rate, lift, latency, reliability, and cost; build the business case for adding, replacing, or renegotiating; and manage integrations with funding and capital markets partners.
* **Write clear requirements.** Document vision and scope through use cases, PRDs, epics, and user stories that give agile scrum teams what they need to build the right thing.
* **Partner with engineering and design.** Work closely with engineering, design, and data teams to shape solutions that are usable, technically sound, and secure.
* **Use data to decide.** Pull and analyze data with SQL and BI tools to size opportunities, understand behavior, and evaluate the impact of what we ship.
* **Find opportunities for automation and AI.** Identify manual work and decision points where automation, integrations, or AI can create value, and work with technical teams to deliver them responsibly.
* **Drive launches and adoption.** Coordinate with sales, marketing, operations, and support on launch plans, training, FAQs, and documentation so new capabilities get used.
* **Ensure quality.** Define acceptance criteria, support testing and UAT, and work with business and engineering teams to triage and resolve issues.
* Stay current on the alternative lending and fintech landscape, competitor offerings, and emerging technology.

**What You Bring:**

* 4+ years of product management experience delivering software products, ideally in a B2B, fintech, or financial services environment
* A track record of shipping products that delivered measurable business results
* Strong product discovery and prioritization skills, and the judgment to balance customer, business, and technical needs
* Experience using AI tools in your day-to-day work, such as drafting user stories, summarizing feedback, or analyzing data, and good judgment about when to double-check the results
* Comfort with data; working knowledge of SQL and BI tools is strongly preferred
* Enough technical fluency to work closely with engineers, including understanding AP

**Position Overview**

The Optimization Product Manager drives the product direction, development priorities, and commercial strategy for Vericut's optimization portfolio, including Vericut Force, Vericut Optimizer, and related optimization data products and services.

This role combines technical machining expertise, product management, and business strategy to translate customer needs, industry trends, and market opportunities into innovative software solutions. Working closely with Engineering, Sales, Applications Engineering, Marketing, and customers, the Product Manager guides product development, supports go-to-market initiatives, and drives product adoption and long-term portfolio growth.

The role also contributes to emerging optimization technologies and commercial offerings, including automated workflows, AI-assisted capabilities, and Optimization as a Service (OaaS).

**Key Responsibilities**

**Product Management & Development**

  

* Define and maintain product requirements, specifications, workflows, acceptance criteria, and roadmap priorities for Vericut's optimization portfolio.
* Manage product direction and development priorities for Vericut Force, Vericut Optimizer, the Stock Material Catalog, and the Vericut Tool Performance Database.
* Translate customer feedback, machining workflows, technical requirements, and market insights into actionable product improvements and new capabilities.
* Collaborate with Engineering, UX, and cross-functional teams throughout the product development lifecycle, including sprint planning, testing, validation, and release readiness.
* Evaluate machining workflows to improve product accuracy, reliability, usability, performance, and automation.
* Maintain and expand optimization-related material and cutting-tool performance data to support product functionality and customer needs.
* Identify opportunities to incorporate emerging technologies, including AI-assisted capabilities, digital solutions, and automated optimization workflows.

  

**Product Strategy & Commercialization**

  

* Develop and recommend short- and long-term product strategies, including a 1–3 year roadmap aligned with business objectives, customer needs, and market opportunities.
* Evaluate market potential, commercial viability, and business cases for new product capabilities, services, and revenue opportunities, including OaaS and optimization data services.
* Recommend pricing, packaging, licensing, and subscription models to strengthen competitive positioning, drive revenue growth, and accelerate customer adoption.
* Assess market segments, customer applications, and industry opportunities to identify areas for portfolio expansion, differentiation, and commercial growth.
* Monitor competitive technologies and industry developments in CNC machining, CAM, simulation, cutting tools, and optimization.
* Conduct competitive and win/loss analyses to inform product positioning, roadmap priorities, and commercialization strategies.
* Identify and evaluate strategic partnerships with cutting-tool manufacturers, material suppliers, machine-tool builders, and CAM vendors to expand product capabilities and market reach.

  

**Sales Enablement & Customer Engagement**

  

* Partner with Sales, Marketing, and Applications Engineering to support product demonstrations, customer evaluations, technical inquiries, and strategic commercial opportunities.
* Develop sales enablement resources, including product presentations, ROI calculators, proof-of-value assessments, competitive comparisons, and technical documentation.
* Establish validated optimization benchmarks and measurable customer results to demonstrate product value and strengthen commercial positioning.
* Support go-to-market planning, product launches, and initiatives to increase adoption among existing and prospective Vericut customers.

jobs.title: Technical Product Manager - Core Models
jobs.desc:
**Who You Are**

You are a highly analytical professional that operates at the interface of Product Management and Data Science.. You understand that a model's value depends only on how well it solves a real customer problem. You can translate a use case into a clear prediction target, define what constitutes a true positive, and reason through the tradeoffs between missed risk and unnecessary alerts. You are comfortable discussing precision, recall, and ROC analysis with data scientists, and explaining what those metrics mean to customers.

You are drawn to the intersection of product strategy and applied machine learning. You know how to turn customer needs into model requirements, evaluate whether an improvement matters in practice, and prioritize new capabilities alongside improvements to existing models. You are rigorous and analytical, but you move with urgency and make practical decisions with imperfect information.

You are collaborative by nature and have achieved success as a team player. You thrive by setting ambitious goals and tracking progress until they are met. You feel strongly about being mission-driven in your work, and above all else you are innately curious and motivated to learn new things.

**Who We Are**

Quantifind is the Risk Intelligence company. We help some of the world's biggest banks identify money laundering and fraud. Quantifind also works with government agencies, using the same platform, to uncover criminal networks and support national security. Unlike other players in this space, Quantifind delivers results in a software-as-a-service (SaaS) model with consumer-grade user experiences.

Quantifind's Graphyte platform uncovers signals of risk across disparate and unstructured text sources using artificial intelligence and natural language processing techniques. In financial crimes risk management, Quantifind's solution combines internal financial institution data with public domain data to assess risk in the context of Know Your Customer (KYC), Customer Due Diligence (CDD), Fraud Risk Management, and Anti-Money Laundering (AML) processes.

Our customers need to understand the intelligence they rely on: what our models assess, how their performance is measured, and where their limitations lie. The Core Models product area connects the development of our models to those customer needs and the workflows they support.

To help you succeed, we provide a supportive environment that fosters collaboration between teams and team members, where learning and professional growth are considered a key part of your success, and of ours. We offer a flexible work environment with a family-friendly work-life balance.

**What A Great Candidate Looks Like:**

* BS or MS in computer science, statistics, mathematics, engineering, or a related technical field, or bring equivalent practical experience.
* 2+ years of product management, data science, and/or data analytics experience working with software powered by machine learning models or with significant model-driven capabilities.
* You have a strong working command of classifier performance metrics, including precision, recall, false-positive and false-negative rates, and ROC analysis and can interpret evaluation results, explain threshold tradeoffs, and connect those tradeoffs to customer outcomes.
* You can turn an ambiguous customer problem into a well-defined model use case, prediction target, and measurable acceptance criteria.
* You understand how label quality, class imbalance, and the representativeness of evaluation data affect conclusions about model performance.
* You are comfortable partnering closely with Data Science and Engineering, distinguishing product decisions from modeling implementation choices while contributing meaningfully to both discussions.
* You communicate clearly with technical and nontechnical audiences and can explain model capabilities and limitations without overstating what the evidence supports.
* You understand agile software

============

At **eLEND**, we're transforming the lending industry through technology, automation, artificial intelligence, and modern digital platforms. We combine deep financial services expertise with cutting-edge innovation to build scalable solutions that improve operational efficiency, customer experience, and business performance.
