Posting Description:

**Technical Product Manager – Facultative Reinsurance**

Do you have technical product management experience and a passion for driving digital transformation? Are you a strategic leader who can connect business and technology to deliver innovative solutions? Join us as a Product Manager and help build the future of our placement platforms at Aon!

*This position is located in Bloomington, MN, USA, offering the option to work remotely or from our nearby office.*

**Aon is in the business of better decisions**

At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world.

As an organization, we are united through trust as one inclusive team and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed.

**What the day will look like**

As a Technical Product Manager, your day is dynamic and collaborative. You’ll work closely with senior business leaders and cross-functional teams to drive product innovation in the reinsurance sector. Your focus will be on aligning technology solutions with business strategy, ensuring regulatory compliance, and championing digital transformation across the facultative business. You’ll balance planning, working with partners, and hands-on leadership to deliver impactful results in a fast-paced environment.

**Typical Daily Activities:**

* Meet with senior leadership to align product roadmaps with strategic objectives and market trends.
* Represent the technology team in meetings with collaborators, promoting transparency and accountability.
* Communicate product vision and strategy to both internal and external collaborators.
* Analyze market research and competitive intelligence to identify new opportunities for product differentiation.
* Lead cross-functional sessions with engineering, architecture, and business SMEs to define and prioritize product features.
* Guide teams through the product development lifecycle, from concept to launch.
* Advocate for coordinated technology platforms and drive adoption among users.
* Monitor product performance using important metrics and customer feedback, driving continuous improvement.

* Ensure compliance with insurance market regulations and industry standards around the globe.
* Facilitate conflict resolution and keep product initiatives on track with business goals.

**How this opportunity is different**

This role is crafted to serve as a strategic link between important business partners and technology teams. It ensures technology solutions directly drive business growth and improve operational efficiency. The position includes representing the Technology team in meetings with collaborators and aligning efforts across regions with global goals. The Product Manager should act as a product champion, sharing vision and strategy inside and outside the company while leading teams through cooperative problem-solving and resolving conflicts.

**Skills and experience that will lead to success**

* Demonstrated experience as a Product Manager with at least 3 years of business background, 3 years applying Agile methodologies, and 2 years managing product teams.
* Strong leadership and team-building skills, with the ability to encourage and motivate cross-functional teams.
* Excellent critical thinking, technical problem-solving, and decision-making skills.

* Highly developed communication skills, with proficiency in executive presentations.
* Advanced negotiation, facilitation, and consensus-building skills.
* Ability to communicate complex technical concepts to non-technical collaborators.

* Experience with digital transformation initiatives.
* Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, a related field, or equivalent years of industry experience.

For positions in San Francisco and Los Angeles, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction record in accordance with local Fair Chance ordinances.

jobs.title: Product Manager - Payment Processing
jobs.desc:
Shift4 (NYSE: FOUR) is boldly redefining commerce by simplifying complex payments ecosystems across the world. As the leader in commerce-enabling technology, Shift4 powers billions of transactions annually for hundreds of thousands of businesses in virtually every industry. For more information, visit www.shift4.com.

SHift4 is expanding globally and hiring a key Payment Processing Product Manager, Lead – North America owns the product strategy and delivery for the core transaction processing domain in North America, spanning Clearing, Settlement, and Exceptions/Dispute Management.

  

This role is central to the company's move away from legacy, homegrown processing infrastructure toward a modern, modular processing platform, and requires close, ongoing engagement with the third-party processors and networks the business relies on today as that transition unfolds. Reporting into the Global Payment Delivery leadership, this individual translates architectural direction into a concrete, sequenced product roadmap, working across engineering, operations, finance, and external processing partners to ensure the platform is reliable, compliant, and positioned for eventual platform independence.

**Responsibilitie**s

  

* Own the product roadmap for Clearing, Settlement, and Exceptions/Dispute Management within the North America processing stack, ensuring alignment with the broader global processing architecture and platform-independence strategy.
* Serve as the primary product point of contact with existing third-party processing and network partners, managing day-to-day requirements, escalations, and roadmap dependencies while planning for eventual consolidation onto the target processing platform.
* Translate high-level architectural direction (e.g., separating switching/auth, clearing, and settlement into modular, replaceable components) into detailed product requirements, phased migration plans, and measurable delivery milestones.
* Partner with Engineering to scope build-vs-buy decisions for processing capabilities not fully covered by external platform partners (e.g., residuals, billing nuances, reconciliation, reporting), and own the resulting internal product backlog.
* Work closely with Finance, Risk, Operations, and Compliance to ensure clearing, settlement, and exception-handling flows meet regulatory, funding, and reconciliation requirements across card networks and payment types.
* Define and track success metrics for processing reliability, settlement accuracy, exception resolution time, and partner performance, and report progress to senior product and executive stakeholders.
* Document and maintain the logical data model and interface contracts between the processing domain and adjacent systems (onboarding/merchant data, gateway, billing), ensuring consistency in naming conventions and identifiers as legacy systems are decomposed.
* Support internal and external certification efforts (e.g., network/scheme certifications) tied to new clearing and settlement capabilities.
* Act as a bridge between regional (North America) needs and the global Payment Architecture function, surfacing local requirements for peer review and ensuring North America is represented in global processing standards.

**Qualifications**

  

* 7+ years of experience in a product management role within payments processing, acquiring or a related financial technology domain.
* Working knowledge of transaction lifecycle mechanics, specifically clearing, settlement, and dispute/exception processes across card networks.
* Experience managing relationships with external processing or network partners, including roadmap negotiation and issue escalation.

The Product Manager owns the strategy, roadmap, and outcomes for a core area of the company’s platform, as well as the stakeholder relationships that shape it. * Proven experience owning stakeholder management and aligning priorities across multiple teams with competing goals.

Global enterprises, governments, and organizations rely on Bitsight to prioritize cybersecurity investments, build trust within their ecosystem, and reduce the chance of financial loss.

------------------

Bitsight's engineering organization is changing fast. AI tools now write and review a growing share of our code, and the path from ticket to shipped change is shifting with them. We need a Technical Product Manager to help prioritize and coordinate execution on improvements to our process.

jobs.desc:
**Product Manager**

  

**Job Description:**

Thomson Reuters is seeking a dynamic Product Manager to drive the development and commercialization of innovative analytical solutions, ensuring alignment with customer needs and strategic business objectives.

  

The Product Manager owns the vision, direction, and priorities for a larger, more complex, or strategic product or group of products, managing the full product lifecycle from strategic planning through to tactical execution. They understand the needs of the customers the product is designed to serve in depth, communicate those needs crisply across the organization, and work with design and engineering to translate them into clear priorities, compelling roadmaps, and high-impact solutions. They reason across the full system understanding how decisions in their area impact adjacent products, teams, and the end-to-end customer experience and bring the right people into the room to make trade-offs visible.

  

They confidently shape product direction with a clear view of commercial impact, balancing short-term delivery with long-term system health and customer trust, and maintain a sharp sense of focus on the right problems, the right customers, and the right investments, treating scope creep and the impulse to build for everyone as the strategic risks they are. The balance between tactical execution and strategic vision is critical at this level, as is the ability to coordinate across multiple functions simultaneously and to lead in building AI-enabled products and experiences with depth and credibility. This is a hybrid role

* Lead the entire product lifecycle from ideation through launch and post-launch optimization, focusing on analytical solutions.

* Collaborate cross-functionally with engineering, design, sales, and marketing teams to ensure successful product development and commercialization.
* Develop and execute go-to-market strategies, including pricing, positioning, and promotional activities.
* Monitor product performance, gather customer feedback, and iterate on features to drive continuous improvement and customer engagement.
* Effectively communicate product vision, roadmap, and updates to internal and external stakeholders.
Manage multiple projects simultaneously, prioritizing tasks to maximize organizational efficiency.  

**Required Qualifications:**

* Proven experience in product management, particularly with analytical solutions.
* Strong understanding of product development methodologies and product commercialization processes.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex ideas clearly.
* Demonstrated ability in group problem solving and strategic execution.
* Proficiency in computer literacy, including advanced skills in Microsoft Office Suite.
* Experience with marketing and customer engagement strategies.
* Highly organized, detail-oriented, and capable of effective multitasking.
Strong researching abilities to inform product decisions and market understanding.

* Experience managing tax, accounting, or other regulated professional-services software, ideally enterprise products serving large firms.

* Demonstrated ownership of commercial outcomes such as adoption, retention, and revenue, with experience in pricing, packaging, and business-case development.
* Experience mentoring junior Product Managers and leading cross-functional initiatives without direct authority.

**Anticipated deadline to submit application: October 21, 2026 before 5pm EST. Position may close early if application limit is met. Apply promptly for full consideration.**

**The Opportunity**

At CEO, Product Managers own a portion of the organization's technology ecosystem and staff user experience with a focus on ensuring efficient, compliant, and integrated systems that minimize user friction. Product Managers blend strategic product management, systems support, business process improvement, and change management to enable the organization to scale its impact across 650+ employees and 30+ sites.

By defining and executing multi-year product roadmaps, Product Managers unify staff-facing applications, optimize workflows, and drive user adoption in alignment with organizational goals.

**Role-Specific Responsibilities**

CEO has several Product Management roles with differing functional scopes, but with shared underlying responsibilities.

The Product Manager (Digital Workplace) owns the suite of digital tools that connect, empower, and support staff across all sites. This includes user devices, enterprise collaboration tools, project management/workflow automation software (e.g., Monday.com), Google Workspace, and AI assistants This role unifies employee-facing applications to maximize productivity, streamline workflows and enable CEO to scale its impact. They focus on frontline non-profit operations, eliminating friction between central staff, office-based personnel, and mobile/frontline teams to improve communication, efficiency, and service delivery.

As part of our mission, we strongly encourage individuals who have lived experience of incarceration or involvement in the justice system to apply for this role.

**Who We Are**

The Center for Employment Opportunities (CEO) provides employment services to people recently released from incarceration. Across the United States, 8,000-9,000 people participate in CEO each year, transitioning to employment that supports themselves, their families, and their communities.

What began as a demonstration project of the Vera Institute of Justice in the 1970s to address employment barriers facing the formerly incarcerated following release in New York City has grown into the leading reentry employment organization in the country, where over 30,000 formerly incarcerated individuals have secured full-time employment since 1996.

* You have experience supporting distributed organizations with complex multi-site operational structures.

* You have familiarity with reentry or social services operational environments.
* You have experience with low-code/no-code workflow automation tools or intranet/knowledge management design.
* You have experience with Agile product development methodologies.

This role will collaborate across multiple product, business, and technology domains to define the systems, business rules, data requirements, and functional capabilities needed to deliver seamless, efficient, and client-centric experiences. Operating initially across multiple teams and workstreams, the Senior Manager will drive cross-functional alignment, shape product requirements, and establish a clear vision for delivery, with the opportunity to assume dedicated product leadership responsibilities as the initiative evolves.

CORPAY is currently looking to hire a Product Manager within our North American Trucking division. This position falls under our US Vehicle Payments line of business and is located in Atlanta, GA.
  
  
Corpay's North American Trucking team operates differently than a typical large enterprise product organization. While we're part of a global company, our team runs with the speed, ownership, and accountability of a startup.
  
  
We're looking for a Product Manager who is energized by ambiguity, thrives with autonomy, and enjoys building products and businesses from the ground up. This isn't a role where you are given a roadmap, you'll define your own way, drive alignment, and own execution from concept through launch and beyond.
  
  
One day you may be interviewing customers and writing product requirements. The next you might be reviewing UI designs, developing go-to-market materials, negotiating strategic partnerships, analyzing product performance, or working with engineering to solve technical challenges. Success requires someone who is equally comfortable thinking strategically and rolling up their sleeves to execute.
  
If you're looking for a role with clearly defined boundaries, this probably isn't it. If you're excited by ownership, variety, and building products that make a measurable impact, we'd love to meet you.
  
  
You will report directly to the VP of Connected Vehicle Products and regularly collaborate with the team and other departments.

* Bringing products to market. Partner with Sales, Marketing, Operations, Customer Success, and Training to develop positioning, launch plans, enablement materials, and adoption strategies that maximize product success.
* Using data to drive decisions. Define success metrics, monitor product performance, and continuously iterate based on customer feedback, analytics, and business results.

* Wearing multiple hats. This role extends well beyond traditional product management. jobs.title: Technical Product Manager - Operations Project Delivery
jobs.desc:
#### **Who We Are**

CoVolt Power is a leading utility-scale EPC (Engineering, Procurement & Construction) company specializing in the design and delivery of solar, battery energy storage (BESS), and high-voltage infrastructure. Since its founding in 2005, the company has built a reputation for de-risking project delivery and providing creative, integrated solutions that span the power and digital infrastructure sectors.

Consistently ranked as a top-tier EPC, CoVolt Power leverages a mission-driven approach to safety and quality, delivering thousands of megawatts in renewable assets that support a more resilient and sustainable energy future for developers, utilities, independent power producers (IPPs), and data center operators across North America.

#### **Position Summary**

The **Technical Product Manager - Operations Project Delivery** owns the technology roadmap for CoVolt's Project Delivery and field operations capabilities from the technical side. You translate business needs into product requirements, prioritize the backlog, and drive delivery of tools, integrations, reporting, and AI-enabled capabilities across the full construction lifecycle — from project setup and field execution through closeout.

The role is intentionally product-led, not order-taking. You partner closely with Project Delivery, field operations, and the enterprise functions that support them — project controls, finance and payroll, data/BI, architecture, security, and change management — to define problems, clarify ownership, and move priority capabilities from idea to adoption. The business owns the operating process and field execution outcomes; this role owns the product roadmap, platform capability, integration, data readiness, and the delivery and adoption support that enable them. **This role is Houston-based on a hybrid schedule (3 days in office, 2 remote).**

#### **What You'll Own**

* **Own the Project Delivery product roadmap —** build and manage the prioritized roadmap for construction, jobsite, and field operations technology capabilities, aligned to project execution priorities, business value, process maturity, and enterprise architecture principles.
* **Turn business needs into product requirements —** partner with field, project controls, finance and payroll, safety and quality, data/BI, and enterprise architecture teams to convert pain points into clear requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and release priorities.
* **Lead field technology enablement —** advance the roadmap for the platforms behind field execution, time capture, productivity, cost, equipment, and compliance, including Procore, Vista/Viewpoint, B2W Track, UKG, LCPTracker, Power BI/Snowflake, SharePoint/M365, Smartsheet, Fleetio, and Motive.
* **Drive real-time operations and time capture —** own the backlog for real-time site visibility, jobsite dashboards, and operational intelligence, along with digital time, attendance, and productivity — including field approval workflows, payroll integration, and fraud-prevention/location controls.
* **Build the field data foundation —** own the master data, data quality, and integration readiness that make quantity, cost, and executive-ready reporting trustworthy and scalable.

jobs.desc:
### **About Traversal**

Traversal is the AI Site Reliability Engineer (AI SRE) for the enterprise.

Production complexity was already outpacing what engineering teams could manage manually, and AI-generated code is accelerating that gap. Traversal is built for that challenge, autonomously understanding and reasoning across even the largest, most complex production environments to diagnose, fix, and prevent incidents. Our mission is to free engineers from endless firefighting and give them more time to focus on creative, high-impact work.

Today, Traversal operates in mission-critical environments at some of the world's largest enterprises. Our roots remain deeply embedded in AI research, and we've brought together researchers from institutions including MIT, Harvard, Berkeley, Columbia, and Cornell with world-class technical staff and operators from companies like Google, Meta, Datadog, ServiceNow, and Citadel Securities to take on one of the hardest problems for AI to solve. Traversal is backed by Sequoia Capital, Kleiner Perkins, Hanabi, NFDG, and American Express Ventures.

### **The Role**

Traversal is building a superintelligent AI SRE: always-on AI employees, used daily by hundreds of engineers at the world's largest companies during their highest-pressure moments. At the core are the agents and AI capabilities our engineering and research teams build. As a Product Manager at Traversal, you'll build the product on top of them: how the agent behaves, what it does, how it communicates, when it should act, and the user interfaces / product experiences built around it.

On-call engineers and SREs use the Traversal agent to troubleshoot production incidents, work through alert channels, and answer the everyday questions that come with keeping systems running, and adoption and usage have grown explosively. The agent lives in a web app and across headless surfaces: agents in Slack and Microsoft Teams, an MCP that works with coding agents like Claude Code and Cursor, and an API engineers build workflows around. You'll bring the same craft to all of them, from pixel-level detail in the UI to tone, clarity, and evals in Slack, and you'll know which surface fits which problem.

Our product team is small but mighty: just a few PMs, each with high agency and a real hand in shaping how the function works. You'll help set the roadmap and the way we work as the company scales through rapid growth. If you use AI agents compulsively, have strong opinions about what makes them great, and want to build AI-native products engineers love so much they turn to them first, we'd love to meet you.

### **Responsibilities**

* Partner closely with customers, engineers, and AI researchers to define product strategy and roadmap, leading discovery with SREs, platform engineers, and incident responders at some of the world's largest enterprises
* Build the product layer on top of the core AI agents our research and engineering teams build, thinking holistically across the web app and headless surfaces (Slack, Microsoft Teams, MCP, and API, where the user is often another agent).
* Sweat the details of the agent's prompts: iterate on multiple versions of prompts and harnesses, run evals to see which output is better, and tell a good output from a great one
* Own the features that make the product enterprise-ready, like fine-grained access control and RBAC
* Prototype ideas yourself, and bring a prototype, not just a PRD, to product reviews
* Sequence rollouts: find the MVP: the smallest feature set that tests a hypothesis, shipped on the most minimal surface (headless, Slack, or UI), tested with beta users, then expanded over time
* Work with forward-deployed engineers during customer POVs to turn gaps into shipped features, fast
* Bring in ideas from across the agent ecosystem and anticipate where agents are going next
* Shape the product function: roadmap, process, and how product works with a fast-growing engineering team

#### **Who We Are**

CoVolt Power is a leading utility-scale EPC (Engineering, Procurement & Construction) company specializing in the design and delivery of solar, battery energy storage (BESS), and high-voltage infrastructure. Since its founding in 2005, the company has built a reputation for de-risking project delivery and providing creative, integrated solutions that span the power and digital infrastructure sectors.

Consistently ranked as a top-tier EPC, CoVolt Power leverages a mission-driven approach to safety and quality, delivering thousands of megawatts in renewable assets that support a more resilient and sustainable energy future for developers, utilities, independent power producers (IPPs), and data center operators across North America.

#### **Position Summary**

The **Technical Product Manager - Corporate Applications** owns the technology roadmap for CoVolt's corporate applications from the technical side, anchored on our Trimble Vista ERP. You translate business needs into product requirements, prioritize the backlog, and drive delivery of enhancements, integrations, interfaces, reporting, and governance across the platforms that run Finance, Accounting, Payroll, HR, Project Accounting, and Procurement. Beyond Vista, you serve as the technical product owner for a portfolio of corporate applications (for example, UKG, LCPTracker, and FloQast), and you own the integrations that connect Vista to the broader enterprise (for example, Procore, B2W, and our reporting and data platforms).

The role is intentionally product-led, not order-taking. You partner closely with Finance, Accounting, Payroll, HR, Project Controls, Procurement, Data/BI, Enterprise Architecture, Cybersecurity, and vendors to define problems, clarify ownership, and move priority capabilities from idea to adoption. The business owns the process, data, controls, and outcomes; you own the ERP platform roadmap, integration strategy, interface reliability, governance discipline, and technical delivery that enable those outcomes.

#### **What You'll Own**

* **Own the Vista ERP and corporate applications roadmap —** build and manage a prioritized roadmap for Vista and adjacent corporate platforms, balancing business value, process maturity, compliance, and enterprise architecture.
* **Own the ERP integration and interface strategy —** manage the health, reliability, and roadmap of integrations between Vista and connected platforms (for example, Procore, B2W, and our reporting and data platforms), including Trimble App Xchange, SFTP/SQL feeds, and the manual Excel bridges (such as B2W Excel Vista budget upload, equipment forecast, and SOV setup) that need to be replaced with governed, auditable integrations.
* **Drive ERP governance —** operationalize the Business System Owner / IT System Owner model — change control, configuration standards, security roles, segregation of duties, access reviews, and a monthly ERP steering cadence — so Vista stays compliant, controlled, and auditable.
* **Protect master data discipline —** clarify system-of-record boundaries and data ownership across Vista (vendors, customers, jobs, cost codes, chart of accounts) and partner with data/BI to reduce duplicate entry and shadow trackers.
* **Manage vendor and platform relationships —** coordinate platform and integration vendors on updates, patches, upgrades, defects, and roadmap alignment; hold vendors accountable to SLAs and product commitments.
* **Drive reporting and AI/automation opportunities —** improve financial and operational reporting off Vista (Power BI, Crystal Reports, Spreadsheet Server) and identify high-value automation and AI use cases such as AP invoice automation, reconciliation, and reporting assistance, using governed platforms.
* **Run delivery with product discipline** — own intake, backlog refinement, MVP scoping, release planning, testing, cutover, and adoption across Vista modules (GL, AP, AR, SL, PO, PR, JC, EM) and corporate application changes

-----------------

Own the move from legacy quoting to Kin’s multi-product platform — retire old systems, simplify and improve quoting for our agents and customers across multiple channels.

Kin makes life simpler, more affordable, and better for homeowners — especially in the places where climate risks, rising costs, and outdated systems make it hardest. We start with smarter homeowners insurance and expand to everything homeowners need to thrive.

-------------------

This is an individual contributor role, and you’ll partner closely with fellow PMs, engineering counterparts, Sales and Operations leaders and other stakeholders across many cross-team dependencies.

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.desc:
Habitat Health empowers older adults to experience more good days in their homes and communities. Through the Program of All-Inclusive Care for the Elderly (PACE), we provide comprehensive medical care along with support for daily needs such as meals, transportation, and in‑home assistance. We deliver coordinated clinical and social care in our centers and directly in participants' homes, creating a fully integrated experience that brings peace of mind and a true sense of belonging. As we expand our scalable, affordable PACE model to meet the growing and complex needs of aging populations, our mission‑driven care teams continue to help participants live well on their own terms.

Habitat Health is supported by leading healthcare organizations and investors including New Enterprise Associates, Kaiser Permanente, and Town Hall Ventures. We are entering a period of significant growth and are looking for exceptional teammates to help us scale a better model of care for older adults. To learn more, visit www.habitathealth.com.

**Location**: Remote; requiring regular travel for onsite go-lives, department rounding and other support activities as needed.

**Role Scope**

Habitat Health is looking for a Product Manager to own strategy, roadmap, and delivery outcomes across our clinical and business applications portfolio — including EHR, CRM, Call Platform, Risk Suspecting, and ancillary clinical applications.

This role would be accountable for knowing the problem space deeply, deciding what gets built and in what order, and proving that what shipped actually worked. You'll run discovery with clinical, growth, and operational stakeholders, define clear requirements and success metrics, prioritize a backlog against a real prioritization framework, and partner with technical and vendor teams to deliver against it. You'll work closely with Platform, Clinical, Operations, and Growth leaders — not just to gather requirements, but to shape what the roadmap should be, defend trade-offs with data, and drive adoption once features ship.

**Primary Areas of Responsibility**  

* Own and evolve the product roadmap across the clinical and business applications portfolio, using a structured prioritization framework to balance strategic bets against operational demand
* Lead product discovery — engaging clinical and business stakeholders and end users directly to surface real workflow pain points, not just intake tickets — and translate findings into clear problem statements
* Write product requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria; partner with technical and vendor delivery teams (Epic/OCHIN, Salesforce, TalkDesk, and others) to scope, sequence, and de-risk delivery
* Maintain the product backlog end to end, balancing new capabilities, enhancements, and technical debt
* Work with business stakeholders to define success metrics and KPIs for each initiative, track adoption and outcomes post-launch, and use that data to inform the next iteration of the roadmap
* Partner with PACE Center Leadership, the Office of the CMO, Population Health, Practice Operations, Finance, Strategy, Growth, and Health Plan Operations to align product direction with business strategy
* Partner with Operations leadership to drive adoption of new rollouts — closing training gaps through documentation, demos, and change management
* Coordinate with multiple vendors, escalating to leadership when vendor needs to be held accountable to scope, documentation, and delivery timelines
* Facilitate stakeholder and steering meetings, and represent the voice of the product to senior leadership
* Operate with a high degree of ownership and autonomy, exercising sound independent judgment to identify issues, evaluate options, make recommendations, and drive matters to resolution

**Qualifications**  

* Aligns with our purpose and our values, and is excited about living those out in daily practice
* 3+ years as a Product Manager or Product Owner, ideally in healthcare, health

Foxen advances financial wellness through multi-family real estate. Founded in 2018 and headquartered in Columbus, Ohio, we provide a platform of compliance solutions for multifamily property owners, operators and residents.

Foxen is building a leading platform of proptech solutions for property operators, and we are looking for an exceptional Product Manager to own partner integrations. These integrations connect Foxen with the property management systems our customers use to run their businesses, leasing platforms, and strategic partners. This role will shape the future of Foxen's connected platform, building integrations that expand what our products can do and help our customers achieve more.

As Product Manager, Partner Integrations, you will own the integration roadmap, manage our relationships with PMS vendors and technology partners, lead new strategic partnerships from evaluation through launch, and work alongside our engineering team to make every connection deeper, more automated, and more reliable. * Partner with the engineering team to translate partner and customer needs into clear requirements, make smart prioritization calls across competing partner timelines, and ensure what ships is reliable at scale.
* Be the integration expert for Sales, Implementation, and Customer Success: support deals, unblock implementations, keep our integration compatibility story current, and turn field feedback into roadmap.
* Define and track the metrics that matter for integrations, including time to integrate, automation rate, data accuracy, and partner-sourced revenue, and use them to drive continuous improvement.
* Integrate AI into both how you build and what you build, using tools to sharpen your process and embedding capabilities into the integration platform to advance its competitive edge.
* Continually measure, analyze, and optimize the integrations that you own.

jobs.title: Product Marketing Manager
jobs.desc:
At Salient, some of the most important conversations about our products happen when nobody from Salient is in the room. An integrator is advising a school district on a new security system. A sales engineer is explaining how a manufacturer can use the cameras it already owns. A customer is deciding whether a platform that looks good in a demo will hold up across dozens of sites.

We need a product marketer who can make those conversations clearer, sharper, and easier to win, even when we’re not there to help. You would be our first dedicated Product Marketing Manager, with ownership of how we position the portfolio, equip our sales team and partners, and learn from the deals we win and lose.

**Why Salient, and why this role**

Salient Systems makes CompleteView, an open video management platform for organizations managing security across many sites. In plain terms: we take the video from a customer’s cameras, record it, and put it in front of the people who need it. That might be an operator watching live, an investigator piecing together what happened last Tuesday, or an administrator making sure every camera is still online. Customers choose their cameras, and we make them all work together.

We also build the recording platforms underneath it for customers who want a system that’s ready to go. Much of this market still runs on-premise, and we’re building toward a hybrid cloud future. That combination gives us an interesting story to tell, but not one that fits neatly on a single slide.

We sell through integrators and distributors. A message isn’t finished when everyone here approves it; it has to be useful to a partner who may be explaining us to a customer three weeks later. You’ll have the scope to build the product-marketing practice around that reality, not inherit a content calendar and call it strategy.

This is a chance to put several consequential pieces of a go-to-market system together: positioning, pricing and packaging research, launches, sales enablement, competitive intelligence, and win/loss. The work gives you room to build a product-marketing practice with a measurable commercial voice, not just a portfolio of finished assets. We do need someone who can make the assets, too.

 **Requirements**  
  
**What you’ll do**

* **Give the portfolio a clear story.** Develop positioning, messaging, and packaging for CompleteView and our recording platforms. Translate product briefs into language that works for security leaders, IT teams, integrators, and distributors. Carry that language through sales, marketing, our revenue-operations partner, and the channel so it gets used, not merely approved.
* **Build tools that help people sell.** Own the living sales deck, create a total-cost-of-ownership model that can stand up to scrutiny, and develop competitive guides, objection handling, and other tools around the points where real deals stall. Partner with Sales on a demo narrative and script that others can deliver well. A deck that lives in someone’s Downloads folder does not count as enablement.
* **Lead major product launches.** Connect the product’s value to the release, build the internal and partner-facing plan, and make sure the story holds together across training, web content, sales materials, and demand generation. Work closely with the people running partner programs; this role owns the product story and the materials those programs use, not the co-marketing funds or partner-event calendar. You’ll also spend time with partners at the events where this market comes together.
* **Make market evidence useful.** Run pricing and packaging studies, maintain a practical view of competitors, and build a repeatable win/loss practice. Bring Product, Sales, and Finance recommendations they can act on. Build customer references and case studies with proof beyond “improved efficiency.”

**PURE HomeRiver** **is looking for an**

**Product Manager**

**Come join our team!**

We are looking for an AI-forward fintech **Manager** who wants to grow quickly with our team. We're building software in collaboration with our users, who are deeply insightful and incredible to work with.

This role will support our Property Manager Accounting Domain, the financial core of our multi-ledger accounting and payments engine. This includes trust accounting, ledgering, rent posting, and high-volume transactional payments processing, reconciliations, closing workflows, and financial reporting - the systems where accuracy, compliance, and clarity matter. Our platform will support hundreds of thousands of monthly transactions. You'll be making product decisions that balance user needs, compliance requirements, operational workflows, and financial accuracy.

You'll work closely with internal accounting experts to ensure compliance with trust accounting regulations and build workflows that support clean, auditable financials. The role will focus on shipping our platform internally and increasing efficiency for our property managers. You'll be involved in research, user interviews, writing stories, and defining the strategy and roadmap as we grow.

**PURE HomeRiver offers a Comprehensive Total Rewards Package of Benefits containing:**

* **Medical, Dental and Vision Coverage**
* **401(k) plan with a 4% Instantly Vested Match**

* **3-5 years of experience** as a product manager on B2B2C or enterprise products, ideally with complex user workflows involving heavy use of third-party integrations and vendors.
* You are proficient in AI-enabled product development and excited to work on emerging technologies.
* Strong communication skills and ability to translate technical concepts into plain language that customers can understand
* A motivated self-starter who can move work forward autonomously
* Subject matter knowledge of one or more of the following:

  + Double-entry accounting
  + Bank reconciliations
  + Integrations for payments and money movements
  + Financial reporting
* **Startup or scale-up experience is key** – We work in a fast-paced environment with considerable ambiguity. You need to be comfortable with this.

**User empathy** – Experience working with non-technical users, deep empathy for their challenges, and genuine interest in user experience.

**Remote team experience** – Comfort working with distributed and outsourced teams.

Hygiena’s proprietary diagnostic technologies enable customers to prevent illness and save lives, comply with regulations, protect products and brands, run businesses more effectively. * In providing the highest quality products & service

The Product Manager (Platform) is responsible for turning Hygiena's portfolio of software applications, including SureTrend, SureKleanz, SureDoc and SureLab, into one connected system that customers experience as a single product. This role owns the platform roadmap end to end: unified sign-in, cross-app navigation, shared data and combined reporting, in-app cross-sell between products, and the integrations that connect our applications to CRM, ERP and billing systems.

We're building the financial systems backbone that lets a fast-scaling manufacturing company move with the speed of a software startup and the rigor of a public company. * Demonstrated experience designing and implementing finance solutions end to end—requirements through deployment and adoption—not just administering existing systems

jobs.title: Product Manager, DL
jobs.desc:
**OBJECTIVE / PURPOSE**

This position requires a product leader who owns the roadmap and lifecycle for Distance Learning (DL) physical kits. The Product Manager sets pricing and margin targets, and plans launch and go-to-market. The role is the single intake point for field product requests and makes the call on prioritization and discontinuation.

**MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES AND FUNCTIONS**

  

* Own the product roadmap and lifecycle for DL physical kits and courses, from concept and definition through launch, growth, and discontinuation.
* Define new courses and kits, projected demand, product cost, pricing, and margin.
* Estimate and suggest pricing to the Senior Manager, DL Operations and Product.
* Monitor the competitive landscape and define competitive positioning for DL kits and courses.
* Serve as the intake point for field product requests; evaluate, prioritize, and communicate decisions back to the field.
* Make product decisions for New Product Portal entries and hand them off to the Operations Specialist, DL for execution; define the product content of each launch checklist.
* Collaborate with the Senior Manager, DL Operations and Product on demand assumptions and build-and-ship readiness before each launch.
* Track product performance after launch, including sales, margin, and customer feedback, and use results to update the roadmap.
* Collaborate with subject matter experts to ensure kit and course content meets academic and program requirements.

**POSITION REQUIREMENTS**

**Education:** Bachelor’s degree in relevant field is required. Relevant fields include business, marketing, life or health science, or related discipline.

**Experience:** 3-5 years of experience in product management, preferably for physical products, required. Experience with higher education, science lab kits.

**Specialized Training/Skills:** Project Management training/experience a plus. Strong financial and analytical skills, including pricing, margin, and market analysis. Ability to make and defend prioritization decisions with internal stakeholders and the sales team. Ability to effectively plan, implement, and monitor self-directed and group projects. Must possess good written and oral communication skills.

jobs.title: Product Marketing Manager
jobs.desc:
**Our Mission**
===============

Private markets shape which companies get built and how innovation scales - yet origination still runs on manual workflows and fragmented tools. **Raylu is the AI origination engine for private markets**, so every investor can see more of the market, qualify faster, and move first.

We’re not building generic AI. Raylu is purpose-built for Growth Equity and PE - already powering sourcing for leading funds with:

* Real-time market maps aligned to your thesis
* Standardized, enriched company signals and benchmarks
* Deep contextual research on emerging companies
* Automated, fund-voice outreach to founders and execs

**The Role**
============

We're hiring a Product Marketing Manager to turn what Raylu builds into launches, messages and sales tools that win deals with investors. You'll work closely with Product, Engineering, Sales, and Growth.

You'll sit where the roadmap meets the market. You'll decide how each feature is positioned, make sure every launch lands and arm our sales team to beat competitors in demanding conversations with partners and deal teams.

This is a high-ownership role: you'll own launches from early roadmap discussion to post-launch analysis, and your work will show up in every pitch, page and campaign we run.

**What You'll Do**
==================

* **Own launches end to end.** Run every feature and product launch from roadmap planning to post-launch analysis, and keep the launch calendar.
* **Build the messaging framework.** Turn Raylu's capabilities into clear value propositions for each buyer (PE, growth equity, VC) and each persona, from partners to analysts.
* **Sales enablement.** Create demo narratives, decks, and one-pagers that hold up in competitive, technical conversations.
* **Track the competition.** Monitor AI-for-finance and deal-sourcing tools, and turn what you learn into sharper positioning and roadmap input.
* **Be the voice of the customer.** Interview customers and lost deals, and bring what you hear back to product, sales and marketing.
* **Create customer proof.** Produce case studies, ROI stories and customer quotes that show results like pipeline lift and more founder meetings.
* **Feed growth.** Give the Growth team the messaging, landing pages and assets that power SEO, paid social and campaigns.
* **Build with AI.** Use AI workflows for competitive research, content and enablement; this is how the whole team works.

**Your First 90 Days**
----------------------

* **Days 1–30:** Learn the product deeply, sit in on sales calls and talk to customers. Map the competitive landscape.
* **Days 31–60:** Ship a messaging framework by segment and persona, plus the first battle cards and an updated sales deck.
* **Days 61–90:** Run your first major launch end to end and publish at least two customer case studies.

**What We're Looking For**
==========================

* 5+ years in product marketing, ideally at a B2B SaaS company, with a track record of owning launches for technical products.
* Domain knowledge in finance: you understand how PE, growth and VC funds source and evaluate deals, and the language they use.
* A working understanding of LLMs and AI systems, enough to explain what our product does and why it's credible.
* Proven ability to turn complex capabilities into sharp value propositions for partners, deal teams and analysts.
* Sales enablement instincts: you have built demos and narratives that win competitive deals.
* Experience working closely with product, engineering and sales to shape roadmap-informed messaging.
* Clear, compelling writing, and the judgment to know what to cut.
* High agency, organized and comfortable with ambiguity; you'll build our product marketing playbook from scratch.

**Big Bonus Points**
--------------------

* Marketed to private equity, VC, investment banking or other financial buyers.
* Launched an AI or data product into a competitive market.
* Background in investing, banking or consulting before mov

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.desc:
Hygiena provides rapid microbiology diagnostic tests and solutions for mission-critical, time-sensitive processes around the world. Hygiena’s proprietary diagnostic technologies enable customers to prevent illness and save lives, comply with regulations, protect products and brands, run businesses more effectively. Solutions are sold in a wide range of industries globally, but the core focus is food safety. Headquartered in Camarillo, California and with offices around the world, we are actively looking for talented individuals to help grow the business!

At Hygiena we believe:

* In providing the highest quality products & service
* Being a leader in innovation
* Having a compelling desire to improve and win in the marketplace
* In contributing positively not only in the workplace, but in our community and environment!

With rapid growth comes opportunity. We are looking for a Product Manager (Platform) to join our team. This is a full-time, exempt, remote role, but preferably based in Southern California.

**About the Role:**

The Product Manager (Platform) is responsible for turning Hygiena's portfolio of software applications, including SureTrend, SureKleanz, SureDoc and SureLab, into one connected system that customers experience as a single product. This role owns the platform roadmap end to end: unified sign-in, cross-app navigation, shared data and combined reporting, in-app cross-sell between products, and the integrations that connect our applications to CRM, ERP and billing systems.

The Product Manager (Platform) pairs strong UI/UX judgment with a clear understanding of how accounts, data and systems fit together behind the scenes. Our applications were built separately, and this person will make them feel as if they were designed together. Working cross-functionally with Engineering, UX, the other product managers, Sales, Marketing, Finance and Customer Success, the Product Manager is measured on customer adoption, cross-app usage and cross-sell revenue, not on tickets shipped.

**Responsibilities:**

* Own and maintain the platform product roadmap and revenue objectives, prioritizing cross-app capabilities based on customer value, revenue impact, technical feasibility, and the needs of each product line.
* Define the unified customer experience across applications, including single sign-on, cross-app navigation, account and site switching, and shared settings, partnering with UX design to deliver experiences that are simple, consistent, and intuitive.
* Define the shared data model and integration requirements that let applications work together, including common customer, site, and user identities, roles and entitlements, and APIs and events, so that combined reporting and cross-app workflows are possible.
* Own in-app cross-sell between products end to end: identify moments of customer need, define prompts and offers with Marketing, route leads to account owners, and run experiments to improve conversion.
* Own integrations between the applications and Hygiena's commercial systems, including CRM, ERP (Microsoft Dynamics NAV), and billing (Stripe), so that Sales sees accurate customer and plan data and invoicing is timely and correct.
* Lead the phased separation of applications from shared legacy architecture into standalone products, planning migrations that avoid disruption to customers' daily workflows**.**
* Partner with Engineering in Azure DevOps for backlog refinement, sprint planning, and release coordination across platform workstreams.
* Collaborate with the other product managers to set cross-app standards and agree on shared roadmap priorities; communicate platform strategy to leadership and enable Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's Degree in Business Administration, Economics, Computer Science, Human-Computer Interaction, or a related field required. MBA or other advanced degree a plus.
* Minimum of 5 years of experience in product management for B2B SaaS sof

jobs.desc:
**About CodeHS**
----------------

CodeHS is a comprehensive platform helping K-12 schools teach computer science. We provide curriculum, professional development, and a full software platform. CodeHS is used by millions of students and thousands of schools and districts around the US and the world.

**Mission**
-----------

**The mission of CodeHS is to empower all students to meaningfully impact the future.** We believe that in the 21st century, coding is a foundational skill, just like reading and writing. That’s why we say: **Read, Write, Code.** Coding and computer science are essential skills for students to learn and schools to teach.

### **Location**

**Chicago — our River North office, five days a week.** Reports to Zach Galant, CTO & co-founder.

CodeHS is hybrid overall. We have people in other offices and people who work remotely, and you’ll work with them regularly. This role is in person because it depends on coming up to speed quickly — on the product, on our customers, and on how the engineering team works — and that happens faster sitting next to people. So does mentorship. We want someone who wants to work that way and is excited about getting to work in person in the office.

We’re hiring our first product manager to work inside the engineering team.

We have about fifteen engineers in small project teams that re-form each cycle, and we ship constantly. What limits our impact usually isn’t engineering capacity — it’s conviction about what to build, why, and how to communicate it to the rest of the team and our customers. We want someone who can get that conviction from teachers, districts, the market, our data, and our own team, and turn it into something engineering can act on.

This is not a people management role.

### **The role**

You own a product area end-to-end from concept to launch. Most likely a newer bet where we’re still working out the shape of it, though it could be an existing surface that needs more attention, or a few smaller ones. We’ll decide together once you’re here and have completed onboarding. Either way the goal is that you build up experience and domain expertise in that area and act like an owner.

You’ll sit with our engineering managers as a peer. You’ll run small teams of engineers with a focus area and are responsible for keeping them on track and ensuring that we build the right thing.

This is our first formal product role, so you have an opportunity to help shape what the product function can do and how it fits within engineering and the company more broadly.

### **How you work**

**You build.** When you have an idea, go make a version of it. Not production code — a working prototype you drove an AI coding agent to build. Engineers review and take it to completion.

**You write things down.** Specs, product briefs, the reasoning behind a decision. If it isn’t written down here, it doesn’t count.

**You talk to the people who use this.** Much of the work is strategy and synthesis. But when the answer is in a classroom or on a call with a district, you go. It isn’t a heavy travel role, but you will need to join calls, talk to people on the team and customers, and build an understanding beyond just reasoning through things on your own.

**You connect engineering to everyone else.** Sales, customer success, support, and curriculum all have product or tooling needs. Your job is to gather the information, synthesize it, and use that to inform what the right things are to build.

### **You should be**

**Comfortable being technical**, without necessarily having been an engineer. You can read a pull request and argue about a tradeoff without needing it translated. When an engineer raises an issue or blocker, you can ask a useful second question to move us back in the right direction.

The company is headquartered in Morrisville, North Carolina and Jeffersonville, Indiana. To learn more about Valeris, please visit www.valeris.com.

The Product Manager, Patient Access Product Innovation owns the product direction for Valeris’s next-generation patient access technology and leads the Product Owners who own its individual product areas. You decide what is built once and shared versus built for a specific area, and how requests are turned into configurable, scalable product, and you set the priorities that Product Owners execute. This role is both internally and externally facing: you represent the product to senior leadership and to current and prospective customers, including conducting product demonstrations.

This role sits on the Patient Access Product Innovation team and reports to the VP, Patient Access Innovation. You work two-in-a-box with an engineering lead, partner with Operations, implementation and cross-functional readiness teams, and represent product direction to senior leadership.

**Key Responsibilities:**

Product & Portfolio Strategy

* Own the product definition and vision for the shared platform and the portfolio of product areas built on it.
* Articulate the problems that users and buyers face, and the value of solving them, and use that to prioritize the work that delivers the highest value; bring requests from many customers and sources together into one configurable, scalable product.
* Maintain a capability record and answer requirement and pre-sale questions against it within committed turnaround and in accordance with the product roadmap: available today, planned next, or future consideration.
* Lead customer discovery and validation sessions to test assumptions and shape direction.

Prioritization & Roadmap

jobs.title: Technical Product Manager, Private Markets Integrations
jobs.desc:
**Role** **Context**

Altic is the rules-based operational network that enables private markets to operate within managed accounts at scale. It is the infrastructure layer that did not exist before. Not a platform, not a portal, not a workflow tool. The right historical reference is what NSCC and Omgeo did for equities: common standards, rules and infrastructure that allowed an entire asset class to operate at volume.

A network is only worth as much as it is connected. An alternatives trade touches a wealth platform, a trading or order management platform, a custodian, and a transfer agent or fund administrator. Today each of those connections is built bilaterally, differently, every time. That is why the industry runs at an 8 to 10 per cent not-in-good-order rate. Altic is targeting less than 0.01 per cent, and connectivity is where that is won or lost.

The connectivity itself is unglamorous and genuinely hard. Some counterparties expose modern REST APIs. Many still exchange fixed-width or delimited files over SFTP on a nightly cycle. Some sit behind decades-old platforms with a batch window and no appetite to change it. The job is not to wish that away. It is to design flows that work across all of it and still deliver a trade end to end, in good order, at volume.

**Purpose of the Role**

You will own how data moves into, through and out of the Altic network. That means consuming the interfaces our network participants already have, exposing the interfaces Altic offers back to them, and designing the flows in between so that the full lifecycle of an alternatives trade completes without manual intervention.

The counterparties in scope are wealth platforms, trading and order management platforms, custodians, and transfer agents and fund administrators. Each has a different technical reality and a different set of constraints. Your job is to build reusable connectivity rather than a series of one-off builds, so that the tenth integration of a given type is materially faster than the first.

You work against the network's rules and technical specification rather than inventing requirements from scratch. Where a rule cannot be implemented as written, you are the person who says so and works it back through.

**Key Stakeholders**

* Wealth platforms, trading and order management platforms
* Custodians, transfer agents and fund administrators
* GPs and asset managers participating in the network
* Altic Engineering and Architecture
* Altic Network Rules and Governance
* Altic Operations, Business Development and Partnerships

**Why This Role Is Different**

This role offers:

* The chance to connect network participant types that have never been connected for this asset class. There is no existing integration pattern for alternatives inside a managed account, because the flow did not exist.
* Ownership of an integration product, not an integration project. Success is a reusable interface that shortens every subsequent onboarding, rather than a delivered connection.
* Real technical heterogeneity to solve for. Modern APIs on one side, nightly flat files on the other, and a trade that has to complete across all of it.
* A specification that already exists. The rules and technical specification are being written alongside you, so you are building against something rather than guessing.
* A measurable target. Less than 0.01 per cent not-in-good-order is not a slogan, and connectivity design is most of how it gets hit.

The network is real to a network participant at exactly the point their systems connect to it. That point is yours.

This role is technical, external and detail-heavy. On any given week, you might be:

* Sitting with a custodian's technology team working out which of their existing feeds can carry an alternatives position, and what has to be built if none of them can.
* Mapping a transfer agent's file layout to the network data mod

jobs.desc:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  
  
  

You enjoy shaping the future of product innovation as a core leader, driving value for customers, guiding successful launches, and exceeding expectations. Join our dynamic team and make a meaningful impact by delivering high-quality products that resonate with clients.

  

As a Product Manager in Wholesale Lending Services you are an integral part of the team that innovates new product offerings and leads the end-to-end product life cycle. As a core leader, you are responsible for acting as the voice of the customer and developing profitable products that provide customer value. Utilizing your deep understanding of how to get a product off the ground, you guide the successful launch of products, gather crucial feedback, and ensure top-tier client experiences. With a strong commitment to scalability, resiliency, and stability, you collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality products that exceed customer expectations.

**Job responsibilities**

* Develops a product strategy and product vision that delivers value to customers
* Manages discovery efforts and market research to uncover customer solutions and integrate them into the product roadmap
* Owns, maintains, and develops a product backlog that enables development to support the overall strategic roadmap and value proposition
* Builds the framework and tracks the product's key success metrics such as cost, feature and functionality, risk posture, and reliability
* Make authoritative decisions on scope, requirements, assumptions, and delivery tradeoffs to maximize outcomes
* Define workflows, controls, and audit-ready traceability expectations within delivered solutions
* Partner with technology and governance stakeholders to align intent, constraints, and delivery approach
* Drive end-to-end integration thinking across platforms, vendors, and operational handoffs
* Own backlog refinement and readiness to enable releasable increments and predictable delivery
* Establish and monitor product metrics tied to quality, cycle time, and exception reduction
* Lead continuous improvement by reviewing performance, root causes, and control effectiveness

**Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills**

* 5+ years of experience or equivalent expertise in product management or a relevant domain area
* Advanced knowledge of the product development life cycle, design, and data analytics
* Proven ability to lead product life cycle activities including discovery, ideation, strategic development, requirements definition, and value management
* Proven ability to translate operational complexity into clear requirements and defensible priorities
* Strong decision-making and ability to communicate rationale aligned to outcomes, risk posture, and feasibility
* Prior experience owning a backlog and defining outcomes in a regulated or control-focused environment
* Ability to operate effectively at the intersection of delivery, governance, controls, and auditability
* Skilled in driving clarity through ambiguity and shaping problems into actionable work
* Ability to define acceptance criteria that withstand operational scrutiny and fit the operating model
* Experience working across multiple systems and teams in integration-heavy, end-to-end workflows
* Strong stakeholder management, serving as the single source of truth for business intent and outcomes

**Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills**

* Demonstrated prior experience working in a highly matrixed, complex organization
* Experience partnering with risk, compliance, audit, or control functions to design traceable and testable controls
* Experience building and using product metrics to reduce exceptions and operational friction
* Experience delivering modernization in systems of record and integration-heavy landscapes
* Familiarity with scaled Agile delivery practices and regulated delivery governance
* Domain exposure to insurance operations or lender insurance proces

This is a high-leverage moment to join. We grew revenue 7x last year, we're launching OpenArt Director (our new "vibe directing" category), and we're expanding into Brazil, India, and Europe. Growth done well over the next 12months is category-defining.

You'll work directly with the founders, a distributed engineering team, and our marketing and lifecycle leads.

**About OpenArt**

OpenArt is a leading AI Creative Platform for visual storytelling, used by millions worldwide. We're building the next generation of creative tools powered by cutting-edge AI, enabling anyone to create videos, images, visuals, characters, and stories with unprecedented speed and imagination. **About us:**

Jerry.ai is a Series C, YC-backed tech startup with 5M+ customers and $240M in funding. Founded in 2017, product launched in 2019, and achieved profitability in 2024.

**Why we exist:**

Your car, home, and motorcycle aren't just purchases, they're the physical embodiment of the life you've worked hard to build. Yet the experience of owning them is stuck in the 90s. Every step of the journey — buying, insuring, maintaining, repairing, selling — is fragmented, complicated, and expensive.

Imagine having a trusted friend in your pocket who takes care of everything: they find you the right car or home at the right price, lock in the best insurance rate without you lifting a finger, remind you before that service appointment turns into an expensive repair, and help you sell at the best price when the time is right. That friend is Jerry.

We are building the first AI-powered advisor to manage all your physical assets. We started with your car in 2019, now we’re expanding into new verticals (e.g. home, motorcycle, RV, boat).

**Why we’re hiring:**

Our next chapter is about accelerating growth – from 5M to 50M customers by 2030.

This year alone, we launched 5 new products – home insurance, property tax, motorcycle insurance, car repair shop bids, and roadside assistance. Each of these new businesses comes with its own operational complexity, distinct customer pain points, and its own path to scale.

As our business expands, we have a growing list of ideas but not enough people to execute them. This role exists to close that gap. We are looking for 2-3 Product Managers to work directly with, and be mentored by, our Cofounder/CEO (2x YC founder), and work on building or scaling one of our new product verticals.

Reporting directly to our CEO, you will have a unique opportunity to develop the craft of product building, learn how a serial founder/CEO thinks and makes decisions, and see/understand a late stage tech startup’s day-to-day challenges as it goes through a rapid growth phase. You will be exposed to nearly every function at the company (i.e., product, growth, operations, finance, engineering, data), learn how to execute big-picture strategies and navigate the intricacies of a complex business.

**Who we get excited about:**

* **Insatiable learner:** You are constantly seeking to deepen your knowledge, sharpen your skills, and master whatever craft or goal you’ve set your mind to.
* **Owner:** You act like your name is on the door. If something is broken, you feel responsible for fixing it, even if it’s outside of your swim lane.
* **Tenacious:** You are highly resilient. No challenge is too difficult, no issue unsolvable.
* **Sense of urgency:** You have a strong bias for action and are impatient when progress is stalled.

**What you bring:**

* Ideally 1+ years of experience in a demanding environment such as management consulting, investment banking, venture capital, private equity, an early startup environment, or similar
* Bachelor's degree in any discipline
* Ability to work in-person in our Palo Alto office alongside our CEO and executive team at least for the first 6-12 months

**Compensation:**

This position offers base salary and stock options. The base salary for this position within the San Francisco Bay Area is 130,000—160,000 USD, but we can be flexible based on your prior experience and appropriate job levelling. We also offer comprehensive benefits including health, dental, and vision coverage, paid time off, paid parental leave, 401(K) plan with 4% employer matching, and wellness benefits, among others.

This role requires being in our Palo Alto office five days a week, at least until you are capable of operating independently.

jobs.title: Product Manager, TalentPro
jobs.desc:
At ProService, our mission is to help Hawaii employers succeed, and hiring the right people is often the hardest part of that. TalentPro is our managed service for finding and keeping talent. It brings together recruiters, technology, and local expertise so Hawaii businesses can hire hourly workers quickly and keep them. We’re looking for a Product Manager who will own the whole TalentPro experience for clients, candidates, and recruiters, and who wants to build the improvements themselves.

The role sits between product and service. TalentPro isn’t pure software and it isn’t a traditional staffing operation. It runs on an ATS and a payroll platform that you’ll integrate around rather than rebuild. Your candidates apply from their phones and talk to us by text, so one awkward step can cost us hundreds of applicants. Success looks like this: a new client goes live in under an hour, more hires come from our own candidate pool every quarter, and clients see their pipeline in real time without having to ask. When that happens, you’ll know you’ve built something people rely on.

**IN THIS ROLE YOU WILL**

* Own the end-to-end product experience for TalentPro, turning input from clients, recruiters, and candidates into one prioritized backlog
* Build and ship workflows, automations, and integrations yourself using no-code tools, APIs, and lightweight scripting, and bring in engineering help only when it’s truly needed
* Improve conversion across the mobile and SMS candidate funnel, from application completion through interview scheduling and show rates
* Map and re-engineer how data moves between the ATS and payroll platforms so client setup feels like one click and onboarding is error-free
* Build the data pipelines, dashboards, and monitoring that track operational and financial health and catch issues before a client or candidate does
* Manage relationships with our ATS partner and internal payroll platform team, pushing for changes and knowing when a workaround will get there faster

**IS THIS ROLE RIGHT FOR YOU?**

This is a builder’s role in an early-stage business. There’s no playbook and no dedicated engineering team waiting for your specs. You’ll decide what matters most, build it, test it with a live client or recruiter, and then make it standard. You’ll have close partners in our Customer Delivery Manager and Recruiting Lead, who stay close to clients and candidates every day, and leadership that wants you to move fast. Hands-on building and owning the outcome are not optional — they’re the job.

You’ll also need to love the details. Every text a candidate gets and every click a client makes is something you’ll want to improve, because small friction adds up quickly in a high-touch service. If you’d rather write requirements than build, or need a clearly defined roadmap before you can start, this role will be frustrating. If you find it energizing to turn a messy manual process into something clean that runs itself, you’ll do well here.

**WHAT YOU’LL BRING TO THE TEAM**

You’ve owned a product experience from end to end and have built real tools yourself with no-code or low-code platforms, APIs, or scripting. You know how to get value out of third-party software you don’t fully control. You’ve turned input from customer-facing and operations teams into a prioritized list and shipped against it. You’ve measurably improved a high-volume conversion funnel and have helped shape how a product is packaged and priced. Experience in HR tech is a plus. Above all, you bring deep customer obsession, sharp analytical skills, sound judgment, and the independence to drive work forward with minimal oversight.

SpyCloud is on a mission to make the internet a safer place by disrupting the criminal underground. SpyCloud's solutions thwart cyberattacks and protect more than 4 billion accounts worldwide. Cybersecurity is an exciting, evolving space, and being at the forefront of the fight to disrupt cybercrime makes SpyCloud a special place to work. If you're driven to align your career with a fantastic mission, look no further!

As the Product Manager, Investigations, you will own the delivery of key capabilities in SpyCloud's Investigations product line. Security teams, fraud analysts, investigators, and threat intelligence professionals use Investigations to uncover, understand, and act on cybercriminal activity using SpyCloud's recaptured darknet data. Reporting to the Director of Product, Enterprise & Investigations, and working closely with the Principal Product Manager, Investigations, you will turn product strategy into shipped capabilities that customers rely on.

This is a hands-on, highly cross-functional role. You will work daily with Engineering, Design, and Data Science, and partner with SpyCloud Labs, Threat Intelligence, Customer Success, and Go-to-Market teams. The Investigations roadmap is ambitious, and you will own a meaningful share of it, from discovery through launch and adoption.

As an AI-forward company, SpyCloud expects you to build AI into the product and into how you work, using it to gather, organize, prioritize, and define requirements.

**What You'll Do:**

* Manage backlog and delivery for assigned Investigations capabilities, in line with the portfolio strategy set by the Principal PM and Director.
* Ship AI, machine learning, and automation features that cut manual effort out of investigative workflows, working with Data Science from problem framing through model evaluation and launch.
* Develop a working understanding of how customers investigate: the data they pivot on, the questions they need answered, and where their workflows break down.
* Run discovery for your areas through customer interviews, usability testing, and competitive analysis, and turn findings into clear requirements, epics, and user stories.

* Represent your product areas in customer and prospect conversations, and serve as the go-to product expert for internal teams.

* Keep your features consistent across the Investigations UI and programmatic interfaces (API, MCP, A2A), in partnership with the Principal PM, who owns portfolio cohesion.
* Track developments in AI, threat intelligence, fraud, identity, and digital investigations, and bring relevant opportunities back to the team.
